notes.title: Ambassador Spotlight: Ninuschk
notes.content:
Continuing our series introducing the Abyssal Depths [url=https://albiononline.com/news/abyssal-depths-ambassadors][b]AOCP Ambassadors[/b][/url], [b]AlbionTV[/b] welcomes [b]Ninuschk[/b] to the spotlight! Tune in to [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url] this [b]Friday, September[/b] [b]19 [/b]at [b]20:00 UTC[/b] to meet the healer who proves that saving lives can be just as chaotic and entertaining as taking them.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/508abbee334ec1d4ea5e65eab124a53b242a702d.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Ninuschk[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ninuschkAO][b]youtube.com/@ninuschkAO[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ninuschk/][b]twitch.tv/ninuschk[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Healer / PvP[/b][/*][/list]This week’s spotlight shines on [b]Ninuschk[/b], a techno DJ turned healer main who brings expert support play and good energy to the battlefield. Based in Germany and streaming in English, German, and Russian, her content is as unique as it is helpful. Each Youtube video kicks off with a pup dancing to hardcore techno, a chaotic intro that contrasts delightfully with her calm, thoughtful breakdowns of healing strategy.

[previewyoutube=gLdj2I7P5tQ;full][/previewyoutube]
A proud healer through and through, Nina has built a full guide series around mastering this often-overlooked and underestimated role. From leveling solo to supporting in full ZvZs, she covers all your healing concerns with clarity and precision. If you ever thought that healing was “just pressing a button,” she’ll kindly show you what actually goes into keeping a reckless DPS alive in a fight they probably weren’t prepared for.

[previewyoutube=nnEOUDqWXek;full][/previewyoutube]
On stream, Nina keeps things focused and chill. Whether she’s duoing in the Depths or supporting a full group, she carries the same steady presence, even when everything else is on fire. And in a world where healers only get noticed when something goes wrong, she proves that staying calm and keeping your team alive under pressure is an art form all of its own.

[previewyoutube=ZMWXwmMmpPk;full][/previewyoutube]
Now, as an AOCP Ambassador, she’s raising the banner for support players everywhere. If you’ve ever wanted to try healing yourself, or just want to be a better ally to your resident healer, Ninuschk’s here to help. Tune in to [b]AlbionTV[/b] this [b]Friday[/b] to see her live, learn from the best, and win a [b]vanity bundle[/b] of her choosing.

notes.title: Upcoming Changes to Referral Seasons
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1bfdee615565758e254bb4806e14a097c2084c3d.jpeg[/img]

With the next Referral Season, we’re making a change to the way referrals work in Albion Online. From [b]October 1, 2025[/b], only Premium time purchased with real money from the [url=https://albiononline.com/shop/subscriptions][b]Albion Online Web Shop[/b][/url] or [b]ingame store[/b] will count towards referral rewards (30 days of Premium or more). This means that Premium purchased with Gold or Silver will no longer earn rewards for the referrer. In making this change, our aim is to encourage organic referrals, while we also hope to see a downward effect on Gold prices as a result of this and will be observing developments there.

If you have any questions or feedback about these changes, you can visit this [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/216263][b]dedicated forum thread[/b][/url]. For more on Referral Seasons, and to find your referral link, see [url=https://albiononline.com/profile/referral/overview][b]this page[/b][/url] (login required).

notes.title: Behind the Banner: Griffin Empire
notes.content:
[b]Behind the Banner[/b] is a series that shines a light on Albion's many diverse guilds, from fierce PvP warbands to tight-knit social communities. Each episode delves into the identity, playstyle, and goals of a different guild, offering a glimpse into what life is really like behind the banner.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a4b1b170ab849290181ed113e410ec4c8bd287a5.png[/img]

[list]	[*][b]Guild Name[/b]: Griffin Empire[/*]	[*][b]Alliance[/b]: JIN[/*]	[*][b]Guild Leader[/b]:  Hieuquoc[/*]	[*][b]Date Founded[/b]: September 2021[/*]	[*][b]Size[/b]: 280~300 members[/*]	[*][b]Primary Language[/b]: Vietnamese and English[/*]	[*][b]Server[/b]: Albion Asia[/*]	[*][b]Discord[/b]: [url=https://discord.gg/seedervn][b]discord.gg/seedervn[/b][/url][/*][/list][b]Tell us about your guild. [/b]

Griffin Empire was founded on Albion Americas before moving to Albion Asia. Our journey started out rough. At first, we were just renters, and after being kicked out, we wandered from place to place before finally settling in Lymhurst thanks to the help of a few friends. Even then, things weren’t easy: our member count was small, and our skills at the time weren’t great. Everything changed after a few clashes with [i]Endernation[/i], a guild that pioneered the brawl meta. We realized that this playstyle worked well for both newcomers and veterans, so we started learning from [i]Endernation[/i] and refining the strategy for larger-scale fights. Today, Griffin Empire is widely recognized as one of the strongest guilds when it comes to brawls in the open world.

[b]Why did you choose this name? Is there a story or meaning behind it?[/b]

The name “Griffin Empire” was chosen because the griffin symbolizes strength, loyalty, and resilience. It’s both mythical and representative of our collective spirit: always protecting comrades and ready to fight until the end.

[b]What sort of activities do you focus on?[/b]

ZvZ has always been our core content, from small and mid-sized skirmishes to massive battles. What’s the point of stacking Silver forever if you’re not going to spend it on real fights?

[b]What sort of members are you looking for?[/b]

Whether you’re a fresh newbie or a seasoned veteran, you’ll always have a place in Griffin Empire. What we look for are active and engaged players, that is, people willing to communicate, share experiences and struggles, and grow together with the guild.

[previewyoutube=pFSpvvHXQAk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Where is your guild primarily located?[/b]

We are currently based in Martlock because our alliance, JIN, is stationed here. Razorrock Verge offers great advantages, giving us easy access to plenty of high-value targets nearby.

[b]Do you have any rivalries or ongoing quarrels with other guilds?[/b]

As one of the strongest Vietnamese guilds in Albion, we’ve made quite a few enemies. One of the most notable rivals has been [i]VUA[/i] (now known as [i]Wata[/i]). We actually started out as friends, but after a few “small incidents” we caused, things turned sour and we’ve been enemies ever since. They used to be strong enough to drive us out of our territory… but in our most recent castle fight, we wiped them in under two minutes. On the flip side, we’ve also had allies. Back in the early days, smaller guilds like [i]BlackPearl[/i] and [i]Maldito[/i] supported us when we needed it most. Nowadays, our strongest ally is definitely [i]CCTV[/i]. What began as friendly scrims eventually turned into a solid partnership, and we’ve been fighting side by side ever since.

[b]What are some of your most memorable battles or activities?[/b]

Two stand out the most. The first was a small-scale fight against [i]PLAC[/i] at Runnelvein Bog. All we wanted was some PvP content, but it was misunderstood as an attempt to steal an objective from [i]FckCall[/i]. That clash was the first time we truly realized how powerful the full-brawl playstyle could be.

[previewyoutube=_IXAOYZxi8Y;full][/previewyoutube]
The second was a series of battles against [i]One Gin[/i], [i]Tuk Tuk[/i], and [i]CCTV[/i]. This was Griffin Empire’s very first taste of large-scale ZvZ. We won some, we lost some, but those fights put GE on the map and made us much better-known in the community.

[previewyoutube=TEdZtWilgZA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What does your guild do for fun?[/b]

When we’re not clashing in Albion, we’re active in the Seeders Community Discord. Our members play other games, share tech and gaming discussions, or just hang out and laugh together. Because our guild is part of this larger community, there’s always something happening: casual events, mini-games, or simply building friendships that go beyond Albion.

[b]What is your guild's approach to the game? Do you have any core values or beliefs that guide how you play together?[/b]

We focus heavily on training newbies, giving them early access to the Outlands so they can experience what we believe is Albion’s most exciting content. Many of our core players actually came up through this path. Our playstyle isn’t overly complicated, but it’s effective. As long as you’re motivated, there will always be content waiting for you.

[b]What are your goals for the future?[/b]

Griffin Empire is striving for the highest possible Crystal rank, but just as important is how we achieve it. We’re committed to remaining a friendly and welcoming guild for both newcomers and veterans, offering a place where everyone can take part in battles of every scale.

[b]Anything else to share about your guild?[/b]

Some say brawling is brain-dead, some say we’re zombies. But the truth is, they lost to these zombies – and not just once!

[i]Want your guild to be featured next? Click [/i][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScUfId1Qq6FdglFsmR7034U6EXHfA1xtZ7CO3tMDnF0hxmSSQ/viewform][b][i]here[/i][/b][/url][i] to apply.[/i]

notes.title: Guide: Corrupted Dungeons
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8d6686b9790ba692156cc798ee7365c2a7c68e02.jpeg[/img]

[b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b] offer a unique experience in Albion Online. As one player fights their way through hallways of demonic enemies to face off against a final boss, other players try to invade, hoping to emerge triumphant in a one-on-one encounter and make off with valuable loot. Invaded players are presented with a choice of how to banish their foe: destroying Demonic Shards in the dungeon, or facing off in a deadly duel.

Coming in three difficulty levels – Hunter, Stalker, and Slayer – they’re equally appealing to new players learning the ropes of combat, and fearless veterans on the hunt for loot. So if you haven’t tried out a Corrupted Dungeon yet, check out our guide to learn all about them, and then dive in to experience the challenge:

[url=https://albiononline.com/guides/article/corrupted-dungeons+116]LEARN MORE[/url]

[h3]DocPlayz[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@DocPlayzTV][b]youtube.com/@DocPlayzTV[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Discord: [/b][url=https://discord.com/invite/M8QNhQQreE][b]discord.com/invite/M8QNhQQreE[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Solo PvP[/b][/*][/list][b]What is the main content you create on Twitch/YouTube?[/b]

notes.title: Creator Spotlight: Nangoroth
notes.content:
[b]Creator Spotlight[/b] is a series where we shine a light on Albion Online’s dedicated [b]Content Creators[/b] by sharing their stories, unique perspectives, and favorite moments. Get to know them and, if you’re intrigued, follow their channels for more!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8c9a5c4a7d56685f35462b529d0918839a68fb7b.png[/img]

[h3]Nangoroth[/h3][list]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nangoroth][b]twitch.tv/nangoroth[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@nangorothtv][b]youtube.com/@Nangorothtv[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]PvP / ZvZ / Community Growth[/b][/*][/list][b]What is the main content you create on Twitch/YouTube?[/b]

I love discovering the many ways to experience Albion, with a strong emphasis on PvP, ranging from intense 1v1 duels to coordinated ZvZ battles. I enjoy playing many roles, whether that’s supporting as a healer, shielding the good guys as a rootbound, holding the bad guys off as a tank, or dishing out damage when needed. For me, it’s about constantly learning, improving, and growing alongside friends. One of my favorite parts of streaming is sharing that journey with Twitch chat – teaching, learning, and supporting each other – because I truly believe we’re all stronger when we grow together.

[previewyoutube=Yi_tGYE7izI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]How and when did you get into creating Albion Online content?[/b]

I used to stream League of Legends years ago, but for a long time I didn’t find another game that inspired me to create, so I took a long break from Twitch. Then I discovered Albion last fall and immediately fell in love with its mix of challenge, freedom, and community. As I played more, I realized I wanted to share that experience with my old Twitch community and meet new people who felt the same way.

[previewyoutube=AI0QbdzbbMo;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Do you have a favorite video of yours that you think everyone should have seen? Let us know why it's special![/b]

My most recent video really feels like “me” as a creator. It’s a Corrupted Dungeon run using an off-meta 1h Nature Staff build – not to heal, but to brawl. It’s fast clears, intense PvP, and a little chaos all rolled into one. I love it because it shows what I enjoy most about Albion: trying new things, having fun, and proving you don’t need to stick to popular builds to have exciting, rewarding experiences.

[previewyoutube=YqbKl3T2Eac;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Do you have any new content in the making that you would like to tease?[/b]

I’m working on more short-form videos that capture my favorite moments from streams: incredible loot, clutch small-scale plays, or even laughing at my own instant defeats. They’ll be quick, fun bursts of both the exciting and lighthearted sides of Albion.

[b]What advice would you give other players who are considering becoming Albion Online content creators?[/b]

The best advice I can give is to truly be yourself. Albion has such a warm, welcoming community, and when you share the kind of content you genuinely enjoy, people connect with that. Don’t worry about being perfect, focus on having fun, learning, and letting your personality shine. Streaming Albion has been one of the most rewarding experiences I’ve ever had, and I love seeing new creators join in and share their own journeys.

notes.title: Season 28 Wrapup
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9cab01da4d1892958a1898affaa3c21d29612e4a.png[/img]

As the dust settles on [b]Season 28[/b], it’s clear this two-month campaign brought everything Albion’s [b]Guild Seasons[/b] are known for: commanding performances, sudden surges, long-fought wars, and some unexpected shakeups. Let’s recap:

[h3]Albion Asia[/h3]
Season 28 saw the continued rise of the [i]CTP Alliance[/i], with [i]Sunset[/i] leading the charge. After promising to take the crown, they delivered with precision, steadily climbing to over 850,000 Season Points and securing the win well before the final battles. Their coalition partner [i]Peony Flower[/i] also lived up to their word, holding second place and fending off all challengers. It was a show of force and coordination that left little doubt about who ruled the Outlands this season. But while the top two were mostly uncontested, the fight for third place provided its own drama. [i]Agila[/i] and [i]Griffin Empire[/i] entered the final Invasion Day nearly neck-and-neck, separated by only a few thousand points. In the end, [i]Agila[/i] held firm and locked in the bronze position

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b66b6e26aefbea9447fa5026599c9e9be44be631.png[/img]

The race for third place has ignited regional interest, with both emerging guilds now considered strong contenders for the upcoming season. Meanwhile, other alliances are already strategizing for Season 29, leading to heightened tensions. With several factions openly declaring their goals, the stage is set for another compelling season.

[h3][/url]Albion Europe[/h3]
What began as a three-way standoff on Albion Europe ended in a clean sweep. The [i]GRRR Alliance[/i], composed of [i]Woof Woof[/i], [i]Skoggangr[/i], and [i]O M B R A[/i], methodically dismantled their opposition to claim the top three spots on the leaderboard. [i]Woof Woof[/i] led the charge with dominant territory control and strong participation, locking in the win. [i]Skoggangr[/i] followed in second, while [i]O M B R A[/i] surged late in the season to push [i]Heralds of Valhalla[/i] out of third place. [i]GRRR[/i]’s momentum began early. After forcing the [i]Worldwide [/i]and the [i]GLOBE[/i] Alliance to disband during the first month, they shifted focus to [i]GIRTH[/i], weathering their raids and denying them any meaningful gains. Despite some strong pushes from [i]Heralds of Valhalla[/i], a major breakthrough never came, and the final weeks saw [i]GRRR[/i] tighten their grip on the Outlands.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5cfac58fee04928d24e1fadd2aee639432b826fe.png[/img]

Now, the question on everyone's mind is whether this dominance can be challenged. With [i]GLOBE[/i] gone and [i]GIRTH[/i] on the back foot, other alliances may rise to fill the void, or perhaps former rivals will regroup for a counteroffensive. Either way, the pressure is on for Albion Europe’s guilds to answer [i]GRRR[/i]’s challenge in Season 29.

[h3]Albion Americas[/h3]
From start to finish, this season on Albion Americas was all about [i]PIVAS[/i]. After declaring their intention to take the top spot, they wasted no time locking down key territories and racking up points. Their lead never wavered, even as rumors of returning heavyweights like [i]IFures[/i] and [i]FAX[/i] began to stir mid-season. Those whispers never materialized into a real threat, and PIVAS stormed ahead to secure their second Guild Season crown. [i]Upside[/i] maintained a respectable second-place finish, keeping pace through steady participation and solid territory holds. But the real suspense came in the race for third. [i]INTERDITS[/i] and [i]Make Albion Great Again[/i] were locked in a close contest, trading places on the leaderboard in the final weeks. Ultimately, [i]INTERDITS[/i] edged ahead on the last Invasion Day, holding onto vital zones to secure their place on the podium.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2cc7804169bd43fb1d1acf839ea7a45e0f755517.png[/img]

Despite the dominance at the top, the season was anything but calm. Strategic plays, zone flips, and lingering rivalries kept tension high throughout. With new guilds gaining confidence and former powers hinting at a return, Season 29 could see a major shift – especially if the sleeping giants awaken this time.

With Season 28 concluded, congratulations go out to [b]PIVAS[/b], [b]Sunset[/b], and [b]Woof Woof [/b]for taking first place on each server. But every season reshapes the balance of power, and with fresh ambitions rising and old scores still unsettled, [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-29-coming][b]Season 29[/b][/url] promises another exciting chapter in Albion’s ever-evolving guild warfare.

Check out the full [b]Season 29 [/b][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/215596-Season-29-Schedules/][b]schedule[/b][/url], and don’t forget to tune in to [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] for live coverage as the new season unfolds. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Changelog: Abyssal Depths Patch 5
notes.content:
[h3]Economic Adjustments[/h3]

[quote][i]In response to the recent Gold Market price increases, we are making several economic adjustments to bring the market back in line.[/i]

[i]While we are primarily targeting rewards that are generated [b]in addition[/b] to normal gameplay (e.g. Albion Journal Rewards), it’s also necessary that we make some targeted adjustments to gameplay rewards if we hope to have a substantial effect on the Gold Market. These changes are all only slight decreases, as we hope to make gradual changes over time rather than introducing too many changes all at once.[/i]

[i]We will continue to monitor all of these changes closely, as well as the impact they have on the accessibility of Premium for Silver.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Many Albion Journal missions that award Silver have had their rewards changed[/*]	[*]Roaming Mobs now take slightly longer to charge up into more powerful mobs	[list]		[*]We will be monitoring this change closely to see how this impacts gameplay, but we expect the change to be minimal as it’s only a 10% change to the upgrade frequency[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Loot Region Modifier for high-quality Black Zones now increases by +20% instead of +30% from Quality 4 to Quality 6	[list]		[*]This makes the increase purely linear, as is already the case with the Silver bonuses from the same Region Modifier[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The chance that loot is generated for a Territory Activity Chest from activity in local and neighboring regions has been slightly decreased	[list]		[*]This chance now increases by ~1.25% per level rather than 1.5% per level[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The price of Conqueror’s Chests has been increased from 5,500 Favor to 6,750 Favor	[list]		[*]The influx of Silver from Favor has steadily increased over time as Favor has become more readily available – this aims to restore the influx to values seen prior to the Rogue Frontier update[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Chests in Avalonian Dungeons have had their loot decreased by 10%[/*]	[*]Small, Medium, and Large Treasures now spawn 10% less frequently[/*]	[*]While we’re happy with the experience of finding a Boss Lair Map, the influx of Silver from Boss Lairs is significant. Rather than reducing the value of Boss Lairs, Lair Maps instead spawn 25% less frequently[/*]	[*]Hardcore Expeditions remain too competitive for their non-lethal nature, and have had their loot bonuses decreased by 10%[/*]	[*]While the Depths is minimally impactful to the overall economy, very successful players are still able to draw competitive loot. To prevent the feature from competing with higher-risk lethal features, the following changes have been made:	[list]		[*]Chests at the Altar of Greed in The Depths have had their loot output decreased by ~9.1%[/*]		[*]The following chests within The Depths now yield ~25% less loot when looted by solo players:		[list]			[*]The reward chest at the end of a room[/*]			[*]The chests at the Altar of Greed[/*]			[*]Miniboss and Boss chests[/*]			[*]The keyed Treasure Vaults on Level 3[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]While we like that The Depths offers an avenue for the advancement of the Conqueror’s Challenge, we feel the income is too competitive with Lethal activities as player kills occur more frequently than expected – as a result the Might generated by player kills and Soul deliveries has been reduce[/*]	[*]We will continue to monitor the Depths and make incremental changes if necessary. Our goal is to make certain they feel rewarding while preserving the balance between non-Lethal, partially Lethal, and fully Lethal activities[/*][/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Crystal Offhand Artifacts can now be crafted from Crystal Shards[/*]	[*]Adjusted Mists instance management to improve upon the changes previously made in Patch 4[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Freezing Wind (Frost Staffs): Fixed issue where enemies could be rooted after less than one second inside the area[/*]	[*]Blood Ritual (Demonfang): Now correctly deals 20% of the caster’s max health as true damage to the caster after the 3rd cast[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where the entrance UI to the Depths would not show[/*][/list]

notes.title: Behind the Banner: Catgdom
notes.content:
[b]Behind the Banner[/b] is a series that shines a light on Albion's many diverse guilds, from fierce PvP warbands to tight-knit social communities. Each episode delves into the identity, playstyle, and goals of a different guild, offering a glimpse into what life is really like behind the banner.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8987a6e21552d622a187e8e33134c1e350070af6.png[/img]

[list]	[*][b]Guild Name[/b]: Catgdom[/*]	[*][b]Guild Leader[/b]:  Kolt500 and my warlords Chaossik and Ranvy[/*]	[*][b]Date Founded[/b]: April 2024[/*]	[*][b]Size[/b]: ~200 members[/*]	[*][b]Primary Language[/b]: Czech/Slovak and English[/*]	[*][b]Server[/b]: Albion Europe[/*]	[*][b]Discord[/b]: [url=https://discord.gg/hYvd5ADpwT][b]discord.gg/hYvd5ADpwT  [/b][/url][/*][/list][b]Tell us about your guild. [/b]

I hated how divided the Czech/Slovak Albion community was. There was so much hate between every CZ/SK guild. That’s why I wanted to create a community that would stay neutral, and I think it worked really well. Our community feels very friendly.

Today, we’re known for being the biggest Czech/Slovak guild on Albion Europe. We are non-mandatory and offer nearly all of Albion’s activities! And although we have many members now, we still try to focus on each individual and support one another. Catgdom’s DNA is built on a healthy approach to the game: mandatory CTAs are not a requirement to achieve great things.

[b]Why did you choose this name? Is there a story or meaning behind it?[/b]

Back when there was only one server, I invited my ex-girlfriend (Mion) to play Albion with me. She loves cats, so I came up with the idea: Kingdom + Cats = Catgdom. Fun fact: we’re not a couple anymore, but we’re still playing Albion together… in Catgdom.

[previewyoutube=7EOxyxIesls;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What sort of activities do you focus on?[/b]

We focus on a broad mix of content: 10- and 20-man Avalonian Dungeons, daily Static Dungeons, and World Bosses. Small-scale fights happen three to five times a day, while at 18 UTC we often gather 30 to 40 players for mid-scale content. On top of that, we put strong emphasis on economy, with crafting and refining supported by a boosted Hideout and stations in every city.

[b]What sort of members are you looking for?[/b]

We are mainly looking for Czech and Slovak players, though we also have a small group of English-speaking players. Our one rule is simple: don’t be overly toxic toward your fellow guild members or other players. Newbies are just as welcome as seasoned veterans. The only requirement is active participation and a willingness to progress, learn, and improve. Everything else will come with time.

[b]Where is your guild primarily located?[/b]

Our home is Floatshoal Bight. It’s an awesome map that offers excellent crafting bonuses for our regear system and is close to the Portal, making it easy for players to transport everything to and from the Hideout.

[previewyoutube=CTwuhivB_Ys;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Do you have any rivalries or ongoing quarrels with other guilds?[/b]

Our main rivalry was with another Czech guild, which I won’t name because things have finally cooled down. Their guild master had a reputation for being toxic within the community and even tried to lure some of our members away. Eventually, we had a straightforward talk between guild masters and agreed to put an end to it.

[b]What are some of your most memorable battles or activities?[/b]

Our most memorable battle was against that rival guild. We were heavily outnumbered and had almost no chance of winning, but somehow we managed to pull off an 18 vs 33 victory. Since that day, we have earned their respect.

[b]What does your guild do for fun?[/b]

We enjoy plenty of activities outside Albion. Many of our members like to play other games such as Goose Goose Duck. The guild also organizes real-life meetups from time to time. There will always be someone hanging out in a Discord call, ready to play together or just chat. As a guild master, that’s incredibly rewarding. Seeing the guild stay connected and active even outside Albion is exactly what I always wanted!

[previewyoutube=fNtuzHUKj30;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What is your guild's approach to the game? Do you have any core values or beliefs that guide how you play together?[/b]

We focus on keeping CTAs non-mandatory, while still giving both newbies and veterans a friendly, supportive environment where they feel accepted.

[b]What are your goals for the future?[/b]

Our main goal is to conquer the Floatshoal Bight territory, as that’s where our home is located in the Outlands. Another priority is to secure a high-quality Hideout so our crafters can produce at higher profits.

[b]Anything else to share about your guild?[/b]

Tulaghon is [i]zahradník[/i] [gardener]. Kolt500 is bad at gathering. Monkey brawl always works. Chaossik is new to the game. Arrachnid is back in the game and has no depression. BPKJ is a young, experienced shotcaller with big potential. Wrek is a bomber.

[i]Want your guild to be featured next? Click [/i][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScUfId1Qq6FdglFsmR7034U6EXHfA1xtZ7CO3tMDnF0hxmSSQ/viewform][b][i]here[/i][/b][/url][i] to apply.[/i]

notes.title: Light the Fuse of Chaos in the Heretic Challenge
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8c20f10df6bae400c24345396b61f40c2c95777d.jpeg[/img]

This month’s [b]Adventurer’s Challenge[/b] is stacked with Heretic-themed rewards, straight from the minds of Albion’s most explosive faction. Among them is their most unhinged creation yet: the [b]Heretic Combat Mule[/b]. Earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] through open-world mayhem to unlock this barely functional combat beast, bolted with creaky wooden cannons and fueled by pure madness. Crack open chests stuffed with volatile surprises, and ride like you're one loose screw away from glory. But hurry! That makeshift cannon doesn't look very stable...

[h3]Mighty Mules and Heretic Decor[/h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3a6bf05566265ce250cb8b7b0f6c63d000c0c515.png[/img]
[b]HERETIC COMBAT MULE:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the [b]Heretic Combat Mule[/b], a war machine from the twisted minds of Heretic saddlers. The Combat Mule fires a powerful cannon shot that knocks back and slows targets, but watch out for its massive recoil!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/12fd582ccdfc7ca27aac7734ff0a698ab5718a81.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Heretic Challenge Avatar Ring[/b]. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this crazed, ramshackle avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f0163d6a973a0ac3179a1159c5b1b49ff25b2356.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock Heretic Challenge Chests. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, and resources, you'll also have a chance to unlock special furniture items like the [b]Heretic Lantern, Heretic Junkpile [/b]and [b]Heretic Scarecrow[/b].

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/66c86d0c98bee_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to participate in the Adventurer's Challenge[/h3]
The [b]Adventurer's Challenge[/b] is a monthly event where you can earn [b]exclusive rewards[/b] such as mounts, Tomes of Insight, bags of Silver, and more. By [b]gathering, fishing, farming, [/b]and[b] defeating monsters, [/b]you'll earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] that fill daily, weekly, and monthly progress bars. To track your progress, open the Adventurer's Challenge UI by clicking on the [b]Activities menu[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bbe632b8c242dd9526c11b8d54741acce88fee5a.png[/img]

While only [b]Premium[/b] players can unlock the [b]Monthly Rewards [/b](Avatar Ring, Mount) and [b]Weekly Rewards[/b] (Challenge Chests), anyone can claim the [b]Daily Rewards[/b], which include 10 Learning Points and a Tier 4 Tome of Insight. Non-Premium players also make progress on all reward tracks, so when you’re ready to unlock Premium, your earned rewards will be waiting for you!

notes.title: Ambassador Spotlight: Megz
notes.content:
[b]AlbionTV[/b] continues its interview series bringing the spotlight to the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/abyssal-depths-ambassadors][b]AOCP Ambassadors[/b][/url] introduced with the Abyssal Depths update. This week, the spotlight is on [b]Megz[/b]. Tune in to [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url] this [b]Friday, August 29[/b] at [b]20:00 UTC [/b]for a live interview with one of Albion’s most community-driven and warmhearted streamers.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2be6ebc0742da4a730338a9a448bc063aed74fb6.png[/img]

[h3]Megz[/h3][list]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/megz][b]twitch.tv/megz[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Discord: [/b][url=http://discord.gg/UN5aXmpEdd][b]discord.gg/UN5aXmpEdd[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Community / Long-stream content[/b][/*][/list]Megz never planned to be a streamer, let alone an AOCP Ambassador. In fact, she says she hated the game at first. But when her husband, fellow Ambassador Nazori, asked her to help edit his videos, she gave Albion another chance, and this time it stuck. What began as a reluctant favor quickly became her passion, and today she’s one of the game’s most wholesome voices.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4ea14afd4e8688266bf66aacc5f8322cb552a690.png[/img]

Unlike many creators, Meggy doesn’t run a Youtube channel. Her content isn’t about flashy highlight reels or clutch plays, it’s about being present with her community. Every stream is centered on spending time together, sharing laughs, trading sassy jokes, and building connections. And if that’s not enough, her Twitch bot dishes out questionable Albion-themed pick-up lines to keep everyone on their toes.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/53653410659376d721c2e61590c07ca6d704ef7c.png[/img]

Outside of the game, Megz is a mum of four and often channels that same “mama bear” energy into Albion. She runs an active guild, guiding her “guild babies” with patience and humor. Under her leadership, they’ve reached back-to-back Gold rankings – not bad for someone who calls herself “below average skill-wise”. She also organizes the long-running 20v20 Extravaganza on AlbionTV, now thriving across both Albion Americas and Europe.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c27d10b28005991749f3cb833a6212436905232d.png[/img]

As an Ambassador, Megz fosters a more welcoming environment in Albion: drawing in new players, creating community, and proving you don’t need to be top tier to make a difference. So if you’re after content that’s equal parts wholesome, chaotic, and hilarious, Megz is the one to watch. Catch her live interview this [b]Friday[/b] at [b]20:00 UTC[/b] for more laughs, a shot at winning the [b]Priest[/b] [b]vanity bundle[/b], and perhaps the chance to learn a pick-up line or two.

notes.title: Behind the Banner: Graymane
notes.content:
[b]Behind the Banner[/b] is a series that shines a light on Albion's many diverse guilds, from fierce PvP warbands to tight-knit social communities. Each episode delves into the identity, playstyle, and goals of a different guild, offering a glimpse into what life is really like behind the banner.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d7793bb603ecae405733d3f7335e05a9d4675f82.png[/img]

[list]	[*][b]Guild Name[/b]: Graymane[/*]	[*][b]Alliance[/b]: US Border Patrol[/*]	[*][b]Guild Leader[/b]:  CorpPorBoom, FreeSandwichDay, Yungcricket, Glxay[/*]	[*][b]Date Founded[/b]: September 2023[/*]	[*][b]Size[/b]: 100-150 active members[/*]	[*][b]Primary Language[/b]: English[/*]	[*][b]Server[/b]: Albion Americas[/*]	[*][b]Discord[/b]: [url=https://discord.gg/graymane][b]discord.gg/graymane[/b][/url][/*][/list][b]Tell us about your guild. [/b]

Graymane started out as a small group of IRL friends running static dungeons, group dungeons, and daring lethal-zone roams in search of high-quality resources and unsuspecting victims. By spring of 2024, we had become a small-scale ZvZ guild, battling with similar-sized blobs around Bridgewatch Portal. By late summer, we had grown in size and strength, moved to Fort Sterling, and found ourselves with Hideouts and territories in deep Outlands zones like Drownfield Fen.

We stayed in the Fort Sterling area for several seasons, fighting for territories, castles, and outposts in many epic battles. At our peak there, we owned four Hideouts and three territories, reaching Gold in Season 27. Along the way, we allied with well-known guilds, and fought against them too. [i]Militant[/i] and [i]Assassins Greed[/i] both come to mind, as we’ve been friends and bitter enemies with them at different times. Such is the changing tide of war in Albion.

These days, Graymane is known as a chill, non-mandatory guild made up mainly of North American 9-to-5’ers, logging on after work. But don’t mistake “chill” for uncompetitive. We hold our own and have earned some epic wins.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6501713eefebcdf2c61c6a929bae1fb7ea761470.png[/img]

[b]Why did you choose this name? Is there a story or meaning behind it?[/b]

Our founding GM was JoetheGray, so the guild name was simply an extension of his own.

[b]What sort of activities do you focus on?[/b]

Our main focus is small-scale ZvZ, typically in the 20-30 player range. That’s large enough for most castles and outposts, and when it comes to territory fights, we join forces with allies and friends to form a formidable zerg. We’re not a cluster-queue guild, though. To succeed in small-scale ZvZ, you need a strong economy and the right skill specialization, so we also spend off-timers on the activities that support it: ganking, Static and Avalonian dungeons, Roads, and economic play. The Depths have been especially popular with our members this season!

[previewyoutube=-XyqU2pjFZs;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What sort of members are you looking for?[/b]

We’re not too picky, but if you’re a working adult with a job or family, you’ll likely be a good fit. Willingness to work on different meta builds and learn ZvZ is very important. “Non-mandatory” doesn’t mean “non-contributing,” and we’ve had to remove a few leeches who took advantage of safe Hideouts and territories without helping to claim or defend them. We welcome players from all over the world, but high-strung or easily upset people won’t thrive here.

[b]Where is your guild primarily located?[/b]

Right now, we’re between cities. After several seasons in Fort Sterling, we let our Hideouts and territories go, and decided to try other areas. We spent a few bloody weeks in Bridgewatch and are currently roaming from Lymhurst. We’ll settle on one soon, drop Hideouts, and fight for new territories.

[b]Do you have any rivalries or ongoing quarrels with other guilds?[/b]

[i]Assassins Greed[/i] was our first alliance, and it didn’t end well. The breakup happened before I joined (I came to Graymane on May 2, 2024), but during my early days in Graymane, the relationship was still acrimonious, to say the least. Over the past year, though, we’ve patched things up. I feel their GM, Murphy, is like me. He tries to [i]lead[/i] people rather than [i]drive[/i] them, which keeps a guild healthy long-term, and their track record supports that. This season we’ve fought both against and alongside them. They’ve been the best “enemies” we’ve ever had.

[b]What are some of your most memorable battles or activities?[/b]

Our best win has to be allying with [i]Militant[/i] to crush the [i]HANG[/i] alliance (led by KingAnkio). It was a small-scale battle, but this five-minute, 28-kill, zero-death shellacking after days of verbal sparring was incredibly satisfying. Beyond that, we’ve fought countless battles for territories in Fort Sterling and Bridgewatch. Win or lose, we enjoy the content and stay positive, always trying to learn from each engagement.

[previewyoutube=7YA9DTSQCEA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What does your guild do for fun?[/b]

We enjoy adult activities like playing blackjack in our Discord (not for real money, of course), and creating our own minigames ingame. We’re not a roleplaying guild, however – one real-life spouse is enough! It’s also much easier to say “Hit that!” than to yell “Onward to the enemy, upon yonder hillock!” Deleting clumps is our kind of fun.

[b]What is your guild's approach to the game? Do you have any core values or beliefs that guide how you play together?[/b]

We try to keep things respectful and treat each other like family. Sure, we’ve had our times when things have gotten heated or stressful, but at the end of the day, we try to be respectful and let everyone have a voice and offer opinions, solutions, and suggestions.

[b]What are your goals for the future?[/b]

Our immediate goal is to find a zone that suits us, plant a new HQ, and start competing for territories again. Our long-term goal is to continue being a force to be reckoned with in the small-scale ZvZ community.

[b]Anything else to share about your guild?[/b]

We’re a community, not a dictatorship. I think that sets us apart from many guilds, since we invite input from everyone and make many decisions by community vote.

[i]Want your guild to be featured next? Click [/i][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScUfId1Qq6FdglFsmR7034U6EXHfA1xtZ7CO3tMDnF0hxmSSQ/viewform][b][i]here[/i][/b][/url][i] to apply.[/i]

notes.title: Guide: The Mists
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c6e340d3c0662d0acf5017a4374d00c0c7af3c5c.jpeg[/img]

Wander through Albion’s open world and you might encounter strange, floating Wisps, tweeting and screeching as they flit past you. Follow one of these, and you’ll find yourself facing a portal to a mysterious world, operating on a different plane of space and time. Here you’ll encounter a plethora of magical creatures, teeming resources, abandoned abbeys, and more and more of these peculiar, unpredictable Wisps.

We’re talking about the [b]Mists[/b], of course, those short-lived, ever-shifting, and strikingly beautiful realms. These contain a world of possibilities offering great wealth and Fame to adventurers willing to explore within, and we’ve put together a [url=https://albiononline.com/guides/article/mists+115][b]guide[/b][/url] to tell you everything you need to know to make the most of them. Read it here, before you set out on your mystical journey:

[b][url=https://albiononline.com/guides/article/mists+115]INTO THE MISTS[/url]
[/b]

notes.title: Ambassador Spotlight: ElPelotasssss
notes.content:
[b]AlbionTV[/b] continues its interview series bringing the spotlight to the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/abyssal-depths-ambassadors][b]AOCP Ambassadors[/b][/url] introduced with the Abyssal Depths update. This week, the mic belongs to [b]ElPelotasssss[/b]. Tune in this [b]Friday[/b], [b]August 22[/b] at [b]20:00 UTC[/b] for a live interview with one of Albion’s most influential Spanish-speaking creators, only on [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/de60905a5eb17fbf216d7855b050bfb9087f8487.png[/img]

[h3]ElPelotasssss[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@elpelotasssss][b]youtube.com/@ElPelotasssss[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/elpelotasssss][b]twitch.tv/elpelotasssss[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]PvP / ZvZ / Guides[/b][/*][/list]There’s no mistaking the presence of “Pelo” when he goes live. Known for his fearless Carving Sword plays and leading zergs into glorious mayhem, ElPelotasssss brings more than just skill, he makes you feel like you’ve dropped into a casual chat with a friend who happens to be deep into Albion (and won’t shut up about it.)

[previewyoutube=okP6miH89Cg;full][/previewyoutube]
On Twitch, his streams are more like a community hangout than a formal broadcast. Viewers swap stories, joke around, and share life updates while the action rolls on. Over on YouTube, his guides and Dev Talk reactions keep the same relaxed vibe, explaining things like a regular player, complete with the good moves, the occasional mistakes, and the laughs in between.

[previewyoutube=XrYaC1O2q1c;full][/previewyoutube]
That unfiltered, approachable style has earned him trust across the Spanish-speaking community. From being the first to successfully introduce the Carving Sword into the Mists to making economy tips easy to follow, he’s built a voice that commands respect and a space where anyone can learn without feeling overwhelmed. It’s this mix of authority and accessibility that’s made his word a touchstone in the community. If Pelo says it, people tend to act on it.

[previewyoutube=J54bnT0DKoA;full][/previewyoutube]
As an Ambassador, Pelo channels that same energy into representing one of Albion’s largest language groups, making sure their voice is heard. With the Depths now in play, his focus remains sharp, and his community is right there with him, ready for whatever challenge Albion throws next. Catch his live interview this Friday for more stories, more laughs, and a chance to win a [b]Corrupted Preacher[/b] vanity bundle.

notes.title: Creator Spotlight: Schrank
notes.content:
[b]Creator Spotlight[/b] is a series where we shine a light on Albion Online’s dedicated [b]Content Creators[/b] by sharing their stories, unique perspectives, and favorite moments. Get to know them and, if you’re intrigued, follow their channels for more!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6a8b49ab8ed133cdc7f5f78e8e7da3a6410c0420.png[/img]

[h3]Schrank[/h3][list]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/schrannk][b]twitch.tv/schrannk[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@schrannk][b]youtube.com/@Schrannk[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Gameplay & Economy Guides[/b][/*][/list][b]How and when did you get into creating Albion Online content?[/b]

I started streaming in March 2022, just for fun. Back then, I was only streaming crafting content, until an old friend told me that there was a real need for crafting video guides in Spanish, and at that time nobody was really covering Albion’s economy in Spanish at all. So I started making economy guides in November 2022, and that’s been my focus ever since.

[previewyoutube=uGY_5niI1Rc;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Do you have a favorite video of yours that you think everyone should have seen? Let us know why it's special![/b]

I have a video where I explain all the different ways to make Silver through economic content, without relying on PvP. I think it’s important to show this kind of content to newer players, because when you're just starting out, you don’t yet understand the mechanics or have the knowledge needed to survive in PvP. This gives them another way to progress and enjoy the game:

[previewyoutube=rAje8De9czE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Do you have any new content in the making that you would like to tease?[/b]

Yes! I’ve written scripts for new videos where I go over every type of economic gameplay in Albion: with or without PvP, using Focus or not. The goal is to have a complete channel where players can find a guide for every single economic path available in the game.

[previewyoutube=Reo31YZULxk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What advice would you give other players who are considering becoming Albion Online content creators?[/b]

The best advice I can give is: [i]create content[/i], don’t just play Albion. It doesn’t matter what kind of content it is, but make sure it’s useful to your audience. Think guides, “how to play” weapon videos, news, and so on. Focus on content that helps people, not just gameplay.

notes.title: The Crucible Results Are In!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f7b819aa809027e74ae4689bbeeaa72fd8d724c8.png[/img]

The battle is over, the dust has settled, and after a month of intense fighting and grinding, one figure has emerged from [b]the Crucible[/b] with the crown. So congratulations to [b]Zizaran[/b], a worthy champion!

Zizaran made a strong start to the tournament, jockeying with [b]Zerator[/b] for first place. After edging ahead in the second week, he pulled away during the latter half of the tournament and finished with a lead of over 200,000 points – a truly impressive showing! In second place came [b]Diables & ZWIERZAAK[/b], who joined forces midway through to challenge Zizaran’s place, but ultimately couldn’t dislodge him. Completing the top three is [b]REVENANT,[/b] who made such a strong showing in the last two weeks to secure a podium place.

Zizaran had this to say about his experience:
[quote][i]“The tournament was a great way for me to learn Albion Online, because I got to leverage experienced players and create a unique moment that reminded me of Eve University. I love PvP Games like Darkfall and Eve, so I got addicted quickly, although whoever made the pull monsters in Corrupted Dungeons hates players! Thanks for having me, it was a blast!”[/i][/quote]
He also made an appearance on [b]AlbionTV[/b] ([url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url]) the other day to discuss his victory, check it out here:

[previewyoutube=Tc0cHs5OYWU;full][/previewyoutube]
Zizaran receives a much-coveted, hand-forged, extremely heavy [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=irIP9xWm82c][b]Galatine Pair[/b][/url] for his triumph, a one-of-a-kind prize befitting of his achievement. And all of the top 20 receive a share of 10,000 gifted subscribers, depending on their final position.

notes.title: Changelog: Abyssal Depths Patch 3
notes.content:
[quote][i]This patch introduces Season 26 statues and changes to the Vanity Merchant, along with various other adjustments.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Season 26 Winner Statues Unveiled[/h3]

The statues to the victorious guilds from Season 26 have been unveiled in each server’s Conqueror’s Hall. Congratulations once again to [i]IFures[/i], [i]Peony Flower[/i], and [i]Heralds of Valhalla[/i]!

[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]Depths Changes[/b][list]	[*]The duration of each level has been reduced by 3 minutes[/*]	[*]Players now display a ghostly animation upon death, making it easier to distinguish them from those turning invisible[/*]	[*]The time between entering the Depths and being allowed to reenter has been reduced	[list]		[*]This means that players who die soon after entering can enter another Depths instance quickly[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Vanity Merchant Changes[/b][list]	[*]Tabs in the Vanity Merchant UI have been reorganized to better match those in the Appearance UI, as follows:	[list]		[*]Wardrobe, Mount Skins, Victory Emotes, Avatars, Furniture & Consumables[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The price of Victory Emotes purchased with Community Tokens has been doubled, but they now grant five times as many charges[/*]	[*]Adventurer Tokens can no longer be crafted	[list]		[*]These can be salvaged for 100 Community Tokens[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Any Adventurer’s Challenge Avatar or Avatar Ring can now be crafted with Community Tokens	[list]		[*]These can be salvaged for 40% of their Community Token value[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Changes[/b][list]	[*]Damage dealt by bosses and minibosses in Hunter Corrupted Dungeons has been reduced[/*]	[*]The number of tracks in Tier 5+ blue and yellow zones has been increased to match the amount in Tier 3 and 4 blue zones[/*]	[*]Avalonian Raid bosses are now immune to silence effects[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]The following items can now be sold at the Tutorial Marketplace in the Cove:	[list]		[*]Tier 1 equipment[/*]		[*]Carrot Soup[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]In Streamer Mode, region names are now hidden in region queues	[list]		[*]This applies to the HUD tracker, overhead messages, and notifications[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Cooldown for /whisper, /faction, and /factionlocal chat has been reduced to 0.5 seconds[/*]	[*]Trading in Corrupted Dungeons has been disabled[/*]	[*]The Journal missions 'Get 150,000 Infamy in Corrupted Dungeons' and above have had their rewards reduced[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b]

[quote][i]Halberd now reduces enemies’ CC resistance, giving it a utility role and making it more attractive to bring one to group fights.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Tear Apart (Halberd)	[list]		[*]Added: enemy CC resistance decreased by 0.2 for 4s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crossbows[/b]

[quote][i]Sweeping Bolt is now slightly easier to hit with, and has a cooldown that better matches ally CC. Its damage has also been increased to help Heavy Crossbow find a place in the meta.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sweeping Bolt (Heavy Crossbow)	[list]		[*]Improved hit detection, including a slightly larger hitbox[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 15s → 20s[/*]		[*]Damage: 192 → 225[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Cursed Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Haunting Screams now travels more slowly across the ground, allowing it to hit crowd-controlled targets more often and more reliably, benefiting both solo and group play.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Haunting Screams (Cursed Skull)	[list]		[*]Max duration: 5.3s → 5s[/*]		[*]Distance covered: 12m → 10m[/*]		[*]Damage per tick: 28 → 31[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Pulse Shock has continued to be favored over Reality Fissure, even for 1v1 combat with ranged shapes. To make it a more attractive option in those situations, its cast time has been reduced to improve reliability.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Reality Fissure (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 0.4s → 0.3s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]

[quote][i]Mighty Blow’s stand time and ending distance from the target have been reduced, making it easier for Heroic Strike to follow up on fleeing enemies despite its recent range reduction.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Mighty Blow (Broadsword)	[list]		[*]Dash stand time: 0.3s → 0.1s[/*]		[*]End position offset: -2.5m → -2m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Helmets[/b]

[quote][i]Now that purges like those from Knight Armor are common, Displacement’s cooldown has been reduced to keep it a reliable answer to forced movement effects.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Displacement Immunity (Knight Helmet)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 30s → 25s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Energizing Shield has provided slightly too much energy security in 1v1 content. Increasing its cooldown gives opponents a larger window to punish energy-hungry builds that rely on it as their sole sustain.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Energizing Shield (all Helmets, Caps and Cowls)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 25s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]Mistwalker has been slightly too strong in both 2v2s and ZvZ bombing. To rein it in, its dash range has been reduced by one meter to match Cleric Sandals’ Blink.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]After Image (Mistwalker Shoes)	[list]		[*]Dash range: 11m → 10m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Ethereal Form’s invincibility duration has been reduced from 4.5s to 4s, so solo ZvZ bombers who are CC’d during the two-second vulnerability window can now be more reliably punished.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ethereal Form (Feyscale Sandals)	[list]		[*]Maximum Duration: 6.5s → 6s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b][list]	[*] Inner Shadow (Shadowcaller)	[list]		[*]Improved visual indication of the area affected by Plate Armor’s effect[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3][list]	[*]Fixed resource filters not working correctly in the Bank Overview[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where changing regions with an overcharged item equipped would cause health to display its base value[/*]	[*]Fixed rare issue in the Depths where two teams could spawn in the same location[/*][/list]

notes.title: Behind the Banner: Agila
notes.content:
[b]Behind the Banner[/b] is a series that shines a light on Albion's many diverse guilds, from fierce PvP warbands to tight-knit social communities. Each episode delves into the identity, playstyle, and goals of a different guild, offering a glimpse into what life is really like behind the banner.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e8f7706cdb482ed89069e831d24f64d3ca1a4080.png[/img]
[list]	[*][b]Guild Name[/b]: Agila[/*]	[*][b]Guild Leader[/b]:  Rafael[/*]	[*][b]Date Founded[/b]: March 17, 2023[/*]	[*][b]Size[/b]: 300 members[/*]	[*][b]Primary Language[/b]: English / Tagalog[/*]	[*][b]Server[/b]: Albion Asia[/*]	[*][b]Discord[/b]: [url=https://discord.gg/9DqjuCxrpA][b]discord.gg/9DqjuCxrpA[/b][/url][/*][/list][b]Tell us about your guild. [/b]

Agila began as a guild focused on PvE and yellow-zone Faction Warfare. In the second week of the Albion Asia server, we placed our first hideout in Gravemound Hills. From that base, we started working toward our goal: to be as strong as Contingent, a guild we looked up to. Over time, we shifted our focus to small- and mid-scale PvP, developing a reputation for our kite-and-clap playstyle. Soon, other players began calling us strong castle defenders.

[b]Why did you choose this name? Is there a story or meaning behind it?[/b]

When I first saw an ad for Albion Online, I decided to give it a try. After arriving in Fort Sterling, I spotted an eagle mount, and one of my lifelong dreams has been to ride one. That moment stuck with me, and when it came time to start a guild, I chose the name Agila, the Tagalog word for eagle. To me, it represents freedom, vision, and ambition.

[b]What sort of activities do you focus on?[/b]

We focus on small- and mid-scale PvP using kite-and-clap comps. Brawling’s just too boring.

[b]What sort of members are you looking for?[/b]

We’re looking for members who want to grow with us long-term and improve in PvP.

[previewyoutube=wMhmzgbuNxY;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Where is your guild primarily located?[/b]

Gravemound Hills is our home. It was our first Hideout and has a lot of sentimental value. We picked it because it used to be a 10am map and almost nobody massed up at that time. As a small-scale guild, we couldn’t afford to fight the bigger ones, so we carved out our own spot.

[b]Do you have any rivalries or ongoing quarrels with other guilds?[/b]

Our biggest quarrel was with One Gin. They evicted us from Gravemound Hills after Arirang paid them two billion Silver. After that, we joined their opponents in Albion Asia’s major coalition war. That gave us a new home and pushed us to up our game.

[b]What are some of your most memorable battles or activities?[/b]

The Gravemound Hills war, no question. It was our first home, and we defended it against a full alliance: One Gin, TukTuk, and more. We had 400 deaths. Most of us were newbies or mobile players who just wanted to protect our homeland. We gave it our all but, ultimately, we lost. Maybe the map is called Gravemound Hills for a reason.

[b]What does your guild do for fun?[/b]

Agila isn’t just a guild, it’s a community. We play other games together, do late-night podcasts, hold in-house scrims and tournaments in Albion, and sometimes just roleplay ingame.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/eb526d11297aac7e381c3a866f45fa46eee5bf40.jpeg[/img]

[b]What is your guild's approach to the game? Do you have any core values or beliefs that guide how you play together?[/b]

Agila does not tolerate toxicity ingame or on social media. We believe any form of toxicity can harm the guild’s reputation in the long run.

[b]What are your goals for the future?[/b]

The goal is to be number one, not necessarily in rank, but as the number one Filipino guild on Albion Asia. For this season, we’re aiming for Rank 3. Of course, every guild dreams of winning the crown someday.

[b]Anything else to share about your guild?[/b]

We have what we call an IRL CTA, where 30 to 40 members meet up, rent an Airbnb, and just hang out, whether it’s for the first time or to catch up. As I said, we’re more than just a guild, we’re a community.

[i]Want your guild to be featured next? Click [/i][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScUfId1Qq6FdglFsmR7034U6EXHfA1xtZ7CO3tMDnF0hxmSSQ/viewform][b][i]here[/i][/b][/url][i] to apply.[/i]

notes.title: Ascend to Glory in the Divine Challenge
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ee8123ef823b04921923ea97e407d1ba8061b520.jpeg[/img]

The heavens open, and with them a chance to walk the sacred path. Throughout this month’s[b] Divine Challenge[/b], earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] from open-world activities to unlock chests overflowing with celestial rewards. At the journey’s peak awaits the [b]Divine Owl[/b]: a radiant mount of gleaming white, whose wings carry not just its rider, but a blessing of divine protection. Claim heavenly riches and let your spirit shine before this sacred season fades.

[h3]Simply Divine[/h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3f4f7ce5d48107bff83a2c1d288e830a351c9b57.png[/img]
[b]DIVINE OWL:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back this ghostly white flying mount with a brisk base move speed. This mount has a special ability, [b]Foresight[/b], which creates a shield that gives a temporary speed boost when broken. (Note: like all mounts, the Divine Owl can only move in navigable ground areas and cannot fly over obstacles.)

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a2744f3b0071de40e5a6a4880bd74c9b6dce365f.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Divine Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], which will frame your chosen avatar in a heavenly golden aura. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2392d9c853ad99fe5b741229282058dde321c0e1.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Divine Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver, you'll also have a chance to unlock mystical furniture items like the [b]Mage Statue, Magic Rune Circle[/b], and [b]Glass Sphere[/b].

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/62cbee83a0a08_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to participate in the Adventurer's Challenge[/h3]
The [b]Adventurer's Challenge[/b] is a monthly event where you can earn [b]exclusive rewards[/b] such as mounts, Tomes of Insight, bags of Silver, and more. By [b]gathering, fishing, farming, [/b]and[b] defeating monsters, [/b]you'll earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] that fill daily, weekly, and monthly progress bars. To track your progress, open the Adventurer's Challenge UI by clicking on the [b]Activities menu[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bbe632b8c242dd9526c11b8d54741acce88fee5a.png[/img]

While only [b]Premium[/b] players can unlock the [b]Monthly Rewards [/b](Avatar Ring, Mount) and [b]Weekly Rewards[/b] (Challenge Chests), anyone can claim the [b]Daily Rewards[/b], which include 10 Learning Points and a Tier 4 Tome of Insight. Non-Premium players also make progress on all reward tracks, so when you’re ready to unlock Premium, your earned rewards will be waiting for you!

notes.title: Gear Up for the Midseason Invasion Day
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5ca47b39c2b05659ccd67fe0a0603acf605ac70f.png[/img]

With [b]Season 28[/b] hitting its halfway mark, familiar names have returned to the spotlight… but not always in familiar ways. Some guilds that ended last season on top have fallen silent, while unexpected forces are pushing to fill the power vacuum. This weekend’s [b]Midseason Invasion Day[/b] could cement a new order, or spark the next great conflict.

Here's an overview of the current situation:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: From the very start of the season, guilds made their intentions clear, and they’re staying true to their word. [i]Sunset[/i] declared they were going for the crown and have surged ahead with over 470,000 Season Points. Meanwhile, their coalition partner, [i]Peony Flower[/i], promised to take second place and now sits there securely. There’s been no shortage of action, with Hideouts being destroyed and tit-for-tat territory launches, but despite the skirmishes, the top two seem firmly in control… at least for now.[/*]	[*][b]Albion Europe[/b]: On their way to their first ever victory, [i]Woof Woof[/i] currently leads with over 330,000 Season Points, holding off fierce competition from the [i]GIRTH [/i]and [i]GLOBE [/i]alliances. Their grip on first place tightened after [i]Worldwide[/i], once just 5,000 points behind, disbanded. Meanwhile, [i]FRIES[/i], a new alliance made up of [i]O M B R A[/i], [i]Crumbs[/i], and [i]Clean Kill[/i], has emerged in the Outlands and is already launching raids. We’ll see if [i]Woof Woof [/i]can defend against this new threat.[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas[/b]: Surprisingly, the season began on a quiet note: [i]PIVAS[/i] declared their intent to take the top spot, and so far they’re delivering on that promise. With over 435,000 Season Points, they hold a commanding lead, while [i]Upside[/i] trails far behind in second. But whispers of returning giants like [i]IFures[/i] with Daliuess and [i]FAX[/i] with Dazroun have stirred speculation. Will [i]PIVAS[/i] cruise to a peaceful victory, or will these whispers erupt into all-out war?[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e24107f10a6e4a2a5179811f3b8f8c25feda5411.png[/img]
[h3]Watch it All Live on AlbionTV[/h3]
As [b]double scoring[/b] kicks in, every fight during this Invasion Day could tip the balance. Luckily, the [b]AlbionTV[/b] team will be following the action across all three servers, bringing you zone flips, surprise raids, and last-second defenses as they happen. Tune in to catch it all on [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url] at the following times:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: August 2, 14:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Albion Europe[/b]: August 2, 18:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas[/b]: August 3, 01:00 UTC[/*][/list]Be there to witness the turning point of the season. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Development Update July 2025
notes.content:
The [b]Abyssal Depths[/b] update has been live for a few weeks, bringing fresh life to Albion’s instanced PvP and new player experience. In this [b]Dev Talk[/b], Game Director [b]Moritz Bokelmann[/b] looks at how the update is performing so far and offers an early look at the upcoming Faction Warfare rework.

[previewyoutube=qgv9CAx_WQc;full][/previewyoutube][h3]Abyssal Depths[/h3]
[b]Instanced Content[/b]
[list]	[*][b]The Depths[/b] have seen strong engagement from both competitive and casual players	[list]		[*]Over [b]4 million sessions[/b] have already been played[/*]		[*]Players spent over [b]100 years of collective playtime[/b] in the first few weeks[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]The [b]risk-reward balance[/b] seems just right, keeping a wide range of players involved[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/15c3dcafc8d06b3ca4d3e61617910f0a393a3cee.png[/img][list]	[*]The [b]Antiquarian’s Den[/b] is working well as a hub for hell-themed PvP content	[list]		[*][b]Increased population[/b] across all modes in Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons[/*]		[*]Players appreciate the cohesive feel of the entire hell-themed experience[/*]	[/list][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/85c6411193856d7b1ba90dd575e7ed0b2154c433.png[/img]

[b]New Player Experience[/b]
[list]	[*]Quality-of-life changes are helping new players settle in more smoothly with:	[list]		[*][b]Clearer progression[/b] paths[/*]		[*][b]Better onboarding[/b] experience[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Early signs suggest [b]improved retention[/b], though it’s still too soon for long-term data[/*][/list]Overall, the update has largely been met with a positive response, and we’ll continue to pay attention to your feedback as we move forward.

[h3]What’s Next: Faction Warfare Rework[/h3]
Planned for release this fall, the next major update will bring a significant rework to [b]Faction Warfare[/b]. This core PvP system plays a key role in Albion’s open-world activity, and the team aims to build on its foundation to make it more engaging, accessible, and rewarding.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/41e3099e9bceec2effead1d378b66ac8da2297c4.png[/img]

[b]Faction Warfare’s Role[/b]
[list]	[*]Acts as a [b]stepping stone[/b] between casual open-world content and high-stakes guild warfare[/*]	[*]Supports meaningful, repeatable PvP activity across the map[/*]	[*]Drives [b]regional conflict[/b] and[b] player circulation[/b], enriching Albion’s dynamic economy[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8f3c36576525681e6902b337a1adf32f1562b97a.png[/img]

[b]Current Issues[/b]
[list]	[*]The [b]frontline system[/b] isn’t consistently bringing opposing groups into conflict[/*]	[*][b]Long travel times[/b] to conflict zones create friction and missed opportunities	[list]		[*]Many players bypass each other, and fights often fizzle out before others can arrive[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*][b]Gameplay variety[/b] is limited, with most activity focused solely on capturing Outposts[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f2d95fb3927d9ff220671bd128af9889c405759.png[/img]

[b]Areas of Improvement[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Refocus fighting[/b] into clearer hotspots to encourage more frequent and predictable PvP	[list]		[*]This includes [b]reducing travel time[/b] and making active zones easier to reach[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Introduce a wider [b]variety of objectives[/b] to prevent repetition and deepen tactical play[/*]	[*]Improve [b]accessibility [/b]for solo players and pickup groups	[list]		[*]Without requiring guild membership, players should still be able to find allies and jump into the action[/*]	[/list][/*][/list]The update is still in early development, but we’ll share more details as soon as we’re able. As always, your feedback is important, so we’re eager to hear your ideas. Watch the full [b]Dev Talk[/b] above and share your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: New Twitch Drops Have Arrived!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e71b0096dbd0f9d6d39ab063b96af7bccaba77f7.png[/img]

[b]Twitch Drops[/b] just got an upgrade. A new tier of rewards is now available through [b]Noble Community Chests[/b], offering you exclusive vanity items, new token types, and even more ways to collect unique cosmetics.

[h3]Watch and Earn[/h3]
[b]Community Chests[/b] continue to be available on any stream in the Albion Online category. You can still earn up to 7 per week, each containing:
[list]	[*]A selection of non-tradable [b]vanity items[/b], including Twitch exclusives[/*]	[*][b]Victory Emote[/b] [b]charges[/b] to celebrate your PvP wins[/*]	[*][b]Community Tokens[/b] to exchange at the ingame Vanity Merchant for vanity items and emotes[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5692a3ae1e8185b27e48af2a18437d95062ccd05.jpeg[/img]

These drops remain a great way to personalize your character just by watching your favorite Albion streamers.

[h3]Noble Community Chests[/h3]
[b]Noble Community Chests[/b] are a new kind of drop, available only on streams hosted by members of the[b] Albion Online Creators Program[/b] – our official partnered creators. These chests contain everything found in standard Community Chests, plus a chance to receive:
[list]	[*][b]Vanity items[/b] only available through Noble Community Chests[/*]	[*][b]Noble Community Tokens[/b], which you can exchange for these exclusive items or salvage into regular Community Tokens[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/93c12ca03854ab4f232f682e6303e6cee3994422.png[/img]

Noble Drops follow a [b]biweekly[/b] [b]schedule[/b]: one week active, one week off. During active weeks, you can earn one Noble Community Chest per day, up to 7 per week.

[h3]First Drop: Buttercup[/h3]
The first exclusive vanity item available through Noble Community Chests is none other than [b]Buttercup[/b]! This skin transforms your fearsome [b]Direboar[/b] mount into a gentle boar wearing a buttercup flower behind its ear…  And we all know boars aren’t winning any beauty contests. But Buttercup? Buttercup [i]tries[/i]. One flower on one ear. That’s it. That’s the look. And against all odds, the result is kind of adorable.

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/688346876afc4_720.mp4[/video]

Buttercup is just the beginning. More Noble-exclusive vanity will be added regularly, so stay tuned to your favorite AOCP streams to see what drops next!

notes.title: Ambassador Spotlight: Scribbleloops
notes.content:
Continuing its series introducing the Abyssal Depths [url=https://albiononline.com/news/abyssal-depths-ambassadors][b]AOCP Ambassadors[/b][/url], [b]AlbionTV[/b] brings Scribbleloops to the stage! Tune in to [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url] this [b]Friday 25[/b] at [b]20:00 UTC[/b] to learn more about the creator known for letting his fists do all the necessary introductions.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/25bc3108a278d6e669c60e5be4eaa587f23aeddd.png[/img]

[h3]Scribbleloops[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@scribbleloops][b]youtube.com/@Scribbleloops[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scribbleloops][b]twitch.tv/scribbleloops[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Solo PvP[/b][/*][/list]If you’ve ever thought “I could totally take that group solo,” Scribbleloops is here to teach you how to turn that dream into a reality. Specializing in outnumbered fights and off-meta War Gloves, he’s made a name for himself by turning impossible odds into stylish wins. His YouTube channel is a shrine to solo plays. With minimal commentary, he lets the action speak for itself.

[previewyoutube=-ELJ7uwb89w;full][/previewyoutube]
Scribble doesn’t just survive outnumbered fights, he seeks them out. Whether he’s roaming the Roads, diving into the Depths, or walking into the Greater Mists completely alone, it’s always a masterclass demonstration of smart tactics and solid execution. His videos prove that you don’t need BiS gear or a 10-man squad to make your mark. Oh, and the PvP soundtrack? You’ll want your volume up for this one:

[previewyoutube=wn01LXB940w;full][/previewyoutube]
Recently, Scribble’s brought his solo-slayer energy to Twitch, joining the ever-growing Albion PvP streamer scene. His streams match his videos: no gimmicks, just raw gameplay and a chilled atmosphere. It’s the kind of stream where one moment you’re casually banging your head to the music, and the next you’re watching a mind-blowing counterplay unfold in real time.

[previewyoutube=fTLq3B_8TuI;full][/previewyoutube]
As an Ambassador, he’s continuing to do what he does best: inspiring players to pick up overlooked weapons, try content they didn’t think was possible solo, and prove that sometimes, it’s you against the world... and you can still win. Catch him live on [b]AlbionTV[/b] this [b]Friday[/b], where you could win a [b]vanity bundle[/b] chosen by Scribble himself.
