notes.title: Prove Your Valor in the Knight Challenge!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e3db1ddc95da02abb923604f837476d12abcae1f.png[/img]

The [b]Knight Challenge[/b] begins and Albion calls for champions of honor. Now is the time to ride forth, uphold your code, and claim the reward worthy of a true knight: the [b]Gallant Horse[/b]. This proud steed carries not just its rider, but the weight of tradition, discipline, and unshakable loyalty. Earn [b]Challenge Points[/b], claim your mount, and let your deeds show forth!

[h3]Knight Moves[/h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3d4a51dc1bb07402ea3fdc19d88a4324f3df1a11.png[/img]
[b]GALLANT HORSE:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the powerful [b]Gallant Horse[/b], a noble mount with a combination speed boost / immunity spell that leaves foes in the dust. Ride fearlessly into the wilds of Albion on the back of this mighty steed!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2b0524399909f8b5d641b12a04a39529877dc7ae.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Knight Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], a bold, plate-armor-themed ring that will give your avatar an aura of nobility. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar ring for one character – or you can trade it at the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bc808617dc858a78e7eaf78e9e535e9474692b99.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Knight Challenge chests[/b]. These chests contain valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver bags, plus knight-themed furniture like the [b]Stone Throne, Round Table, Knight Statue, [/b]and [b]Regal Carpet[/b].

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/68308da5ba8d6_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to participate in the Adventurer's Challenge[/h3]
The [b]Adventurer's Challenge[/b] is a monthly event where you can earn [b]exclusive rewards[/b] such as mounts, Tomes of Insight, bags of Silver, and more. By [b]gathering, fishing, farming, [/b]and[b] defeating monsters, [/b]you'll earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] that fill daily, weekly, and monthly progress bars. To track your progress, open the Adventurer's Challenge UI by clicking on the [b]Activities menu[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bbe632b8c242dd9526c11b8d54741acce88fee5a.png[/img]

While only [b]Premium[/b] players can unlock the [b]Monthly Rewards [/b](Avatar Ring, Mount) and [b]Weekly Rewards[/b] (Challenge Chests), anyone can claim the [b]Daily Rewards[/b], which include 10 Learning Points and a Tier 4 Tome of Insight. Non-Premium players also make progress on all reward tracks, so when you’re ready to unlock Premium, your earned rewards will be waiting for you!

notes.title: Behind the Banner: CompletelyStrange
notes.content:
[b]Behind the Banner[/b] is a series that shines a light on Albion's many diverse guilds, from fierce PvP warbands to tight-knit social communities. Each episode delves into the identity, playstyle, and goals of a different guild, offering a glimpse into what life is really like behind the banner.

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/68309ca5635f4_360.mp4[/video] [list]	[*][b]Guild Name[/b]: CompletelyStrange or “COM”[/*]	[*][b]Alliance[/b]: Leaders of [WhyU] Why Are U Running[/*]	[*][b]Guild Leader[/b]: JustMeWhyNot[/*]	[*][b]Date Founded[/b]: December 3, 2021[/*]	[*][b]Size[/b]: 256 (active) / 285 (total)[/*]	[*][b]Primary Language[/b]: English[/*]	[*][b]Server[/b]: Albion Americas[/*]	[*][b]Discord[/b]: [url=https://discord.com/invite/EN8gUBmfS9][b]discord.com/N8gUBmfS9[/b][/url][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/791d90b07aaa6327022e3eb9f2fd293c55549796.png[/img]

[b]Tell us about your guild. [/b]

CompletelyStrange was originally a small group of friends who were in it purely for the fun, without caring much for endgame content. We’d rather focus on helping each other and newer players.

That’s still our main focus, even though our numbers and the content we do have changed quite a bit by now. Our name still fits us – we’re completely strange. Some of our ideas may sound ridiculous at first, but you might be surprised when they actually work.

A good example is our beloved “Pike Gang.” Born out of a joke, it’s just a group of members in the cheapest T4 gear – and of course… pikes! It may not sound great in theory (and it still isn’t on closer inspection), but the Pike Gang has made millions in PvP and even managed to capture Black Zone Outposts. It’s not the most efficient way, but it’s basically no risk and a whole lot of fun.

[b]Why did you choose this name? Is there a story or meaning behind it?[/b]

The name represents how we always approached things – not necessarily conforming to the “norm” and not always doing things the same way others do.

[b]What sort of activities do you focus on?[/b]

We follow a simple principle. As long as our members are willing to put effort into something, we can do it:
[list]	[*]If they want to join certain content, they can ping content-specific roles in our Discord[/*]	[*]If enough members are interested, the guild supports events with gear and/or Silver[/*]	[*]COM combines players from all Albion playstyles, so there's a wide range of content to choose from[/*][/list]In parallel to member-hosted content, we have Mentors, members who’ve proven trustworthy, helpful, and knowledgeable. They’re asked to take on that role as the main pillar of scheduled content. They consistently put in a lot of time and effort, and they are the glue of our community.

[video autoplay="no" loop="no" muted="no"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/68309c506718c_720.mp4[/video]

[b]What sort of members are you looking for?[/b]

We welcome anyone who wants to learn, teach, or just enjoy a good time with laid-back players who aren’t too into the ultra-sweaty side of things. We expect everyone to treat each other with respect and behave in a civilized manner. Apart from that, anything goes.

[b]Where is your guild primarily located?[/b]

Our Hideout is in the Roads of Avalon. Right now, we share our Road with six lovely allied guilds and their HQs. Everyone in the alliance has full access to our Hideout, it’s a central place to team up, trade, duel, refine, and craft. We chose the Roads because most of our members prefer small-scale PvP over ZvZ. Plus, the Roads are always changing, with new areas, new resources, and new adventures every few hours.

[b]Do you have any rivalries or ongoing quarrels with other guilds?[/b]

We try to avoid in-game politics or personal vendettas. We focus on internal growth and building a positive environment. That applies in our Hideout region as well. But there’s one moment that stands out: when CompletelyStrange and MANDRAGORA became allies, after being hostile neighbors in the Roads for a long time.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fbe7ac93d22ae9bb380506dcb9ba443f8e134c7b.png[/img]

[b]What does your guild do for fun?[/b]

We run all sorts of events, tournaments, and workshops. Donkey races through lethal zones, weekly activity rewards, PvP and economy workshops, group game nights, picture contests, and just casual voice chats. There’s always [i]something[/i] going on.

[b]What is your guild's approach to the game? Do you have any core values or beliefs that guide how you play together?[/b]

Patience, especially when things go wrong. That’s probably our most important value. We all started somewhere, and no one knows everything. We share knowledge through member-written guides and in person, and we celebrate when members succeed using that knowledge. Even then, mistakes are normal. We all make lots of them along the way. What matters is getting back up by working together. One of our members summed it up best: “CompletelyStrange” Characters Welcome!

[b]What are some of your most memorable battles or activities?[/b]

Honestly, it’s usually the goofy, mostly “useless” activities that are the most memorable. We’ve collected a lot of those situations over time. For example, we decorated our entire Hideout floor with our shiny corpses:

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/56b9a18baa600e180836eb02f7299a51176d202c.png[/img]

[b]What are your goals for the future?[/b]

This season, we’re in the process of purchasing or associating city stations, ideally one in each city, based on local bonuses. That’ll help support members’ passive economies. Next season, we plan to finish setting up all our guild islands. But COM doesn’t tax members – if they want to contribute, they can donate resources for upgrades. It’s fully voluntary. Teamwork makes the dream work!

[b]What is your ultimate goal in Albion?[/b]

Our core goal is to help, teach, fame, and train members. That effort restarts with every new player who joins. Some will stay. Some will move on to Black Zone guilds. Either way, we want them to succeed, and if things turn out differently than they expected, they’re always welcome to come back.

[b]Anything else to share about your guild?[/b]

I would like to express how incredibly proud I am of all our members, allies, and friends who have supported us through times of success, doubt, and everything in between. COM wouldn't exist without you, and I'm grateful our paths crossed. This is especially true for our lovely Mentors: TJSOLI, MasterPantheon, Daucina, RubberDuckie, OneTap25, Samasamasama, and Slywynn – they alone make up half of COM’s heart and soul.

[i]Want your guild to be featured next? We’ve launched a form where guilds can apply to be highlighted in the [b]Behind the Banner[/b] series. Click [/i][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScUfId1Qq6FdglFsmR7034U6EXHfA1xtZ7CO3tMDnF0hxmSSQ/viewform][b][i]here[/i][/b][/url][i] to apply.[/i]

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 8
notes.content:
[quote][i]This small patch addresses some combat balance issues and improves underused spells, alongside some minor bug fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]To make Magic Shock a more reliable tool for dealing damage and interrupting enemy casts, its cast time has been significantly reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Magic Shock (all Arcane Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 0.5s → 0.35s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crossbows[/b]

[quote][i]Divine Engine was dealing too much damage too quickly following its recent buffs. Its damage per tick has therefore been reduced somewhat, while remaining higher than before its recent buffs.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Divine Engine (Energy Shaper)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 117 → 106[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Flickershots’ dash range and speed have been increased so that its dashes are no longer slower than most sprint speeds.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Flickershots (Arclight Blasters)	[list]		[*]Dash range: 7m → 8m[/*]		[*]Dash speed: 9.33m/s → 10.66m/s (duration unchanged)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Fire Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Searing Flame has high damage potential with very long range. To help other ranged weapons fight back, its range has been reduced somewhat.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Searing Flame (all Fire Staffs)	[list]		[*]Range: 19.5m → 18m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Living Armor now has an instant guaranteed heal to improve its baseline value, even in suboptimal conditions.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Living Armor (Great Nature Staff)	[list]		[*]Added instant heal for 66[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b]

[quote][i]Cartwheel’s cooldown has been reduced to help Quarterstaff tanks find more success, but to maintain a consistent total mobility, the movement speed buff on hit has been removed.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Cartwheel (all Quarterstaffs)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 8s → 6s[/*]		[*]Removed: 20% movespeed bonus when hit[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

notes.title: This Weekend, Season 27 Reaches its Turning Point
notes.content:

[b]Season 27[/b] marks the second round of the frantic two-month format, and if last season taught us anything, it’s that in a shorter season a lead can vanish in an instant. With [b]double scoring[/b] about to begin, anything is possible, and this season is already shaping up to be a wild one. Get ready, because this is where Season 27 really kicks into high gear.

Let’s take a look at where things stand at the halfway mark:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Europe[/b]: At the halfway point of Season 27, [i]Statement [/i]is making a bold charge for their first season title on the European server. With over 500,000 Season Points to their name, no other guild has come close. [i]WorldWide[/i] sits in second with 186,000, while [i]Heralds of Valhalla[/i] trails just behind. With such a massive lead, attention now turns to the battle for the remaining podium spots. Can anyone catch up, or will [i]Statement[/i]’s dominance go unchallenged in the final stretch?[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas[/b]: The king is dead, long live the king! After ruling with an iron grip, the [i]IFures [/i]coalition collapsed in dramatic fashion. Mistreatment and threats at the end of Season 26 sparked a full-blown rebellion, and within weeks, [i]AYUDA[/i] and their allies had wiped [i]IFures[/i] from the Outlands, erasing nearly every trace of their former dominance. With revenge complete, [i]AYUDA [/i]has now declared victory… and disbanded. From here on, its former members intend to fight each other, promising a chaotic second half. No renting. No alliances. Just war. Once again, the Americas server provides the drama.[/*]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: As the politics of the top guilds unfold, [i]CCTV [/i]and [i]All Rise[/i] find themselves in a strange head-to-head for Season 27 – despite both being in the same coalition. [i]CCTV[/i] currently holds the lead with 517,000 Season Points, while[i] All Rise [/i]trails just behind at 490,000. Rumors are swirling that [i]All Rise[/i] was aiming for Rank 1 this season, but [i]CCTV [/i]isn’t stepping aside. With tensions rising, many are wondering: will we see a betrayal on Invasion Day? We’ll be watching closely as this slow-burn rivalry heats up in the weeks ahead.[/*][/list][h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8dbc205d07064988c93d207c5860d8c0b0847424.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: Behind the Banner: Wild Cards / High Cards
notes.content:
[b]Behind the Banner[/b] is a series that shines a light on Albion's many diverse guilds, from fierce PvP warbands to tight-knit social communities. Each episode delves into the identity, playstyle, and goals of a different guild, offering a glimpse into what life is really like behind the banner.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7e0fc90a183934ccd259a57c1b86df5737eae8d6.png[/img]

[list]	[*][b]Guild Name[/b]: Wild Cards / High Cards[/*]	[*][b]Alliance[/b]: [6dog] 6oo bie ma wo[/*]	[*][b]Guild Leader[/b]: Monojd and Monodj[/*]	[*][b]Date Founded[/b]: January 1, 2025[/*]	[*][b]Size[/b]: 550 - 600 members[/*]	[*][b]Primary Language[/b]: English, Filipino[/*]	[*][b]Server[/b]: Albion Asia[/*]	[*][b]Discord[/b]: [url=http://discord.gg/wildxhigh][b]discord.gg/WildxHigh[/b][/url][/*][/list][previewyoutube=xt8kLPQQoQ8?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Tell us about your guild. [/b]

When I came back to Albion, I was a complete newbie and didn't know what to do. So I started a community called [i]Albion - New Player Society[/i] and invited over 100 new players from all over Asia to help them and teach them what I had learned. Eventually, many of us joined a guild, but it was not what we were looking for. That's when I decided to create Wild Cards: a place where players would be treated fairly, with no forced timers, no tax ratting, and real transparency and benefits.

Also, as I reached out to other guilds to make connections, I realized that many so-called casual guilds were really just dying guilds, like former ZvZ guilds with mandatory timers trying to go casual after losing momentum. So I used that knowledge to unite them under my own “casual system”, a system that combines quantity and quality.

[b]Why did you choose this name? Is there a story or meaning behind it?[/b]

The name comes from the idiom “wild card”: unpredictable, flexible, and bizarre.

[b]What sort of activities do you focus on?[/b]

I believe our guild is the [i]most[/i] active out there because we do every kind of content! We don’t focus on just one thing. Different hosts run all sorts of activities throughout the day. That said, this ZvZ-casual guild is addicted to group dungeons. I guess we enjoy the fun and chill environment that’s created when they're closed and we don't have to worry about getting ganked. It’s a nice change of pace.

[b]What sort of members are you looking for?[/b]

Anyone with more than 10 million Fame, who knows at least the basics and has a good mindset. That mindset means understanding that even if we lose 1,000 times, those losses are just part of winning. As long as we remember we can be Wild or go Higher, we’ll never truly lose.

[previewyoutube=e7PT7JlK2fE?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Where is your guild primarily located in the Outlands?[/b]

Sunfang Wasteland, Quality 6 – right next to Wailing Bulwark.

[b]Do you have any rivalries or ongoing quarrels with other guilds?[/b]

Right now we're chill, but we're trying to take over World Boss politics and overthrow the current tyrannical government in control. Revolution, a guild that monopolizes World Bosses for their own gain, became our main rival after the World Boss fight in Wailing Bulwark. I want to stop them, and right now my side is winning. We’ve disrupted their farming, pushed back their supporting guilds, and even bonked their Hideout. In return, they’ve tried to stir up drama, claiming they own the World Bosses and warning others not to farm them. We responded by farming them freely, wiping their guild, and enjoying the spoils of their arrogance.

[b]What are some of your most memorable battles or activities?[/b]

Our first clean ZvZ win. We’d been training daily, each of us scrimming one to three times a day since April. Sure, we’d technically "won" ZvZs before, but this was different. This was the first time we cleanly wiped our enemies – not with just quantity, but with quality:

[previewyoutube=waAcx6DwJ04?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What does your guild do for fun?[/b]

Welp, we laugh at our mistakes and bounce back from them. Oh, and we play poker whenever Albion is on maintenance.

[b]What is your guild's approach to the game?[/b]

Our approach is chill yet explosive. We may be a casual guild, but we play with discipline and respect – not only toward each other, but also toward our allies and the friends we’ve made along the way.

[b]Do you have an overarching philosophy?[/b]

We always stand by this conviction: Two armies go to war. One is relentlessly trained and tired. The other is well-rested and happy. You might say the first one wins through sacrifice, but the army that is happy always wins, even in defeat.

[previewyoutube=IAvsC9MCHDQ?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What are your goals for the future?[/b]

Our first priority is to keep the “casual system” running strong and make history. Beyond that, I want my members to experience what it’s like for a casual guild to make it to Crystal. I’m not sure if we’d be the first one, but a casual guild running for Crystal is just woah!

I want to see everyone rich, riding Mammoths, and casually toppling Albion’s economy. We’ll become a legendary casual guild, one that breaks through handholding systems and World Boss monopolies, reclaiming content that should belong to everyone.

[b]What is your ultimate goal in Albion?[/b]

To have fun with my guild. I really want to live up to the game’s promise to "Create Your Own Story". For me, that means to play without being forced into strict timers, and enjoy the time I have to play.

[b]Anything else to share about your guild?[/b]

We’ve been through a lot – defeat, drama, and everything in between – but it’s only made our bond stronger. I’m grateful to the members who believed in me and followed this bizarre path I’m trying to create.

[i]Want your guild to be featured next? We’ve launched a form where guilds can apply to be highlighted in the [b]Behind the Banner[/b] series. Click [/i][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScUfId1Qq6FdglFsmR7034U6EXHfA1xtZ7CO3tMDnF0hxmSSQ/viewform][b][i]here[/i][/b][/url][i] to apply.[/i]

notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/290c5d95455dfdb26979e8c0ee44e1edba012a90.png[/img]

The [b]AlbionTV[/b] interview series with [b]AOCP Ambassadors[/b] returns this Friday, and it’s about to get a whole lot more paw-some. Tune in to [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url] live at [b]20:00 UTC[/b] on [b]May 2[/b] as the crew sits down with [b]w0n[/b]. Before he goes live, here’s a glimpse into the claws, creativity, and energy he brings to Albion.

[h3]w0n[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@w0n23][b]youtube.com/@w0n23[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/w0n23][b]twitch.tv/w0n23[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Instanced & Open-World PvP[/b][/*][/list]When it comes to high-speed Albion action, few channels have the [b]cat-like reflexes[/b] of [b]w0n[/b]. His content is a non-stop stream of PvP encounters, from stealthy Mists ambushes to open-world brawls and daring fresh-account challenges. No matter the odds, he pushes his builds to their limits and never lets up.

[previewyoutube=NXB4Jx5fC7c?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
Best known for his deadly [b]Deathgivers play and solo prowling[/b] through Mists and Corrupted Dungeons, w0n quickly earned a reputation for taking on tough fights and making them look easy. Always looking for new edges, he began pushing off-meta builds to stay unpredictable. And after joining the Ambassador program with the Rogue Frontier update, he took that fearless spirit into open-world PvP, diving into chaotic solo battles against groups and finding new ways to flip the odds in his favor.

[previewyoutube=tW5ezRl8DqA?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
But his content is not just about the battles. Backed by energetic beats and his iconic cat avatar dancing in the corner, [b]w0n’s streams always feel like a party[/b]. He keeps the conversation flowing with constant banter, while the chat erupts with cat emojis during the wildest moments. He might even recruit viewers for spontaneous clashes, making every stream a community event where everyone’s invited.

If you’re looking for a channel that blends nonstop PvP with sharp claws and a welcoming, high-energy atmosphere, w0n’s stream is the place to be. Catch him live, or tune in to AlbionTV on May 2 to meet the creator behind the kitten and have the chance to snag a [b]Reaver vanity skin[/b] during the broadcast!

notes.title: The Morgana Challenge Brings Back the Darkness
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7cb5cebaf2ab918f9b578012d1e47c3718e1cf13.png[/img]

The [b]Morgana Challenge[/b] begins, as cultists loyal to the exiled sorceress gather in secret to restore her lost power. Embrace the darkness and earn a reward pulled straight from the depths of nightmare: the [b]Morgana Raven[/b]. Draped in shadow, this unholy mount glides with spectral speed and unleashes a cry that scatters the weak in fear. Earn [b]Challenge Points[/b], claim your mount, and let the darkness be your weapon!

[h3]Embrace the Darkness[/h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/52730b26d43c7acb500a97266e27664755578c46.png[/img]
[b]MORGANA RAVEN:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the popular [b]Morgana Raven[/b], a fearsome, fast-moving flying mount with an area-of-effect Fear spell. (Note: the Morgana Raven requires the same terrain pathing as all other mounts, and cannot fly over gaps or obstacles).

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/175ed5e819977913f6ace2cd32c91c580891d193.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Morgana Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], a menacing, fiery frame that will give your avatar an aura of dread. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar ring for one character.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d8d2b4012ed682b05e9e12428f4bd0ba820113b2.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Morgana Challenge chests[/b]. These chests contain valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver bags, along with unique Morgana-themed furniture items.

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/680f8cc040401_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to participate in the Adventurer's Challenge[/h3]
The [b]Adventurer's Challenge[/b] is a monthly event where you can earn [b]exclusive rewards[/b] such as mounts, Tomes of Insight, bags of Silver, and more. By [b]gathering, fishing, farming, [/b]and[b] defeating monsters, [/b]you'll earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] that fill daily, weekly, and monthly progress bars. To track your progress, open the Adventurer's Challenge UI by clicking on the [b]Activities menu[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bbe632b8c242dd9526c11b8d54741acce88fee5a.png[/img]

While only [b]Premium[/b] players can unlock the [b]Monthly Rewards [/b](Avatar Ring, Mount) and [b]Weekly Rewards[/b] (Challenge Chests), anyone can claim the [b]Daily Rewards[/b], which include 10 Learning Points and a Tier 4 Tome of Insight. Non-Premium players also make progress on all reward tracks, so when you’re ready to unlock Premium, your earned rewards will be waiting for you!

[list]	[*][b]Guild Name[/b]: Scourge of GOD[/*]	[*][b]Alliance[/b]: DIOR[/*]	[*][b]Guild Leader[/b]: Attila[/*]	[*][b]Date Founded[/b]: Albion Europe launch[/*]	[*][b]Size[/b]: 300 members[/*]	[*][b]Primary Language[/b]: English/Turkish[/*]	[*][b]Server[/b]: Albion Europe[/*]	[*][b]Discord[/b]: [url=http://discord.gg/KurBZQhhYX][b]discord.gg/KurBZQhhYX[/b][/url][/*][/list][previewyoutube=4SrTiAwA7YU?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Tell us about your guild. What sort of activities do you focus on?[/b]

We participate in every type of content Albion has to offer. Our daily activities include all forms of PvE (Avalonian Dungeons, Group Dungeons, Static Raids) and PvP (large-scale ZvZ, small-scale skirmishes, ganking, and objective-based roaming).

[b]Where is your guild primarily located in the Outlands?[/b]

Martlock / Martlock Black Zone.

[b]Do you have any rivalries or ongoing quarrels with other guilds?[/b]

All the guilds we've fought so far have disbanded, so at the moment, we have no remaining enemies.

[b]What are some of your most memorable battles or activities?[/b]

A recent memorable win was the 1v2 battle against SIX and SENT. SIX had gained enough strength to remove other guilds from territories they wanted, but they underestimated us. They tried to take our homeland, even calling SENT for backup, but it wasn’t enough. They didn’t just lose the war – they were pushed back to their territory and eventually lost it altogether:

[previewyoutube=DjQ_KukrFTs?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
Another important moment for us was the fight that fixed our reputation. Bober, a #1 ranked guild, used to call us “Scourge of Noobs”  until we pulled off a full wipe against them. Their trash talk became our motivation. Everyone expected us to lose, especially since they were dominating the server, but this became a historic moment for us. We didn’t just surprise them, the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline/clip/FamousSlipperySageDatSheffy-pE3m9jbDdTM9gIJx][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] casters gave us recognition as well. It was a proud moment for our guild.

[b]What does your guild do for fun?[/b]

We celebrate our victories with giveaways and memorable content. But more than that, we’re like a family. We spend time together outside of Albion, playing other games as well. We're building not just a gaming community, but a well-rounded social environment.

[b]What is your guild's approach to the game?[/b]

Our focus is having fun while maintaining a healthy competitive mindset. We like to win, but we never forget to enjoy the game.

[b]What are your goals for the future?[/b]

As an English and Turkish-speaking community, our ultimate goal is to reach the top and become the number one guild on the Europe server.

[b]Anything else to share about your guild?[/b]

Come join us!

[previewyoutube=St7ZkCVs5-s?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Want your guild to be featured next? We’ve launched a form where guilds can apply to be highlighted in the [b]Behind the Banner[/b] series. Click [/i][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScUfId1Qq6FdglFsmR7034U6EXHfA1xtZ7CO3tMDnF0hxmSSQ/viewform][b][i]here[/i][/b][/url][i] to apply.[/i]

notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0c45fd49e3c7ed9f4874cbc44bca4b7ef2205d26.png[/img]

The [b]AlbionTV[/b] ([url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url]) interview series with [b]AOCP Ambassadors[/b] returns this [b]Friday[/b] after a short off-season break. Kicking things off is none other than Fakturka, who joins the crew at[b] 20:00 UTC[/b] for a live interview. We’ve put together this spotlight to give you a proper introduction before he goes live.

[h3]Fakturka[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=http://youtube.com/@FakturkaAO][b]youtube.com/@FakturkaAO[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=http://twitch.tv/fakturka][b]twitch.tv/fakturka[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Solo PvP, Corrupted Dungeons[/b][/*][/list]There’s something refreshing about a channel that cuts [b]straight to the action[/b], and that’s exactly what you’ll find with [b]Fakturka[/b]. His content is a throwback to classic “just play” streams: no distractions, no drama, just smart builds and sharp strategies.

[previewyoutube=0qG59wlIA_w?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
Streaming daily in Albion Europe while testing weapons, climbing ranks, or kicking off another zero-to-hero run, he’s all about clean [b]PvP fights[/b] with precision and adaptability. And if you think you’ve got the edge in a 1v1, be warned. Fakturka has a habit of turning would-be champions into highlight reel material.

A longtime fan of the original Corrupted Dungeons, Fakturka keeps that spirit alive with every duel he takes. He’s not interested in abusing metas or cheese strats, he simply shows what works when [b]skill meets focus[/b]. Now, as a new Ambassador, he’s bringing that philosophy to a wider stage. His YouTube videos often open with brief, practical explanations of his current build, then dive straight into extended footage showing how it holds up in real combat. It’s a clear, honest, and highly watchable [b]teaching-by-doing[/b] approach.

[previewyoutube=PSAEkstTpvA?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
While Fakturka streams primarily in Russian, his content is crafted for a global audience, with English intros, subtitles, and descriptions that make it easy to follow. So if you’re into gameplay that speaks for itself, Fakturka’s channel is a must-watch. Catch him live, or tune in to AlbionTV on April 25 to meet the duelist behind the clips – and don’t miss your chance to win a [b]Demon Hunter[/b] vanity skin during the broadcast!

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 6
notes.content:
[quote][i]This light patch brings a handful of balance tweaks, background optimizations, and minor fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Evensong and Locus have fallen out of favor as Great Arcane has grown increasingly valued. Their cooldowns have been adjusted to promote variance in the arcane support slot.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Dark Sphere (Evensong)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 42s → 38s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Void (Malevolent Locus)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 68s → 62s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Time Freeze (Great Arcane Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 45s → 50s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]As most Frost players have shifted toward Frozen Surge and sustain builds, some damage has been added back to Ice Shard to better reward cast speed-focused setups.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ice Shard (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage vs players: 125 → 130[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Spears[/b]

[quote][i]Cripple’s damage has been increased, as it was too conservative for a low-range, single-target ability that requires users to hold it for the right moment.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Cripple (all Spears)	[list]		[*]Damage: 106.03 → 120[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]

[quote][i]Hamstring’s first cast has felt underwhelming for players, so its base slow duration has been increased, the time window to cast Heroic Leap extended, and the cooldown when not multicasting reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Hamstring (all Swords)	[list]		[*]1st cast cooldown: 10s → 8s[/*]		[*]Time window duration: 3s → 4s[/*]		[*]Slow duration: 3s → 4s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]

[quote][i]Create Opening’s restrictive range has limited its effective output, so its baseline damage and resistance reduction have been increased to improve its overall value.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Create Opening (all War Gloves)	[list]		[*]Damage: 72 → 80[/*]		[*]Pierce: 0.1 → 0.12[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Potions[/b]

[quote][i]Hellfire Potion has been a powerful addition for builds with heavy CC but limited damage. Its damage against players has been too high, especially when paired with Smuggler’s Cape in IP-capped content, so it has been reduced. To keep the potion attractive, its healing reduction has been increased.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Hellfire Potion	[list]		[*]Damage vs players (700 IP): 42.4 → 36[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (800 IP): 64.5 → 54.8[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (900 IP): 82.5 → 70.1[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1000 IP): 98.2 → 83.5[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1100 IP): 112 → 95.2[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1200 IP): 126 → 107[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1300 IP): 138 → 117[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1400 IP): 149 → 126[/*]		[*]Healing received reduction: 35% → 50%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Mounts[/b]

[quote][i]Take Cover! and Charge! have been reworked to improve performance and address behavior issues.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Take Cover!, Charge! (Command Mammoth)	[list]		[*]Buffs are now applied via an aura, and are removed when leaving this area[/*]		[*]Buffs are no longer purgeable[/*]				[*]High Command now correctly increases their effects for the full duration[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

notes.title: Behind the Banner: Militant
notes.content:
[b]Behind the Banner[/b] is a series that shines a light on Albion's many diverse guilds, from fierce PvP warbands to tight-knit social communities. Each episode delves into the identity, playstyle, and goals of a different guild, offering a glimpse into what life is really like behind the banner. Let's get started!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/90290fccdfbf8b628858031ab350a9ab8f5f9e47.png[/img]

[list]	[*][b]Guild Name[/b]: Militant[/*]	[*][b]Alliance[/b]: [WARC] War College[/*]	[*][b]Guild Leader[/b]: xSarge[/*]	[*][b]Date Founded[/b]: February 15, 2021 (Season 14)[/*]	[*][b]Size[/b]: 200 at peak, 85 active members since re-opening[/*]	[*][b]Primary Language[/b]: English[/*]	[*][b]Server[/b]: Albion Americas[/*]	[*][b]Discord[/b]: [url=http://discord.gg/Militant][b]discord.gg/Militant[/b][/url][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5b6e6cfe9d7343aa242a07d51309b8e2ec08056e.png[/img]

[b]Tell us about your guild.[/b]

Militant is an international, English-speaking Black Zone guild focused primarily on all sizes of ZvZ and PvP content. Our roster includes both veteran and newer PvP-centric players seeking competitive, end-game content. When success is measured by the tears of our enemies, Militant always wins.

[b]What sort of activities do you focus on?[/b]

We engage in small, medium, and large-scale ZvZ. Our members regularly roam for objectives, fights, and ganking. The guild typically masses once or twice per day during our main Albion Americas timers. As a full-loot split guild, members are rewarded for their victories through large loot payouts.

[b]What sort of members are you looking for?[/b]

We welcome players of all levels who share a passion for ZvZ and PvP. Newer players are encouraged to apply if they demonstrate the Militant three A's:
[list]	[*]Activity – Show up and support the guild when you're online[/*]	[*]Attitude – Be strong enough to avoid rage quitting after being killed or mentally breaking when receiving constructive criticism[/*]	[*]Ability – Have the general gaming ability to hit a few buttons in combination at the right time[/*][/list]If you’re interested, come visit us at [url=http://discord.gg/Militant][b]discord.gg/Militant[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/67b17018f03c0dd6ffccb72ac98c12ca80b96076.png[/img]

[b]Where is your guild primarily located in the Outlands?[/b]

Militant is currently based in Fort Sterling (The Best City). We are the Fort Sterling breakers of chains and destroyers of rental empires. When you choose to enter the bear’s den, you do so at your own risk.

[b]Do you have any rivalries or ongoing quarrels with other guilds?[/b]

Any and all reds. We don't discriminate, and we don't make non-aggression pacts outside of potential coordination for CTA objectives. We do things how we want, when we want.

[b]What are some of your most memorable battles or activities?[/b]

Militant has fought and won multiple wars. We stand for the people and for content – we are never renters or landlords to others. One of our most defining campaigns was [i]The War in the North[/i] – a five-month war now immortalized in a full-length movie:

[previewyoutube=LE1eS6PNAZQ?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What does your guild do for fun?[/b]

We enjoy our tight-knit community of like-minded gamers. We love to ZvZ, trash talk enemies, and scoop up all that juicy loot.

[b]What is your guild's approach to the game?[/b]

ZvZ content is king. Individual skill gets you kills, but teamwork and coordination win the fights.

[b]Do you have an overarching philosophy?[/b]

Militant's #1 priority is content and fights. We reject the rental empire mindset, the avoidance of combat, and the queue-to-win garbage. If we need to war, then we war – and we don’t quit until our enemies break.

[b]What are your goals for the future?[/b]
[list]	[*]2+ million players killed and 50 billion+ kill fame[/*]	[*]Drink the Tears of Our Enemies[/*]	[*]Season 27: Silver/Gold rebuild[/*]	[*]Season 28: Gold/Crystal – by smashing everyone we can[/*][/list][previewyoutube=wZX62rLNxTE?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What is your ultimate goal in Albion?[/b]

To disrupt the status quo and play the game as we see fit. Militant will win or die trying, and we always take care of our own.

[b]Anything else to share about your guild?[/b]

I’d like to personally thank the following for standing with me and Militant through Albion’s highs and lows: Re1nn, Mistee, Kate, Bone, Alex, Tomato, Hiccup, HeiHei, Zike, Element, Armyyyy, VasEdas, Doc, and our team mom Miss Saffiana. Special thanks to the players who motivated our return and helped us re-launch: MrFlako, Creen, Khelron, Worhaven, and SuuNY. And a very, very special thank you to l7wali, our Minister of Propaganda and Kingmaker legend.

notes.title: The Rites of Spring Returns: Now with Even More Chocolate!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/233129f5d5bd9da457a9a24bda8d35b215a94d27.jpeg[/img]

Spring has sprung in Albion, and the chocolate-fueled eggstravaganza begins soon! For two full weeks, the[b] Rites of Spring[/b] returns in a cocoa-rich celebration. From Fame boosts to combat-ready bunnies, get ready for an event full of loot, fluff, and far too many types of eggs.

After each server’s next maintenance, the chocolate rush begins:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: April 14 at 23:00 UTC – April 28 at 23:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas & Europe[/b]: April 15 at 10:00 UTC – April 29 at 10:00 UTC[/*][/list][h3]Snack for Fame[/h3]
This year, Albion’s bunnies have outdone themselves, scattering even more types of treats across the land. Find new [b]Chocolate Eggs[/b] and crack them open to get a [b]15% Fame boost[/b] for 30 minutes. Just don’t try sitting on these – everyone knows bunnies don’t hatch from eggs…

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fe26d93a31afb6ab98a2c7bc624d07c74c73f864.jpeg[/img]

[h3]The Cottontail Mafia Returns[/h3]
Oh, who are we kidding? Of course bunnies hatch from eggs! Keep an eye out for the rare [b]Cottontail Eggs[/b] during your egg-hunting adventures. These can be raised into Tier 8 bunny mounts with serious hop: the [b]Spring Cottontail[/b], a soft, snowy puffball of speed and bounce, and the rarer, darker [b]Caerleon Cottontail[/b], whose leap ends with a fearsome bite that roots enemies and sends them running. Don’t let the fluff fool you… these mounts bite back!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/624f050bc1743_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]Hunt for Spring Loot[/h3]
Wondering where to find all those eggs? [b]Spring Treasure Chests[/b] will be popping up across the open world, packed with Chocolate Eggs and, if fortune favors you, a Cottontail Egg or two.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/85a6cd1548e1db89cb5c8d1b1622dff8a56f6c93.jpeg[/img]

Meanwhile, [b]Colored Eggs[/b] have also returned. These vibrant finds may [i]also[/i] contain Chocolate Eggs and, on very rare occasions, a Cottontail Egg. But that’s not all: you might also uncover [b]Chocolate bars[/b] to boost your Energy, and, most importantly, [b]Surprise Eggs[/b]. Bring those to the Vanity Merchant and trade them for seasonal delights like the [b]Bunny Stalker[/b] wardrobe, the [b]Snow Bunny Hat[/b] that spawns cuddly companions, or the coveted [b]Eggsecutioner[/b] – an overengineered contraption that lobs eggs and spawns critters on impact.

Phew! At this point, we’ve got more eggs than sense, and more chocolate than any one adventurer should safely eat.

It’s chaotic, it’s egg-cellent, and it all begins very soon. Hop to it!

notes.title: A New Batch of Crystal Weapons is Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1b3925a40474f859512772a751b0dc4814ece472.png[/img]

With [b]Guild Season 26[/b] concluded and rewards distributed, a new set of [b]Crystal Weapons[/b] has been unlocked for crafting. Those who have earned the necessary Artifacts from [b]Conqueror’s Chests[/b] can now forge and wield the latest additions to this powerful and prestigious category, each offering unique battlefield potential and high-end tactical versatility.

Let’s take a closer look at what this trio of weapons brings to Albion’s battlegrounds:

[h3]Flamewalker Staff (Fire Staff)[/h3]
Spell: [b]Spontaneous Combustion[/b]

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/67f3be6257861_720.mp4[/video]

This is fire magic with the heat cranked all the way up. [b]Spontaneous Combustion[/b] transforms you into a living fireball, letting you crash through enemy lines while immune to new spells, damage, and crowd control. Enemies you pass will be set ablaze, and if you land on an opposing player, the spell's cooldown partially resets, making it ideal for follow-ups or escapes. Perfect for bursting single targets, it also has potential in team fights, offering fire users a bold tool for breaking through frontline defenses.

[h3]Forgebark Staff (Nature Staff)[/h3]
Spell: [b]Dual Nature[/b]

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/67f3be8395447_720.mp4[/video]

Who says healers can't lead the charge? [b]Dual Nature[/b] is a two-pronged spell, giving Nature Staff users the power to either anchor their team with Fortify – shielding and healing teammates while enhancing their own healing output – or flip the script with Ensnare to root enemies and boost your allies’ damage. The ability encourages fast decision-making and makes it possible to switch from support to disruption in the blink of an eye. A bold pick for healers who want to step up and shake up the frontline.

[h3]Arclight Blasters (Crossbow)[/h3]
Spell: [b]Flickershots[/b]

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/67f3be514d589_720.mp4[/video]

[b]Flickershots[/b] brings the boom, the bounce, and the bolt spam. This ability sends you dashing a short distance while unleashing a barrage of energy bolts in a wide radius, damaging enemies and granting resistances mid-move. You can recast it up to three times, but each use increases its cooldown – so pick your moments carefully. Whether you’re peppering the enemy backline or executing a quick in-and-out, this is a spell that rewards calculated aggression.


This latest trio of Crystal Weapons brings fresh firepower to Albion’s elite battlefields. Designed for high-level PvP, each one offers a new way to outmaneuver, outplay, and outlast your opponents.

For those already looking ahead: the next batch of Crystal Weapons is set to arrive with Albion’s next major update. Until then, it’s time to take to the battlefield with fire, magic, and unrelenting force.

notes.title: Ambassador Spotlight: Argoldh
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2621a656f90b9c3803b947f988d46364d969e623.png[/img]

Back in March, [b]AlbionTV[/b] ([url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url]) had the opportunity to sit down with none other than [b]Argoldh[/b] for a chill, prime-time chat during Arena match breaks. With AlbionTV now on a short break during the off-season, we’re taking the opportunity to give this endlessly positive French streamer the spotlight he deserves.

[h3]Argoldh[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Argoldh][b]youtube.com/@Argoldh[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/argoldh][b]twitch.tv/argoldh[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Outlands roaming & Faction Warfare (Lymhurst pride!)[/b][/*][/list][b]Argoldh[/b] is the kind of streamer that makes the Black Zone feel like a living room. A founding member of the Ambassador program, he’s been [b]live almost every day[/b] for over a year at 5–6 UTC (except Mondays – because who streams on Monday mornings?). He’s become a go-to companion for Albion Europe’s early risers, gatherers, and solo adventurers looking for a place to hang out, ask questions, or just vibe in either French or English.

[previewyoutube=Dbldvaj2NCQ?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
As an Ambassador, Argoldh’s impact goes beyond content. [b]He’s all about community[/b]. His streams are part survival guide, part social lounge, and are full of curious builds, spontaneous tips, and running commentary on why [i]that guy over there is[/i] [i]definitely not solo[/i]. He’s known for making new players feel welcome, breaking down decisions in real time, and posting beginner-friendly tutorials on YouTube to make Albion’s more intimidating content easier to approach.

[previewyoutube=czmJzNSWQEk?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
From chasing billions in Silver and Fame to leveling every magic weapon under the most absurd conditions possible, Argoldh’s goals may be ridiculous, but [b]they’re always entertaining[/b]. He’s also on a personal quest to improve his English, so if you stop by and chat, you’re not just joining a stream, you’re helping a fellow adventurer level up IRL. Just expect a mix of different languages, dad jokes, and at least one viewer begging him [i]not[/i] to make that pun.

So if you’re looking for a stream that feels like a laid-back guild voice chat – where the advice is solid, the energy is chill, and the jokes are… well, still in beta – then Argoldh’s channel is the perfect place to park while you roam.

notes.title: Dev Talk: Meet the New Creative Directors
notes.content:
Today’s Dev Talk is a bit different than usual, because after 11 years at the helm of Albion Online, [b]Robin Henkys[/b] is stepping down as Game Director. While he will continue to play a role in the development of the game, Robin is taking a step back from his day-to-day responsibilities in order to focus more on his family. Overall creative leadership will pass on to three longstanding members of the senior design team – [b]Moritz Bokelmann[/b], [b]Michael Schwahn[/b], and [b]Jon Craft[/b].

[previewyoutube=bciBKtPuS6I?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
Robin had this to say about the transition:
[quote]
[i]“After 11 years as Game Director, I’ve recently stepped down from this responsibility and I’m passing it into new hands. We wanted to make sure this transition was handled with care, and most importantly, with continuity in mind. Rather than bringing someone in from outside, we’ve looked inward and promoted from within.[/i]

[i]The people stepping into the design leadership roles are long-standing members of our senior design team – people who have been in the trenches of Albion’s development for many years, and who many of you know well. They know this game inside and out, and they’ve helped me to shape its direction.
I’m really thankful for the joy Albion has given me over the years, and I want to thank all of you for continuing to be a part of that.[/i]

[i]I’m really looking forward to seeing where the team takes the game from here. It’s an exciting time for Albion Online, after all. The game is bigger than it ever was, and there are more people working on it than ever before. I’m also still going to be a part of that. [/i]

[i]Even now, I’m working in the background on long term plans for the game, expanding the world of Albion and its backstory. I also won’t completely disappear from videos. In fact, please let us know in the comments what questions you may have about this transition, and we’ll make sure to answer them if we can.”[/i]
[/quote]
Robin’s tenure as Game Director saw Albion Online go from strength to strength, with many important milestones along the way, and his impact has been immeasurable. The new creative leadership team bring boundless passion, experience, and talent to the game, though, and its future is in good hands indeed.

For Robin’s full statement, and to hear from two of the new Creative Directors, check out the video above. And if you have questions, post them in the comments – we’ll be back with a new video to address them soon!

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 5
notes.content:
[quote][i]This patch focuses on Guild Season content, introducing the next batch of Crystal Weapons and several balance changes to shake up the ZvZ meta ahead of the new season.[/i][/quote]
[h3]New Crystal Weapons[/h3]

This patch introduces three brand-new Crystal Weapons, craftable from Artifacts awarded in Conqueror’s Chests at the end of Season 26. Each Crystal Weapon has its own unique, powerful spell:[list]	[*][b]Flamewalker Staff[/b] (Fire Staff): [b]Spontaneous Combustion [/b]transforms you into a raging fireball, flying towards your enemies and dealing damage to those in your path[/*]	[*][b]Forgebark Staff [/b](Nature Staff): [b]Dual Nature[/b] allows you to switch between fortifying your allies and ensnaring your enemies[/*]	[*][b]Arclight Blasters[/b] (Crossbow): [b]Flickershots [/b]unleashes a barrage of energy bolts as you spin through the air, dealing damage and increasing your resistances[/*][/list]
[h3]Season 27 Changes[/h3]

The following categories in the Conqueror's Challenge have had their Might requirements per level reduced, while their Season Point output for each level has also been reduced to maintain overall Season Point payouts:

[b]Treasures[/b][list]	[*]Might needed per Level: 13,000 → 10,400	[list]		[*]Season Points per Level: 20 → 16[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crystal Creatures[/b][list]	[*]Might needed per Level: 6,000 → 4,000	[list]		[*]Season Points per Level: 30 → 20[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Smugglers[/b][list]	[*]Might needed per Level: 34,000 → 27,200	[list]		[*]Season Points per Level: 20 → 16[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]Gathering has also had its Might requirement per level reduced, to make it easier for smaller guilds to earn Season Points from this activity:

[b]Gathering[/b][list]	[*]Might needed per Level: 3,500 → 2,700[/*][/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Smuggler Crates are now visible on the minimap to everyone in the same region[/*]	[*]Players can now send only one message every two seconds in the following chat channels:	[list]		[*]Say[/*]		[*]Whisper[/*]		[*]Help[/*]		[*]Faction[/*]		[*]Faction Local[/*]		[*]All language channels[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The following automated chat message has been changed:	[list]		[*]“Player x has committed suicide.” → “Player x has died.”[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Text entered in the Marketplace UI search box now carries over when switching between the Buy and Buy Order tabs[/*]	[*]The Kills and Deaths tabs in the Player Stats UI now remember the previous dropdown selection on opening[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b]
[quote][i]Despite multiple nerfs, Infernal Scythe has continued to dominate as the ZvZ damage dealer of choice, crowding out alternatives. The damage of the second swing has been increased but converted into a DoT to disincentivize zergs from running five per party.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Bloody Reap (Infernal Scythe)	[list]		[*]2nd swing now deals damage in 3 ticks over 2 seconds (doesn’t stack)[/*]		[*]Damage per tick below 40%: 85 (total damage 220 → 255)[/*]		[*]Damage per tick above 40%: 47 (total damage 120 → 141)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Raging Blades has been a powerful component of axes’ domination in ZvZs, so its area has been reduced to limit its effectiveness in the largest fights.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Raging Blades (all Axes)	[list]		[*]Radius: 6m → 5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crossbows[/b]
[quote][i]Energy Shaper has remained a niche pick in ZvZs. Its total channel duration has been reduced, while the damage per tick has been increased to make accurate beams deadlier in a shorter time.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Divine Engine (Energy Shaper)	[list]		[*]Channel duration: 3.3s → 2.6s (Total ticks 11 → 9)[/*]		[*]Damage per tick (vs players): 96 → 117[/*]		[*]Damage per tick (vs mobs): 57 → 70[/*]		[*]Initial tick: 0.2s → 0.1s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Daggers[/b]
[quote][i]Because Demonfang has been a menace in ZvZ, it has received multiple nerfs to damage and resilience penetration over previous patches. Some of that damage has now been restored.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Blood Ritual (Demonfang)	[list]		[*]Damage per cast: 106 → 112[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Due to the significant setup required for Ring of Death, its penalty for misexecution has been softened, giving Twin Slayer players more opportunities to land the one-shot.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ring of Death (Twin Slayers)	[list]		[*]1st cast cooldown: 25s → 15s[/*]		[*]Energy cost: 12 → 10[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Fire Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Raging Flare’s damage has been condensed and increased to provide Fire users with a quicker, more impactful long-range damage option.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Raging Flare (all Fire Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 0.6s → 0.4s[/*]		[*]Impact damage: 186 → 205[/*]		[*]DoT ticks: 6 → 3 (1s interval unchanged)[/*]		[*]DoT damage per tick: 7.2 → 21.4[/*]		[*]Total DoT damage: 43.2 → 64.2[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Frost’s spell stack requirement has been reduced, as it felt too high on builds using less spammable abilities like Frozen Surge and Frost Nova. This will help Frost players keep enemies locked down more consistently.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Frost (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Stack requirement: 5 → 4[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Icicle Staff has remained a niche defensive tank option in ZvZs, but its dramatic hit delay has made it feel outdated in modern Albion, so this has been reduced to improve responsiveness.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Frozen Hell (Icicle Staff)	[list]		[*]Hit delay: 0.7s → 0.3s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Permafrost has been a strong ZvZ option, but its crowd control when stacked as an 8-man bomb squad has left too little room for reaction. With such a consistently valuable long-range stun, its damage has been reduced to compensate.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ice Crystal (Permafrost Prism)	[list]		[*]Damage: 184.69 → 173[/*]		[*]Stun duration now ignores diminishing returns (but does not apply it)[/*]		[*]Stun duration no longer refreshes by consecutive Ice Crystal stuns[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Hammers[/b]
[quote][i]Grovekeeper has fallen out of favor as both an engage and peel tank option. The bonus resistances for hitting targets have not felt impactful to Grovekeeper players, so they have been removed in favor of an instant knock-up, making engages more deadly, even against enemy cleanses.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ground Pound (Grovekeeper)	[list]		[*]Removed: Increased resistances per targets hit[/*]		[*]Added: Knocks up all targets for a duration based on the amount of enemies hit		[list]			[*]1, 2, or 3 enemies hit: 0.4s knock up[/*]			[*]4, 5 or 6 enemies hit: 0.8s knock up[/*]			[*]7 or more enemies hit: 1.2s knock up[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]To help Exalted Staff feel more responsive and succeed in its intended role of clearing hostile ground areas, its long cast time has been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sanctify (Exalted Staff)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 1s → 0.6s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Maces[/b]
[quote][i]Dreadstorm Monarch has struggled to find a strong foothold in the meta. As a result, the value of Eye of the Storm’s uncleansable resistance reduction has been increased, to help it compete with alternative pierce options.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Eye of the Storm (Dreadstorm Monarch)	[list]		[*]Resistance reduction: 0.15 → 0.18[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Vendetta’s pull hit delay has felt overly generous to opponents, so it has been shortened to help Camlann compete with other clump tank options.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Vendetta (Camlann Mace)	[list]		[*]Hit delay: 1.5s → 1.2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Protection of Nature has been a strong defensive tool with a very high uptime. Its high damage reduction, paired with the bonus healing received, has resulted in targets having too much survivability too often in smaller-scale group fights, so its resistance has been reduced somewhat.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Protection of Nature (all Nature Staffs)	[list]		[*]Resistance: 0.24 → 0.2[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b]
[quote][i]To help Fatal Blades counter fast ZvZ engages, its damage reduction now stacks higher and faster, but with reduced duration.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Fatal Blade (Black Monk Stave)	[list]		[*]Damage reduction (vs. players): 22% → 30%[/*]		[*]Duration: 6s → 5s[/*]		[*]Initial tick: 0.25s → 0.1s[/*]		[*]Projectile speed: 30 m/s → 35 m/s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Soul Shaker has fallen out of favor as a viable defensive tank option in ZvZs. To help players better protect their team’s flanks, its root duration has been increased to match its area duration.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Soul Shaker (Grailseeker)	[list]		[*]Area duration: 4s → 3.5s[/*]		[*]Root duration: 3s → 3.5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Soulscythe has remained a niche shotcaller option in ZvZs, so its standtime has been reduced to make it feel more responsive and return control to its users more quickly.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Tornado (Soulscythe)	[list]		[*]Standtime: 0.7s → 0.4s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Spears[/b]
[quote][i]While Cripple has been a good tool to counter swords, adjustments have been made to help it feel powerful in more situations, more often.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Cripple (all Spears)	[list]		[*]Damage type: magical → physical[/*]		[*]Added: Auto-attack speed is reduced by 25% for 4s[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 18s[/*]		[*]Move speed buff duration: 5s → 4s[/*]		[*]No longer gives bonus damage when purging a sprint[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]
[quote][i]The previous buff to Blade Cyclone has been reverted, as it became the default option and outperformed all other options, particularly for Carving and Infinity Blade players.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Blade Cyclone (all Swords)	[list]		[*]1 charge damage: 70 → 60[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]
[quote][i]To help Ursine Maulers find more success, the damage reduction from a previous nerf, originally paired with a significant resilience penetration decrease, has been reverted.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Hundred Striking Fists (Ursine Maulers)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 32.4 → 36 (vs players)[/*]		[*]Delayed damage: 27 → 30 (per stack)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Some of Infernal Boulder’s instant damage has been moved into its DoT component, to both reward skilled players for hitting all three boulders and to limit its effectiveness when stacked in ZvZs.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Infernal Boulder (Hellfire Hands)	[list]		[*]1st boulder damage: 199.5 → 177[/*]		[*]2nd boulder damage: 133 → 126[/*]		[*]3rd boulder damage: 66.5 → 76[/*]		[*]DoT tick damage: 14 → 18[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]
[quote][i]To make Protection of the Fiends more risky, its negative resistance penalty has been increased, making it more important to combo with allies or cancel the channel early.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Protection of the Fiends (Demon Armor)	[list]		[*]Caster resistance reduction: 0.34 → 0.37[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Taunt has been simplified to apply the same effects regardless of the selected target, while increasing its value as a short-cooldown damage option for Plate Armor users.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Taunt (all Plate Armors)	[list]		[*]No longer distinguishes between target types[/*]		[*]Bonus Damage vs All: 10% → 20%[/*]		[*]Defense vs Players: -10% → -20%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Capes[/b]
[quote][i]The Fort Sterling Cape has had its cooldown significantly reduced at higher tiers to justify its price increase and enable players to rely on it as a consistent cleanse option.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Untouchable (Fort Sterling Cape)	[list]		[*]Base cooldown: 139 → 168[/*]		[*]Cooldown reduction per 100 IP: 3s → 8s (118s → 112s at 700 IP, 91s → 40s at 1600 IP)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Potions[/b]
[quote][i]Invisibility Potion’s damage reduction has not been significant enough or lasted long enough to give opponents a fair chance to react to fully undetectable engages. Damage reduction has now been changed to reduce all damage dealt by players, making it harder to bypass the penalty with stacked damage buffs. The effect also lingers for 2 seconds after exiting stealth, rather than starting from the moment of use, giving players a chance to fight back if revealed early.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Invisibility Potion	[list]		[*]Ability damage reduction → Damage vs All reduction (-50% value is unchanged)[/*]		[*]Duration: Fixed time on cast → While Invisible, and remaining for 2s once revealed[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Other[/b][list]	[*]Judgment (Lightcaller) visuals have been updated to be more readable in large-scale fights[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Spinning Blades (Dual Swords): Fixed issue where immunity to Crowd Control persisted after impact[/*]	[*]Holy Beam (Holy Staffs): Fixed issue where stacks persisted after casting was interrupted[/*]	[*]Razor Cut (Bear Paws): Fixed issue where the same enemy could be hit multiple times[/*]	[*]Time Freeze (Great Arcane Staffs): Fixed issue where frozen enemies could still receive healing from lifesteal effects[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where the Arena queue timer would not reappear if a player canceled the match invitation[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where combat logs in the Death Recap would be overwritten by new actions performed on the player when switching tabs in the UI[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the ‘Take All’ button on the Marketplace would reset filters without resetting the filter text	[list]		[*]The text is now reset along with the filters[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where main dynamic action button on the virtual controller could appear to remain in motion after use[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Fixed issue where ‘Select Next Party Member’ keybinding option was missing from the Settings menu[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed Faction Warfare “connection bug”; it is now always possible to capture Outposts in a region if at least one adjacent frontline or backline region is owned by your Faction[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where it was possible for players to buy their own items at the Marketplace[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Rock Giant’s Aspect would not pursue players or use melee attacks[/*][/list]

notes.title: Watch the Final Invasion Day of Season 26
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ee58dbe7937da4b844f981d11da5ba5fdbf2dfeb.png[/img]

[b]Guild Season 26[/b] is about to reach its dramatic conclusion, and with the[b] final Invasion Day[/b] upon us, guilds across all servers are scrambling to make their last moves. This season was the first with the new shortened format, and it’s been wild from the very start. With only 59 days to fight and claim territories, the action has been fast and ruthless.

Before the final reset shakes up the Outlands one last time, [b]let’s take a quick look[/b] at how things stand:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Europe[/b]: The [i]Woof Woof[/i] coalition started strong but faced overwhelming pressure from the massive [i]GIRTH[/i] alliance. Their desperate defense of Deathwisp Bog turned into a bloody warzone, and despite holding out for several days, [i]Woof Woof[/i] eventually lost their home zone and withdrew from the race for first place. [i]Heralds of Valhalla[/i] stepped in to claim the top spot, but in a surprising twist, [i]Woof Woof[/i] returned at the end of March with one goal: deny [i]Contingent[/i] second place. With just 30,000 Season Points separating them, all eyes are on whether they can pull it off during the final point payout.[/*]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: [i]Peony Flower[/i] continues their reign with allies holding the second and third positions, making the top of the rankings look locked in. But behind the scenes, war has raged on. A fierce conflict between [i]1PIG[/i] and [i]JIN[/i] has turned Rivercopse Fount and Runnelvein Sink into contended battlegrounds, while the[i] XM Alliance[/i] has been launching bold attacks against [i]Peony[/i]’s coalition. Could cracks be forming in the reigning power? These tensions may not change Season 26’s results, but they’re already setting the stage for a potentially explosive Season 27.[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas[/b]: [i]IFures[/i] continue their steady march toward their third season victory and that coveted third gem. This time, with their coalition member [i]Outlimits[/i] in second place, there’s been no sign of betrayal… yet. However, the [i]CHEF[/i] alliance has kept things interesting, waging open war and contesting territories in a fierce final push. With [i]Make Albion Great Again[/i] still chasing second place, the pressure is on. Closing a 150,000-point gap would be a massive play, but this is Albion, and we’ve seen crazier![/*][/list][h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8dbc205d07064988c93d207c5860d8c0b0847424.jpeg[/img]

[/h3]
[h3]Watch the Battles Live on AlbionTV[/h3]
The final Invasion Day is more than just a reset – it’s the last chance for guilds to shift the rankings and cash in on high-value territories. Don’t miss the climactic battles across the Outlands as guilds clash one last time this season.

Catch all the action live on [b]AlbionTV[/b] ([url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url]):
[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: April 5, 14:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Albion Europe[/b]: April 5, 18:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas[/b]: April 6, 01:00 UTC[/*][/list]With only days left until the end of Season 26, the leaderboard is still in flux, and the tension is sky high. Who will triumph, who will fall, and who might surprise everyone at the last minute? Tune in and find out!

Already looking ahead to [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-27-coming][b]Season 27[/b][/url]? Then check out the [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/209673-Season-27-Schedules/][b]official forum thread[/b][/url] and get ready for another season of warfare. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Ambassador Spotlight: Hosshii_Japan
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/313400516443d2695699b0b980be2cd7b692816a.png[/img]

As part of an ongoing [b]AlbionTV [/b]([url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url]) interview series highlighting [b]AOCP Ambassadors[/b], [b]Hosshii[/b] will be joining the broadcast this [b]Friday, April 4[/b] at [b]20:00 UTC[/b]! Known for her fiery ZvZ battles and her uplifting energy, she’s got a story worth hearing – and we’re here to give you a preview before she goes live.

[h3]Hosshii_Japan[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@hosshiijapan][b]youtube.com/@hosshiijapan[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/hosshii_japan][b]twitch.tv/hosshii_japan[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]ZvZ & Mists PvP[/b][/*][/list][b]Hosshii[/b] brings a one-of-a-kind presence to the Ambassador program. Since joining after our last major update, she’s quickly become a bright and recognizable force in Albion’s competitive scene. Her high-energy [b]ZvZ streams[/b] are packed with fast-paced action and set to a banging J-core soundtrack that keeps the spirits high and the chaos fun.

[previewyoutube=5CSL8uJ4JJw?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
She pulls viewers straight into the action with live caller comms, low delay, and a front-row seat to Albion's most explosive battles. But what really makes her stand out is[b] the vibe[/b] – she’s always smiling and giggling (especially after ganking an unsuspecting gatherer in the Mists), which somehow manages to make even the most brutal clashes feel charming. Who knew that mercilessly killing your enemies could be so cute?

[previewyoutube=Hp2MdKJi4oM?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
Outside of ZvZ, Hosshii is documenting her growth in small-scale PvP across the Mists and Roads. She’s open about not having ‘pro-level’ mechanics yet, but that’s part of the charm. Her content captures the steady, honest [b]journey of improvement[/b], with all the heroic (and hilarious) moments along the way. She’s just being real, and her viewers love her for it.

As an Ambassador, she’s working to [b]shine a spotlight on ZvZ for Asian players[/b], showing that anyone can jump in – and maybe even giggle their way through a frontline push. If you’re into high-stakes brawls, community vibes, and the occasional panicked burst of Japanese, Hosshii’s content is your new happy place (≧▽≦)!

notes.title: Track Your Prey in the Hunter Challenge!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/51b0902b256574216a78cbabebb9ecc6d70f3238.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Hunter Challenge[/b] calls all master predators to the wilds for the ultimate test! Prove your skill, and you’ll be rewarded with the [b]Black Panther[/b], a formidable beast that boasts a powerful burst of speed, propelling its rider across vast distances in a heartbeat – [i]silent[/i], [i]swift[/i], and [i]relentless[/i]. Earn [b]Challenge Points[/b], claim your prize, and show the world you’re the apex predator!

[h3]Hunt Down Fantastic Items[/h3]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/65c7ebd0bcfd8882b852c1c9ac87eaa7c6954b21.png[/img]
[b]BLACK PANTHER:[/b] This month's Challenge sees the return of the mighty [b]Black Panther[/b], a sleek feline mount with a fearsome appearance. It boasts a powerful [b]speed boost[/b] spell that can propel its rider across large distances – helping both hunters and hunted alike.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/66c0235463c49befe79f1a8d85cc5c2f4f67d56c.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Reach your goals to unlock the [b]Hunter Challenge avatar ring[/b] to give your favorite avatar a hunting-themed border. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded for one [b]Adventurer's Token[/b] at the Vanity Merchant.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/343bde109e559187dfdfa642750988366c00824b.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Hunter Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver bags, and rare resources, this month's chests contain various [b]hunting-themed statues and furniture items[/b].

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/67d9809849357_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to participate in the Adventurer's Challenge[/h3]
The [b]Adventurer's Challenge[/b] is a monthly event where you can earn [b]exclusive rewards[/b] such as mounts, Tomes of Insight, bags of Silver, and more. By [b]gathering, fishing, farming, [/b]and[b] defeating monsters, [/b]you'll earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] that fill daily, weekly, and monthly progress bars. To track your progress, open the Adventurer's Challenge UI by clicking on the [b]Activities menu[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bbe632b8c242dd9526c11b8d54741acce88fee5a.png[/img]

While only [b]Premium[/b] players can unlock the [b]Monthly Rewards [/b](Avatar Ring, Mount) and [b]Weekly Rewards[/b] (Challenge Chests), anyone can claim the [b]Daily Rewards[/b], which include 10 Learning Points and a Tier 4 Tome of Insight. Non-Premium players also make progress on all reward tracks, so when you’re ready to unlock Premium, your earned rewards will be waiting for you!

notes.title: Ambassador Spotlight: MomoMonii
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3a72caf265b28c5d2f344d227e0d8a5d9df6782b.png[/img]

[b]AlbionTV[/b] ([url=https://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url]) is currently running a series of interviews with the [b]AOCP Ambassadors[/b], and this Friday is [b]MomoMonii[/b]’s turn in the spotlight. Tune in [b]Friday 28[/b] at [b]20:00 UTC [/b]for a chat that promises chaos, karaoke, and PvP insights in equal measure. Check out this profile to get to know her before the show kicks off.

[h3]MomoMonii[/h3][list]	[*][b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@momomonii][b]youtube.com/@momomonii[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Twitch[/b]: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/momomonii][b]twitch.tv/momomonii[/b][/url][/*]	[*][b]Main Focus[/b]: [b]Instanced PvP[/b][/*][/list]Meet [b]Momomonii[/b], one of the newest AOCP Ambassadors – and already a standout in Albion’s streaming scene. In just a short time, she’s built a name for herself as one of the most entertaining PvP creators out there. Why? Because she does what most players wouldn’t dare: [b]singing mid-fight[/b] while throwing hands.

[previewyoutube=p2joTqMT_2M?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
Specializing in [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b] and [b]2v2 Hellgates[/b], Momomonii thrives in Albion’s instanced PvP, where soft caps level the playing field and put the spotlight on skill, game sense, and creative tactics. [b]Healing[/b] is her tune, but she’s just as dangerous on DPS – especially when using wild off-meta builds that keep every fight unpredictable and explosive (for her opponents, mostly).

[previewyoutube=hIh6ajdbNgA?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
Her work as an Ambassador focuses on making Albion’s [b]PvP more accessible[/b], especially for newer players. She’s quick to hit pause on the karaoke to answer questions – in English, Polish, and Russian – offer practical advice, and share insights on everything from healing mechanics to build matchups and reading your opponent’s next move.

Who said being a healer was boring? Definitely not [b]Momo[/b]. So if you want sharp PvP tips, a chill stream atmosphere, and the sheer joy of watching someone hit both enemies and high notes at the same time, you've just found your new favorite content creator.
