notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Patch 4
notes.content:
[quote][i]This patch follows up on previous combat balance changes, enhances some less prominent weapons and abilities, and introduces additional changes and fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Dropped banners no longer reduce Fortification protection[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Stack and Sort buttons have been restored to the main Inventory menu[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Bows[/b]

[quote][i]Wailing Bow has been underperforming in ZvZs despite being the only ability with custom AoE escalation. We have increased the damage escalation per target hit to bring Wailing Bow back to its glory days.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Demon Arrow (Wailing Bow)	[list]		[*]Damage to 1st target: 189 → 189 (unchanged)[/*]		[*]Damage to 2nd target: 236 → 256[/*]		[*]Damage to 3rd target: 283 → 323[/*]		[*]Damage to 4th or more targets: 331 → 391[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Cursed Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]While Dark Matter has high damage potential, it has been too easy to counter. We have decreased its cooldown to improve reliability but have also increased the energy cost to keep the ability's spam potential in check.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Dark Matter (all Cursed Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 15s[/*]		[*]Energy cost: 10 → 16[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Sanctify’s unique ability to remove hostile ground effects created by enemies has proven less impactful than anticipated. As a result, we have increased its value as a traditional healing weapon.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sanctify (Exalted Staff)	[list]		[*]Healing: 122 → 138[/*]		[*]Range: 10m → 12m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Maces[/b]

[quote][i]We have given Dreadstorm Monarch’s Eye of the Storm additional damage and resistance reduction to help it command the respect it deserves.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Eye of the Storm (Dreadstorm Monarch)	[list]		[*]1st & 2nd cast damage: 39 → 50[/*]		[*]Resistance reduction: 0.12 → 0.15[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Vendetta’s cast time has been significantly reduced to help Camlann players hit their intended targets more accurately without requiring additional setup.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Vendetta (Camlann Mace)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 0.7s → 0.25s[/*]		[*]Stand time: 0.7s → 0.2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]The previous changes to Soul Link have been a step in the right direction, giving Iron Root players a legitimate reason to use the Ally/Enemy effect. However, with the increase in power, the reduction to the Ally/Ally effect was too conservative. The intent is to maintain the Ally/Ally effect as the powerful and consistent option it has always been.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Soul Link (Ironroot Staff)	[list]		[*]Ally/Ally healing transfer percentage: 50% → 75%[/*]		[*]2nd cast stand time: 1s → 0s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b]

[quote][i]We have added more value to the 1st and 2nd casts of Phantom Twin to help the Phantom Twinblade perform more effectively as a DPS Quarterstaff.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Phantom Twin (Phantom Twinblade)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 36 → 41[/*]		[*]Slow: 10% → 15%[/*]		[*]Added missing energy costs: 5/5/7[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Separator is emerging as an effective tool for singling out a target. To help it succeed in that role, we have increased its single-target damage.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Separator (all Quarterstaffs)	[list]		[*]Damage to target: 125 → 157[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]

[quote][i]Ravenstrikes have become a more viable option now that players are no longer at risk of dying without the ability to stop their own damage. Due to this increased consistency, their damage and speed while channeling have been reduced to give enemies more room to react and recover.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Earth Crusher (Ravenstrike Cestus)	[list]		[*]Self-slow: 25% → 40%[/*]		[*]0 charge damage: 175 → 155[/*]		[*]1 charge damage: 185 → 165[/*]		[*]2 charge damage: 195 → 175[/*]		[*]3 charge damage: 205 →  185[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]

[quote][i]Following recent buffs, we are happy with the adoption of Armor of Valor as a powerful defensive option with unique utility. However, tank items should not provide high CC, strong defenses, and significant damage in a single ability. The amount of damage it could return, particularly in 1v1 fights, was too high.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Requite (Armor of Valor)	[list]		[*]Damage: 46 → 31[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]Mage Sandals have fallen out of favor in modern Albion, so we have added a new resistance buff upon landing. Additionally, changes have been made to make it harder for enemies to predict the exact landing location.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Delayed Teleport (Mage Sandals)	[list]		[*]Now increases resistances by 0.2 for 2s after landing[/*]		[*]No longer shows the exact ending position VFX to enemies[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Mounts[/b]

[quote][i]Tanks have been using Morgana Ravens as an additional CC option, overwhelming large groups of players by chaining long-duration fears. We have made changes to Raven Scream to address these issues.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Raven Scream (Morgana Raven)	[list]		[*]Now gives feared targets immunity to consecutive Raven fears for 15s[/*]		[*]No longer inherits the rider’s bonus CC duration[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Reactive Scream has been removed as it had the potential to put the mount's rider into combat uncontrollably, hindering their ability to flee.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Reactive Scream (Morgana Raven)	[list]		[*]Removed[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Potions[/b]

[quote][i]The recent change to potion swapping has made using Fish Bait inconvenient, so we have changed the way it is consumed.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Fish Bait (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Fish Bait is now consumable from inventory, rather than as a potion[/*]		[*]If a character had Fish Bait equipped in the potion slot prior to this patch, this will need to be removed before it can be used from the inventory[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Vengeful Sprint (Demon Boots): Fixed issue where the active charge count VFX did not display correctly[/*]	[*]Hellfire Potion: Fixed issue where it reduced healing cast instead of healing received[/*][/list]
[b]Salvaging Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where certain items would have a lower salvage value than intended[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where non-salvageable items would display a salvage value[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Keeper Bear and Giant mobs could knock players out of combat range, causing them to reset[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Morgana Fang boss would stand still while casting Splitting Claw[/*][/list]
[b]Albion Journal Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Restored progress towards the mission ‘Have the offspring of every type of animal’ that was lost with Horizons Patch 2[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Deliver a Weakened Wisp in Lethal Mists’ could not be completed in Greater Mists[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Directly sell 9999 preferred luxury goods to Caerleon’ would only count those sold in one of Caerleon’s Marketplaces[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Raise a Tier 7 Mount’ could be completed by raising a pig[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Get your very own island’ could be completed by having any type of island in your island list[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where ‘Kill or assist in killing players within one minute’ missions would not count assists[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Have 2 offspring from a single horse’ could not be completed[/*]	[*]Changed mission ‘Reach Guild Challenge Level 100 with your Guild’ to ‘Reach Guild Challenge Level 99 with your Guild’[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Talk: 2024 In Review
notes.content:
Another year is almost over, and it’s been a busy one for Albion Online, with four content updates bringing numerous new features and improvements to the game. With so much having happened, Game Director [b]Robin Henkys[/b], Co-Creative Director [b]Michael Schwahn[/b], and Head of Production [b]Moritz Bokelmann[/b] took a moment to recap the game’s development over the past twelve months and look ahead to what’s in store for 2025.

[previewyoutube=NYly30z8Duk?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Crystal Raiders[/h3]
2024 kicked off with the [b]Crystal Raiders[/b] update:
[list]	[*]This overhauled [b]Guild Warfare[/b] in Albion	[list]		[*]Added [b]Territory Raiding,[/b] allowing guilds to steal Siphoned Energy from their rivals[/*]		[*]This gave more options to smaller guilds, and added tactical depth to seasons[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]The first [b]Crystal Weapons[/b] were introduced[/*]	[*]The [b]Conqueror’s Challenge[/b] was revamped	[list]		[*]Players can earn valuable personal and guild rewards from a wide range of activities[/*]	[/list][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/252f4f4b1231f20c52bb1ab57218858e52fda8fb.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Foundations[/h3]
Improvements to guild warfare continued with Albion’s second update of the year, [b]Foundations[/b]:
[list]	[*]Guilds can upgrade [b]Fortifications[/b] in their territories, making them tougher to raid[/*]	[*]Attackers can use [b]Siege Banners[/b] to attack these Fortifications[/*]	[*][b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] reward active guilds, but provide a further incentive to attackers[/*]	[*]In the future, Fortification gameplay may be developed further with new siege possibilities, and options for less advanced players[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f52125b2645bc3b821e17a7e304db8f63f1a2ab.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Paths to Glory[/h3]
[b]Paths to Glory[/b] introduced a new achievement system: the [b]Albion Journal[/b]:
[list]	[*]This serves two main functions:	[list]		[*]Guides [b]new players[/b] through features, and encourages [b]older players[/b] to try new activities[/*]		[*]Provides tangible goals for each feature of the game[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*][b]Unique vanity items[/b] reward progress	[list]		[*]These are [b]non-tradable[/b], so act as a genuine mark of achievement[/*]	[/list][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fb14b20e5a9e82f42ca198a9542055397fb91892.jpeg[/img]

This update also overhauled the Roads of Avalon:
[list]	[*]Activities and rewards were [b]rebalanced[/b][/*]	[*]New activities were added, like [b]Tracking[/b][/*]	[*]As a result, activity in the Roads has increased significantly[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/182a5e794ec3c608213471cc14c27124aa0434e8.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Horizons[/h3]
The last update of 2024 was [b]Horizons[/b], which focused on revitalizing the open world:
[list]	[*]New points of interest were added	[list]		[*]These include [b]Dynamic Encampments[/b], [b]Boss Lairs[/b], [b]Dynamic Resource Hotspots[/b] and new [b]Crystal Creatures[/b][/*]	[/list][/*]	[*][b]Higher-tier mobs[/b] were made more challenging, but more rewarding[/*]	[*]In the [b]Outlands[/b], rewards increase the deeper you go[/*]	[*][b]S.A.F.E. Portals[/b] transport solo players to random locations in the Outlands[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7be72f2174df1694eb441b1c1a1724a3273f2002.jpeg[/img]

Horizons also brought many more significant improvements, like the [b]HUD Editor[/b], [b]Tier 6 Yellow Zones[/b], and two further Albion Journal categories.

[h3]Looking Ahead[/h3]
The next update is currently in production, bringing with it:
[list]	[*]Further exciting additions to the [b]Outlands[/b], such as:	[list]		[*]New small-scale objectives[/*]		[*]New areas for non-guild players to base themselves[/*]		[*]New trade opportunities[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]New [b]Crystal Weapons[/b][/*]	[*]New [b]Albion Journal[/b] features[/*]	[*]And more…[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bdeca8f0bc2769a448b0d7b14c7e518625139c77.jpeg[/img]

2025 will see other significant developments and changes, for example:
[list]	[*]Measures will be taken to stabilize the [b]Gold market[/b] and address high Gold prices[/*]	[*]The [b]production schedule[/b] will be revised	[list]		[*][b]Seasons[/b] will be reduced in length to two months[/*]		[*][b]Updates[/b] will arrive every two seasons[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Other topics that may be addressed include [b]Hellgates[/b], [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b], the [b]new player experience[/b], and [b]Faction Warfare[/b][/*][/list]We’ll discuss these developments more in the new year. Until then, thanks for being part of Albion in 2024, and happy holidays!

notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Patch 3
notes.content:
[quote][i]This patch further refines the Horizons update with tweaks and fixes. We are also reintroducing developer notes for Combat Balance changes to provide more context for these adjustments.[/i]

[b]Note for Android users: With this patch, we are rolling back the recent platform migration introduced with the Horizons Update. This will again require a larger-than-normal installation. If you experience space issues, please uninstall the Albion Online app before performing a clean install.[/b][/quote]
[h3]Changes and Improvements[/h3]

[b]Albion Journal Missions[/b][list]	[*]Collect 20 offspring in 10 minutes on a single island → Have offspring from 10 different animals[/*][/list]
[b]HUD Editor[/b][list]	[*]Default Spells and their Transformation Spells are now always displayed	[list]		[*]If Vanity Spells are in use, they will switch to the default spells while the HUD Editor is open[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Dynamic Encampments[/b][list]	[*]Lair Maps in Solo Encampments are now hidden until the Encampment's objective has been completed by a player. Once completed, the Lair Map becomes visible to all players	[list]		[*]This change does not affect Lair Maps in Group Encampments[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*][Mobile] Adjusted Custom Button Slot hotkey assignments:	[list]		[*]‘Recording Mode,’ ‘Walk Up,’ ‘Walk Down,’ ‘Walk Right,’ and ‘Walk Left’ can no longer be assigned to custom buttons[/*]		[*]‘World Map’ and ‘Destiny Board’ can now be assigned[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Frazzle has been outshined by Enigma Blade in DPS arcane builds, even in smaller group fights. We’ve increased its burst damage to make it more competitive, even if allies don’t take advantage of the powerful damage-amplifying component.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Frazzle (all Arcane Staffs)	[list]		[*]Now reduces enemy defenses before dealing damage[/*]		[*]Damage: 103.11 → 125[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Daggers[/b]

[quote][i]Bridled Fury players have struggled to find success in ZvZs, so we’ve reintroduced some resilience penetration to make Merciless Finish live up to its name.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Bridled Fury	[list]		[*]Resilience penetration: 30% → 35%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Ice Storm hasn’t been very popular, despite its high damage potential. We've reduced its travel distance to boost area denial and threat to keep chokes covered longer. We've also reduced its cast and stand times to make its use smoother.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ice Storm (Glacial Staff)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 1s → 0.5s[/*]		[*]Stand time: 0.5s → 0.3s[/*]		[*]Travel distance: 18m → 12m (1.2m/s → 0.8 m/s)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]We’ve smoothed out Sacred Pulse’s animation and stand time for a better experience in both PvE and PvP.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sacred Pulse (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Stand time: 0.5s → 0.3s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]

[quote][i]Counter is outshined by other War Gloves’ W abilities in most contexts. Extending the powerful defense buff should provide more flexibility, allowing players to either disengage more safely or follow up confidently after a successful counter.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Counter (all War Gloves)	[list]		[*]75% defense buff duration: Up to 1.2s → always 2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Ravenstrikes haven’t been performing well in ZvZs, despite recent buffs. A big downside is that while the damage can be reflected, the caster can't cancel the channel once the ability has started. So we’ve made the ability non-reflectable to make it less likely to die to Demon Armor in ZvZ. Since this makes it significantly more valuable, we’ve reduced its damage slightly.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Earth Crusher (Ravenstrike Cestus)	[list]		[*]No longer reflectable[/*]		[*]0.5s Charge-up damage : 179 → 175[/*]		[*]1s Charge-up damage : 190 → 185[/*]		[*]1.5s Charge-up damage : 202 → 195[/*]		[*]2s Charge-up damage : 214 → 205[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Helmets[/b]

[quote][i]Royal Helmet is currently only used by niche one-shot combo builds. To encourage tank and support use, we’ve significantly reduced its cooldown.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ballista Support Fire (Royal Helmet)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 40s → 30s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]

[quote][i]Dynamic Defense is strong and popular in ZvZs as both an offensive and defensive tool. Due to the prevalence of reflect, Dynamic Defense has been putting pressure on DPS players to strongly consider only magic damage weapons, as Jacket of Tenacity would do double duty as a strong defense against enemy reflect while also providing a damage boost that brings magic damage users close to the damage levels of cloth armor. We’ve reduced the maximum damage potential, but allowed players to choose the optimal defensive buff without losing access to the bonus damage.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Dynamic Defense (Jacket of Tenacity)	[list]		[*]20% bonus damage based on opponents weapon → 10% bonus to all damage types[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]Scholar Sandals have fallen short of their promise to be a complete energy solution, so we’ve significantly increased their mana regeneration.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Focused Run (Scholar Sandals)	[list]		[*]Energy per tick: 2.63 → 4 (max 26.3 → 40)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Demon Boots' movement speed was previously reduced to prevent them from being a guaranteed ‘get out of jail free card’. However, since they are now a fairly underused item, we believe they deserve a cooldown in line with other sprints in their class.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Vengeful Sprint (Demon Boots)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 40s → 30s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Potions[/b]

[quote][i]Underutilized potions have been given significant buffs to make them more competitive with their alternatives.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Acid Potion (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Increased armor and magic resistance reduction by 50%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Cleansing Potion (Tiers 3.1 and above)	[list]		[*]Added 30% movement speed buff for the duration of immunity only if CC or debuffs are removed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Hellfire Potion (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Added 35% healing reduction for 3s to all targets hit[/*]		[*]Increased true damage to players and mobs by 25%[/*]		[*]Cooldown 60s → 90s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Sticky Potion (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Increased damage reduction by 50%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Tornado in a Bottle (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Radius: 3m → 4m[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 90s → 60s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Misc[/b][list]	[*]Deflecting Spin (all Spears)	[list]		[*]No longer stops moving on usage[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mimic (all Arcane Staffs)	[list]		[*]No longer queues auto-attacks after casting[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where spells that activate at a certain health threshold would not be triggered by damage from potions[/*][*]Fixed issue where mounting up immediately after casting an invisibility spell would not break the invisibility[/*]	[*]Mend Wounds (all Armors): Fixed issue where it would sometimes override movement commands[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Morgana Occultists in the Mists would not spawn bats after using their instant ability[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where search filters would reset after switching tabs in the Marketplace UI[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where clicking a loadout shared in chat would also move the character to the clicked position[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Building Management UI of some tiers of Guild Halls and Houses could not be opened while inside[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Element Switch button could appear on invalid elements when opening the HUD Editor	[list]		[*]This button is no longer available on Desktop[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where selected emotes in the Key Bindings settings would reset when selecting a Custom Button Slot[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where the on-screen keyboard obstructed the Loadouts dropdown in the Marketplace UI[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where static Randomized Dungeon entrances in the Roads of Avalon would not be visible[/*]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: Spread the Joy and Claim Your Yuletide Yak
notes.content:
Refer a friend this winter season, the [b]Yuletide Yak [/b]is all the reason! With a jingle bell hat and gifts in its sack, this jolly steed will have your back. Unlock this mount with festive fervor, for all your characters on that server!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/6368d4d850008_720.mp4[/video]

The more friends you invite, the merrier your adventures will be! Form a festive caravan with your friends and earn additional [b]Fame[/b] and [b]Gold[/b] along the way. Here’s what’s available with each friend you invite:

notes.title: The Yuletide Challenge Brings Holiday Magic!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/887c6acfa5693e983b7f066b5da3544661037ab4.jpeg[/img]

It’s time to celebrate the holidays with the arrival of the [b]Yuletide Challenge[/b]! Tireless and true, the [b]Snow Husky [/b]will dash through icy winds and snowdrifts for you. With its fluffy fur keeping you warm on long winter nights, this good boy is the perfect companion for a season of triumphs and festive cheer. Let the Yuletide spirit guide your journey as you earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] this month to unlock this and other festive rewards!

[h3]Yuletide Greetings[/h3]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9ddc23c30b8fa56077944e0f5f3a72c8eeda3e83.png[/img]

SNOW HUSKY:[/b] You've got another chance to claim the charming [b]Snow Husky[/b], a handsome canine companion that will carry you through Albion's harshest terrain. Along with its strong base move speed, its Hunting Instinct spell gives a short but powerful speed burst.
 

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/aa747399b53699a7bd2eed5c6be3d296d1e4439c.png[/img]

AVATAR RING:[/b] Along with the Snow Husky, adventurers who reach this month's total point goal will unlock the [b]Yuletide Challenge Ring[/b], which gives your avatar a cheery holiday look any time of year. And remember: unclaimed Adventurer's Challenge Rings can always be traded in for Adventurer's Tokens at the Vanity Merchant!
 

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0f7030ae6ea3d3c0e75a7faa62b51498bb55d887.png[/img]

SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] Unlock Yuletide Challenge chests to get a mix of holiday-themed prizes, along with goodies like Silver, Tomes of Insight, treasures and resources. Each chest has a chance to give classic Yuletide decorations like [b]Presents [/b]and [b]Decorated Trees[/b] as well as the [b]Yuletide Candle, Wreath, Lantern,[/b] and[b] Candy Boot[/b]!

 
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/6749980a8fbd1_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to participate in the Adventurer's Challenge[/h3]
The [b]Adventurer's Challenge[/b] is a monthly event where you can earn [b]exclusive rewards[/b] such as mounts, Tomes of Insight, bags of Silver, and more. By [b]gathering, fishing, farming, [/b]and[b] defeating monsters, [/b]you'll earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] that fill daily, weekly, and monthly progress bars. To track your progress, open the Adventurer's Challenge UI by clicking on the [b]Activities menu[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bbe632b8c242dd9526c11b8d54741acce88fee5a.png[/img]

While only [b]Premium[/b] players can unlock the [b]Monthly Rewards [/b](Avatar Ring, Mount) and [b]Weekly Rewards[/b] (Challenge Chests), anyone can claim the [b]Daily Rewards[/b], which include 10 Learning Points and a Tier 4 Tome of Insight. Non-Premium players also make progress on all reward tracks, so when you’re ready to unlock Premium, your earned rewards will be waiting for you!

notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Patch 2
notes.content:
[quote][i]This patch makes some adjustments to features introduced with the Horizons update, along with combat balancing and some other important changes and fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Season 24 Winner Statues Unveiled[/h3]

The statues to honor the winners of Season 24 are now viewable in each server’s Conqueror’s Hall. Congratulations to the triumphant guilds!

[h3]New Boss Lairs[/h3]

The Boss Lairs introduced with the Horizons update have been revamped, with new layouts and visuals that better communicate their status as a faction boss hideout.[list]	[*]There is now a new Boss Lair for each faction (Undead, Heretic, Morgana)[/*]	[*]The +200% loot bonus for Boss Lairs has been removed, but now there are 3 chests instead of 1[/*]	[*]Each Boss Lair now contains only the boss, and no other mobs[/*]	[*]Their entrances in the open world have been modified slightly[/*][/list]
[h3]Territory Raiding Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Once a banner has been dropped and channeled, the time until it is destroyed has been reduced from 5 minutes to 3 minutes[/*]	[*]Raid Banners can no longer be used to raid a territory if an older Raid Banner is already active there, or if two banners are spawned simultaneously	[list]		[*]In order to raid a territory with your own banner, older Raid Banners must first be destroyed[/*]		[*]Raid Banners that need to be destroyed first are visually distinguished on the minimap[/*]		[*]If two Raid Banners are raised within 30 seconds of each other, one must be destroyed before the other can be used to raid[/*]		[*]Raid Banners that are raised later on in the battle cannot be used to prevent raiding[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Mob Combat Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Spells and combat behavior have been updated for a number of mobs[/*]	[*]Out-of-combat status in PvE now begins when the mob is killed, rather than when its corpse disappears[/*][/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3][list]	[*]As a followup to our Solo Dynamic Encampment loot increases in Patch 1, Group Dynamic Encampments now award less Fame and Objective progress to players if they are solo or in very small groups	[list]		[*]Our intent with this, along with the changes in Patch 1, is to create rewarding gameplay loops both for solo players in Solo Encampments, and for group players in Group Encampments[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mini roaming mob camps in the open world no longer spawn around World Bosses[/*]	[*]Equipping food or potions now puts all spells on a 10 second cooldown[/*]	[*]Enchantment Level 4 Treasure Resources are now more likely to unlock at Prime Time, rather than spawning at Prime Time and unlocking later[/*]	[*]Certain items are now less expensive to Journey Back or use a S.A.F.E. Portal with	[list]		[*]This mostly affects Randomized Dungeon Maps and Player Island furniture[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The radius of the Crystal Beetle’s ‘Magical Discharge’ spell has been significantly increased[/*]	[*]Hostile player count in safe regions now only counts players explicitly flagged as hostile, not unflagged players in open PvP areas[/*]	[*]Guild Codexes (guilds’ internal descriptions) can now be edited by any member with the ‘Change Guild Logo’ permission[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b][list]	[*]Relentless Assault (Crystal Reaper)	[list]		[*]Leaving the area does not end the spell[/*]		[*]Hitting enemies while outside of the area does not reduce weapon ability cooldowns[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Sanctify (Exalted Staff)	[list]		[*]Cast Range: 8m → 10m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Soul Link (Ironroot Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 12s[/*]		[*]Energy cost: 18% → 11%[/*]		[*]Duration: 7s → 5s[/*]		[*]Ally/ally effect:		[list]			[*]Healing shared: 100% → 50%[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Ally/enemy effect:		[list]			[*]Enemy healing redirected to ally: 30% → 50%[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Casting both parts on the same target now resets its cooldown[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Circle of Life (Nature Staff)	[list]		[*]Max targets: 5 → 10[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b][list]	[*]Soul Shaker (Grailseeker)	[list]		[*]Area duration: 3.5s → 4s[/*]		[*]Multicast time window: 3s → 5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Werewolf Transformation (Bloodmoon Staff)	[list]		[*]Bloody Roar lifesteal: 6% -] 8% (while below 40% health)		[list]			[*]Lifesteal is now only triggered by Werewolf form abilities[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Distortion (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 54 → 48[/*]		[*]No longer reflectable[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Sinister Swipes (Prowling Staff)	[list]		[*]Range: 4m → 5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Spirit Bear Transformation (Primal Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 5s → 10s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Tether Shift (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Dash now applies a shield to yourself which absorbs 200 damage for 1.5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Helmets[/b][list]	[*]Ice Block (Cleric Cowl)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 60s → 90s[/*]		[*]Removed 50% healing debuff while frozen[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b][list]	[*]Dodge (all Shoes)	[list]		[*]Added immunity to transformation[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Capes[/b][list]	[*]Devious Trap (Heretic Cape)	[list]		[*]Trap hit delay: 0.8s → 0.4s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Energy Reserve (Lymhurst Cape)	[list]		[*]Energy restoration: 80% → 70%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Battle Mounts[/b][list]	[*]Healing Sapling (Ancient Ent)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 4s → 3s[/*]		[*]Radius: 2.5m → 4m[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Ent's Blessing (Ancient Ent)	[list]		[*]Can no longer be interrupted[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Albion Journal fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Raise all different types of animals’ could not be completed because it required an obsolete animal[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Knock down another player in a Yellow Zone’ could be completed by knocking down oneself with self-damaging spells[/*][/list]
[b]Spell fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Avalanche (Hoarfrost Staff) could knock-up targets with forced movement immunity[/*][/list]
[b]Mount fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Phalanx Beetle and Roving Bastion dismount cooldowns were higher than intended	[list]		[*]Cooldowns are now 30 seconds[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Morgana Raven: Fixed issue where Reactive Scream’s fear would ignore forced movement immunity[/*][/list]
[b]UI fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where player count display would sometimes fail to update immediately after changing regions[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where player nametags would sometimes fail to display in safe regions[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where gathering tooltips would not scale correctly with window size[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where chat window size would reset after saving HUD changes[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Bandit Assault countdown would remain on the World Map after changing servers[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where, after an Arena battle, the Player Stats UI would open under the Arena Stats UI when clicking a player’s avatar[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where some UI elements would not function correctly after entering a Randomized Dungeon[/*]	[*]Various fixes and improvements made to the Travel Planner UI[/*][/list]
[b]Other fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where some mobs in the Hardcore Expedition ‘Fistful of Silver’ had higher resistances than intended[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Mists Encampments could sometimes contain mobs that did not count towards completing the quest[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where some Resource Guardians would grant too little Fame[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where rerolling an item’s quality would sometimes incorrectly state that the player’s inventory is full[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where saved frame rate settings would not be applied immediately after starting the game[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Forgotten General mob would perform a slide after its auto-attacks[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where guild logos on the ground of Guild Islands would appear mirrored[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where emotes could not be used with custom hotkeys[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Patch 1
notes.content:
[quote][i]This patch focuses on making adjustments to new features introduced with the Horizons update, along with important fixes to a few gameplay issues.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]Alternate Mount-up[/b][list]	[*]Running back to a mount when using the Mount ability in the half-mounted radius is now available as a toggle option	[list]		[*]This new option can be found in the ‘General’ section of the settings menu[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crystal Creatures Changes[/b][list]	[*]Crystal Cobra: Some abilities have had their damage and potency reduced[/*]	[*]Crystal Beetle: The Lightning Strike ability has had its duration and frequency reduced[/*][/list]
[b]Journal Changes[/b][list]	[*]The Journal mission ‘Your voice sounds familiar…’ has been renamed ‘Talk to yourself…’ and its reward has been adjusted:	[list]		[*]200 Ghost Victory Emote Charges → Master’s Tome of Insight[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Dynamic Encampment Adjustments[/b][list]	[*]Based on feedback, mobs in Encampments no longer have a Fame penalty, resulting in a significant increase in Fame gained per mob    	[list]		[*]Fame required to complete the objective has been increased proportionally to match the new values[/*]		[*]To mitigate the risk of creating extremely powerful Fame farms, Fame can no longer be gained from mobs after the objective has been completed or if the player is outside the Encampment area[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Tomes of Insight have been removed from Uncommon, Rare, and Legendary Caches to partially offset the increase in Fame[/*]	[*]Common Caches continue to reward the majority of their Tomes of Insight, but at a slightly reduced value	[list]		[*]Common Caches have been renamed to ‘Common Tome Caches’ to highlight their primary reward[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]As a result of Fame increases, Might conversions have increased accordingly	[list]		[*]To partially offset this, the Might rewarded for completing the objective has been reduced[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These changes result in an overall buff to the Fame gained from Encampments[/*]	[*]The changes above also apply to Mists Camps[/*]	[*]Solo Caches in Open World Dynamic Encampments have had their loot values (excluding Tomes of Insight) substantially increased[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Daggers[/b][list]	[*]Ring of Death (Twin Slayers)	[list]		[*]Improved Recall hit detection[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Arctic Volley (Arctic Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 15s[/*]		[*]Initial energy cost: 8 → 3[/*]		[*]Damage: 97 → 90[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Frost (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Effect now charges with 5 spells instead of 3 normal attacks[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Hammers[/b][list]	[*]Giant Steps (Forge Hammer)	[list]		[*]Damage: 110 → 125[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Sacred Pulse (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage vs mobs: 112 → 168[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b][list]	[*]Vault Leap (regular Quarterstaff)	[list]		[*]Range: 12m → 13m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Light Spark (Lightcaller)	[list]		[*]Radius: 5m → 4m[/*]		[*]Damage: 83 → 75[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Spears[/b][list]	[*]Fling (Glaive)	[list]		[*]Cast range: 4m → 5m[/*]		[*]Pull distance: 7m → 10m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

notes.title: Unleash the Steelplate Cougar by Referring a Friend!
notes.content:

notes.title: The Grim Challenge Creeps Back
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/ec1560b9441b828936377c59c79adf7e38cc0ecf.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Grim Challenge[/b] has risen, and with it a dark presence flickers its tongue, searching for its next victim – the poisonous [b]Pest Lizard[/b] is slithering from its tomb, leaving a trail of venom in its wake! By earning [b]Challenge Points[/b] through open-world activities, you can claim this toxic mount and other sinister rewards. Rise to the challenge and claim them before they crawl back into their crypt!

[h3]Pestilential Prizes For Intrepid Adventurers[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/37098394fc221f53b22942d5c2018a17b86b1dca.png[/img]

[b]PEST LIZARD: [/b]This month's Challenge offers another chance to claim the popular [b]Pest Lizard[/b]. This sleek, slithery mount comes with a [b]Toxic Cloud[/b] ability that causes enemies who touch it to become temporarily disoriented, and can be used to disrupt enemy players in numerous situations.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/fd248429c8bb16fadb892cc6075439f63762bd27.png[/img]

[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Grim Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], featuring a spooky skull-topped iron frame. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b4e8429d41f50d3444dd5beab0bf7fc0a7f824ca.png[/img]

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly point totals to unlock [b]Grim Challenge Chests[/b]. Along with valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, resources, and other loot, you'll also have a chance to unlock four furniture items: the [b]Empty Coffin, Grim Gravestone, Grim Lantern, [/b]and[b] Weeping Woman Statue.[/b]

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes"]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/67211fc695427_720.mp4[/video]

[h3]How to participate in the Adventurer's Challenge[/h3]
The [b]Adventurer's Challenge[/b] is a monthly event where you can earn [b]exclusive rewards[/b] such as mounts, Tomes of Insight, bags of Silver, and more. By [b]gathering, fishing, farming, [/b]and[b] defeating monsters, [/b]you'll earn [b]Challenge Points[/b] that fill daily, weekly, and monthly progress bars. To track your progress, open the Adventurer's Challenge UI by clicking on the [b]Activities menu[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bbe632b8c242dd9526c11b8d54741acce88fee5a.png[/img]

While only [b]Premium[/b] players can unlock the [b]Monthly Rewards [/b](Avatar Ring, Mount) and [b]Weekly Rewards[/b] (Challenge Chests), anyone can claim the [b]Daily Rewards[/b], which include 10 Learning Points and a Tier 4 Tome of Insight. Non-Premium players also make progress on all reward tracks, so when you’re ready to unlock Premium, your earned rewards will be waiting for you!

notes.title: Horizons is Live!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6d6512b0d8a42cfd90374f633a7e10ab01235d0a.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Horizons[/b] are open! Today sees Albion’s latest update arrive, bringing with it improved [b]open-world gameplay[/b], some huge new [b]UI features[/b], new [b]Albion Journal[/b] categories, and much more. And, as always, there’s a fresh [b]trailer [/b]to boot. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=_zw91Vj29nc?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Unexpected Encounters[/h3]
Horizons brings some brand-new features to Albion’s open world. [b]Dynamic Encampments[/b] are mob camps which appear in random locations for a limited time, offering loot, Might, and Favor to those who can complete them. And other shifting, unexpected objectives are appearing too: [b]Dynamic Resource Hotspots[/b] which offer a wealth of resources for a short time, [b]Coffers[/b] which offer rewards to those who find them, and [b]Lair Maps[/b] which provide access to a hidden Boss Lair. With these unpredictable objectives springing up, exploring the open world has new layers of depth, interest, and chance.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e8ed1561f5175f13a1d7743773f2b4b4071f4530.png[/img]

[h3]S.A.F.E. Travels[/h3]
Albion’s inventors have been hard at work, and by reverse-engineering Avalonian technology have developed the new [b]S.A.F.E Portal[/b]. This transports solo players from Portal Towns into unpredictable Outlands locations, offering a means to venture into Albion’s deepest regions. At the same time, the Outlands now increase in [b]difficulty and rewards[/b] the higher the region quality, encouraging exploration of their less-trodden areas. New Crystal Creatures – the [b]Crystal Beetle[/b] and [b]Crystal Cobra[/b] – roam the Outlands, providing frightening new objectives for groups. And the Royal Continent now has [b]Tier 5 Blue Zones[/b] and [b]Tier 6 Yellow Zones[/b], proving more valuable content before players enter the deadlier regions.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7e917bacb2a516d36dd0b411eb237bf6aa771b4d.png[/img]

[h3]Freedom at your Fingertips[/h3]
The [b]HUD Editor[/b] provides players with unprecedented control over their display, with the ability to adjust the size, scale and opacity of different elements, and move them around freely. These custom layouts can be saved and shared, and [b]Quick Settings Presets[/b] allow them to be assigned to a hotkey and switched for different gameplay scenarios. [b]Inventories[/b] now have adjustable icon sizes, a collapsible equipment display, and new sorting options, allowing far greater flexibility. And [b]Banks and Chests[/b] have improved UIs, too, with optimizations like the ability to repair items from within Banks.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e958fbf88f0370577185446eab6f99024d303ec0.png[/img]

With all this and more – like two brand-new [b]Albion Journal[/b] categories – there’s so much to explore across the Horizons. For the full patchnotes, click [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/horizons-update][b]here[/b][/url].

And if you want to see what’s new as soon as the update launches, our AOCP Ambassadors are exploring the new content on Twitch today! For more information, click [url=https://albiononline.com/news/horizons-launch-streams][b]here[/b][/url].

notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Update
notes.content:
[quote][i]Horizons reinvigorates the open world with a more dynamic, rewarding, and accessible gameplay experience, as well as enhanced PvE challenges. It also introduces significant quality-of-life improvements, new customization options, and two new Albion Journal categories.[/i][/quote]
[h3]New Open World Objectives[/h3]

New dynamic objectives appear for a limited time across the open world, cycling through active and inactive phases. Players must explore the world to uncover these areas while they're active, as they reveal themselves only when closely approached.

[b]Dynamic Encampments[/b]

Dynamic Encampments are temporary camps settled by mobs from each Faction, who protect valuable Caches:[list]	[*]These Encampments come in two sizes: Solo for individual players, and Group for parties of about 5 players[/*]	[*]Approaching an active Encampment activates a quest for the player or party that finds it, to earn a certain amount of Fame from clearing its mobs:	[list]		[*]Fame requirements scale with an Encampment’s tier and region type		[list]			[*]Quest progress is not affected by Premium or Fame bonuses[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Party progress is shared, as long as members stay within the camp's vicinity		[list]			[*]Fame is divided among party members, meaning larger groups will need to defeat more mobs to complete the quest[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Once a quest has been started, you can leave the region and return to the camp within 60 minutes without losing your progress, provided the camp hasn’t gone inactive[/*]		[*]Camps in Yellow and Red Zones are unrestricted PvP areas[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Clearing an Encampment rewards the player or party with access to a Cache containing valuable loot, as well as Might and Favor	[list]		[*]Loot distribution and rarity is instanced for each player[/*]		[*]If unclaimed, loot is automatically removed from these Caches 10 minutes after a camp is completed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]When a camp becomes inactive, all mobs, map markers, caches, and quest progress are immediately removed[/*][/list]
[b]Lair Maps[/b]

Lair Maps can spawn in mob camps - including Dynamic Encampments - giving players the chance to uncover a hidden Boss Lair belonging to the corresponding Faction:[list]	[*]These maps are unlocked by defeating Faction mobs within a radius around them, independent of the Dynamic Encampment’s quest[/*]	[*]Boss Lairs correspond to the size of the camp, whether solo or group	[list]		[*]Solo Lair Maps have a higher spawn rate in Solo Dynamic Encampments than in other open-world mob camps[/*]		[*]Group Lair Maps only spawn in Group Encampments[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Once a player interacts with the map, it disappears for everyone else[/*]	[*]Defeating the Lair’s Boss unlocks an additional chest, with its rarity only revealed once completed[/*][/list]
[b]Dynamic Resource Hotspots[/b]

A significantly higher density of resources now spawn in certain areas of the open world for a limited time, shifting locations on a daily basis.     

[b]Open World Coffers[/b]

New Coffers, similar to those found in the Mists, now spawn across the open world. These have a short unlock timer, offering quick opportunities for those nearby during their active phase.

[b]Further Notes[/b]

Hideouts and furniture cannot be placed where open world objectives may appear[list]	[*]Characters, Hideouts, and furniture will be removed from these areas when the update goes live:	[list]		[*]Characters and Hideouts, along with all their contents, will be automatically relocated[/*]		[*]Guilds are able to move their Hideouts for free for up to three days after relocation[/*]		[*]Furniture in the open world will be destroyed[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Outlands Changes[/h3]

[b]S.A.F.E. Portals[/b]

S.A.F.E. Portals can now be found in the Portal Towns of the Outlands, offering solo players a quick teleport to random locations within the Outlands. These portals provide a convenient way to reach the new dynamic objectives in higher-tier regions.[list]	[*]Destinations are random within each Portal Town's assigned section of the Outlands, with no overlap between S.A.F.E. Portal ranges:	[list]		[*]A map overlay highlights the portal’s assigned region, making it easy to identify the destination range[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Portal use requires a fee:	[list]		[*]This fee increases with each subsequent use within a limited time to discourage players from fishing for specific locations[/*]		[*]After using any S.A.F.E. Portal, there is a 30 second cooldown before another portal can be opened[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*] Personal portal mechanics:	[list]		[*]After paying the fee, the player is teleported instantly and appears through a personal S.A.F.E. Portal, receiving a region change protection bubble upon arrival[/*]		[*]The personal S.A.F.E. Portal location is indicated exclusively on the owner’s world and region maps, but it is visible in the game world when the owner is nearby[/*]		[*]The personal S.A.F.E. Portal remains open for 90 minutes, providing enough time for exploration and a safer, instant teleport back to the originating Portal City[/*]		[*]Using the personal S.A.F.E. Portal to return to the Portal City is free[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]S.A.F.E. Portals close under the following conditions:	[list]		[*]Its duration expires[/*]		[*]It is used to return[/*]		[*]The player dies, uses Journey Back, or travels to another safe location[/*]		[*]The player collects any items from containers or performs trades with another player[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Region Difficulty and Reward Modifiers[/b]

Rewards and mob power now increase progressively based on region quality, making higher-quality regions more challenging and rewarding:[list]	[*]There is now a bonus to gathering and fishing Fame in the Outlands, based on the quality of the Region[/*]	[*]Fame from gathering, fishing, and defeating mobs, as well as Silver and loot from mobs and chests, all scale higher towards the center of the Outlands[/*]	[*]Mobs have increased health and damage in higher-quality regions	[list]		[*]This does not apply to resource and territory mobs (such as Hide Animals and Territory Guards)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Outlands region maps now include a dropdown with information showing reward bonuses and mob strength modifiers[/*][/list]
[b]Outlands Player Count Indicator[/b]

A new player count indicator has been added to Outlands regions, offering a rough estimate of the number of players present.
[quote][i]This feature helps smaller groups gauge the presence of larger groups, allowing players to engage in fights of a more appropriate scale with increased confidence. We will closely monitor the impact of this addition.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Other Open World Changes[/h3]

[b]Royal Continent Changes[/b][list]	[*]Some Tier 6 regions can now be found in Yellow Zones, and some Tier 5 regions in Blue Zones, giving players access to a broader range of content before stepping into full-loot PvP zones[/*][/list][quote][i]These changes are carefully balanced with the new Region Modifier system and the increased availability of Dynamic Resource Hotspots in full-loot PvP zones, ensuring the high-end economy remains intact while still offering more content for newer or risk-averse players.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Tier 7 resources now spawn in Tier 7 Red Zones[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]Kill details are now suppressed for 5 minutes for everyone except the killer and the victim[/*]	[*]During a region’s Prime Time, the Next Activity Chest Value overlay now displays the current chest value instead of the upcoming one[/*]	[*]The value of Hidden Treasures has been increased by roughly 400%[/*][/list]
[h3]Mob Power Changes[/h3]

[quote][i]Player power has grown with every update, while mobs have lagged behind. This update reworks mob power progression from Tier 5 and up to match current player strength.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Mobs from Tier 5 and above now receive incremental power boosts, starting with a 9% increase at Tier 5 and 42% by Tier 8[/*]	[*]These adjustments do not apply to:	[list]		[*]Avalonians in the Roads of Avalon[/*]		[*]Tracking targets[/*]		[*]Demons in Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons[/*]		[*]Elite enemies in Randomized Dungeons and World Boss Areas[/*]		[*]Territory Guards[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]As mob power increases, corresponding rewards (Fame, loot, and Silver) will scale as well to offer more substantial incentives for taking on these tougher foes[/*]	[*]Note that these changes are distinct from the mob power changes mentioned above (in ‘Region Difficulty and Reward Modifiers’)[/*][/list]
[h3]Group Content Changes[/h3]

[quote][i]Albion’s group content is meant to challenge teams, but players have often found it more profitable to farm this content alone. These changes aim to make these activities more rewarding and enjoyable for groups.[/i][/quote]
[b]Reward Changes[/b]

Rewards for most group and raid activities have been adjusted:[list]	[*]Rewards now scale with group size, increasing significantly as more players are involved[/*][/list]
[b]Group Randomized Dungeon Changes[/b][list]	[*]Group Randomized Dungeon entrances now close a short time after a player enters	[list]		[*]Royal Continent: 60 seconds[/*]		[*]Outlands: 90 seconds[/*]		[*]As with Solo Randomized Dungeons, a channel is now required to enter[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Fame and loot rewards for groups of 3 or more players have been increased by approximately 50%[/*][/list]
[b]New Crystal Creatures[/b]

This update introduces two new Crystal Creatures to the Outlands, aimed at groups of about 5 players – the Crystal Beetle and the Crystal Cobra.[list]	[*]Crystal Beetle	[list]		[*]A powerful, winged enemy which can punish its attackers with lightning strikes and magical energy[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Crystal Cobra	[list]		[*]A vicious and intimidating reptile which can spit devastating, poisonous venom[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crystal Creature Adjustments[/b][list]	[*]All Crystal Creatures, including Crystal Spiders, now spawn much more frequently; their spawn rate is adjusted based on the overall Guild Season point output[/*]	[*]Each individual Crystal Creature now yields less loot and Might, to partially counterbalance their significantly increased frequency	[list]		[*]Loot rewards have been reduced by 56%, and Might by 83%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Crystal Creatures no longer grant Favor, so that their rewards can be more focused on loot[/*]	[*]Crystal Creatures are now only marked on the map when players are nearby[/*][/list]
[h3]Quick Settings Presets[/h3]

Quick Settings Presets allow players to save different configurations of in-game options and instantly switch between them with customizable shortcuts:[list]	[*]Presets can be accessed and managed from the bottom-left corner of the main in-game Settings menu[/*]	[*]Each preset can include settings from the following categories:	[list]		[*]General[/*]		[*]Graphics[/*]		[*]Audio[/*]		[*]Interface (including the new HUD Editor layouts)[/*]		[*]Controls[/*]		[*]Social[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players can either start a fresh preset, or duplicate an existing one	[list]		[*]A preset can then be customized by modifying settings as needed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Up to 14 presets can be saved for specific playstyle needs or activities, such as PvP, ZvZ, PvE, or gathering[/*]	[*]Custom names and key bindings can be assigned to each preset for quick switching[/*]	[*]Presets can be exported to share with friends, guildmates, or other players[/*][/list]
[h3]HUD Editor[/h3]

The new HUD Editor allows players on both mobile and desktop to fully customize nearly all aspects of their in-game interface, allowing for a highly customizable experience tailored to individual needs and playstyles.

[b]Customization Options[/b][list]	[*]The HUD Editor can be opened from the ‘Interface’ section of the in-game settings menu[/*]	[*]When entering the Editor, all HUD elements are highlighted on the screen, even those not currently active[/*]	[*]Players can freely move and adjust most elements	[list]		[*]Selecting Align to Elements snaps components to other UI elements[/*]		[*]Selecting Align to Grid reveals a grid for precise placement[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Each element can be clicked to open a dedicated settings window	[list]		[*]Here, adjust anchor points, scale, and opacity can be adjusted[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Some elements are part of predefined groups, allowing for simultaneous movement and scaling for easier organization	[list]		[*]Each individual element within these groups can still be adjusted independently[/*]		[*]Custom groups can be created[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Some elements have additional specific settings for further customization	[list]		[*]For example, the Status Effects bar can be configured to adjust its layout in rows and columns[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]On mobile, the offset to the screen edge can also be adjusted[/*][/list]
[b]Saving and Sharing Layouts[/b][list]	[*]After making adjustments in the HUD Editor, players can save their custom HUD layouts[/*]	[*]Up to 10 layouts can be saved for different activities[/*]	[*]These can be easily switched with the new Quick Presets feature[/*]	[*]Once saved, layouts can be quickly accessed from the ‘Interface’ settings menu[/*]	[*]To share a layout, players can copy it to the clipboard and share it	[list]		[*]This layout can be imported and saved directly into the HUD Editor[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Layouts are platform-specific and can only be shared between players on the same platform (PC or mobile)[/*][/list]
[b]Changes to Interface Settings[/b][list]	[*]The scale of the HUD layout is now adjusted independently from the window scale	[list]		[*]Window scaling now refers exclusively to UI windows like menus and popups[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Due to low demand, the default layout ‘Spells on Right’ has been removed	[list]		[*]Players who wish to use this setup can recreate it manually using the HUD Editor[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Inventory and Storage Improvements[/h3]

This update brings a number of significant improvements and changes to the Inventory, Bank, and Chest UIs:[list]	[*]The equipped items display above the player’s inventory can be condensed into a compact view	[list]		[*]This allows more inventory space to view carried items[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Item sizes in the inventory can be customized, allowing more items to be visible at once[/*]	[*]Items in a player’s inventory can be sorted by the following categories	[list]		[*]Weight[/*]		[*]Tier[/*]		[*]Estimated Market Value[/*]		[*]Estimated Value by Weight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Items can now be repaired from inside bank tabs, with the option to Repair All items in one click[/*]	[*]A new Move All button allows for easy transfers between inventory, chests and bank tabs[/*]	[*]Item search is now also available in the inventory UI[/*]	[*]The average item power of your equipped items is now displayed in the header of the inventory UI[/*]	[*][DESKTOP] When mounting or dismounting transport mounts, a visual indicator in the inventory and the HUD now shows your load capacity change[/*][/list]

Portals and Open World Coffers[/*]		[*]New Gathering missions related to Dynamic Resource Hotspots[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Improved automatic Journal mission recommendations and mission order[/*]	[*]Adjusted various mission conditions to enhance early-game progression[/*]	[*]Achievement mission progress elements in the Albion Journal UI are now fully clickable[/*][/list]

notes.title: Season 24 Wrapup
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2cafe4b272e6213fc8454544b0a01feca123d993.jpeg[/img]

[b]Season 24[/b] has drawn to a close, and what a season it was, with betrayals, uprisings, and devastation all round. So congratulations to season winners [b]Druyds[/b], [b]One Gin[/b], and [b]POLSKA GUROM[/b], and without further ado, let’s take a look back at the events of this most dramatic Guild Season.

[h3]Albion Americas[/h3]
Season 24 started as many before it on the Americas server, with the [b]IFures[/b] coalition in control and looking to push for another season title, but with the [b]BOBER[/b] coalition a constant thorn in their side.

With battles between the two coalitions raging at 18:00 and 20:00 UTC, [b]The Lonely Men[/b] were able to keep themselves in the shadow of the [b]IFures[/b] and [b]Druyds[/b] guilds at the top, spending most of the season in third. But things were about to come crashing down for IFures on the final Invasion Day, when all territory points are paid out as Season Points.

Druyds, who had been working with IFures for many seasons, now felt betrayed by their partners and the leadership of the coalition, as IFures prepared to deny them a season victory and claim it for themselves despite Druyds having put in most of the work this season and last. The lack of respect was felt keenly, and led to one of the most dramatic betrayals we've seen on Albion Online in many, many years.

Druyds and IFures were just 20,000 season points apart as the final Invasion Day began. Druyds’ leadership proceeded to reach out to the BOBER coalition, who they'd been fighting for many seasons now, to make a pact to deny IFures their third season victory – and for Druyds to claim it for themselves.

Three major territories were in play: [b]Runnelvein Sink[/b], [b]Razorrock Gulch[/b], and [b]Deathwisp Bog[/b]. These three territories held roughly 170,000 season points in total.

Druyds were gifted Runnelvein Sink from the BOBER alliance, while the main zerg forces battled it out and pushed IFures coalition back from the surrounding zones of Razorrock Gulch, which also fell into Druyds’ hands. But it wasn't all plain sailing, as IFures and their forces were able to wipe the enemy forces within Deathwisp Bog and claim it for themselves. After that it was a pure scramble for leftover Season Points, with both sides running around the Outlands securing any territories that offered points.

But as the dust settled, it became clear that Druyds were successful with their backstab, and emerged victorious to claim Season 24 for themselves.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/16577115145ab7bb38950edbb167f9d6b88eb98e.jpeg[/img]

[h3]FAX Wave Farewell[/h3]
As Season 24 came to an end, though, it wasn't all laughter and smiles as the Americas server bid farewell to a long-standing guild: [b]FAX[/b].

After three long years, with FAX rising from a group of friends to become a powerhouse within the Outlands and the political landscape, [b]Dazroun[/b] announced that FAX are calling it a day.

FAX were a guild who did what they wanted, and weren’t afraid to do what some considered impossible. They threw themselves into countless wars over the years, and were a ZvZ force to be feared... at least when Dazroun could actually land a Hand of Justice engagement.

But with that being said, we wish Dazroun the best of luck with whatever comes next, and to the members of FAX, we hope you find a new guild to call home for Season 25 and beyond.

o7 FAX.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f49619eb45ed2db660fd1c0c6ebaa4ad5bfa77be.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Albion Asia[/h3]
With three season victories under [b]PLAC[/b]’s belt, all eyes were on [b]Peony Flower[/b] for Season 24, with [b]Fuckcall[/b]'s leadership looking to push them to season victory. But the [b]SQUAD[/b] alliance, led by [b]One Gin[/b], had other plans.

The first two weeks saw the once-powerful PLAC coalition crumble, and with the SQUAD coalition taking control of key territories throughout the Outlands and destroying Hideouts along the way, it was soon clear that SQUAD were too strong and Peony Flower didn't have what it took to keep pushing for top spot.

Fuckcall then announced that he was stepping away for Season 24, which allowed One Gin and their coalition a smooth ride for the rest of the season, which saw One Gin break Albion Online’s [b]all-time Season Point record[/b]!

So congratulations to One Gin, not just on their Season 24 victory, but on writing themselves into Albion’s history books, with a final total of [b]1,397,546 points[/b]!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7676cfc62b92f104c997dd0d3ae95b6435c4ae08.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Albion Europe[/h3]
The second season on Albion Europe was by no means a quiet one. The season began with [b]Sex and Flex[/b] pushing for the title, and at first it didn't seem that there would be much contest. As the weeks passed, however, a certain group called the [b]BOBER[/b] alliance ([u]not [/u]the same as the BOBER alliance on Albion Americas…) started to creep up the season rankings, closing a gap that at one stage stood at over 250,000 Season Points.

Then things exploded. BOBER formed a coalition and declared war on the [b]FFlow[/b] coalition, stating that [b]POLSKA GUROM[/b] would be taking the season title. Battles spanned across multiple timers, day in, day out for nearly two whole months. It was a bloodbath for all sides, with thousands upon thousands of players dying in battle every day.

But as the weeks went on, FFlow’s lead slowly shrank, with their territories raided nearly daily and ownership changing hands constantly. It seemed that FFlow didn't have the strength to counter attack BOBER at 18:00 UTC (BOBER’s main timeslot), so as FFLow's territories failed to generate Season Points, BOBER’s strongholds were pumping them out without fear of a counterattack.

After two months of fighting, FFlow conceded their challenge, and both POLSKA GUROM and [b]Take Care[/b] overtook Sex and Flex on the season leaderboard. After that, it was a slow and painful death for Sex and Flex. With their territories lost to the enemy and their Hideouts destroyed, the only thing left was their Headquarters, which became a prime target and soon fell after the Power Level required to maintain it was breached.

It was a bloodbath of a season on Albion Europe, and congratulations are due to POLSKA GUROM on their victory, with their allies Take Care finishing second and coalition members [b]APE[/b] coming in third.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/99fdf4e98d98b4072b1a5feb7f59960be7887a59.jpeg[/img]

Phew, we need a break after all that. But there’ll be no such luck, as [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-25-coming][b]Season 25[/b][/url] begins on November 2! And there’ll be a very special event to kick us off, as the [b]AlbionTV[/b] crew will be broadcasting [b]live from the Sandbox Interactive studios[/b]. Tune in to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url] at the following times to see the action from each server:
[list]	[*][b]14:00 UTC[/b] on November 2: Albion Asia [b]live from Albion HQ[/b][/*]	[*][b]18:00 UTC[/b] on November 2: Albion Europe [b]live from Albion HQ[/b][/*]	[*][b]01:00 UTC [/b]on November 3: Albion Americas[/*][/list]
For a full rundown of the Season 25 schedule and changes, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/203539-Season-25-Schedules/][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: Allhallows Rises Again
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/44f10383c0cdf63604ac407b2f2e7bace0cfe5c3.jpeg[/img]

As [b]Allhallows[/b] looms, whispers echo from the void. An ominous shiver runs down your spine as you hear a terrifying creature clawing its way out of the ground... but wait, it's just [b]Bob[/b]. Yes, that pumpkin-headed nuisance is back, crawling from his grave to wreak more havoc.

This Allhallows, enter the [b]Hallowed Ground [/b]dungeon to face Bob and his twisted minions – but don't let his silly grin fool you. He's deadly serious about keeping his loot!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e1dfbd28eb379fdca736e3e8e1271d670e7e5249.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Spook your Way to Rare Rewards[/h3]
The Hallowed Ground dungeon can appear randomly in [b]T4-T8 regions[/b] in the open world, and can be recognized by the special [b]pumpkin-decorated portals[/b] that will lead you to Bob's lair. Defeat him to unlock a special chest, with a chance of getting the elusive[b] Jack o' Donkey[/b] or [b]Horse Macabre[/b] mount skins. Along the way you can collect [b]Allhallows Treats[/b], eerie candy that temporarily [b]boosts your Fame[/b] for non-PvP activities. But beware – these creepy treats won't last forever, so eat them before they spoil, like Bob probably should have!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cd5233e6903c1a885fc5c982d8008bfd2dbfa8a1.jpeg[/img]

Here’s when Allhallows will take over each server:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: 00:00 UTC on October 25 to 00:00 UTC on November 14[/*]	[*][b]Albion Americas [/b]and [b]Albion Europe[/b]: 10:00 UTC on October 25 to 10:00 UTC on November 14[/*][/list]Prepare to head down into the depths and wipe that grin off Bob’s face!

notes.title: Season 25 Is Around the Corner
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

New horizons, new battles! Guilds across Albion are gearing up as [b]Season 25[/b] kicks off just days after the release of the [b]Horizons[/b] update on October 28.

So mark your calendars: Season 25 begins on [b]November 2[/b], with [b]Albion Asia[/b] starting at [b]00:00 UTC[/b], followed by [b]Albion Americas and Albion Europe[/b] at [b]11:00 UTC[/b].

[h3]Season Rewards[/h3]
Rewards such as [b]Avatar Sets[/b], [b]Fame[/b] buffs, and more await members of successful guilds, along with Artifacts to craft the next batch of powerful [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], revealed at the end of the season.
These rewards can be found in [b]Conqueror’s Chests[/b], unlocked by earning [b]Might[/b] through activities in lethal zones as a guild member.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8f3026da394dba42efdf4c4e7e89f7a28f8c8cc0.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Season Schedule Highlights:[/h3][list]	[*][b]November 2[/b]: Season start and Invasion Day[/*]	[*][b]November 30[/b]: Second Invasion Day[/*]	[*][b]December 28[/b]: Third Invasion Day, Season Points doubled[/*]	[*][b]January 25[/b]: Final Invasion Day[/*]	[*][b]January 27[/b]: Season ends[/*][/list]For the full schedule and a detailed list of rewards, visit the [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/203539-Season-25-Schedules/][b]official forum post[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ba6757ec1816af3d2b34bf1f018869ab9ac247ab.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Live Stream from Albion HQ![/h3]
For the [b]Season 25 launch[/b], we’ve got something special in store: the [b]AlbionTV[/b] team will be streaming from the[b] Sandbox Interactive[/b] studio live! Stay tuned for more information so you don’t miss this exciting event.

After that, be sure to watch [url=http://twitch.tv/AlbionOnline][b]twitch.tv/AlbionOnline[/b][/url] throughout the season for live coverage of the major events and territory battles.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f657f99c373c18f31d8b8ad287817d34856baa57.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Season Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]Territory Raids[/b]: The energy destruction rate has been increased from 5% to 10%[/*]	[*][b]Fortifications[/b]: Dropped Banners no longer reduce protection[/*]	[*][b]Crystal Creatures[/b]: The Crystal Spiders category is now Crystal Creatures, including the new Crystal Beetle and Crystal Cobra	[list]		[*]These creatures spawn much more frequently[/*]		[*]To balance their increased frequency, their Might and loot rewards have been reduced[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*][b]Corrupted Dungeon: [/b]Requirements have been reduced[/*]	[*][b]Hellgates: [/b]Offer more Season Points per level, with reduced Might requirements[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/52eded474456536c1eb91fffa9eea4ebc4eb368d.png[/img]

[h3]New to Guild Seasons? Here's What You Need to Know![/h3]
[b]Guild Seasons[/b] are a key part of Albion's competitive landscape, where guilds battle over several months to claim territories, earn Season Points, and rise up the rankings. Participating in a Guild Season allows you to contribute to your guild's success through various activities – even if you’re not focused on PvP, you can still help your guild gather Season Points and unlock valuable rewards!

Ready to get started? Use the [b]Guild Finder[/b] to connect with a guild and start your journey to guild glory, and don’t forget to check out our [url=https://albiononline.com/news/guide-guild-seasons][b]Guild Season Guide[/b][/url] to get all the necessary information.

notes.title: Dev Talk: New Albion Journal Categories
notes.content:
In this [b]Dev Talk[/b], [b]Game Director Robin Henkys[/b] introduces two exciting new [b]Albion[/b] [b]Journal [/b]categories coming with the [b]Horizons[/b] update: Social & Guild, and Islands. Each offers their own brand-new, themed rewards, so join us as we take a look within.

[previewyoutube=PEKxnECaSlQ?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Social & Guild[/h3]
Take part in guild activities like large-scale PvP battles and hunting Crystal Creatures to earn these prestigious rewards:
[list]	[*]A jousting-themed [b]Armored Horse skin[/b] which displays your guild colors[/*]	[*]A[b] Heraldic Banner[/b] to flaunt your Guild heraldry, with an elite version also available[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5bbf27c1b6c5904b6550e11213a8af5aa7d9a968.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Islands[/h3]
Enjoy the simple life by completing farming, cooking, and building challenges to unlock these rustic rewards:
[list]	[*]Farming-themed [b]Transport Ox skin[/b]: The farmer’s perfect companion[/*]	[*]A [b]Straw Hat[/b], whose elite version features a [b]double rainbow[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4e82c898c5a9a00ff609ff5298a9f9101cff77f5.jpeg[/img]

The Horizons update lands [b]October 28[/b], so you'll be able to enjoy these new challenges very soon.

You’ll hear more about our future plans after the update. Stay tuned!

notes.title: The Final Invasion Day of Season 24 is Coming!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/63e13d44758253dce2b893430f12bfdc3652c6d0.jpeg[/img]

As the [b]final Invasion Day[/b] of [b]Season 24[/b] approaches this weekend, guilds are preparing for the final push. Here's a recap of the state of play after the previous Invasion Day:
[list]	[*][b]Albion Americas[/b]: Members of the [i]AZULE[/i] alliance have been holding the top two spots, with [i]The Lonely Men[/i] close behind. With their allies [i]FAX[/i] in 4th, The Lonely Men pose an even greater threat to the top two as we reach the season’s end.[/*]	[*][b]Albion Europe[/b]: The big war between the [i]FFlow[/i] and [i]BOBER[/i] coalitions saw the fall of [i]Sex and Flex[/i]'s headquarters, leaving [i]POLSKA GUROM[/i] in a dominant position. With the support of their allies, [i]POLSKA GUROM[/i] has a clear path to victory, and many guilds are now focused on securing Crystal and Gold rankings.[/*]	[*][b]Albion Asia[/b]: [i]One Gin[/i] is on track to surpass 1.3 million Season Points – an all-time Albion record! With a surely unassailable lead, the question is just how many points they’ll gather as this historic season draws to a close.[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f7fa40ebd13cf850868e065d7da0110cd3ed846e.jpeg[/img]
