notes.title: Changelog: Paths to Glory Update
notes.content:
[h2]Paths to Glory Update - Version 26.000.1 - July 22, 2024[/h2]

[h3]The Albion Journal[/h3]
[b]Overview[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal is a personal logbook that will help you keep track of your adventures and to build up the chronicle of your journey through the lands of Albion[/*]	[*]This is a new achievement tracking feature designed to provide clear guidance and exciting goals for all players, whether you’re a seasoned veteran or just starting out[/*]	[*]The journal offers a mixture of missions that can be completed in a single play session, as well as longer-term goals that unlock valuable rewards and unique vanity items[/*]	[*]The Journal provides an overview of the game’s core activities and features, guiding players through Albion’s sandbox structure immediately after the tutorial[/*][/list][quote][i]We want every play session to have an achievable goal. Whether you're completing a quick task or taking on a more significant challenge, progress should always be within reach. With the introduction of the Albion Journal, we want to provide everyone with a quantifiable way to measure their progress while exploring all the different features Albion Online has to offer.[/i]
[i]With this update, the Journal has five main categories, and we plan to expand this with four further categories in the future.[/i][/quote]
[b]HUD changes[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal has its own section, the Journal Tracker, on the player HUD — just below the Destiny Board button[/*]	[*]The Journal Tracker displays up to three missions for you to follow your progress.	[list]		[*]You can choose which missions to follow here, or let it show recommended missions[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Journal Tracker is a collapsable menu, which notifies you when you have rewards available[/*][/list]
[b]Your Journal[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal starts with one revealed mission and gradually reveals more as you progress[/*]	[*]Missions can be completed even if they are not yet revealed in the Journal[/*]	[*]Missions are organized into categories and subcategories, with goals and rewards unlocking as you progress[/*]	[*]Main Categories included in the Paths to Glory update:	[list]		[*]PvE[/*]		[*]Gathering[/*]		[*]Economy[/*]		[*]Exploration[/*]		[*]PvP[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Some brand-new items are available as rewards as you progress through the Journal (see ‘Albion Journal Rewards’ below)[/*]	[*]Many existing Steam Achievements are now part of Journal Missions	[list]		[*]If these were completed prior to the launch of the Journal, their rewards will be ready to claim[/*]		[*]Steam Achievements will remain in the Achievements section separately[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Albion Journal Rewards[/h3]
[b]Mission Rewards[/b]
[list]	[*]Each completed mission grants a reward	[list]		[*]These rewards can be claimed in the Albion Journal UI[/*]		[*]Rewards for individual missions include Tomes of Insight, Silver, Focus Restoration Potions, Gathering Tomes, and many more![/*]		[*]A new reward item is available, Tome of Learning, which grants Learning Points when used[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Category Rewards[/b]
[list]	[*]As you progress through each of the main categories, you will unlock unique new vanity rewards at various stages	[list]		[*]20% completion: A unique Avatar[/*]		[*]40% completion: A matching Avatar Ring[/*]		[*]60% completion: A wardrobe item with a vanity spell[/*]		[*]80% completion: A brand-new mount skin[/*]		[*]100% completion: A very rare, elite version of the wardrobe item and spell[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These vanity rewards follow the theme of each category[/*]	[*]All Category Rewards are non-tradable[/*][/list]
[h3]Dynamic Spawn Rates[/h3]
In order to provide more content during each server’s peak times, this update introduces a new feature to the open world and the Roads of Avalon: Dynamic Spawn Rates.
[list]	[*]Snapshots of each server’s activity levels will be taken ongoingly[/*]	[*]Some spawn and upgrade rates will be automatically adjusted based on this activity	[list]		[*]Spawn rates will dynamically increase during busy times and decrease during off-peak periods[/*]		[*]There are limits in place to ensure that low-activity periods don’t offer too little, and busy periods don’t offer too much[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]As a result, it should be easier to find content during the busiest times on each server. With this update, this feature will affect treasures, resources, and mobs, with the amount available more in line with each server's activity. The impact will be measured and adjusted as necessary and it may be expanded to other content in the future.
[h3]Roads of Avalon Improvements[/h3]
[quote][i]We've listened to your feedback and, as promised, we're working on the most popular change requested by the community. With these changes, we’re not looking to completely reshape the Roads of Avalon, but rather to rebalance their regions and rewards while adding new content in the form of Tracking. We will continue to monitor gameplay in the Roads after this update, to see what further changes and improvements can be made.[/i][/quote]
[b]Region Balancing[/b]
[list]	[*]The tier of Roads region you enter is now based on the zone type from which you enter	[list]		[*]Tier 4 Roads: Primarily found when entering from Blue and Yellow zones[/*]		[*]Tier 6 Roads: Typically found when entering from Red and Black zones[/*]		[*]Tier 8 Roads: Exclusive to Deep Roads and 20-Player Portals[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The number of 20-Player Portal Regions has been increased to provide more frequent connections to Roads Hideout Regions	[list]		[*]Some connections to 20-Player Portal Regions from non-Hideout Regions have been added too, to increase competition[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Group Portals within the Roads now have a 300 second recharge time[/*][/list]
[b]Content and Reward Balancing[/b]
[quote][i]We wanted to better balance Roads content and rewards with other activities in Albion. There will be fewer Roads regions for gathering, but those that do exist will have higher respawn rates to compensate. Additionally, the Roads will not be quite as powerful for leveling as in the past, but will instead be more attractive for loot.[/i]
[i]On average, Fame has been reduced by around 20-25%, while the total Silver output from the Roads (taking into account increased spawn rates) has been approximately doubled.[/i][/quote]
[list]	[*]Tracking is now possible in the Roads[/*]	[*]Group rewards have been significantly increased to encourage cooperative play, while solo rewards have been reviewed to ensure fairness compared to other content	[list]		[*]Avalonian Chests have had their value increased		[list]			[*]Tier 4 and Tier 6 chests have received a slight buff, and Tier 8 chests a significant buff[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]They now also upgrade in size over time if left untouched[/*]		[*]Small Avalonian Chests can never be rare or legendary, while Large Avalonian Chests can never be common[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The number of areas dedicated to gathering has been reduced	[list]		[*]Their respawn rate has been increased to maintain total resource output in the Roads[/*]		[*]The free spots will be used to introduce additional PvE areas and Solo Randomized Dungeon entrances[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Randomized Dungeons with fixed entrances have had their bonus loot reduced	[list]		[*]To compensate, they are always Enchanted now[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Randomized Dungeon entrances, Mobs, Chests, and Resources have been moved to offer greater diversity of content and remove ultra-specialized regions with only one resource type[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Adjustments[/b]
[list]	[*]Mob tiers are now standardized in each different Roads region	[list]		[*]With the exception of resource mobs, all Roads mobs will match the tier of the region[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Pathfinder Initiate, Ascetic and Monk’s knockback spell now has an AoE indicator and can be dodged[/*]	[*]Pathfinder Heavy Drones no longer use their spells off-cooldown[/*]	[*]Bosses protecting chests offer significantly less Fame	[list]		[*]Instead, opening a chest will reward Fame to the first group who open it[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]	[*]Roads Portal tooltips now show the danger type of the Roads region[/*]	[*]Avalonian Chest tooltips no longer show their rarity, regardless of your proximity to them[/*]	[*]Furniture can no longer be placed in PvE and gathering areas[/*]	[*]Some areas have updated visuals, for greater variety[/*][/list]
[h3]Guild Islands Rework[/h3]
Paths to Glory updates Guild Islands to bring them in line with Personal Islands
[list]	[*]Guilds can now also own multiple islands in every city on the Royal Continent – one each in Martlock, Bridgewatch, Fort Sterling, Lymhurst, Thetford, and Caerleon –.[/*]	[*]Guild Islands have reworked visuals which reflect the atmosphere, aesthetics, and biome of their host city[/*][/list]
[h3]New Crystal Weapons[/h3]
New update, new Crystal Weapons! This update introduces the next batch of these weapons, which will be craftable at the end of Season 24:
[list]	[*]Twin Slayers (Daggers): Ring of Death throws your daggers in a ring around you, which can then be summoned back, slicing through all enemies in their path[/*]	[*]Dreadstorm Monarch (Mace): Eye of the Storm conjures a growing storm around you that slows enemies and shreds their resistances[/*]	[*]Exalted Staff (Holy Staff): Sanctify heals allies and removes ground-based damaging, debuffing, or crowd-control areas of effect[/*][/list]
[h3]Corrupted Dungeon Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Corrupted Dungeon Maps have been added	[list]		[*]These can be crafted at the Artifact Foundry[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Bat spawn times adjusted	[list]		[*]Hunter: 5 minutes → 3 minutes[/*]		[*]Stalker: 5 minutes → 3 minutes[/*]		[*]Slayer: 3 minutes (unchanged)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[quote][i]With this update, we wanted to provide several much-requested quality of life enhancements by improving a number of important weapon functions and UI elements, along with some other frequently-requested changes and additions.[/i][/quote]
[b]Weapon Improvements[/b]
Based on your feedback, two important changes have been made to weapon functionality:
[list]	[*]Weapons now have all of their spells unlocked from Tier 4 upwards, to increase gameplay variety[/*]	[*]Items can now be overcharged twice in combat, increasing overcharge duration at a  greater risk of breaking the item	[list]		[*]This will allow for prolonged ZvZ battles beyond the 30-minute mark[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Party Ready Check[/b]
A new system allows party leaders to check on the readiness of their group members, to help in activities which require coordination.
[list]	[*]A party leader can initiate a Ready Check in two ways:	[list]		[*]From their character drop-down menu[/*]		[*]By typing /readycheck in the chat[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]All party members, regardless of location, receive a notification asking if they are ready or not[/*]	[*]Responses are displayed to all party members	[list]		[*]Green check-mark: Ready[/*]		[*]Red cross: Not ready[/*]		[*]White question mark: Pending/AFK[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]If a member does not respond in 60 seconds, they are marked as Pending/AFK[/*]	[*]Responses remain on-screen for 30 seconds after the end of the Ready Check	[list]		[*]If a new Ready Check is initiated in this time, the original responses are overwritten[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]UI Improvements[/b]
[list]	[*]The Destiny Board has improved scaling and zooming[/*]	[*]All players in a Randomized Dungeon now receive a message when the entrance closes	[list]		[*]No more counting to 90 and guessing if an entrance is gone![/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Daily Bonus Tracker in the HUD can now be collapsed[/*]	[*]Last Death Recap can now be accessed from the Player Menu at any time during the same play session[/*]	[*]Siege UI:	[list]		[*]The Siege UI is now accessible at any time when using the Siege Banner item[/*]		[*]Improved information display that better reflects the requirements necessary for Siege Banner use[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Added a market value estimation of equipment when inspecting a player	[list]		[*]The estimated value includes equipped items only, not items in inventory[/*]		[*]Displayed value is a rounded number; hovering over estimated value shows the exact amount[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Player Rankings UI:	[list]		[*]Added options to filter rankings by “Guild Members only” and “Friends List only”[/*]		[*]When a player ranks outside the top 10,000, their position along with the two players immediately above and below them are displayed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Party and guild management:	[list]		[*]Player markers are now displayed in front of other elements (such as health bars) and are easier to distinguish from the background, improving the visibility of marked players in large battles[/*]		[*]Player pings now appear as system messages in chat[/*]		[*]Added button to Guild UI to copy Guild Member list to the clipboard[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Territory Activity Chest world map overlays added, showing:	[list]		[*]Average Activity Chest Value[/*]		[*]Next Activity Chest Value[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Trade UI now displays projected character weight after a prospective trade[/*]	[*]Added confirmation popup message when using Journey Back to better inform about Silver costs[/*]	[*]Added an opacity setting for the chat box in focused mode[/*]	[*]Improved search function by allowing variation in words instead of requiring an exact match[/*]	[*]Improved target dummy DPS view to be more consistent and closer to actual damage timing[/*][/list]
[h3]Additional Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]In order to create some economic space and bring greater parity to Albion’s various features, various slight adjustments have been made to the Mists and Knightfall Abbey:	[list]		[*]Boss and Shrine chest values in Knightfall Abbey reduced by approximately 10%		[list]			[*]Duo Mists’ chests have had their bonus values adjusted to offset this change, and are unaffected[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Resolved an issue where some mobs in Knightfall Abbey gave too little Silver		[list]			[*]This has resulted in a ~9% overall increase in Silver from mobs[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Already small loot chances from mobs removed to offset increased Silver and protect chests from further reductions[/*]		[*]Arcane Spiderling spawn chances in the Mists reduced by 18%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Veteran and Elite mobs now regenerate health in combat, making them less profitable when engaged by fewer players	[list]		[*]Their overall health has been reduced to maintain the time needed for a group to kill them[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mobs with very long respawn times (e.g. Ancient Resource Mobs) will spawn at more unpredictable intervals[/*]	[*]Reworked animations and VFX for Quarterstaffs and Scythes[/*]	[*]The following spells have also been visually redesigned:	[list]		[*]Threatening Smash (all Maces)[/*]		[*]Slowing Charge (two-handed Hammers)[/*]		[*]Rending Strike (two-handed Axes)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]A-key can now be used to exit islands[/*]	[*]Dynamic Events added for the Mists, Roads of Avalon, and Tracking[/*]	[*]Territory Activity Chests are now lootable by anyone after a Raid if the Territory has no owner[/*]	[*]Players who are inactive during a Faction Warfare week will no longer receive a weekly report[/*]	[*]Removed recipes that use Arcane Essences and Faded Essences from the Artifact Foundry	[list]		[*]Arcane Essences can now be salvaged for Silver[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Crystal Gladiator vanity items are no longer available from Crystal League chests	[list]		[*]These are now only available via Albion Journal Crystal League Missions[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Spawn buff prevention no longer counts down while between regions[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Added S, W, and E indicators to Minimap[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Moved "Emotes" to the D-pad action wheel[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Added a "Travel Mode Settings" controller button action to the Region Map[/*][/list]
[h3]Steam and Mobile Achievement Conditions[/h3]
With the launch of the Albion Journal, the conditions for certain Steam and Mobile achievements have been changed. Your progress in these achievements has not been reset, after the changed condition.
[list]	[*]Successfully finish an Expedition → Finish a Tier 3 Solo Expedition[/*]	[*]Enter a Randomized Dungeon → Finish a Tier 3 Solo Dungeon[/*]	[*]Enter 1,000 Randomized Dungeons → Finish 1,000 Solo Dungeons[/*]	[*]Complete your first hunt → Track down a rare solo creature[/*]	[*]Track down and kill one of each creature type →  Track down 7 different rare solo creatures[/*]	[*]Kill a Guardian Aspect from every biome → Harvest resources from Guardian Aspects in every biome[/*]	[*]Defeat a Guardian in a Road of Avalon → Harvest resources from a Guardian in the Roads of Avalon[/*]	[*]Defeat the final boss in a Corrupted Dungeon→ Defeat the final boss in a Hunter Corrupted Dungeon[/*]	[*]Gain 100,000 Infamy in any Hellgate type → Gain 100,000 Infamy in 2v2 Hellgates[/*]	[*]Gain 250,000 Infamy in any Hellgate type → Gain 250,000 Infamy in 2v2 Hellgates[/*]	[*]Win a Crystal League Match → Win a 5v5 Crystal League Match[/*]	[*]Win a Crystal League Match of Rank 3 → Win a Rank 3 5v5 Crystal League Match[/*]	[*]Win a Crystal League Match of Rank 7 → Win a Rank 7 5v5 Crystal League Match[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
[quote][i]Our main focus with this update was to adjust the resilience curve, which addresses the survivability of melee and ranged weapons in large scale battles. The goal is to make these fights less focused on melee brawl compositions, and give ranged damage-per-second more room to succeed.[/i][/quote]
[b]Resilience[/b]
The impact of Resilience on large-scale fights has been reduced significantly, making melees less tanky with higher numbers of attackers. This means that all players (including ranged players) deal greater damage to melees. To compensate for this, the resilience penetration for various long range melee weapons has been reduced. This is aimed at large-scale fights - for up to five attackers melee Resilience values are unchanged.

The Resilience curve has also been normalized for ranged weapons, to use the same Resilience values as melees and make both these weapon types more competitive in all group sizes.

notes.title: Paths to Glory is Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/203005dbee4072778b096c48825b1a87a5519a59.png[/img]

It’s time to walk the [b]Paths to Glory[/b]! Albion’s latest content update has arrived, bringing the [b]Albion Journal[/b] - a new achievement system offering unique rewards - new [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], [b]Dynamic Spawn Rates[/b], and a wealth of improvements across the game. And, as always, we’ve produced a [b]brand-new trailer[/b] for the occasion. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=1EvSkwrsGXk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Write your Journal[/h3]
This update introduces the [b]Albion Journal[/b], a brand-new achievement system with missions for every type of player, from the very beginners to the most seasoned veterans, covering the full breadth of Albion’s content. Each mission has its own prize - like bags of Silver and new [b]Tomes of Learning[/b] - while your progress through each category grants you unique, [b]themed rewards[/b]. So whether you’re an extravagant merchant tossing around your wealth, or a rugged gatherer with a barbeque-bearing boar, you’ll be able to demonstrate your expertise to all around you.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6a4653143ec3b3235eae6a27a158c42e567cd577.jpeg[/img]

For more on the Albion Journal and its rewards, check out this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-albion-journal][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].

[h3]A Dynamic World[/h3]
An important new feature is coming to the open world and the Roads of Avalon: [b]Dynamic Spawn Rates[/b]. This adjusts the amount of treasure, resources, and mobs which appear at a given time based on each server’s activity levels, with more available during peak hours. [b]The Roads[/b] have received some adjustments too, with rebalanced zones and content, and the introduction of [b]Tracking[/b]. And speaking of which, there’s a sinister new Rare Quarry out there to hunt down: the [b]Shadowmask[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9cec8a225e0955259ac82bda497e1e90fa6e96ce.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
Weapons now have [b]all of their spells unlocked[/b] from Tier 4, bringing greater diversity to combat and giving you more to play with early on. Items can be [b]overcharged twice[/b], too, allowing fierce, large-scale battles to rage for longer. New [b]Crystal Weapons[/b] are coming for Daggers, Maces, and Holy Staffs. Guilds can now own [b]multiple islands[/b], with beautiful new visuals that reflect the atmosphere and biome of their host city. Countless other quality-of-life changes are being introduced as well, including improvements to the [b]Destiny Board[/b] and a new [b]Party Ready Check[/b] system.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a02b7efd08184be1c13bb80b25df82c76b2606f5.jpeg[/img]

[b]Paths to Glory is live now[/b], so open up your Journal and start writing your story! Read the full patchnotes [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/paths-to-glory-update][b]here[/b][/url], and check out the official update page [url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory][b]here[/b][/url].

notes.title: Albion Online Turns Seven!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ec6a4632c4767f4c43dfc7ba5081f1f3a7b114a7.png[/img]

And just like that, Albion turned seven! With so much going on - a new server, soaring player numbers, and several big updates - the past year has just flown by. And on the eve of the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory][b]Paths to Glory[/b][/url] update, it’s time to take a moment to look back at just how far the game has come. So put on your [url=https://albiononline.com/news/seventh-anniversary-sale][b]Anniversary outfit[/b][/url][b], [/b]grab a slice of [url=https://albiononline.com/news/living-legacy-2024][b]cake[/b][/url], and make yourself comfortable as we look back at some of the biggest moments of the last twelve months.

[h3]Wild Blood[/h3]
Albion’s players got a taste of [url=https://albiononline.com/update/wild-blood][b]Wild Blood[/b][/url] in the fall, as a new content update introduced some massive features to the game.

[previewyoutube=fXc7B8_mrx8;full][/previewyoutube]
With [b]Shapeshifter Weapons[/b], [b]Tracking[/b], [b]Awakened Items[/b], [b]reworked islands[/b], and much more, Wild Blood [url=https://albiononline.com/news/wild-blood-launch-stats][b]unleashed[/b][/url] Albion’s primal side, and opened up a whole world of new possibilities.

[h3]End of Year Awards[/h3]
Winter saw end-of-year awards handed out, and Albion Online added to its growing collection with two more prestigious prizes. MassivelyOP awarded Albion [b]Best PvP MMO[/b] for the [b]third year running[/b], and MMORPG.com then named the game [b]Indie MMO of the Year[/b]. Thanks again to everyone whose continued support has made this possible!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c6450edba7c3bc773660fad1f6f7932f7aad3c32.png[/img]

The end of the year also saw the announcement of a new approach to the game’s [url=https://albiononline.com/news/2024-update-plan][b]update schedule[/b][/url], which would begin at the turn of 2024…

[h3]Crystal Raiders[/h3]
No sooner had [url=https://albiononline.com/news/uncle-frost-2023][b]Uncle Frost[/b][/url] thrown his last snowball of the season, than it was time for Albion’s first update of 2024. [url=https://albiononline.com/update/crystal-raiders][b]Crystal Raiders[/b][/url] was the first in Albion’s three-monthly update cycle, and it brought some big changes to Guild Seasons.

[previewyoutube=th9a8Mu6FWM;full][/previewyoutube]
With the introduction of[b] Territory Raiding[/b] and [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], along with other changes like a [b]reworked Conqueror’s Challenge[/b], Crystal Raiders shook up guild warfare in Albion for the seasons to come.

[h3]Albion Europe[/h3]
A year after the successful launch of the Albion Asia server came another momentous announcement: Albion Online was launching a [b]brand-new server[/b] in Europe. This would bring massively improved ping to thousands of players, old and new, along with the chance to build a completely independent gameworld from the ground up.

To celebrate this development, an all-new live action trailer was released, which might have a familiar ring to some of you…

[previewyoutube=xPyw4nZlGNA;full][/previewyoutube]
Albion Europe had a unique [url=https://albiononline.com/news/europe-beta-challenge][b]Beta[/b][/url] phase, with players flocking to the new server to earn the exclusive Duelist vanity set. A special, condensed Guild Season was won by Escalation, and then, on April 29, the new server [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-europe-live][b]opened its doors[/b][/url].

[h3]Foundations[/h3]
While all this was going on, development of the game didn’t slow down. Along with the new server, April saw the release of Albion’s second update of 2024: [url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations][b]Foundations[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=vTj-NaMx4gs;full][/previewyoutube]
Foundations continued to add new dimensions to Guild Seasons, with the introduction of [b]Fortifications[/b], [b]Siege Banners[/b], [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b], and more. With guilds now able to construct powerful defenses for their territories, Season 23 marked the beginning of a new era of warfare in Albion.

[h3]Record Player Numbers[/h3]
2024’s updates and the launch of Albion Europe made Albion more vibrant than ever before, and this was confirmed when the game smashed its [url=https://albiononline.com/news/record-player-numbers][b]player number record[/b][/url] in May.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cfda3872353587472e2128b0613e21604db1d194.jpeg[/img]

Albion Online surpassed [b]350,000 daily active users[/b] on May 1, eclipsing the previous record set a year ago with the launch of Albion Asia. With so many new and experienced players enjoying the game, it’s a truly exciting time to be a part of the world of Albion as we look ahead to the future.

[h3]Paths to Glory[/h3]
And that future begins next week, with the release of the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory][b]Paths to Glory[/b][/url] update on [b]July 22[/b].

This will bring the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-albion-journal][b]Albion Journal[/b][/url], a brand-new achievement system with some very special rewards available. It also sees some big [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b], a new [b]Dynamic Spawn Rate[/b] system, [b]new Crystal Weapons[/b], and much more. With all this, Albion has never offered so much to so many players.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/203005dbee4072778b096c48825b1a87a5519a59.png[/img]

Join us in celebrating Albion’s anniversary now with the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/living-legacy-2024][b]Living Legacy[/b][/url] event, featuring some all-new statues of Albion’s previous season winners to take down. And the special [url=https://albiononline.com/news/seventh-anniversary-sale][b]Anniversary Paladin[/b][/url] vanity bundle is available until [b]July 30 at 10 UTC[/b], so grab yours while you can! Meanwhile, we’d like to once again give our thanks to you, the community, for what’s been an incredible year. Here’s to the future!

notes.title: Dev Talk: The Albion Journal
notes.content:
Following our recent Dev Talk introducing some of the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-paths-to-glory][b]many different features[/b][/url] coming in the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory][b]Paths to Glory[/b][/url] update, it’s time to take a look at the core feature of Albion’s next update: the [b]Albion Journal[/b]. Game Director Robin Henkys sat down to reveal what you can find within its pages when the update launches on [b]July 22[/b].

[previewyoutube=6CJifOQyu6c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]What is the Albion Journal?[/h3][list]	[*]The Albion Journal is an [b]achievement system[/b] designed to challenge players to explore Albion’s many gameplay areas.[/*]	[*]For [b]new players[/b], this acts as a guide with incentives to explore the various activities available in the game[/*]	[*][b]Veterans[/b], meanwhile[b],[/b] are encouraged to complete the most difficult achievements for truly exclusive rewards[/*][/list][h3]How does it work?[/h3][list]	[*]New players will gain access to the Journal once they've completed the tutorial[/*]	[*]Existing characters will have the Journal unlocked when the update arrives[/*]	[*]It can be opened directly from the [b]HUD[/b], to view open and completed missions[/*]	[*]A [b]mission tracker[/b] in the HUD shows your current progress in selected missions[/*]	[*]The missions in the journal are sorted into [b]categories[/b], and each category is further split into [b]subcategories[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0e4c6f0312f8ba6235136dab0ca22fae00a8beb1.png[/img]
[h3]Progressing through the Journal[/h3][list]	[*][b]Initial missions[/b] in each subcategory are a simple introduction to an area of gameplay[/*]	[*]As you progress through a subcategory, missions become [b]increasingly difficult[/b][/*]	[*]Missions can be completed [b]out of order[/b], even if they have not yet been unlocked – so don't worry about doing something you don't have a mission for, [b]it will still count[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2c5505a6c10e2ae80624ed9bcc9057edd0ad706a.png[/img][/b]
[h3]Individual Mission Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Each mission grants a[b] reward[/b] which can be claimed [b]directly from the Journal UI[/b][/*]	[*]These rewards include Silver, Tomes of Insight, Dungeon Maps, and more[/*]	[*][b]Tomes of Learning[/b] – a new, non-tradable item – are also available as a reward	[list]		[*]These grant [b]Learning Points[/b] when used[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]More difficult missions offer [b]more valuable rewards[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b3f79b45fa0f65c6c578d5734d10fda7258008c9.png[/img][/b]
[h3]Category Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Completing a certain percentage of missions within each main category unlocks [b]unique rewards[/b][/*]	[*]Each category has a themed [b]Avatar[/b], [b]Avatar Ring[/b], [b]Wardrobe Item [/b]with a [b]Vanity Spell[/b], and [b]Mount Skin[/b][/*]	[*]Completing [b]all missions [/b]in a category will grant you a super-rare, [b]elite version[/b] of the wardrobe item[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8fc7d72696ed390b02da17ffda8899cfa91ab131.png[/img]
[h3]Main Categories[/h3]
The Journal will launch with five categories:

[b]PvE[/b]:
[list]	[*]This category challenges you to participate in Albion’s various [b]PvE activities[/b][/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring show off your prowess in dungeon exploration[/*]	[*]The unique wardrobe item is a [b]six-sided die[/b] that you can actually roll[/*]	[*]The elite version is a [b]twenty-sided die [/b]with a critical-hit celebratory roll animation[/*]	[*]The mount skin is a themed [b]Direbear[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/49b82fcf50aac7fdf88acc55ba46358934943627.png[/img]

[b]Gathering:[/b]
[list]	[*]Includes [b]gathering and fishing[/b] missions[/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring showcase your key role in Albion’s industry[/*]	[*]The wardrobe item is a [b]powered chopping axe[/b] with a tree-chopping vanity spell[/*]	[*]The elite version features [b]awesome visual effects[/b][/*]	[*]The mount skin is a [b]mechanical boar[/b] with an integrated barbecue[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ff47fd782c893e4dc55982c2afa4b798c7ccf137.png[/img]

[b]Economy:[/b]
[list]	[*]Focuses on the marketplace, crafting, refining and other [b]economic activities[/b][/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring show off your wealth[/*]	[*]The wardrobe skin is a [b]very fancy coat[/b] that lets you throw some of your [b]actual Silver[/b] on the ground[/*]	[*]The elite version throws [b]even more money [/b]away – you can easily afford it[/*]	[*]This mount skin is Albion’s very first [b]Mammoth skin[/b], which lets you get carried around by Black Market guards[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/be21349a408431ec2daa81eaaab6ae809e046e7f.png[/img]

[b]Exploration:[/b]
[list]	[*]Takes you [b]far and wide[/b] through the lands of Albion[/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring have a [b]bardic[/b] theme[/*]	[*]The wardrobe item is a [b]Lute[/b] to entertain you and your friends[/*]	[*]The elite version lets you perform [b]an additional song[/b][/*]	[*]The mount skin is a very, very cute Swiftclaw skin[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/05f9a6b7469951efae7372e823d7f7989988360a.png[/img]

[b]PvP:[/b]
[list]	[*]This category pushes you to[b] fight with other players[/b][/*]	[*]The Avatar and Avatar Ring [b]strike fear[/b] into the heart of your enemies[/*]	[*]The wardrobe item is a [b]fearsome helmet[/b] which summons a [b]deathly herald[/b][/*]	[*]The elite version gives you an [b]even more threatening[/b] aura[/*]	[*]This is complemented by a frightening new [b]Direwolf skin[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d232c46e9713df1d39d245e9b36f0fab34a3b518.png[/img][/b]

We'll be adding more categories to the journal in the future, but for now, we wish you the best of luck filling your journals when Paths to Glory releases on [b]July 22[/b]!

notes.title: The Living Legacy is Back
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8290a3b61801fc86d286d9105fac1b93ce18ceb8.png[/img]

And just like that, Albion Online is turning seven! What a year it has been, huh? And to kick off the celebrations, the [b]Living Legacy[/b] event returns from [b]23 UTC on July 11 for Albion Asia[/b], and [b]10 UTC on July 12 for Albion Europe and Americas[/b]! Consider this your official invitation to the party, but wear something you can get dirty with – because you'll be hunting down statues old and new while gorging yourself on Fame-filled [b]Anniversary Cake[/b]. It might get a bit messy.

Oh, and before we forget, there’s a brand-new anniversary video too:

[previewyoutube=QC4gx-zJD4w;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Living Monuments[/h3]
The monuments to the heroes of Albion's past are coming back to life, and they have brought with them some of last year's season winners: [b]Paura[/b] from Albion Americas Season 19, and [b]Fr Bailand[/b] and [b]Winter[/b] from the first two seasons of Albion Asia!

Defeat these monumental foes as they roam through any [b]Tier 5 or higher[/b] zone for a chance to obtain [b]tradable rewards[/b] only available during the Living Legacy event:
[list]	[*][b]Seventh Anniversary Stallion[/b]: Riding Horse Skin[/*]	[*][b]Purple Anniversary Banner[/b]: Furniture Item[/*]	[*][b]Anniversary Cake[/b]: Gives you a 15% non-PvP Fame buff for 30 minutes, stackable with other foods[/*]	[*][b]Chromacannon[/b]: Vanity Weapon Skin which shoots celebratory fireworks[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4be49aa61c8ed5c2179dcaf4c89592a8c30597b7.png[/img]

The statues appear in three categories, increasing in difficulty but also in potential rewards:
[list]	[*][b]Construct[/b]: These carry common anniversary loot and cannot be tracked on any map; they can be defeated by solo adventurers or small groups[/*]	[*][b]Colossus[/b]: These stronger statues are visible on the local map while in the same zone, and carry greater riches than Constructs[/*]	[*][b]Titan[/b]: These very powerful statues are visible on the world map up to three zones away, and are best challenged in a group[/*][/list][h3]Anniversary Gifts[/h3]
But that’s not all. Albion’s cities are adorned with festive decorations, and if you log in at any point during the event you’ll receive free, non-tradable [b]commemorative gifts [/b]from us! Just check your in-game mail and you’ll find the [b]Seventh Anniversary Avatar [/b]and [b]Avatar Ring [/b]waiting for you.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2afc9c34657d3fc081a1e69622196c31579d809f.png[/img]

The [b]event times[/b] for each server are:
[list]	[*]Start	[list]		[*][b]Asia[/b]: July 11 at 23 UTC[/*]		[*][b]Europe and Americas[/b]: July 12 at 10 UTC[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]End	[list]		[*][b]Asia[/b]: July 29 at 23 UTC[/*]		[*][b]Europe and Americas[/b]: July 30 at 10 UTC[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
Join in the celebrations and leave your mark on Albion's legacy – [b]by smashing it to pieces[/b]!

notes.title: Paths to Glory Lie Ahead
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/548c256085ff661a7ec8297d25a33ebc53ea7176.jpeg[/img]

On [b]July 22[/b], the [b]Paths to Glory [/b]open up. Albion’s next major update brings the [b]Albion Journal[/b], a brand-new chronicle of your progress which grants a host of [b]unique rewards[/b]. [b]Guild Islands [/b]have been reworked, with beautiful new visuals and the possibility of multiple island ownership. Improvements are coming to the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], and [b]Dynamic Spawn Rates [/b]adjust the amount of content in the Roads and open world based on activity levels. Along with new [b]Crystal Weapons[/b], a new [b]Rare Quarry [/b]to track down, and much more, Paths to Glory offers a host of improvements for a wide range of play styles.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/39969767e422764d0af976dc0672f20ad36cf6b6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]The Albion Journal[/h3]
Paths to Glory introduces a brand-new achievement system: the [b]Albion Journal[/b]. This presents each player with [b]missions [/b]at every stage of the game - from beginner-level tasks to truly gargantuan feats for the most experienced player - divided into [b]five main categories:[/b] PvE, PvP, Economy, Exploration, and Gathering. [b]Valuable rewards [/b]are available as you progress, from individual mission rewards like [b]Silver [/b]and [b]Tomes of Insight[/b], to unique, category-themed [b]vanity items [/b]to show off your progress to friend and foe alike.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4ceb72c25227b3f3bff26e4d69b492d9dbe3fa2c.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Roads to Glory[/h3]
This update also brings [b]Dynamic Spawn Rates [/b]to the open world and Roads of Avalon, adjusting the amount of treasure, resources, and mobs on each server throughout the day based on their activity levels. The [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]have also had their zones and content rebalanced, to make them more competitive and exciting. [b]Tracking [/b]is now possible in the Roads, and a new Rare Quarry can be hunted down too: the fearsome [b]Shadowmask[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/22ce1485fe093221735528f649f54dc91c577e93.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Choose your Path[/h3]
Guilds can now own [b]multiple islands [/b]- one for each Royal City and Caerleon - and these have gorgeous [b]new visuals [/b]reflecting the biome of their host city. [b]New Crystal Weapons [/b]are coming too, which players can earn through their Guild Season successes. In combat, weapons can be [b]overcharged twice [/b]for an extended boost, but at an increased risk of breakage, while weapons now have [b]all their spells [/b]available from Tier 4 upwards. A [b]Party Ready Check [/b]function allows better coordination in group activities, and the [b]Destiny Board [/b]has improved scaling and zooming.

With all this and more, Paths to Glory promises an improved experience in Albion whichever road you take. You can learn more about these features in this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-paths-to-glory][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url], and on the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/paths-to-glory]FIND OUT MORE[/url]

notes.title: Get the Embalmed Tiger with a single referral
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/58c8e4d59ad14893a7353918503dfef51cf26e84.jpeg[/img]

A new [b]Referral Season[/b] has begun, and from now until [b]July 31[/b] just one referral will unlock a brand-new mount skin for you – The [b]Embalmed Tiger[/b]!

This skin transforms your [b]Swiftclaw[/b] into a fearsome mummified cougar that’s just clawed its way out of the tomb and is ready to pounce on your enemies. After a thousand-year slumber, [b]this kitty is hungry[/b]! Fortunately, this mount skin can be used by any of your characters on whichever server you claim it on, so you can be sure to feed it properly…
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"] https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/665ed75e4ee27_720.mp4[/video]
And as always, there are also big rewards for your third and fifth referrals: a [b]T7 Pile of Tomes worth 100,000 Fame[/b] for your third referral, and a[b] T8 Pile of Tomes worth 200,000 Fame[/b] for your fifth. notes.title: Dev Talk: Paths to Glory Introduction
notes.content:
As Season 23 reaches its climax, it’s time to announce Albion’s next major update, coming in July: [b]Paths to Glory[/b]. At the heart of this update is the [b]Albion Journal[/b], which presents players with challenges and offers valuable new rewards. But this update also contains a host of other features, including some specific requests from the community. In this Dev Talk, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys[/b] shows us around some of the features and improvements that you’ll be able to enjoy when Paths to Glory releases next month.

[previewyoutube=Ge-A9Zyy7HY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Guild Island Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Guilds can now own [b]multiple islands[/b]	[list]		[*]Up to one island for each Royal City, plus Caerleon[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Guild Islands now [b]visually reflect the biome[/b] and atmosphere of their parent city[/*][/list][h3]Weapon Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Players can [b]double-overcharge[/b] their weapons in combat	[list]		[*]This prolongs the overcharge duration[/*]		[*]However, it also increases the risk of the weapon breaking afterwards[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players can now use [b]all spells [/b]on weapons of Tier 4 and above	[list]		[*]This will increase gameplay variety for lower tiers[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/817d18afea3950653e0fec68a43d82d053d906a3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Roads of Avalon Changes[/h3]
The most common request we heard was for changes to the Roads of Avalon. Many players said they couldn’t find the content they were looking for in the Roads, but our data showed activity there to be higher than ever.

For this update, we decided to focus on the core experience we had in mind when designing the Roads: an extension of the open world, creating interesting connections between places and offering opportunities for small groups. In the meantime, we’ll continue to think about other ways to provide the kind of small-scale PvP content that players are looking for.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/650b899d9b8f7aa5c8f17a5bda13fb3618b165bb.jpeg[/img]

Here’s what’s changing in the Roads:

[b]Zones[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Mob tiers standardized[/b] in each different Roads area[/*]	[*][b]Adjusted connections[/b] from the open world:	[list]		[*]Blue and Yellow Zones usually lead to Tier 4 Roads[/*]		[*]Red and Black Zones usually lead to Tier 6 Roads[/*]		[*]Tier 8 Roads are now exclusive to Deep Roads and Raid Clusters[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Number of Raid Clusters is being[b] increased[/b]	[list]		[*]This means Hideouts connect to Raid Clusters more frequently[/*]		[*]They also have a few connections to non-Hideout regions, to increase competition[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fd078bad595e0d8b097ddeb81aea59a049a90918.png[/img]

[b]Content and Rewards[/b]
[list]	[*]The Roads contain [b]fewer areas dedicated to gathering[/b]	[list]		[*]Resource respawn rates are increasing, to keep the total resource output the same[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]More PvE areas[/b] have been added	[list]		[*]These offer less Fame than before, to balance their leveling potential with other content[/*]		[*]To compensate, they offer more loot instead​[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Tracking[/b] has been added to the Roads	[list]		[*]This includes a new target that can be hunted here and in the open world: the [b]Shadowmask[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f70b5b2a2f35794fd92c3f5eb04263b4d5a2e54a.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Activity-Based Spawn Rates[/h3]
[b]Activity-Based Spawn Rates[/b] is a significant new feature coming to the Roads and the open world.
[list]	[*]Each server’s activity levels will be measured ongoingly[/*]	[*]Spawn and upgrade rates for treasures, mobs, and resources will adjust based on this metric[/*]	[*]During Prime Time, it should be easier to find content[/*]	[*]During low-activity periods, it will be more challenging and competitive to find massive rewards[/*][/list]
This adjustment will not be too strong, so periods of low activity will still offer more resources per player, but resources will be better distributed across time periods.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7e582bfa15912d9e72a74954ff70e2750a4fe180.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Crystal Weapons[/h3]
Paths to Glory will introduce the third batch of [b]Crystal Weapons[/b].
[list]	[*][b]Twin Slayers (Daggers): [/b]creates a ring of spinning blades that return to the caster, cutting through all enemies in their path[/*]	[*][b]Dreadstorm Monarch (Mace): [/b]creates a growing storm around you, slowing enemies and shredding their resistances[/*]	[*][b]Exalted Staff (Holy Staff): [/b]can remove areas like Sacred Ground[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b8adac5bdb660c1f40339132e10d7fcd52afbe74.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]The [b]Party Ready Check[/b] function lets party leaders see when their group members are ready for action[/*]	[*][b]Corrupted Dungeon Maps[/b] allow you to easily open entrances to these dungeons[/*]	[*]Three [b]new activity events [/b]for Roads of Avalon, Tracking, and the Mists[/*]	[*]Improved filtering in the [b]Rankings UI[/b][/*]	[*]Rescaled [b]Destiny Board [/b]with improved zoom functionality for desktop users[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d9a2921167849a7bf0c334ac5755ec875e17645a.jpeg[/img]

All this is coming to Albion next month when Paths to Glory launches - and that’s not to mention the heart of the update: the Albion Journal. Join us for another Dev Talk soon, where we’ll take a look at this new feature and the unique rewards it brings to the game!

notes.title: Invasion Day is coming to all servers this weekend!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dd063bb66f7eaaebd3a14199f8601fcf28569f3a.jpeg[/img]

This weekend, all three of Albion’s servers will see the action ramp up, as their territories become vulnerable to attack on [b]Invasion Day[/b]. And to up the ante even more, this action-packed weekend will see [b]Season Points[/b] [b]doubled[/b] on Albion Asia and Americas, and [b]tripled[/b] on Albion Europe!

If you're curious to see how it plays out in each region, the action will be streamed live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url]. Finally, Robinhoodrs, Shozen, and Tazzik will present coverage of [b]Albion[/b] [b]Americas [/b]at [b]01:00 UTC [/b]on [b]Sunday 16 June[/b].

With battles spawning all over Albion, this is shaping up to be a big weekend on all three servers, so don’t miss this one! The full season schedule can be found in [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/194638][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: ‘Zero to Hero’: Let’s Hear It for Rock Bottom
notes.content:
[i]In a new series, writer [url=https://twitter.com/bywillborger][b]Will Borger[/b][/url] joins our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] crew as he tries to work his way up from rookie Albion Online player to hardened warrior. This is part one of his journey.[/i]

[i]By Will Borger[/i]

The first week of Albion Online’s current season feels like a dream. We were winning then, you see. Our merry band was crushing it, walking around the Crystal Arena like we owned the place and beating other teams like they owed us money. We were, at one point, 18-1. That seems like a very long time ago. I don’t remember the last time we won a game. Part of it, of course, is me. I don’t know what I’m doing, and the schedule of a freelance writer who spent the last month wracked with illness and overloaded with deadlines that leave me little time to practice doesn’t help.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c0dacf0bb912b12852e58a34e7665e04fe06c608.jpeg[/img]

But the real issue, of course, is that I don’t know what I don’t know. I don’t know what the weapons that aren’t mine do. I don’t know what abilities I need to watch out for. I don’t know what visual cues I need to look for that tell me when, for example, people are immune to damage. It would be a bad idea to attack them at that point, right? Well, you don’t know what you don’t know.

And then there’s the positioning game. It’s easy to get out of position in Albion, and I’ve been guilty of it more than a few times. Being out of position usually means you’re dead. But it’s hard to be in position when you don’t know what the other team is doing, what their builds are, and so on.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8243b1a797d09fb1a59387cbdf7005c09f35a6d2.jpeg[/img]

I can’t expect the team to carry me. I never really did - games like this are too dependent on everyone pulling their weight - but if I’m struggling and another member of the team is struggling? That’s bad news, and not something I can necessarily fix.

Then there’s the stuff beyond your control. We’re an hour-long show, and I don’t always know who I’m going to get for teammates. There’s not a lot of time to practice with them. A decent, well-coordinated team that knows each other can beat a better team. I’m not saying we’re [u]not[/u] well-coordinated, but, well… maybe watch our last stream, where everyone is yelling about whether or not Shozen is at fault for one play (he was: love you, Shozen).

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c3e4a418ca5a0e2e1bb7c78fc2b126d6b331b52c.jpeg[/img]

Speaking of stuff beyond my control, sometimes we fight one team over and over and over again in the arena and they have our number. Not much you can do there, either, except laugh as you get one-shot by a meme build or stunlocked to death or, my personal favorite, stunned and then one-shot. As we say in fighting games, “It can happen to you.”

You may read this column and think “Wow, Will, you sure are making a lot of excuses,” but that’s not the case. I’m trying to figure out what I need to do to improve: what I can do, and what’s beyond my control. Talking out loud, as it were. I can’t control my teammates or how well they play. I can’t control who we draw in the arena. But I can control how much I practice, what I know, how well I position myself, and how much damage I do (more or less). Maybe I need a new weapon. Maybe I just need practice. Maybe the answer is somewhere in between, but I’ll need to play more to find out.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9d7fbe381d6072c346e0520be4879ad0dcacf762.jpeg[/img]

Before our last show, I said “When you hit rock bottom, the only place left to go is up.” It’s not entirely true: you can stay at rock bottom forever. You can get a jackhammer, and start drilling down deeper if you’re really determined. I don’t mind losing in Albion Online, or any game. We’re making capital-C Content down here, after all, and despite it all, I’m having fun. More importantly, it teaches me what I’m doing wrong. You don’t learn at 18-1. But you do down here. And I don’t plan to be down here forever.

[i]Want to see how Will's journey unfolds? Follow his journey every Saturday at 19 UTC on [/i][url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b][u]AlbionTV[/u][/b][/url][u].[/u]

[url=https://albiononline.com/europe][b]Albion Europe[/b][/url] opened its doors to the world on [b]April 29[/b], and tens of thousands of players, new and old, have been pouring onto the server, gathering resources, battling fierce (and sometimes defenseless) mobs, and banding together into guilds and alliances. notes.title: Albion Online Breaks All-Time Player Record — Again!
notes.content:
Since the launch of [url=https://albiononline.com/europe][b]Albion Europe[/b][/url] on [b]April 29[/b], player numbers in Albion have been soaring. And on May 1, the game passed a new milestone with [b]350,000 [/b]daily active users!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cfda3872353587472e2128b0613e21604db1d194.jpeg[/img]

(Note: for the purposes of this chart, "users" refers to active accounts.)

The previous record across all platforms of 300,000 daily active users came following the launch of Albion Asia in April 2023, but this has now been broken by more than 50,000. This makes the launch of the new server one of the most momentous events in the game’s history, with Albion Europe alone accounting for over [b]150,000[/b] players daily. On [b]Steam[/b], too, a new peak player count record was set, with over [b]27,000[/b] concurrent players across all servers.

Albion is now flourishing more than ever across the globe, with new players, experienced players, and returning players alike bringing the world to life. So thanks to our community’s continued support in making Albion what it is, and here’s to the future!

Every day, intrepid souls are stepping onto Albion’s shores to write their stories in a brand-new world, including on the new [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-europe-live][b]Albion Europe[/b][/url] server. [previewyoutube=ZSLuF-MVh2Y;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]“We’re no strangers to video games, and we've taken inspiration for quite a few of our songs from some of our favorite games over the years![/i]

[i]Then last year something extraordinary happened, and the fine people from Sandbox Interactive approached us with the idea of writing an original song for the game - an offer we of course had to accept![/i]

After much anticipation, [b]Albion Europe[/b] is now open to all players! To get this new server off the ground as smoothly as possible, a number of measures are temporarily in place to give all players the best experience possible. This includes an initially reduced world size, some items added to the Marketplace, and certain restrictions on the Black Market. For more details on these measures, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/195377][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=ZSLuF-MVh2Y;full][/previewyoutube]

And this campaign runs [b]in addition to[/b] our regular daily chests. So if you’re not busy building up your character on Albion Europe, tune into Twitch to get a fluffy new mount skin!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7f55ae8006b1f0c456141500c734abfd0bf10d85.jpeg[/img]

At [b]17:50 on Saturday 4 May[/b], join hosts Robinhoodrs, Shozen, and Bogul to watch the very first territory invasions on the new server. notes.title: Your First Steps in Albion Online
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/37fe9cb36ef1298687b45043f6c2e354a13db50c.jpeg[/img]

If you’re new to Albion Online, you might be wondering how best to get started after the tutorial. Albion is a huge, sandbox universe, with practically endless possibilities. But to set you on solid ground before you forge your own unique path, here are some helpful pointers to get you off to a smooth start.

[previewyoutube=UZ0Tqq4mV-o;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Expeditions and Dungeons[/h3]
Albion Online doesn’t offer set quest lines - rather, you decide what path you will take from the beginning. With that in mind, though, a good early objective is to increase your [b]Fame[/b] (Albion’s equivalent of experience points), which will let you unlock more gear and abilities.

Combat Fame can be gained by killing mobs, and an [b]Expedition[/b] is a great way to do this early on. Just visit the Expedition Master near the center of any Starter Town or City - marked by a large glowing blue portal to begin. Expeditions offer plenty of Combat Fame, plus an additional reward for the first Expedition you complete each day.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/47a33977878bd043a0cc8d10a3ec8678b616502c.jpeg[/img]

For a greater challenge, find a [b]Solo Dungeon[/b] in the open world. A tier 3 dungeon should be easy to complete, and offer more Silver and loot than an expedition.
[h3]Playing the Market[/h3]
After a few expeditions or dungeons, you’ll be able to unlock [b]tier 3 or 4 weapons and armor[/b], along with enough Silver to buy some new gear. You’ll also be able to equip a [b]Riding Horse[/b] or [b]Transport Ox[/b], which are big improvements over your humble Mule.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3239a2c63bfa318dc0ae95ddf11aa61c62d13952.jpeg[/img]

This is also a good time to begin gathering resources. Buy a [b]bag[/b] and some[b] tier 2 gathering tools[/b] from the market, and journey out into the open world. Each of Albion’s five biomes contains three types of natural resource:
[list]	[*][b]Steppe[/b]: hide, fiber, ore[/*]	[*][b]Forest[/b]: wood, hide, stone[/*]	[*][b]Swamp[/b]: fiber, wood, hide[/*]	[*][b]Mountain[/b]: ore, stone, fiber[/*]	[*][b]Highlands[/b]: wood, stone, ore[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9bb7a2a94bc19325dc9213cf6fbbd8aa0c3f73ac.jpeg[/img]

The resources you gather can be used to craft weapons and armor, but at this stage it probably makes more sense to sell them at the [b]Marketplace[/b] and buy any items you desire.
[h3]PvP[/h3]
It’s not just mobs that you can fight in Albion Online - you can also go into combat against other players. PvP rules in Albion Online vary depending on the zone you are in. In [b]blue zones[/b], you cannot be killed or looted. In [b]yellow zones[/b], you can be attacked by other players, but not killed or looted - you only get knocked down. In [b]red[/b] or [b]black zones[/b], you can be killed and lose the items you’re carrying, or kill your enemies and take their loot. Keep in mind that you will [b]never[/b] lose your hard-earned Silver or Gold if killed or knocked down by players or monsters.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/243d7dd1ebda095f6ae5c0216646bbdddb1ac43f.png[/img]

If you want to start your PvP journey in relative safety, try some [b]Arena[/b] battles, where you don’t have to worry about losing your items. You can also join a [b]City Faction[/b] to fight against rival factions in the open world. Or try out a [b]Hellgate[/b], with varying degrees of danger.

Once you get the hang of it, PvP in Albion Online can be truly thrilling. Just remember the golden rule: [b]never go into battle with more gear than you can afford to lose[/b]!
[h3]Continuing Your Journey[/h3]
Now that you know the basics, a huge universe is open to you in Albion. Experiment with an almost endless range of possible [b]builds[/b] for your character. Join a [b]guild[/b], and take part in fierce battles for territories or help forge an economic empire. Buy your own [b]island[/b] to farm animals and crops which you can take to market. Venture deeper into the [b]open world[/b], in search of more valuable resources, mobs, and dungeons. Explore Albion’s more mysterious and magical realms like the [b]Mists [/b]and the[b] Roads of Avalon[/b]. Or just go [b]fishing[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/83f70f72bb4cfb6b1007adf1d16762d079a2f3f0.png[/img]

In Albion Online, greater risk brings greater rewards - so don’t be afraid to take the next step into the unknown. Remember, if it doesn’t work out you can just dust yourself off and go again, or try a different path. Your journey is in your hands. So good luck out there, adventurer, maybe we’ll run into each other some time!

notes.title: Season 23 Begins This Weekend
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4cc727135faacdf65f74bfa8fd2668ab7e34b85e.jpeg[/img]

[b]Season 23[/b] begins this Saturday, [b]April 20[/b], on [b]Albion Asia[/b] and [b]Albion Americas[/b]! Following the launch of the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations][b]Foundations[/b][/url] update, guilds will build up mighty Fortifications, raise Siege Banners, and wield the first Crystal Weapons in combat. On [b]Albion Europe[/b] this season - its first - will kick off on [b]May 4th[/b]. For full season schedules and rewards, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/194638][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

[b]Territory Timer Changes[/b]

With the launch of Albion Europe, this season sees some changes introduced to territories across all three servers, to optimize action times and better serve each region. For a rundown of these changes, click [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-23-changes][b]here[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5fe9961db787d37b191deba6b6b8aa586ae465ce.jpeg[/img]

[b]Crystal League Changes[/b]

Season 23 also sees some changes coming to Crystal League schedules on [b]Albion Americas:[/b]

[b]5v5 Crystal League[/b]
[list]	[*]Levels 1-5 reduced from four daily matches to two[/*]	[*]Levels 6-7 reduced from two weekly matches to one[/*]	[*]19:00 - 21:00 UTC timers have been removed[/*][/list]
[b]20v20 Crystal League[/b]
[list]	[*]Levels 1-2 reduced from four daily matches to two[/*]	[*]Level 3 reduced from eight daily matches to four[/*][/list]
All timers have also been adjusted to match regional Prime Times on each server. For full schedules, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/194638][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dd063bb66f7eaaebd3a14199f8601fcf28569f3a.jpeg[/img]

[b]New Features[/b]

This season brings some huge new developments in the form of Fortifications, Territory Activity Chests, Siege Banners, new territory layouts, and more. For full details on what’s coming, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/foundations-update][b]Foundations update patchnotes[/b][/url], and watch this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-fortifications][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].

[previewyoutube=WcFauluLlqY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Watch the Action Live[/h3]
As always, your tireless [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] crew will be bringing you the action from the season kickoffs on all three servers. At [b]13:50 UTC on April 20[/b] you can tune in to watch things get underway on [b]Albion Asia[/b]. Then, at [b]00:50 UTC on April 21[/b], they’ll be bringing you coverage of [b]Albion Americas[/b]. notes.title: The “Foundations” Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a223dfd54182c21ade978aec1a41480233a668a7.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Foundations[/b] are ready for a new era in warfare! With mighty [b]Fortifications[/b], rousing [b]Siege Banners[/b], overflowing [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b], and a lot more, Albion’s latest update lays the groundwork for fierce battles all across its lands.

In anticipation of what’s about to unfold, we’ve produced a brand-new trailer for the occasion. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=vTj-NaMx4gs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Man the Barricades[/h3]
This update introduces[b] Fortifications[/b] to territory warfare. Guilds can upgrade the walls, gates, and guards protecting their territories, providing progressively more staunch barriers to would-be attackers. [b]Siege Banners[/b], meanwhile, change the dimensions of territory battles, forcing attackers and defenders alike to rethink their tactics - attackers must carry a banner to the territory tower to be victorious, but defenders have the opportunity to end an attack early by controlling the banner themselves, until it’s destroyed.

For more on these exciting new features, check out this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-fortifications][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/59d13a9a8dcbb7422c3e263421827979ce58ca79.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Incentives[/h3]
[b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] accumulate loot based on activity levels in surrounding regions. This encourages guilds to be active around their holdings, and even to ensure outsiders operate in safety there. But with greater riches comes an incentive for rivals, who can loot the chests and make off with the spoils themselves.

Foundations also introduces the next three[b] Crystal Weapons[/b] in the game: the[b] Arctic Staff[/b], [b]Phantom Twinblade[/b], and [b]Crystal Reaper[/b]. With unique, powerful spells, these weapons offer a prestigious reward for players who are successful in the Conqueror’s Challenge.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/baf7453dd7db33e06c38b58a8acbfeb8bb1d3a23.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Further Features[/h3]
A much-anticipated [b]Spectator Mode[/b] gives creators and streamers the ability to broadcast their own Custom Matches, allowing them to organize their own, exciting tournaments however they want to. [b]Hammers[/b] have been refreshed with [b]new spells[/b], ready to strike down opponents on Albion’s battlefields. And a host of further features have been added across the game, such as solo [b]Tracking [/b]improvements, [b]new territory layouts[/b], and a number of combat balance changes.

Foundations is live now, so log in and check out these new features! For a full rundown of the changes in this update, read the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/foundations][b]patchnotes[/b][/url], and see the [b]official update page[/b] for more info:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: Guild Season Wrapup: 22 Americas / 4 Asia
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1486fe0d7fe6d2e1960ce0f9e41a98d7ab6aec35.jpeg[/img]

The first [b]Guild Season[/b] of 2024 has reached its conclusion, and it’s time to congratulate the winners! So hats off to [b]IFures[/b], who claimed their first title on [b]Albion Americas[/b], and [b]PLAC[/b], who successfully defended their crown on [b]Albion Asia[/b]. Read on for a rundown of how the seasons played out…

[h3]Albion Americas: IFures Rise to the Top[/h3]
[b]Season 22[/b] began with a flurry of activity, as two major forces announced they'd be gunning for top spot. Both [b]IFures[/b] &[b] Superiore[/b] charged into the season battling it out over castles, cores, vortexes, and anything else that would give Season Points. It soon became clear that this clash of the titans wouldn't just involve these two guilds, though, and it wasn't long until coalitions were formed on both sides.

But within the first week Superiore suffered a devastating defeat in their homeland, [b]Sunfang Cliffs[/b], with IFures able to break through their lines and raid the territory, claiming the Raw Energy and causing a massive rift within Superiore. Within twenty-four hours this led to the guild’s collapse, seemingly opening the way for IFures to steamroll their way through the rest of the season.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/03395ffdd3a76068bc9810d4d3396660b866b7a4.jpeg[/img]

It wasn't all plain sailing from here though, as another contender for the top prize, [b]FAX[/b], stepped up and threw their gauntlet into the ring. This sparked conflicts across multiple timers, but IFures were up for the fight and, in the final month of the season, managed to breach FAX’s homelands and raid their energy. This didn't come without its costs, though, as the FAX coalition was able to evict [b]Contingent [/b]from their home of [b]Darkbough Snag [/b]in the process.

On the final Invasion Day, IFures managed to secure the title, ending their season with just over 1 million points, with FAX coming in second with 869,000 points, and [b]B l a c k-L i s t [/b]third with 581,000 points.

[h3]Albion Asia: PLAC Hold their Title[/h3]
[b]Season 4[/b] got off to a quieter start than previous seasons on [b]Albion Asia[/b], due to the hangover from the season-long war of Season 3. With guilds settling down and making pacts, [b]PLAC [/b]was set for a straightforward victory.

It wasn't long until things spiced up, though, and with the [b]SQUAD [/b]alliance still out for blood against the [b]LIGHT [/b]alliance, pockets of action flared up. Raids gradually gathered pace, along with battles for castles and vortexes, and it wasn't long until a full-scale war broke out again. This lasted until the end of the season, with both sides putting up some incredible battleboards.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/62a96ad356bc67c5080db882809cc431fba85558.jpeg[/img]

But, midway through the season, it wasn't SQUAD that LIGHT were looking to blind, but rather [b]Vermin [/b]and their comfortable hold on second place. [b]RADIANT [/b]looked to loosen their grip and, after a week of raids, Vermin soon conceded and RADIANT were on the way to second spot.

The final Invasion Day was another bloody one, as RADIANT looked to secure their homeland of [b]Sunfang Cliffs[/b], a territory holding 60,000 Season Points. With everyone’s gaze fixed here, RADIANT claimed the territory after a thirty-minute battle, and with that secured second place for the season.

In the final reckoning, PLAC took first place with a million points, followed by RADIANT in 2nd with 635,000 points and Vermin in third with 585,000 points.

notes.title: The Albion Europe Open Beta is Live!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/37fe9cb36ef1298687b45043f6c2e354a13db50c.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Albion Europe Open Beta[/b] is now here, for[b] anyone[/b] who wants to join! Until [b]April 23[/b], players can earn the new [b]Duelist[/b] vanity set, play on a condensed version of Albion with massively [b]buffed progress[/b], and experience the new server before it officially launches - and it’s [b]completely free to play[/b]. Read on for more details…

[previewyoutube=vKt2NkOk37M;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Beta Challenge[/h3]
In the [b]Beta Challenge[/b], you can unlock a brand-new, exclusive vanity set: the Duelist. This razor-sharp fighter is not available in any store, and once unlocked can be used [b]on any server[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f586a137f89da55c651166b6690c5db28ed84837.png[/img]

Performing open-world activities will grant players challenge points, which you can use to unlock each of the vanity items. The milestones for each item are as follows:
[list]	[*][b]25,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Boots[/*]	[*][b]50,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Cape[/*]	[*][b]75,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Hat[/*]	[*][b]100,000 points[/b]: Duelist’s Armor[/*]	[*][b]100,000 points[/b] and [b]Founder Status[/b]: Duelist’s Lynx[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f5a63cdc3ba8c7012d80f7c6af150df3dcae0b75.jpeg[/img]

Players in the Albion Europe Beta receive a number of additional benefits to help them progress quickly through the stages of the game. These are:
[list]	[*][b]Premium status[/b] for the whole beta[/*]	[*][b]2000 Learning Points[/b][/*]	[*][b]+100% Fame[/b] from gathering, farming, and PvE[/*]	[*][b]+200% Resources[/b] from gathering and fishing[/*]	[*][b]+200% Silver[/b] from mobs[/*]	[*]Resource weight [b]reduced by 66%[/b][/*][/list]

notes.title: Crystal Weapons are Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a1df58574894e6b882cda6507728b7bd34fb8c2c.jpeg[/img]

The first Guild Season of 2024 has come to an end, and players are receiving the first [b]Crystal Weapon[/b] artifacts from their Conqueror’s Chests! This means that across Albion those who earned these items through their season prowess can begin crafting, and fighting with, the first weapons in this new and prestigious series.

With that in mind, we thought we’d take a look at these three new weapons, to see what you can bring to the battlefields of Albion.

[b]Infinity Blade[/b]

Infinity Blade is a Crystal Weapon in the [b]Sword[/b] line, with the devastating [b]Limitbreaker[/b] spell.

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/6604201e5df18_480.mp4[/video]

Limitbreaker lets your character rush at whirlwind speed towards your enemies, until you unleash two lethal swipes of the weapon. The first silences and damages your victim, while the second deals an additional dose of damage for good measure.

[b]Rift Glaive[/b]

Rift Glaive is a [b]Spear[/b] weapon which can decimate crowds with the [b]Razor’s Edge[/b] spell.

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/66041fde3828a_720.mp4[/video]

Casting this spell drives your character forward into your enemies, knocking them back and dealing some serious damage. This damage increases the more Spirit Spear charges your character has, giving you the potential to unleash some serious devastation.

[b]Astral Staff[/b]

For those who embrace the arcane arts, Astral Staff is an [b]Arcane Staff[/b] Crystal Weapon, and its unique spell is the awe-inspiring [b]Starfall[/b].

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/660439898d56a_720.mp4[/video]

Starfall calls down a shower of shooting stars around you, periodically inflicting magical damage on your adversaries. This celestial storm cannot be interrupted, and also increases your character’s Resilience Penetration as it imbues you with the power of the heavens.

The [url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations][b]Foundations[/b][/url] update on [b]April 15[/b] will introduce the next three Crystal Weapons: Arctic Staff (Frost Staff), Phantom Twinblade (Quarterstaff), and Crystal Reaper (Axe). Players can begin to earn the artifacts for those in Season 23, which also sees some huge developments arriving in the form of Fortifications, Siege Banners, and Territory Activity Chests. For some of the other changes coming to Guild Seasons, click [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-23-changes][b]here[/b][/url], and for a full season schedule, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/194638][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: Upcoming Guild Season Changes
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7f55ae8006b1f0c456141500c734abfd0bf10d85.jpeg[/img]

The current Guild Season is reaching its climax, and it’s time to start preparing for the next. With the launch of the [url=https://albiononline.com/europe][b]Albion Europe[/b][/url] server on [b]April 29[/b], some significant changes are coming to the way seasons operate. Read on for an overview of these changes, so you can get ready to assemble your forces and fight your way to glory.

[b]Season Names[/b]

Starting with the upcoming Guild Season, we’re simplifying the naming conventions for seasons across the three servers. For this reason, next season will be called Season 23 [b]on all servers[/b], avoiding a confusing situation where the season has a different name on each server.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ba6757ec1816af3d2b34bf1f018869ab9ac247ab.jpeg[/img]

[b]Prime Times[/b]

With the launch of Albion Europe, we’re taking the opportunity to rework Prime Times across all three servers in order to better suit activity periods on each. Each server will now have [b]six Prime Time slots[/b] (rather than seven), and the windows on Albion Americas are now more condensed, encouraging constant action from start to finish. Albion Europe’s Prime Times fit this pattern, covering [b]ten hours in total[/b].

Here is an overview of Prime Times across the servers (click to expand):

[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7c96f6d6c71b0f0b91a0d84845cb5b6769a214c3.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d0d4089dc4f7decd32f8b1f7fafade189b77f40b.jpeg[/img][/url]

As you can see, Castle and Castle Outpost chests unlock [b]one hour before [/b]each server’s Prime Time window, [b]one hour after[/b], and [b]on every hour between Prime Times[/b]. With this in mind, the lock duration of Castle chests has been reduced from [b]120 to 60 minutes[/b].

Additionally, it should be noted that [b]World Bosses on Albion Asia[/b] will now spawn every even-numbered hour (UTC), to avoid colliding with the maintenance window.

[b]Season Winner Statues[/b]

With three servers from Season 23 onwards, Season Winner Statues will be the same across all servers, and will no longer be designed by the guilds themselves but rather by the Sandbox Interactive art team.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4cc727135faacdf65f74bfa8fd2668ab7e34b85e.jpeg[/img]

With [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-fortifications][b]Fortifications[/b][/url], [b]Siege Banners[/b], and all the other changes coming to territory warfare with the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations][b]Foundations[/b][/url] update, Season 23 promises to be truly action-packed. For the season schedule and rewards, check out [b][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/194638]this forum post[/url][/b]. See you on the battlefield!
