notes.title: Dev Talk: 2023 Development Update
notes.content:
The new [b]Albion East[/b] server opened to players worldwide March 20, offering a Singapore-based server with an untouched version of Albion. The launch attracted throngs of new and old players to the server, and we're thrilled to see this new version of Albion take shape day-by-day. 

With the launch a success, Game Director [b]Robin Henkys[/b] discusses what's next for the world of Albion in our newest Dev Talk (subtitles are available for all supported languages):

[previewyoutube=QIOAQ5EVch8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]What's Next in the Short Term?[/h3][list]	[*][b]Rites of Spring[/b] event: Similar to 2022, but with a new, bad-tempered counterpart to the Spring Cottontail[/*]	[*][b]Beyond the Veil Content Patch[/b]: New features for the Mists, adjustments to the Roads of Avalon, usability improvements[/*]	[*]"[b]Dungeons in the Mists[/b]": Central feature; will be discussed in a forthcoming Dev Talk[/*]	[*]After that: Next [b]major content update[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/64c8ac7169e58b25b69a84378209f1c6ef6a9df7.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]Albion's Development Strategy[/h3]
Albion has become quite large and complex, requiring a development strategy that allows us to maintain, improve and revolutionize the game at the same time.

[u][b]Better Basics[/b][/u]

Consistent improvement of [b]core aspects[/b] of the game, especially where most impactful:
[list]	[*][b]Improved Marketplace experience[/b]: Repair All, Sell All, improved filtering and easier large-scale purchases[/*]	[*][b]More stable loot experience[/b] by optimizing [b]Black Market[/b][/*]	[*][b]Improving Stone market,[/b] reworking [b]crafting capacity[/b] and [b]crafting on player islands[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b8a6fbecac6643137aaadefbbe7e34e4954aaed0.jpeg[/img][/b]

[u][b]Continuous Content[/b][/u]

Expanding on features [b]already in the game[/b]:
[list]	[*][b]New gear choices[/b] for the "You are what you wear" system[/*]	[*][b]Rites of Spring + Content Patch[/b] (both with new items)[/*]	[*][b]New Weapon Line[/b] for the Hunter tree[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/38585d9e1599e23c6e92f535c398a4e7b4502e06.jpeg[/img]

[u][b]Fantastic Features[/b][/u]

[b]New features[/b] that expand the scope of Albion Online (these are always in flux, but a few are in progress):
[list]	[*][b]Legendary Weapons[/b]: Weapons can attain "Legendary" status through use, and be given a [b]unique name[/b]; these have a chance of being added to the [b]loot pool [/b]on death, thus leaving a lasting mark on Albion[/*]	[*]Improved spell behavior around [b]walls and height differences[/b]: Precursor to proper [b]castle and siege fights[/b] that may include [b]player-made fortifications[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/731312e687c9e63de8c607de57527b3fa7cd5afc.jpeg[/img][/b]

That's it for today - stay tuned for more Dev Talks covering these themes and Albion’s next major update!

notes.title: Basic Builds: Battleaxe
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/49ddad47e545c1594ec44f3811914c5debe2cdcf.jpeg[/img]

This is the first of our [b]Basic Builds[/b] series of guides for beginner-to-intermediate players. Each guide presents a suggested build and describes how its abilities work in tandem. You can try these out as-is, or use them as a starting point to create new builds of your own.
[h3]Characteristics[/h3]
This build is based around the Battleaxe, which is characterized by a self-sustaining ability called Blood Bandit that lets you throw your axe twice, dealing damage while also healing yourself.

The full build offers additional self-healing, a defensive ability with energy recovery, and additional mobility.

Here’s the full breakdown!
[h3]Equipment and Skills Used[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b7c514db6c71b8a706f2d2c9dfd067d5a08ea5c5.png[/img]

[b]Adept’s Battleaxe[/b]
[list]	[*]Rending Strike/Rending Spin	[list]		[*]You can choose between two spells for your Q slot, one for single targets and one for area damage. They both deal damage and apply bleed stacks to your target(s).[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Adrenaline Boost	[list]		[*]Your W ability offers damage, attack speed and movement speed modifiers that help you maximize your damage and stick to your target.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Blood Bandit	[list]		[*]The main ability allows you to deal additional damage at a range depending on the amount of bleed stacks on your target. This is a two-part combo, with the first cast dealing increased damage and the second applying a direct heal to yourself.[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Adept’s Scholar Cowl[/b]
[list]	[*]Energy Shield	[list]		[*]Your cowl has a defensive spell that decreases your damage taken while recovering energy for every hit taken during its active time.[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Adept’s Mercenary Jacket[/b]
[list]	[*]Bloodlust	[list]		[*]The jackets active ability allows you to regain some health for every time you use an auto attack or damage spell.[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Adept’s Mercenary Shoes[/b]
[list]	[*]Refreshing Sprint	[list]		[*]Your shoes allow you to track down targets while lowering your cooldowns, they can also be used to run away from a fight.[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Adept’s Shield:[/b] An off-hand that passively increases your defenses and cc resistance.

[b]Adept’s Bag: [/b]An accessory that increases your passive carry weight capacity.

[b]Adept’s Cape: [/b]An accessory that increases your energy and passive energy regeneration.

[b]Minor Poison Potion: [/b]A potion that inflicts a damage-over-time effect on a target and decreases their resistances for the duration.

[b]Catfish: [/b]A buff food that greatly increases your health regeneration while out of combat. This allows you to get back to full health after clearing a pack of mobs.

[b]Journeyman’s Riding Horse: [/b]A mounted horse that brings you swiftly across the map while adding more passive carry weight.

[i]All items can be bought via the Marketplace, or crafted if the corresponding crafting node has been unlocked.[/i]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/20e888c38b1d41a60495beb62ab38707678d4e19.png[/img]
[h3]Build Pros and Cons[/h3]
[b]Pros:[/b]
[list]	[*]Great sustain against strong enemies[/*]	[*]Good energy management[/*]	[*]Good clear speed[/*]	[*]Good chase potential[/*]	[*]Affordable[/*][/list]
[b]Cons:[/b]
[list]	[*]Bleeds can put you in combat for an extended period of time[/*]	[*]Not applicable in large scale fights[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/132d8c7f255543971594a9b778e82094e6186a5b.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Playstyle[/h3][list]	[*]Use your Q spell to deal direct damage and apply bleeds to your target(s). You can use direct attacks in between the spells.[/*]	[*]Your W ability can be used to buff your damage output for a short amount of time. It’s also a great tool that lets you stick to your target since its buff can be active for up to 7 seconds as long as you deal direct damage to a target.[/*]	[*]Blood Bandit can be used to deal additional damage, and the second cast can be used to recover some health when enemies have multiple bleed stacks on them. Try to use this ability before utilizing your jacket.[/*]	[*]When you’re low on energy or expect to take an increased amount of energy you can use your head ability. For every hit taken you will replenish some energy while generally decreasing the amount of damage you take.[/*]	[*]The jacket can be used to regain a substantial amount of health. It has a high cooldown so it is advised to be used in emergency situations. For every auto attack or direct damage you deal you will be healed by a certain amount, up to 7 times. Pairing this ability with battle rush will let you heal up faster because of the bonus attack speed.[/*]	[*]Shoes are generally a tool for mobility. You can use them to close a gap or to create distance between yourself and the enemy. Refreshing sprint additionally lowers your cooldowns which allows you to use your abilities more frequently.[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c0707c5a96af3bc55b8d29a328739542d7649fd5.jpeg[/img]

That's it for this week - stay tuned for more Basic Builds guides coming soon!

notes.title: Albion East is Open!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/43731e7b3e7b5fc7ed394a91b46d4462ac7154f5.jpeg[/img]

Today’s the day: after much anticipation, [b]Albion East[/b] is now publicly accessible to all players!

Following a successful Closed Beta phase, and an early access period for Founder Pack owners, anyone can now play on Albion’s new, Singapore-based server as this entirely [b]fresh version of Albion[/b] develops from the ground up. Players are pouring into the Royal Continent and Outlands, gathering, crafting, building the economy, and progressing their characters as they gain Fame and form guilds. It’s a truly momentous occasion!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b569ebb7b2501280bbfc5f33a5a549968b1f493f.jpeg[/img]

Initially, Albion East will have a [b]reduced world size[/b] relative to Albion West, in order to maintain competitiveness and density of players. As the player base grows on this new server, it is anticipated that more regions will be opened up, and its development will be constantly observed in order to judge this process. For an overview of available regions, check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/177778][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/21262877def13a67dbc3e5a7a1055edd15805c27.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Limited-Time Starter Bundle Offer[/h3]
To help you get off to the right start in Albion, for a short time there’s a brand-new [b]Starter Bundle[/b] on offer, featuring the popular [b]Knight Adventurer Vanity Bundle[/b]! For the price of a [b]7-day Premium subscription[/b], you’ll receive the following:
[list]	[*][b]Knight Adventurer Vanity Bundle[/b][/*]	[*][b]7 Days Premium Status[/b][/*]	[*][b]50 Gold[/b][/*][/list]This deal is available in the Albion Online Web Shop, the ingame store, the Steam client, and Google Play. Once purchased, it can be claimed on either Albion East or Albion West, and the Vanity component will be available on [b]both servers[/b] once unlocked. The offer runs until [b]10:00 UTC on April 3[/b], so take advantage now!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/98eba5eddd577bcafb377bca36e5dc4d3a0be8d1.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Special Twitch Drop Campaign[/h3]
To celebrate the launch of Albion East, we’re running a special [b]Twitch Drop campaign[/b] from [b]March 15[/b]-[b]29[/b], with exclusive chests containing [b]brand-new items[/b]. During this period, campaigns will run [b]daily[/b] rather than weekly, meaning you can earn chests each day by watching any channel participating in our regular campaigns. For details, check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/177924-Special-Twitch-Drops-for-the-Early-Access-and-Launch-of-Albion-East/][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: Albion's Next Guild Season is Coming
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ba0f90ee248a9f8d23b17681d0a8badfd3deec27.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s next Guild Season kicks off soon - including the [b]first official season[/b] on the new [b]Albion East[/b] Server!

On [b]March 11[/b], [b]Season 19[/b] will begin on [b]Albion West[/b]. Two weeks after that, on [b]March 25[/b], [b]the first Albion East season[/b] will kick off. Note that this time the Albion East season will be slightly shorter - but moving forward seasons on the two servers should be synchronized. Because of its reduced length this time, the final stretch on Albion East will offer [b]tripled Season Points[/b]. For full schedules for both servers, click [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/177438][b]here[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fb4c837d8eec71c39986eece9841222cab5b8b4a.jpeg[/img]

Both Guild Seasons are [b]open to anyone[/b] who wants to play on that server - so you can participate in both simultaneously if you choose. And both offer fantastic prizes to guilds that reach a high enough rank, like the [b]Roving Bastion[/b] and new [b]Sword Dancer Avatar Sets[/b].

In addition, the top three guilds will no longer receive a furniture item of their season statue, but instead will receive new [b]Direwolf Skins[/b] (see top image).

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79f130300408080aeff7451a26160fa7a90e2f0b.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Season Changes[/h3]
As well as those new Direwolf Skin rewards, these seasons bring changes to scoring in the Crystal League and Crystal Arena. All scoring Runestones will reset at the end of each round, to prevent teams from simply defending a Runestone advantage to win a match. Furthermore, Albion East and Albion West will have different time slots for Crystal League matches. For full details on these changes, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/177438][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Watch the Albion West Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The [b]Albion West Season 19[/b] kickoff on [b]Saturday, March 11[/b] will be broadcast live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] starting at [b]17:30 UTC[/b], with hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Lewpac[/b] and [b]Bogul[/b] bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim. Those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on [b]Sunday[/b] at [b]00:30 UTC[/b], when hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Tazzik[/b] cover the next round of invasions. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out AlbionTV's coverage of a previous Invasion Day, which kicked off Season 18:

[previewyoutube=Y8RswYAmoAE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Keeper Challenge Returns!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9fade3d422c0bb7bdfc7f574d635d1be092368ac.jpeg[/img]

Spring is back, and the Keepers of Albion are beginning to awaken... and for the entire month of March, you can take the [b]Keeper Challenge[/b] to collect fantastic rewards! Earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Grizzly Bear mount[/b].

[h3][b]Timeless Treasures are Yours to Claim[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FdTDY3p.png[/img]
[b]GRIZZLY BEAR:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the popular [b]Grizzly Bear[/b], a huge, intimidating mount with an arsenal of powerful spells. In addition to its Intimidating Aura toggle spell, it also gains a temporary [b]speed boost[/b] when attacked, giving its rider an edge when enemies are in pursuit.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dg76ds8.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Reach your goals to unlock the [b]Keeper Challenge avatar ring[/b], which gives your chosen avatar the stone-and-leather look of Albion's true guardians. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded for one [b]Adventurer's Token[/b] at the Vanity Merchant.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/C4sRQZo.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Keeper Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver bags, and rare resources, this month's chests contain various [b]Keeper-themed furniture and capes[/b].

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim your rewards!

notes.title: The Albion East Closed Beta is Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f87cdb7837971e989e053ae80fa96acbe002eab7.png[/img]

The Albion East Closed Beta is now underway! This special, one-of-a-kind event offers a fresh version of the world of Albion with a reduced world size, where all participants can earn unique, valuable rewards.

If you missed it, the newest [b]Dev Talk[/b] from Game Director Robin Henkys gives a good overview. He discusses what to expect from the Albion East server and the Closed Beta, gives a rundown of the unique rewards and unlocks you can earn, and discusses how the world will be unlocked gradually over the course of both the Beta and the full launch.

[previewyoutube=efCTzcsH1aQ;full][/previewyoutube]
And remember, everyone who gets a Founder Pack and joins the Beta will also get the new premiere Vanity Bundle, the [b]Arcanist[/b], unlocked for free on [b]both servers[/b] before it officially goes on sale!

[h3]A Unique Three-Week Guild Season[/h3]
For the duration of Albion East's beta, a unique [b]Beta Guild Season[/b] will let players experience an intense, condensed three-week season. The Beta Season has much faster progression, to allow players to test out as many features and gameplay options as possible.

This progression buff is automatic for all players, and grants the following:
[list]	[*]+100% Fame from gathering, farming, and PvE[/*]	[*]+200% Resources from gathering and fishing[/*]	[*]+200% Silver from mobs[/*]	[*]Resource weight reduced by 66%[/*]	[*]All characters start with 2000 Learning Points[/*][/list][b]Note[/b]: This boost is active only during the beta, and [b]only [/b]on the Albion East server.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/250d2245ae7f5750007719d922758c2868389781.png[/img]

[h3]Earn Permanent Rewards[/h3]
While normal Guild Season rewards unlocked via the Conqueror's Challenge will only be available during the beta, and will not persist after the server is reset at beta end, top-ranking guilds, along with players who make sufficient progress during the season, can unlock unique rewards that [b]persist even after the beta ends[/b].

[b][u]Guild Rewards[/u][/b]

[b]Custom Guild Logos: [/b]The five guilds with the highest ranking at the end of the season will each get a unique custom guild logo, created in collaboration with our art team. These logos will then be added to the game after the beta and become permanently available to guilds on both servers.

[b]Custom Season Statue: [/b]The season’s top guild will get a unique custom guild statue, which will be permanently placed in Albion East's open world for all to see. The second- and third-place guilds will also receive non-custom statues in the open world.

[b][u]Personal Rewards[/u][/b]

[b]Unique Placeable Statues:[/b] During the beta, each player can unlock up to three unique placeable Statue items that they can claim on Albion East or West after the beta ends. Statues are unlocked once per account, and are earned for the following activities (with only the highest-tier statue given for each activity):

[b]PvE Statue:[/b]
[list]	[*]Bronze: Reach 500,000 PvE Fame during beta[/*]	[*]Silver: Be in the top 30% of the Bronze group[/*]	[*]Gold: Be in the top 10% of the Bronze group[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/63d22759ec9cd3c351cbf7ace4cef5a411badcc1.png[/img]

[b]Gathering Statue:[/b]
[list]	[*]Bronze: Reach 150,000 Gathering Fame during beta[/*]	[*]Silver: Be in the top 30% of the Bronze group[/*]	[*]Gold: Be in the top 10% of the Bronze group[/*][/list][b]Trader Statue:[/b]
[list]	[*]Bronze: Possess 300,000 Silver at the end of beta[/*]	[*]Silver: Be in the top 30% of the Bronze group[/*]	[*]Gold: Be in the top 10% of the Bronze group[/*][/list]For the complete season schedule, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/175203][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Albion East Closed Beta is Coming
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/795e9a78079b9de172b47e3f72d935ed2ac7b148.jpeg[/img]

On [b]February 20[/b], the Closed Beta for the new Albion East server begins! This offers a unique, one-of-a-kind opportunity to play a [b]fully untouched version of the game[/b] with boosted progress, and earn rewards which will persist even after launch.

Key features of the beta include:
[list]	[*]A [b]pristine, untouched version of the world of Albion[/b] to explore[/*]	[*]Hugely boosted [b]Fame progression[/b][/*]	[*]Automatic [b]Premium, 2000 Learning Points, [/b]reduced [b]Resource weight[/b][/*]	[*]Unique, one-of-a-kind [b]Guild Season [/b]with permanent rewards for [b]guilds[/b] and [b]individuals[/b] that persist [b]after the beta[/b][/*][/list]
Additionally, everyone who participates in the beta will get the forthcoming [b]Arcanist Wardrobe and Mount Skin Bundle[/b] permanently unlocked free on all characters on their account, before its official release. This premiere bundle will not only make your character stand out during the beta, but can also be used on Albion West and once the Albion East officially launches as well - so you can stand out amongst the crowds on [b]both servers[/b]!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/63e67be141bc9_360.mp4[/video]

In fact, many [b]unique rewards[/b] that you can earn during the Closed Beta, like custom guild logos and placeable statues, will be claimable on [b]Albion West[/b] as well. So even if you’re primarily an Albion West player, you can still mark your triumphant progress in this one-off beta season there. Go get involved, experience Albion like never before, and claim lasting rewards!
[h3]Albion East Founder Packs[/h3]
[b]Albion East Founder Packs[/b] allow you access to all of these benefits, and even more on top. To see what you can get, check out this video:

[previewyoutube=5VeY973vQp4;full][/previewyoutube]

These Founder Packs come in four different tiers, and among the benefits on offer are:
[list]	[*]Up to one year of [b]Premium[/b][/*]	[*]Up to 2,000 [b]Gold[/b][/*]	[*]Up to five days [b]early access [/b]to Albion East[/*]	[*][b]Closed Beta[/b] access[/*]	[*]Themed [b]wardrobe and mount skins[/b][/*]	[*]… and much more![/*][/list]
And don’t forget that many of these rewards [b]can be claimed on Albion West [/b]too - so if that’s your preferred server you can still enjoy these benefits!

For full details of these new Founder Packs and the Albion East server in general, visit the [b]dedicated Albion East page[/b]: [url=https://albiononline.com/asia]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: Refer One Friend and Claim the Frost Moose
notes.content:
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/video_/media/63c529ec3a25c_360.mp4[/video]

[h3]Get the Frost Moose[/h3]

In the depths of Albion’s long, cold winter, many animals hibernate, buried away with the fruits of the previous season’s gathering. But some keep on trucking, trudging through the elements, bravely ferrying wares across the lands to keep Albion’s economy running smoothly.

One such creature stands stoically above all: the famous [b]Frost Moose[/b]. And until April 1, you can transform your [b]Stag base mount [/b]into one of these cool-headed creatures by referring a single friend! With icicles hanging from its great antlers, it will carry you unflappably through the snow and freezing wind - and once you’ve unlocked it, it can do so for [b]any character on your account[/b].

This referral season lasts until maintenance on [b]April 1[/b], so refer a friend now and claim your rewards!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/aeba2536f2b71e312787a4d27fb5f3a0bb286b11.png[/img]

notes.title: The Carnival Challenge Returns

The [b]Carnival Challenge[/b] is back! For the whole month of February, earn Challenge Points, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Saddled Terrorbird[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8icVSJN.png[/img]

With an above-average base move speed and an additional [b]invincibility/speed burst spell[/b], it's the perfect ride for those who need to cover some ground quickly and safely.

This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded for one [b]Adventurer's Token[/b] at the Vanity Merchant.

notes.title: Live Q&A on AlbionTV
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea41c884314e14ee094047ae7c6cefe17691a557.jpeg[/img]

To celebrate the upcoming launch of the new [url=https://albiononline.com/news/coming-to-asia][b]Albion East[/b][/url] server, we can announce an exclusive live stream on [b]January 24 at 19:00 UTC [/b]with Game Director Robin Henkys!

This live question and answer session will take place on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] and viewers will be able to write their questions in the chat, from which selected questions will be answered. There will be insights into the new system and the thoughts behind it, as well as details on how it will work - so tune in to get your questions answered.

And for those who aren't able to tune in then, there will be a restream of the Q&A at [b]12:00 UTC on January 25[/b]. Although we won't be able to get everyone in front of a camera again for that one, there will be live chat interaction with Community Manager [b]Nesnes[/b], who will collect and answer your questions as best as she can.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5692a3ae1e8185b27e48af2a18437d95062ccd05.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Double Twitch Drops[/h3]
To mark this special event, we’ll be giving away [b]double Twitch Drops [/b]during both the live stream and the restream, exclusive to those watching AlbionTV. This means that after [b]15 minutes [/b]you will be able to receive [b]two Epic Chest drops[/b], and [b]two Legendary Chest drops [/b]after a [b]further 30 minutes[/b], meaning a total of 45 minutes watchtime is needed to receive all drops - and viewers who watch both streams can receive both sets of drops. Don’t miss out!

notes.title: Albion Online is Coming to Asia!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/43731e7b3e7b5fc7ed394a91b46d4462ac7154f5.jpeg[/img]

Albion Online will launch a [b]dedicated server for the Asia-Pacific region[/b] in March 2023! This new server will make the world of Albion more accessible than ever for countless new and existing players.

Watch the brand-new announcement trailer here:

[previewyoutube=iUTHkUlxJ4A;full][/previewyoutube]
Along with offering greatly improved connection speeds and ping for players in the region, the new server will also adjust times of game and server events such as maintenance, territory resets, and the Crystal League schedule.

Here are the major features of the new server:
[list]	[*]A [b]fresh start[/b] in a new and untouched version of the game, where all players start as equals and can claim their own piece of Albion[/*]	[*]A game world that is [b]fully separate and independent[/b] from the existing "Albion West" server[/*]	[*][b]Greatly improved connection speeds and ping[/b] for the whole Asia-Pacific region[/*]	[*]Timings of [b]game and server events[/b] (territory battles, Crystal League, Faction Warfare, maintenance, etc.) that are [b]optimized for the region[/b][/*][/list]For more information about servers, characters, and accounts, check out the [url=http://albiononline.com/asia][b]dedicated Albion East landing page[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea41c884314e14ee094047ae7c6cefe17691a557.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Live Q&A[/h3]
On [b]January 24 at 19:00 UTC[/b], you can take part in an exclusive Q&A with Game Director [b]Robin Henkys[/b] on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url]! Tune in to learn more about the new server and its development, and [b]ask your own questions in the chat[/b], in this special event. Stay tuned for more details.

notes.title: Fame Week Happening Now!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e69097e59b9235c73e6348c2cd8a69f63f7f509a.png[/img]

notes.title: Beyond the Veil Patch 3 is here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0b0763538113b43c5611f3096def7545c7988b03.jpeg[/img]

[b]Beyond the Veil Patch 3[/b] has arrived! This patch continues to improve the Roads of Avalon, as well as introducing Streamer Mode, various Combat Balance changes, and more. Read on for details…

[h3]Roads of Avalon Improvements[/h3]
Following player feedback after the Beyond the Veil update, the [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]have undergone some significant changes to improve their playability for all group sizes, including solo players. Avalonian Camps have been rebalanced for [b]different group sizes[/b], and are once again [b]marked by a chest icon [/b]on the map. Furthermore, mobs surrounding chests in the Roads will [b]upgrade in line with the chests[/b], and with each upgrade all dead mobs around the chest will [b]respawn[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/373090e22886d1b1f596d5ff83ca85a85323d9da.jpeg[/img]

These changes should make the Roads more appealing to a wider range of players, and in turn ensure they’re a lively, well-populated part of Albion. And alongside these improvements, the Roads have received a long-awaited [b]visual overhaul[/b], making them more aesthetically in-tune with the rest of Albion while highlighting their unique character.

[h3]Streamer Mode[/h3]
To improve the experience of those who stream Albion, as well as their viewers, a new [b]Streamer Mode [/b]has been introduced. This can be toggled on and off in the Settings menu, and when activated hides certain UI features that can identify the streamer’s location to viewers. This will help streamers avoid stream-snipers while broadcasting, as well as hide login details when disconnected.

[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Changes to the [b]home removal debuff[/b], allowing more freedom for small-scale travel[/*]	[*]Various [b]Combat Balance changes[/b][/*]	[*]New [b]Crystal Realm map [/b]for Season 18[/*]	[*]… and more[/*][/list]For a complete list of changes, see the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/beyond-the-veil-patch-3][b]official patch notes[/b][/url].

notes.title: 2022: Albion's Year in Review
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72140ef436e0121f99bda78720a02f3b99f8c9ce.jpeg[/img]

2022 was a big year in the world of Albion, with major content updates, a huge five-year milestone, and an ever-growing worldwide community of players. Join us for a look back at some of the major highlights…

[h3]Albion Awakened[/h3]
2022 began by building on the solid foundation laid by the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened][b]Lands Awakened update[/b][/url] in late 2021. The [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], newly introduced with Lands Awakened, was streamlined over the ensuing Guild Seasons in early 2022 to offer guilds of all sizes a huge number of ways to earn Might and Favor and unlock spectacular rewards, while making Might Levels easier to reach.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f30afea69f343eb7dd094fb22faba5b6f4398a8.jpeg[/img]

Rewards for the Crystal League were also increased, and an updated map was introduced to make this core 5v5 content more dynamic and unpredictable.
[h3]Controller Support, Awards and Events[/h3]
In March 2022, Albion Online became playable with controllers and on the newly launched [b]Steam Deck[/b], opening the game up to a whole new audience and playstyle.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2cc5438b6ff74d312016b3c7be89ea7baaf4c9ea.jpeg[/img]

Then in April, Albion Online received the [b]German Computer Games Prize[/b] for [b]Best Mobile Game[/b]. This rounded out a season that saw Albion honored by a growing list of achievements:
[list]	[*][b]Deutscher Entwicklerpreis: Best Mobile Game[/b][/*]	[*][b]MassivelyOP Year-End Awards: Best PvP[/b][/*]	[*][b]GamingonPhone Game Awards: Best Mobile Port[/b][/*]	[*][b]Deutscher Computerspielpreis: Best Mobile Game[/b][/*][/list]Spring also brought a massively expanded [b]Rites of Spring[/b] event that introduced a new mount, the [b]Spring Cottontail[/b] rabbit, which was growable from rare eggs that spawned throughout the world.

[previewyoutube=c2F0CrLMd3k;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Into the Fray[/h3]
In June, the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/into-the-fray][b]Into the Fray[/b][/url] update went live, improving and expanding numerous game systems and introducing fully reworked [b]Magic Staffs[/b]. The update also brought new [b]Portal Towns[/b], improved Castles, the non-lethal Crystal League, Victory Emotes, and numerous other features and much more.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/232d592b4a8baf3962038b41f82ba2143aaf5429.jpeg[/img]

Further improvements to Magic Staffs came with the "Arcane and Frost" Patch several months later, and additional patches later in the year brought features like a new [b]Guild Finder[/b] and support for [b]Japanese and Italian[/b].

[h3]Albion Celebrates Five Years[/h3]
In July, Albion Online celebrated a huge milestone: the [b]fifth anniversary[/b] of its launch in 2017. The celebrations kicked off with a major in-game event, [b]Living Legacy[/b], which saw statues of Albion's past season winners come to life and roam the open world.

[previewyoutube=pwTNtdvemgs;full][/previewyoutube]

The festivities continued with a special [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YlCnHz4g0B4][b]Anniversary Stream[/b][/url] where Albion's developers discussed creating the game, offered rare insights into early development builds, and gave a sneak peek at what the coming months and years might bring to the world of Albion.

[h3]Beyond the Veil[/h3]
In the fall, Albion's next major update, [b]Beyond the Veil[/b], went live. This update brought mysterious and magical new realms to the game, foremost among them the [b]Mists[/b], a new land of danger and opportunity. The update also introduced the lost city of [b]Brecilien[/b], a whole new [b]Fey Armor[/b] line, Pristine Resources, and numerous other features and improvements.

[previewyoutube=rZqlngveFyo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Year-End Honors[/h3]
Last but not least, 2022 was rounded out by another honor: the game received the [b]MassivelyOP "Best PvP" Award[/b] for the second year in a row! It also appeared on several best-of lists in 2022, including [b]Rock Paper Shotgun[/b]'s "30 Best Steam Deck Games" and [b]MMORPG.GG[/b]'s "18 Best Isometric MMOs".

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4bfb4ddd4b9357ac491bf797ed4804cbaff0d1f8.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Looking Forward to 2023[/h3]
In early 2023 we'll continue improving on the updated Mists and Roads introduced with Beyond the Veil. Alongside that, we'll be working on new features and improvements to the game throughout the year, so stay tuned for announcements. For now, we want to extend our thanks to you, the Albion community, for making everything we do possible.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Find Uncle Frost this Yuletide
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/205437b427a7dde28d70c5663c0925947a6ebdfc.jpeg[/img]

Across the lands, monsters and adventurers alike are preparing for the arrival of a legendary being. No one knows where he comes from. Many have even questioned his existence. But we can confirm: [b]Uncle Frost [/b]is real, and he’s in Albion!

Until [b]Friday December 30 at 10:00 UTC[/b], you have the chance of encountering this famous figure in one of his festive grottos. These can appear in any [b]T4-T8 Solo or Group Randomized Dungeon[/b], regardless of the faction or zone - just look for Christmas trees at the end of the dungeon. If you defeat Uncle Frost there, you can find themed furniture and vanity items, including snowballs and, for the very fortunate, the ultra-rare [b]Yule Stag[/b] mount skin!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/810b92b4ef9296276a932ccccc48125d6059d505.png[/img]

[h3]Join the Festivities[/h3]
It’s not just down in the dungeons that you’ll find the seasonal spirit, though. Across Albion the cities will be decked out in festive finery, and all players will be sent [b]fireworks[/b] and a [b]huge heap of snowballs[/b] to join in the mood. To claim these, simply log into the game before [b]10:00 UTC on December 30[/b], and you’ll find an ingame mail containing your gifts. All characters will receive this, as long as they’ve completed the tutorial.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7637238d533cfddb74aade728704aaab304fd77e.png[/img]

So delve into the dungeons, engage in some snowball-based non-lethal PvP, or set the skies ablaze with a firework show - see you out there!

notes.title: Season 18 Starts Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d34f4449fe29068d3473986d6456866a3b3d1873.png[/img]

Albion’s next Guild Season begins Saturday, December 17, with a quicker pace and changes to the Crystal Arena and Conqueror’s Challenge, plus valuable rewards like the powerful [b]Goliath Horseeater[/b] for ranking guilds. Click [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/173054][b]here[/b][/url] for the full season schedule, or read on for more details...
[h3]Unique Season Rewards[/h3]
Players who gain enough Might will receive unique [b]Avatar Sets[/b], as well as the [b]Goliath Horseeater[/b] and valuable [b]Fame Buffs[/b]. Might is earned through a huge range of activities in the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], and there are additional [b]bracket rewards[/b] for guilds who reach at least Iron Rank. And as always, the season's number-one guild will become a permanent part of the world of Albion with their very own statue in [b]Conquerors' Hall[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/300828bd4848feff883b2029f8ade2fbbb593454.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Season Changes[/h3]
Season 18 brings some changes to the [b]Crystal Arena[/b]. Wins will offer more ranking points, to make the rank-up process flow more smoothly. Furthermore, players will receive new avatar frames for reaching Gold, Silver, and Crystal ranks, which are non-tradable and can only be obtained by reaching these ranks. In the Conqueror’s Challenge, the [b]Crystal Spider Rush[/b] requires less Might for each Guild Might Level, and each level gives more Season Points - significantly increasing the point value of each Spider. Finally, Crystal Spiders in the open world and the Roads of Avalon now drop double the loot.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1957905f0fe184f22f277148f99ca4f81e0d61ea.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The season kickoff on Saturday, December 17 will be broadcast live on [url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] starting at [b]17:30 UTC[/b], with hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Lewpac[/b] and [b]Bogul[/b] bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim. Those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on Sunday at [b]00:30 UTC[/b], when hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Tazzik[/b] cover the next round of invasions. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

notes.title: The Yuletide Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/018abb2522e1b1feab3288d50274986151fbcafc.jpeg[/img]

Winter has returned to Albion, and the [b]Yuletide Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of December, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests, and earn rewards like an avatar ring, classic furniture items, and the beloved [b]Snow Husky mount[/b].
[h3][b]Yuletide Greetings[/b][/h3]
[b]SNOW HUSKY:[/b] You've got another chance to claim the charming [b]Snow Husky[/b], a handsome canine companion that will carry you through Albion's harshest terrain. Along with its strong base move speed, its Hunting Instinct spell gives a short but powerful speed burst. 

[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Along with the Snow Husky, adventurers who reach this month's total point goal will unlock the [b]Yuletide Challenge Ring[/b], which gives your avatar a cheery holiday look any time of year. And remember: unclaimed Adventurer's Challenge Rings can always be traded in for Adventurer's Tokens at the Vanity Merchant!

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] Unlock Yuletide Challenge chests to get a mix of holiday-themed prizes, along with goodies like Silver, Tomes of Insight, treasures and resources. Each chest has a chance to give classic Yuletide decorations like [b]Presents [/b]and [b]Decorated Trees[/b] as well as the [b]Yuletide Candle, Wreath, Lantern,[/b] and[b] Candy Boot[/b]!

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/730a9a6a607393bc2948d9877df49f7ab8e1ad52.mp4[/video]

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

notes.title: The Season 17 Crystal League Championship is Coming!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d8db78c4d4adc377d5c945e7ac25f85a7d32f0e8.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Season 17 Crystal League Championship[/b] takes place December 10-11, with Albion's top Crystal League players facing off for tremendous prizes including the ultra-rare [b]Sabertooth Rex Swiftclaw Skin[/b]. The tournament will feature 5 teams from the Lethal Crystal League and 3 teams from the Non-Lethal, based on the following criteria:
[list]	[*]Number of Level 9 wins[/*]	[*]Number of Level 8 wins[/*]	[*]Number of Level 7 wins[/*]	[*]etc.[/*][/list]
(Note: each player can only qualify for the tournament once through [b]either[/b] the lethal or non-lethal format)

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/88bc45edccf4e69b14bc4b25e2b5431335882202.png[/img]

As with the previous tournament, matches will be [b]hard-capped[/b] to limit the overall regear costs to teams, and the tournament will be [b]full-loot[/b].

Additional rules:
[list]	[*]Qualifying teams will be notified when the sign-up period begins[/*]	[*]Teams must consist of five qualified players, [b]at least four of whom [/b]must have qualified with the same team this season[/*]	[*]A player cannot qualify with multiple teams[/*]	[*]Each team can allocate [b]one substitute [/b]in addition to the five players on the team[/*]	[*]For full rules, signup info, and the final schedule, see this [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/172251-Announcing-the-Season-17-Crystal-League-Championship/?postID=1259631#post1259631][b]forum post[/b][/url][/*]	[*]For full tournament rules, see the [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11zG_rUsh-iNsrxFBLxtE68TDUVlniOgz/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=107379016461549602182&rtpof=true&sd=true][b]Official CLC Rulebook[/b][/url][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/11zG_rUsh-iNsrxFBLxtE68TDUVlniOgz/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=107379016461549602182&rtpof=true&sd=true] [/url][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7783620a6e970fcf4a248e8c3fd28efa59fb17b3.png[/img]
[h3]Watch the Action Live on AlbionTV[/h3]
As always, you can watch the action all weekend long on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url], the official Albion Online Twitch Channel. Join hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Lewpac[/b], and [b]Tazzik[/b] as they bring you live coverage and commentary on these high-octane fights. The reigning champions will be crowned and receive their prizes at a ceremony after the final match on Sunday.

Get ready for Albion's next high-stakes tournament, and keep an eye on our [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/172251-Announcing-the-Season-17-Crystal-League-Championship/?postID=1259631#post1259631][b]forum[/b][/url][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/172251-Announcing-the-Season-17-Crystal-League-Championship/?postID=1259631#post1259631] [/url]for updates!

Watch last season’s Grand Finals here:

notes.title: Beyond the Veil is Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c6e340d3c0662d0acf5017a4374d00c0c7af3c5c.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Beyond the Veil [/b]update is now live! This huge update introduces a whole new realm - the [b]Mists [/b]- dedicated to solo and duo play, along with the city of [b]Brecilien[/b], all-new [b]Fey Armor[/b], [b]Pristine enchantment [/b]levels, reworked [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], and more.

To mark this occasion, we’ve created a brand-new trailer:

[previewyoutube=rZqlngveFyo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Enter the Mists[/h3]
[b]The Mists[/b] offer an array of PvP and PvE possibilities to [b]solo and duo [/b]players, with lethal and non-lethal areas and some never-before-seen creatures. Some of these creatures drop valuable artifact pieces, which can be used to craft nine all-new [b]Fey Armor[/b] items with unique spells. And intrepid players will be able to discover an ancient city floating in the Mists - [b]Brecilien[/b] - offering access to the Mists and Roads, plus new [b]Player Islands[/b], for those who are able to get there.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ab431870c9f37a419539f40fd22d1d1095bdfc08.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Roads and Resources[/h3]
The Roads of Avalon have been reworked, offering more gameplay opportunities for [b]smaller and independent guilds[/b]. [b]Headquarters [/b]can now be declared in the Roads, and larger guilds will have to work harder to dominate regions. In the Outlands, meanwhile, rare and extremely valuable [b]Pristine resources[/b] will spawn, encouraging groups to gear-up and fight for these riches, while bringing a new element to the crafting economy.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9584d767352371f41c4a9a1dafb552f5162923c6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Improvements[/h3]
Some major [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] have also been introduced for Albion’s guild players, with a reworked Guild Crest Creator and Guild Description UI, as well as the ability to directly equip and purchase Guild Loadouts. The Character Selection Screen has a new look, and the Character Inspect UI now shows vanity items. And [b]mobile players [/b]will find their experience enhanced by improved spell targeting and casting, along with other UI and usability improvements.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/758cce4d02cc7a6317d61742c83b51992caf6dd5.jpeg[/img]

For the complete list of changes, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/beyond-the-veil-update][b]patchnotes[/b][/url], and for more info, see the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Fey Armor and Pristine Enchantment
notes.content:
With the [b][url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil]Beyond the Veil[/url] [/b]update just around the corner, it’s time for our fourth and final Dev Talk introducing some of the features coming on [b]November 21[/b]. Here, Combat Designer Michael Schwahn and Game Designer Cornelius Nitschkoff take a look at the all-new [b]Fey Armor [/b]and [b]Pristine Enchantment[/b].

[previewyoutube=CqvgfkIbyw8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Fey Armor[/h3]
Within the Mists, dangerous, fantastical creatures can be found, which drop [b]rare artifacts [/b]when killed:
[list]	[*]These can be used to craft new armor:	[list]		[*]The scales of the [b]Fey Dragon [/b]can be woven into Cloth Armor[/*]		[*]The feathers of the [b]Griffin [/b]can be stitched into Leather Armor[/*]		[*]The carapace of the [b]Veilweaver [/b]can be forged into Plate Armor[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These artifacts are exclusively found in the Mists, and [b]cannot [/b]be created at the Artifact Foundry[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/33417e9159874c6113ed83a92252d6031bf33056.jpeg[/img]

These armors:
[list]	[*]Have the same base stats and Item Power as [b]level 3 Artifact Armors[/b][/*]	[*]Can be found next to them on the [b]Destiny Board[/b][/*]	[*]Have their own [b]Combat and Crafting Specializations[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ced781322309007b02fc54e934f593bbacc00ec9.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]New Abilities[/h3]
Each Fey Armor piece comes with its own unique ability, for example:
[list]	[*]The spider-themed [b]Duskweaver [/b](Plate Armor):	[list]		[*]Helmet ability [b]Spider Thread[/b]		[list]			[*]Shoots a thread, if it hits an enemy they are slowed[/*]			[*]Can be recast to pull you close to the enemy[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Mistwalker [/b](Leather Armor):	[list]		[*]Jacket ability [b]Mist Cloud[/b]		[list]			[*]Makes you immune to damage and healing except for when attacking or using an ability[/*]			[*]Allows ‘hit and run’ gameplay[/*]			[*]Allies within the cloud are invisible, but can take damage[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7183fcf729bc24eaf32ac473941b29f9edacba2b.jpeg[/img]
[list]	[*][b]Feyscale [/b](Cloth Armor):	[list]		[*]Robe ability [b]Wild Magic[/b]		[list]			[*]Rotates through [b]three different spell options[/b]:			[list]				[*][b]Ring of Fire[/b]: sets fire to the ground around you, causing enemies to flee[/*]				[*][b]Storm Shield[/b]: Increases resistances and stuns enemies who attack you[/*]				[*][b]Frozen Fragments[/b]: Summons five fragments which shoot at the enemy when you deal damage[/*]			[/list]			[/*]			[*]Recasting the ability casts the highlighted spell[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3]Pristine Enchantment[/h3]
Resources can now exist in a new[b] Pristine [/b]enchantment level:

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/214e866d52e00650276719ec8839fe74ef4a6037.jpeg[/img]
[list]	[*]An [b]open world [/b]objective, encouraging large group fights[/*]	[*]Correspond to a [b].4[/b] enchantment level[/*]	[*]Extremely rare, and found exclusively in the [b]Outlands[/b][/*]	[*]Appear as [b]T4-8 big resource nodes[/b][/*]	[*]Hide, Fiber, Wood, and Ore can be Pristine, but [b]not Stone[/b][/*]	[*][b]Protected [/b]for a long period after spawning by a magic shield[/*]	[*]Appear on the [b]minimap [/b]and [b]zone map[/b], as well as on the [b]world map [/b]when close enough[/*][/list]
[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/203aabf76eeb83bd36e49f0ac5e3c0efa4ccc425.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/edd61d771fb464d8c2b2c7490e9b42acd102b070.jpeg[/img][/url]

Pristine Resources:
[list]	[*][b]Can [/b]be acquired via transmutation[/*]	[*][b]Cannot [/b]be gained via Laborers[/*]	[*][b]Can [/b]be crafted into [b]Pristine Items[/b][/*][/list]
Pristine Items:
[list]	[*]Grant [b]100 additional Item Power[/b][/*]	[*][b]Cannot [/b]be gained by enchantment at the Artifact Foundry[/*][/list]
Fey Armor and Pristine enchantment will bring exciting new dimensions to combat and crafting in Albion. We’re looking forward to seeing what new interactions and playstyles develop around Fey Armor, and witnessing tense open-world fights over Pristine Resources. Thanks for watching, and check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil][b]Beyond the Veil[/b][/url] update when it launches on [b]November 21[/b]!

notes.title: Dev Talk: City in the Mists
notes.content:
In our last [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-mists][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url], Game Director Robin Henkys presented the Mists, a massive new feature release coming with the Beyond the Veil update on November 21. In our newest video, Environment Artists [b]Johannes Geier[/b] and [b]Maria Perakis[/b] take a closer look at [b]Brecilien[/b], the mystical "City in the Mists":

[previewyoutube=ZmN42XJih5I;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]A New City[/h3][list]	[*][b]Brecilien[/b] takes its name from the forest surrounding it[/*]	[*]Serves as a [b]safe haven [/b]for those lost in the Mists or who willingly choose to make it their home[/*]	[*]Built on the ruins of an abandoned Avalonian settlement[/*]	[*]Fusion of [b]wilderness and magic [/b]creates a symbiotic relationship between the forest, the wisps, and the ancient Avalonian architecture[/*]	[*]Position is constantly changing[/*]	[*]Reaching it for the first time is its own challenge[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e4620771f7dcd14b4fcdc7ae794841856f730939.jpeg[/img][h3]Further Explorations[/h3][list]	[*]Once inside, the city has a [b]new mystical environment [/b]resembling the Mists[/*]	[*]Includes [b]new music [/b]as well (as do the Mists themselves)[/*]	[*]Many of the same [b]amenities [/b]as other cities in Albion[/*]	[*]Own [b]crafting specialties[/b], shops, and city plots[/*]	[*]Includes all-new [b]Player Islands[/b]:	[list]		[*]New aesthetic, but [b]identical in price and function [/b]to traditional Player Islands[/*]		[*]Same purchasing requirements, but [b]can be owned alongside [/b]Royal Continent islands[/*]		[*]For this reason, [b]upgrade levels between Brecilien/Royal islands aren’t shared[/b], and abandoning a Royal island does not give a head start in Brecilien[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3]A New Travel Hub[/h3][list]	[*]Allows [b]direct access [/b]to the Roads of Avalon and the Mists[/*]	[*]Roads of Avalon: 	[list]		[*]Chooses a [b]random Roads [/b]zone[/*]		[*]When a party member goes through it binds itself to the destination, allowing [b]up to four [/b]other party members to join[/*]		[*]Only bound for a [b]limited time[/b][/*]		[*]Members who join the group after the binding is in place [b]cannot use it[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Mists:	[list]		[*]Allows access to [b]any available Mists mode [/b](solo nonlethal, solo lethal, duo lethal)[/*]		[*]Entrance can be used at any time, but has a [b]cooldown [/b]to discourage "rerolling" location[/*]		[*]Gives access to [b]common Mists regions[/b]; higher-value regions require Wisps in the open world or the Mists[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/54cdad251668492964c0ec15f73725550007103d.jpeg[/img][h3]Surrounding Areas[/h3][list]	[*][b]Four permanent regions [/b]just outside the city[/*]	[*][b]Minimal resources [/b]can be found[/*]	[*]Primarily there so players can access [b]Randomized/Corrupted Dungeons [/b]and [b]Hellgates[/b][/*]	[*]These regions aren’t protected by the city and players [b]can be attacked[/b], though protections exist:	[list]		[*][b]Invisibility shrines [/b]as in Portal Towns[/*]		[*][b]Several ways to re-enter[/b]: same exit previously used, OR additional portals[/*]		[*][b]Two other exits [/b]linked to other regions around the city[/*]		[*]Total of [b]six ways [/b]to avoid attacks[/*]		[*]Finally, attacking unflagged players results in [b]reputation loss[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3]Wisps of Brecilien[/h3][list]	[*]Brecilien's [b]Wisps [/b]are skeptical of outsiders, but players may be able to earn their respect[/*]	[*]Value of this respect is [b]currently unknown[/b][/*]	[*]However, the locals speak of a leader who left the city and [b]may return[/b], shedding more light on this mystery[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a281f97ed2d6d584d1d76d98980a0fbad94e5bb6.jpeg[/img]

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil][b]Beyond the Veil [/b][/url]launches [b]November 21[/b]; stay tuned for one more Dev Talk on Fey Armor and Pristine Resources.

notes.title: Beyond the Veil Arrives November 21
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c6e340d3c0662d0acf5017a4374d00c0c7af3c5c.jpeg[/img]

[b]November 21 [/b]brings Albion’s latest content update: [b]Beyond the Veil[/b]. This huge update expands the realms of Albion, introducing a new region called the [b]Mists[/b], a [b]new city[/b], [b]new mobs[/b], and new [b]Artifact Armor[/b]. Additionally, the [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]are significantly reworked, making them more competitive for smaller guilds while still offering large-group content. And a [b]new resource enchantment [/b]– Pristine – brings extremely rare and valuable treasures for high-level players. With all this and more, Beyond the Veil expands Albion’s possibilities for every player type.

[h3]Lift the Veil[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b747be96fef0bf0112aeb54e8a074f881a0d65b0.jpeg[/img]

A strange and magical realm known as the [b]Mists [/b]is dedicated exclusively to [b]solo and duo players[/b], offering a range of PvP and PvE in unpredictable zones. The Mists also contain a new City – [b]Brecilien[/b] – with [b]no fixed location[/b], offering access to the Mists and the Roads of Avalon along with its own crafting bonuses. The Mists are also home to [b]fantastical creatures[/b], which drop [b]never-before-seen artifacts[/b] that can be crafted into [b]Fey Armor[/b], with nine items featuring all-new spells.

[h3]Roads Revisited[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5505a4df5a204a519880958ea682ae0189ceb214.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]have received a significant rework, becoming more accessible for [b]smaller and independent guilds[/b]. Such groups will find it easier to make their home in the Roads, while larger guilds will have to work harder to dominate regions. Certain areas of the Roads offer [b]greater riches [/b]than ever before, ensuring they remain attractive to those groups. Back in Albion’s open world, a [b]new enchantment level [/b]of resource is spawning in the Outlands: [b]Pristine[/b]. Extremely rare and valuable, and shielded at first, these resources offer a high-level goal for powerful groups to contest. They can also be created through transmutation, offering [b]high-level crafting [/b]possibilities and bringing new dimensions to combat.

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c3aa011fd1415b9114d39077c2fbec6613fdafad.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s guilds will find their [b]UIs significantly improved[/b], with an updated [b]Guild Crest Creator[/b], a new [b]Guild Description UI [/b]making it easier to reach potential recruits, and [b]Guild Loadouts [/b]easily equippable from the Marketplace and chests. The [b]character selection screen [/b]has been revamped, [b]mobile players [/b]have improved spell targeting and casting, and the Destiny Board better explains Auto-learn and Auto-respec.

[h3]Lock in the Best Price on Premium[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4c3980b7abb7ffad91bac2ee88e9dd6d48587676.png[/img]

With the price of Premium set to increase in November, now is the best time to lock in the current price. Check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/170746][b]this forum post[/b][/url] for more information about the increase.

[h3]Go Beyond[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a2a55b3c3d71d213b4d708ef64edec2f571c9499.jpeg[/img]

Beyond the Veil expands and enriches Albion’s possibilities for players of all types and groups of all sizes. For full details, check out the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/beyond-the-veil]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: The Grim Challenge is Back
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/ec1560b9441b828936377c59c79adf7e38cc0ecf.jpeg[/img]

Allhallows is in full swing, and the [b]Grim Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of November, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Pest Lizard[/b].
[h3]Pestilential Prizes For Intrepid Adventurers[/h3]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/37098394fc221f53b22942d5c2018a17b86b1dca.png[/img]
PEST LIZARD: [/b]This month's Challenge offers another chance to claim the popular [b]Pest Lizard[/b]. This sleek, slithery mount comes with a [b]Toxic Cloud[/b] ability that causes enemies who touch it to become temporarily disoriented, and can be used to disrupt enemy players in numerous situations.

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/fd248429c8bb16fadb892cc6075439f63762bd27.png[/img]
AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Grim Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], featuring a spooky skull-topped iron frame. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b4e8429d41f50d3444dd5beab0bf7fc0a7f824ca.png[/img][/b]

[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly point totals to unlock [b]Grim Challenge Chests[/b]. Along with valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, resources, and other loot, you'll also have a chance to unlock four furniture items: the [b]Empty Coffin, Grim Gravestone, Grim Lantern, [/b]and[b] Weeping Woman Statue.[/b]

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming,[/b] and[b] killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

notes.title: Allhallows Returns to Albion
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e1dfbd28eb379fdca736e3e8e1271d670e7e5249.jpeg[/img]

Well well well... if it isn’t our old pumpkin-headed adversary. Yep, [b]Bob[/b] has returned to Albion, and the [b]Allhallows[/b] event is back!

From [b]10:00 UTC on October 27[/b] through to [b]10:00 UTC on November 10[/b] you can find him in the limited-time [b]Hallowed Ground [/b]dungeon, accessible through special, pumpkin-strewn portals that appear randomly in [b]T4-T8 zones[/b] across the open world. Here you can battle your way past creepy mobs, through tunnels filled with grotesque decorations, until you finally come face-to-face with Bob himself.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cd5233e6903c1a885fc5c982d8008bfd2dbfa8a1.jpeg[/img]

But that’s not all. Defeat Bob and you can find special [b]Allhallows Treats[/b] within the final chest, which grant a temporary [b]boost to all non-PvP Fame[/b]. But be sure to eat them all before Allhallows is over, or they might go bad!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/984fa9f66370ddff00ff00bf13135c357ac17b75.jpeg[/img]

And last but not least, the Hallowed Ground chests once again have a very rare chance of dropping the seasonal[b] Jack o’ Donkey[/b] and [b]Horse Macabre[/b] mount skins. So go find the dungeon, confront Bob, and see what he’s been guarding!

notes.title: Dev Talk: The Mists
notes.content:
Our [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-roads-revisited][b]last Dev Talk[/b][/url] announced the forthcoming [b]Beyond the Veil [/b]update, and introduced the Roads of Avalon rework that will be coming with it. In the second Dev Talk taking a closer look at this update, Game Director Robin Henkys introduces a massive and much-awaited feature: [b]the Mists[/b].

[previewyoutube=6-cJwu6_n-A;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Wisps and Portals[/h3]
When Beyond the Veil goes live, ghostly [b]Will o’ Wisps [/b]will be found drifting through the open world and the Roads of Avalon:
[list]	[*]These will retreat when approached, and [b]open a portal [/b]to their home - the Mists[/*]	[*]These portals are [b]open for a short time[/b], and chasing a Wisp through one will bring a player to this new realm[/*]	[*]Most portals allow [b]only one player [/b]through before closing, but [b]some will allow a second [/b]player to enter[/*]	[*]These two portal types are separate, meaning [b]solo players will never encounter duos [/b]in the Mists.[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e1f88c15dfd761c2747c8d56be67ee48cf6b5c41.jpeg[/img][h3]Mobs, Treasures, and Resources[/h3]
The Mists are a magical realm full of dangers and treasures:
[list]	[*][b]Heretic[/b], [b]Morgana[/b], and [b]Undead [/b]mobs roam the Mists[/*]	[*][b]Treasures [/b]and [b]resources [/b]can also be found, as in the open world[/*]	[*][b]Unique creatures [/b]can be killed for Hides, and three special types of creature exist: the Griffin, the Mistcrawler, and the Fey Dragon[/*]	[*]Similar to solo dungeons, some Mist regions are [b]enchanted[/b], with more powerful but more valuable enemies[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3aae957ac700340e8c9452333476991b1012afa8.jpeg[/img]
[h3]PvP in the Mists[/h3]
Exploring the Mists comes with the possibility of encountering other players, and engaging in combat:
[list]	[*]The Mists have both [b]lethal and non-lethal [/b]areas	[list]		[*]Entrances to lethal Mists areas can only be found in other lethal areas of Albion[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Combat within the Mists [b]does [u]not [/u]affect reputation [/b]on the Royal Continent[/*]	[*]Players have access to their [b]mounts[/b][/*][/list][h3]Rising Mists[/h3]
The tides of the Mists are constantly rising and falling:
[list]	[*]Any region will be [b]consumed by the growing Mists [/b]at some point[/*]	[*]Players can follow Wisps through a new portal to a [b]different Mists region[/b][/*]	[*]Those who do not will become ‘lost’, and returned to the place [b]where they first entered [/b]the Mists[/*]	[*]This ensures players [b]cannot band together [/b]for long within the Mists, as their groups will always be separated[/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3a10bdd151aecc45cdb671747286885e2a0ffeb8.jpeg[/img][/b]

In addition to all this, players in the Mists can encounter Wisps who have been endangered by the influx of new adventurers and are in need of aid. Helping them will [b]earn their gratitude[/b], which may have some benefits…

The Mists offer a whole range of PvE and PvP possibilities similar to the open world, but dedicated exclusively to solo or duo players. We can’t wait to launch this feature and let you explore this magical realm and its mysteries, whatever it is you seek there. See you soon!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Roads of Avalon Revisited
notes.content:
Albion’s next major content update is just around the corner, and we can announce it will be called [b]Beyond the Veil[/b]. Today, in the first of several in-depth looks at some of the new features and changes coming with this update, Game Director Robin Henkys introduces some significant improvements to the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b].

[previewyoutube=UnGPr1C03Xg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Changes to Hideouts in the Roads[/h3]
A number of new features will help players to make their homes in the Roads:
[list]	[*]Hideouts in the Roads will be able to be declared [b]Headquarters[/b][/*]	[*]Hideouts [b]will require power [/b]to be maintained	[list]		[*]There will be an initial three-day grace period before this applies[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Power Cores [/b]can be found in the Roads, but cannot be carried to or from the open world[/*]	[*]Guilds seeking to control entire Hideout regions within the Roads will have to be [b]considerably more active [/b]to do so[/*]	[*]Hideout construction can be [b]accelerated[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c393af9911b4509ff477d5e4856b32869be88802.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]Logout Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Logging out in the Roads will return you to the [b]place you first entered [/b]the Roads	[list]		[*]This causes [b]durability damage [/b]to equipment, and the [b]loss of some stacked items[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players who are disconnected will have an [b]extended window to reconnect [/b]before being removed from the Roads[/*]	[*]This will prevent players staying in high-value locations to scout them constantly, making the Roads [b]more competitive and rewarding exploration[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f529a6523a637bad9871350f5d64dbb34dc19202.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]New Objectives[/h3]
The types of objectives found in the Roads have been expanded:
[list]	[*][b]Open-world treasures [/b]will randomly appear[/*]	[*]Mobs will [b]upgrade over time [/b]if untouched, as they do in the open world[/*]	[*][b]Crystal Spiders [/b]will also be found[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/af407ca838c99b605b72a2234db38444fa691dfb.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Large Group Content[/h3]
The reworked Roads will provide challenging and rewarding content for groups:
[list]	[*]Mobs have been [b]strengthened [/b]overall[/*]	[*]The areas between Hideout regions will contain [b]high-value content [/b]for large groups[/*]	[*]Large portals are now exclusive to these ‘raid regions’, while small portals have been removed entirely[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2ed23273c1be87a3e2c66bc3981c27b24ad86de3.jpeg[/img]

These changes should reinvigorate the Roads of Avalon as an area for[b] small group play [/b]and [b]independent guilds[/b], providing a variety of PvE and PvP options and rewarding exploration. We hope to encourage new guilds to enjoy this content, and can’t wait to see who makes their home in the Roads.

Stay tuned for our next Dev Talk, where we’ll delve into some more mysterious content coming with [b]Beyond the Veil[/b].

notes.title: Ride Into Battle on the Armored Pony

notes.title: New Victory Emotes Are Here
notes.content:
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/47f54dbd3264ea183d7a7feb44fcd1fa1a8485b4.mp4[/video]

Albion can be a harsh land, where the winner takes all while the loser limps back to town. Each victory is an accomplishment, so when you do get a hard-earned PvP kill, [b]Victory Emotes[/b] are the perfect way to leave your mark on the battlefield! These celebratory flourishes were first introduced with the Into the Fray update, and with today's patch, there are now six new emotes to choose from: [b]Platform Banners[/b] (one each for mobile, PC, and Controller), [b]Sword, Hammer, [/b]and [b]Hellgate[/b].

Victory Emotes can be equipped in the in-game Appearance menu, and offer a wide variety of audiovisual effects that play automatically upon killing another player. Each time the effect is triggered, one charge is consumed. Each Emote can be recharged in a variety of ways.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b3ca3728ce13500d19156dc1438bae52c81c59ee.jpeg[/img]

[h3]How to get Emotes and Charges[/h3]
Charges for all Victory Emotes are purchasable with Gold in the Appearance menu, and come in different bundle sizes and prices depending on the Emote’s rarity. In addition, you can also get charges through [b]Twitch Drops[/b] – for more info on those, click [url=https://albiononline.com/twitch][b]here[/b][/url].

For more details about Victory Emotes and how they work, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/170219][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

Pick up some Victory Emotes and charges today and get ready to show off your skills!

notes.title: Season 17 Starts Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79f130300408080aeff7451a26160fa7a90e2f0b.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s seventeenth Guild Season starts Saturday, and brings some important changes to the Crystal Arena, open-world chests, Headquarters Hideouts, and more. Read on for details, or [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/168529-Season-17-Schedule-and-Changes/][b]click here[/b][/url] for the complete Season 17 schedule.

[h3]Crystal Arena Ranking Changes[/h3]
From Season 17 there will be additional substeps in the [b]Crystal Arena ranking system[/b]. While the amount of Ranking Points needed to reach maximum rank remains the same, there will be extra steps between the ranks (Iron III, Iron IV, etc.) As a result, there are now more Chests available for ranking up in a Crystal Arena Season. Additionally, Arena rankings will not fully reset, but instead players will be partially ranked down at the start of the next Season. For example, Crystal Rank players will start at Silver I. All upranking rewards that are skipped will be received in an in-game mail.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5bb077a829cf483d2091ea993245a7364d8303a6.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Headquarters Hideouts Changes[/h3]
[b]Headquarters boosters [/b]are no longer obtained at the end of the season; instead, each guild will always start with a booster. Guilds must still meet the Season Points threshold to use their booster. Using the booster, though, will now trigger a [b]90-day cooldown[/b]. These changes should make it much easier for new guilds to establish a Headquarters Hideout in the Outlands..

[h3]Open-World Chests and Crystal Spiders[/h3]
[b]Large open-world treasure chests[/b] will contain [b]more valuable loot[/b], but will spawn less frequently to make this content rarer, more desirable, and more competitive for groups.

[b]Small open-world treasure chests [/b]will take three minutes to unlock instead of five, making it less likely that organized groups form and giving solo players a better chance to fight over them.

Additionally, Regular Chests will also be slightly more valuable overall, making these open-world objectives more rewarding for all players.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1957905f0fe184f22f277148f99ca4f81e0d61ea.jpeg[/img]

[b]Crystal Spider Might Levels[/b] will be adjusted, with levels much easier to attain. As a result, each Crystal Spider will indirectly give significantly more Season Points, making them more attractive season objectives. Guild Levels for Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons will also be easier to reach, allowing guilds to progress faster through these activities.

[h3]Season Schedule Changes[/h3]
This season will be [b]one week shorter[/b] than most. However, the final three weeks of the season will offer [b]triple Season Points[/b] from Territories and triple Might and Favor from Siphoning Mages.

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
[b]Corrupted Dungeons: [/b]After defeating another player or getting banished, players will now be able to immediately enter a new dungeon or exit into the open world. This allows players who are interested purely in the PvP aspect of this content to directly start another invasion without needing to clear their own dungeon first.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fcc72c82b96e35b64638626f2421961e1488b758.jpeg[/img]

[b]Guild Season Rewards:[/b] In order to receive guild rewards, players must now again be a member of the qualifying guild for at least [b]75% of the season[/b]. Qualifying time spent with a guild will be easily visible in a new UI.

[h3]Unlock the Ancient Ent[/h3]
Players who gain enough Might will receive unique [b]Avatar Sets[/b], as well as the [b]Ancient Ent[/b] and valuable [b]Fame Buffs[/b]. Might is earned through a huge range of activities in the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], and there are additional [b]bracket rewards[/b] for guilds who reach at least Iron Rank. And as always, the season's number-one guild will become a permanent part of the world of Albion with their very own statue in [b]Conquerors' Hall[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2a7bbb848a61c8f02975d2a2dde48a7426069d40.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The season kickoff on Saturday, September 17 will be broadcast live on [b]AlbionTV [/b]starting at [b]17:30 UTC[/b], with hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Lewpac[/b] and[b] Bogul[/b] bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim. Those in the North and South American time zones can tune in for the second round of territory resets on Sunday at [b]00:30 UTC[/b], when hosts [b]Shozen[/b], [b]Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Tazzik[/b] cover the next round of invasions. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out AlbionTV's coverage of the last Invasion Day here:
