notes.title: Strike Your Enemies Down with the Reaver Vanity Bundle
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cb837354168af6c2b31b5f89a6142440913e5dac.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Reaver [/b]has arrived! Available now from the in-game store, this premium vanity bundle includes a full costume set along with a matching [b]Reaver’s Armored Horse [/b]skin for your Armored Horse base mount.

With dark, metallic armor from head to toe and a thick, black cape, the Reaver strikes fear into even the most hardened souls in Albion. The Reaver’s Armored Horse comes clad in the same burnished armor and thick, black fabric - a terrifying sight indeed as you bear down upon your foes. As Season 15 nears its climax, this is the perfect outfit to engage in epic territory battles.

The Reaver Bundle includes the following vanity skins, which work on male and female characters alike:
[list]	[*][b]Reaver's Helmet[/b][/*]	[*][b]Reaver's Armor[/b][/*]	[*][b]Reaver's Boots[/b][/*]	[*][b]Reaver's Cape[/b][/*]	[*][b]Reaver's Armored Horse[/b][/*][/list][video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/abbecb307859333c950e753405684d5d941f2162.mp4[/video]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Into the Fray Introduction
notes.content:
Our last Dev Talk introduced some of the new features and improvements coming to Albion Online in 2022. In this video, Game Director Robin Henkys announces the arrival of many of these features in our next content update:[b] Into the Fray[/b].

[previewyoutube=a-rUKu9vL1M;full][/previewyoutube]
No time to watch the video? Read on for a summary…
[h3]Magic Staff Overhaul[/h3][list]	[*][b]Fire, Holy, Nature, and Cursed Staffs[/b] will receive a thorough overhaul in this update[/*]	[*]This means new animations, VFX, audio and even some [b]new spells[/b][/*]	[*]Arcane and Frost Staffs will also receive an overhaul in a patch following the update[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7954b21a1cf55da4a376ce0eb2f9504d90de5be5.png[/img]
[h3]New Crystal Arena & Crystal League Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]A new Arena mode which uses [b]Crystal League match rules[/b][/*]	[*]There will also be a[b] non-lethal Crystal League[/b], in addition to the current lethal Crystal League[/*]	[*]These new systems will make it easier for players to enter the Crystal League and build up their skills without worrying about gear costs[/*][/list][h3]Castle Overhaul[/h3][list]	[*]Castles are receiving a [b]complete update[/b] to their graphics, layout, and battle flow[/*]	[*]Castles and Castle Outposts will also receive [b]new loot chests[/b][/*]	[*]These chests will be available throughout the day, driving constant action[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a30ec94505493c09ac3b27869fb3b506e6b1c263.png[/img]
[h3]Dynamic Events[/h3][list]	[*][b]Daily events[/b] will be added to the game[/*]	[*]These will encourage engagement with particular features, such as Hellgates or Corrupted Dungeons[/*]	[*][b]Short-term crafting bonuses[/b] will also add market fluctuations and new dynamics to the game[/*][/list][h3]Outlands Travel Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Into the Fray will make traveling into the Outlands [b]more convenient and more accessible [/b]to new players[/*]	[*]New [b]Portal Towns[/b] offer a safe arrival point[/*]	[*]New[b] ‘Journey Back’ [/b]ability on mounts reduces long walk times for return journeys[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b31da4be0d9ebf40c50274adaf3de680f3d7bc6f.png[/img]
[h3]Other Improvements[/h3][list]	[*][b]Victory Emotes[/b] give players a way to mark PvP victories[/*]	[*][b]Training Dummies[/b] for Player Islands[/*]	[*]Tooltips for zone exits[/*]	[*][b]Party UI [/b]improvements[/*]	[*]And more…[/*][/list]The other features mentioned in our [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-2022-roadmap][b]2022 Roadmap Dev Talk[/b][/url], like the solo expansion of the Roads of Avalon and the new Guild Finder UI, are still being worked on and will be introduced in a future update. You can expect to hear more about these once Season 16 has kicked off.

Stay tuned for more Dev Talks coming soon, where we’ll go into more depth about the features coming to the world of Albion with Into the Fray!

notes.title: The Morgana Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/027dde82b736f8d6b84326863dbd8c9d7f287f1f.jpeg[/img]

The Disciples of Morgana have re-emerged from the shadows... and for the entire month of May, you can take the [b]Morgana Challenge[/b] to collect fantastic rewards. Earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Morgana Raven [/b]mount.
[h3][b]Embrace the Darkness[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FCBnHa1.png[/img][b]MORGANA RAVEN:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the popular [b]Morgana Raven[/b], a fearsome, fast-moving flying mount with an area-of-effect Fear spell. (Note: the Morgana Raven requires the same terrain pathing as all other mounts, and cannot fly over gaps or obstacles).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ke0GfuX.png[/img][b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Morgana Challenge Avatar Ring[/b], a menacing, fiery frame that will give your avatar an aura of dread. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar ring for one character.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TjmuDnJ.png[/img][b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Morgana Challenge chests[/b]. These chests contain valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver bags, along with unique Morgana-themed furniture items.

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim your rewards!

notes.title: Stalk the Living on the Undead Direwolf
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8e2fc43a7c668e53617948afb995add633aacc27.jpeg[/img]

For the last two weeks Albion’s inhabitants have been busying themselves collecting eggs and growing bunnies. But every party has to come to an end, and now it’s time for a gruesome reminder of what awaits us all… starting today, the brand-new [b]Undead Direwolf [/b]skin is now available in the in-game store!

This premiere mount skin transforms your Direwolf base mount into an unholy beast, raised from the dead through forbidden magic. With its eerie glowing eyes, tattered pelt, and exposed ribcage, it's sure to strike fear into your enemies as you stalk them from the shadows.

[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fde0dd52c0b7906250a5b65de27010ea22a07fbb.mp4[/video]

Characterized by their high overall speed and maneuverability, Direwolves are consistently one of Albion's most-used mounts. The Undead Direwolf adds another option for those looking to upgrade their Direwolf's appearance, and joins a growing collection of skins for this ever-popular mount.

Like all mount skins, once the Undead Direwolf is unlocked it can be used by [b]all characters[/b] on your account. With the treasure hunters of Albion out on their spring bunnies, grab this skin today and do a little hunting of your own!

notes.title: Lands Awakened Patch 8 is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b73b88bd683c707abb61e310d36f5ffd47e8c03e.jpeg[/img]

[b]Lands Awakened Patch 8[/b] is here! This patch brings extensive [b]combat balance changes[/b], improved [b]Arena matchmaking[/b], and more. Read on for details…

[h3]New Season Winner Statue[/h3]
First up, there’s a new face in Conquerors’ Hall! You can now check out the statue dedicated to [b]IAMNIUBI[/b], who claimed their first crown in [b]Season 14[/b]. The banners of 2nd and 3rd-place runners up [b]Elevate[/b] and [b]Judicate[/b] are also now on display.

[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
This patch brings far-reaching combat balance adjustments, to overhaul some underused weapons and abilities and help others to perform better in the current meta.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0c80143a9d4961703c81dce0da5be1dcc3087d6f.jpeg[/img]

Here are some of the changes:
[list]	[*][b]War Gloves:[/b] Cross Step has been reworked into a new ability called Fleet Footwork, which features a kick-dodge combo[/*]	[*][b]Dual Swords: [/b]Spinning Blades now has an attack speed and attack damage buff, and Weakening affects enemy damage more significantly[/*]	[*][b]Axes: [/b]Resilience Penetration of Halberd and Carrioncaller have been increased to make them more effective in group combat[/*]	[*][b]5v5 Crystal League: [/b]The point reduction per kill has been increased from 4 to 6[/*][/list][h3]Improved Arena Matchmaking[/h3]
Various changes have been made to the [b]Arena matchmaking system[/b] in order to speed up the formation of teams in queues. Solo DPS players in particular should see their waiting times significantly reduced.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c34601151414454e09d9db18cdaaa59617fe1f99.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]New [b]“Hood and Scythe”[/b] guild logo available[/*]	[*]Catching rare fish now sometimes drops additional [b]seaweed[/b] as a bonus[/*]	[*][b]Vengeful Guardian Lord[/b] (Territory Boss) and its summons no longer reset completely when leaving their pursuit range[/*]	[*]…and much more[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d03e60db33496ccb1eaf125ecc2900f359cc337d.jpeg[/img]

For a full list of changes, read the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/lands-awakened-patch-8][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Rites of Spring Begins Today!
notes.content:
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9b3a897c83e2af26c45f873e2e6a0d6572e2a8b0.mp4[/video]

Rejoice, spring has returned to Albion! As life flourishes across the lands, today marks the beginning of a special, two-week in-game event: the [b]Rites of Spring[/b].

With decorations in the cities, treasures and rewards springing up all over the open world, and a unique, [b]brand-new item[/b] available, Albion will be teeming with life for the next fortnight. To mark the occasion we made a special event trailer, which you can watch below. More information follows…

[previewyoutube=c2F0CrLMd3k;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Treasures Galore[/h3]
The Rites of Spring sees Albion filled with treasure for players to hunt down. All types of chests usually found in the open world will spawn at a [b]much increased rate[/b] for the next two weeks. Alongside these, a new [b]Spring Treasure Chest[/b] will appear, which has the chance of containing special, themed items.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/85a6cd1548e1db89cb5c8d1b1622dff8a56f6c93.jpeg[/img]

On top of that, giant [b]Colored Eggs[/b] are once again sprouting from the ground, which can be broken open for Surprise Eggs and chocolate. And both the chests and, on rare occasions, the Colored Eggs may themselves contain a particularly special type of egg if you’re very lucky…

[h3]That’s No Ordinary Rabbit[/h3]
Rumors have been circulating throughout Albion of a strange, never-before-seen entity with unique powers bounding across the lands. And after much investigation it can be confirmed that there is indeed a brand-new creature out there: the[b] Spring Cottontail[/b]!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c3ddc096188e1486e8df962fc097f9ecb8afe317.jpeg[/img]

This is a rare, speedy, [b]Tier 8 mount[/b] with a special [b]Hop[/b] ability, and is sure to be widely coveted. It requires no Destiny Board unlocks to use, so [b]all[/b] [b]characters can find, raise, and ride one [/b]from today. And all stages of its growth are [b]fully tradable[/b], meaning they can be bought and sold at Marketplaces. They’re out there now, so hop to it!

[h3]The Eggsecutioner Returns[/h3]
Spring is a busy time for Albion’s tireless [b]vanity merchants[/b], and they’ll once again be selling their wares in return for gold and Surprise Eggs. Among their products you can find:
[list]	[*]The fearsome [b]Eggsecutioner[/b] vanity weapon[/*]	[*]Stylish[b] "Bunny Stalker"[/b] Armor, Hats, and Backpack[/*]	[*]Delicious[b] Chocolate Bars[/b][/*]	[*]Alluring[b] Fool’s Golden Eggs[/b][/*]	[*]And more…[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f557a77d35faaab76cfc6b838c9a7f4107239dd.png[/img]

With all this going on, Albion will be bustling with life as players hunt down treasures, trade seasonal goods in the cities, and take their new Spring Cottontails out for a ride. Check out the Rites of Spring Patchnotes [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/rites-of-spring][b]here[/b][/url], and go join in the fun!

notes.title: Springtime Surprises are Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4ebed2e0ff580ab190d89122da030b7dcdb8354d.jpeg[/img]

[b]April 12[/b] marks the beginning of the [b]Rites of Spring[/b] in Albion, with decorations in the cities and themed items for you to hunt down.

And in addition, rumor has it that a [b]brand-new, special reward[/b] will be appearing throughout the open world. Details are still unclear, with conflicting reports coming in as to the nature of this mysterious new entity. Some speak of a strange creature, never before seen in Albion, with unique powers - but these are as yet only rumors. The only certainty is that there’s going to be a frenzy across the lands as rival parties fight over the [b]abundant treasures[/b] to be found throughout the open world.

The Rites of Spring begins after maintenance on [b]Tuesday, April 12[/b], and runs until maintenance on [b]Tuesday, April 26[/b]. Make sure not to miss out on the excitement!

notes.title: Refer One Friend and Claim the Farmer’s Ox Skin
notes.content:
[video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79c84f6809cb8482c5aa6566b36c18ff331b588e.mp4[/video]

Farmers of Albion! As the lands get warmer and the days get longer, it’s time to sow your seeds. But with so much work to be done, you’ll need a trusty companion to work the fields. Luckily, today brings a new Referral Season, and from now until June 1 you can get your very own [b]Farmer’s Ox[/b] mount skin for your Transport Ox base mount when you refer a friend!

This brand-new mount skin brings to life a well-known image from Albion’s past - the sturdy ox with a lantern hanging from its horns, crates heaving with wares, and a carrot dangling in front, leading it around as you go about your day’s work. Once you’ve unlocked this skin, it can be used by all characters on your account - so any of them can enjoy the company of this dependable beast.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a1950e7ad7a4a6bd68f1a6248faa24fd3518f067.png[/img]

You can also earn huge amounts of Fame for your third and fifth referrals: three referrals scores you a [b]T7 Pile of Tomes worth 100,000 Fame[/b], and five referrals gets you a [b]T8 Pile of Tomes granting a colossal 200,000 Fame[/b]. And as always, your first-ever referral grants an additional T8 Pile of Tomes along with the mount skin.

The current referral season lasts until maintenance on [b]June 1[/b], so you've got until then to refer your friends and claim these rewards!

[h3]How to Earn Seasonal Referral Rewards[/h3][list]	[*]Send your referral link, which you can find [url=https://albiononline.com/profile/referral/overview][b]here[/b][/url], to a friend. (You must be logged into your account on the website to view this page.)[/*]	[*]Your friend registers an account and starts playing Albion Online (preferably along with you!).[/*]	[*]The first time your friend purchases at least 30 days of Premium, they will trigger a reward for you.[/*]	[*]On top of that, for your very first referral ever, you'll receive a [b]T8 Recruiter's Pile of Tomes[/b], worth a massive [b]200,000 Fame[/b].[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cc116a99cedd528c2094cb07b7dac118a806e8b7.png[/img]

notes.title: New Bundles Available
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0ff53ed93bb7d37a14b671e768a32692278490c2.png[/img]

Looking for a deal? Then check out the brand-new [b]Vanity Value Bundles[/b] and expanded [b]Starter Bundle[/b] selection in the in-game store! These bundles offer vanity items in combination with either [b]Gold[/b] or [b]Gold and Premium[/b] at huge discounts, and are available in-game to [b]all players[/b].

[h3]Vanity Value Bundles are Here[/h3]
[b]Vanity Value Bundles[/b] are the perfect option for those looking to upgrade their appearance and score some extra Gold on the side. Each bundle consists of a popular mount skin or vanity set along with varying amounts of Gold, and offers big discounts versus buying separately.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c9c28b3fd830d907e03d070a388f61c28363a297.png[/img]

The current bundles include:
[list]	[*][b]Mage Adventurer Bundle[/b][/*]	[*][b]Knight Adventurer Bundle[/b][/*]	[*][b]Rogue Adventurer Bundle[/b][/*]	[*][b]Mistbison Bundle[/b][/*]	[*][b]Miststalker Bundle[/b][/*][/list][h3]New Starter Bundles Added[/h3]
Due to popular demand, a total of [b]seven new Starter Bundles[/b] have been added to the in-game store, each offering a vanity set/skin, Gold, and Premium at a huge combined discount:
[list]	[*][b]Druid Bundle + 360 Days Premium + 2000 Gold[/b][/*]	[*][b]Rogue Adventurer Bundle + 180 Days Premium + 1000 Gold[/b][/*]	[*][b]Mage Adventurer Bundle + 180 Days Premium + 1000 Gold[/b][/*]	[*][b]Knight Adventurer Bundle + 90 Days Premium + 500 Gold[/b][/*]	[*][b]Demon Hunter Bundle + 90 Days Premium + 500 Gold[/b][/*]	[*][b]Mistwolf Skin + 30 Days Premium + 150 Gold[/b][/*]	[*][b]Mistbison Skin + 30 Days Premium + 150 Gold[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0a4b4dd48c81535e3dda49c3187553fdd0c8b085.jpeg[/img][/b]

To purchase a Vanity Value or Starter Bundle, just log in on any platform and click the corresponding tab in the in-game store. Any bundle with a skin not yet unlocked on your account will be available. (Note: Vanity Value Bundles are available on all platforms; Starter Bundles are currently unavailable for purchase on iOS.)

Log in today and get great deals on vanity!

notes.title: Become a Learned Fighter with the Master of Fists Vanity Bundle
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/163c57f4d9ebb18b4e8c7fca57f66e3ed6dfb8c1.jpeg[/img]

A new vanity bundle is here - the powerful[b] Master of Fists[/b]! Available now from the ingame store, this premium bundle includes a full costume set along with a matching [b]Master of Fists Horse[/b] skin for your [b]Riding Horse [/b]base mount.

This bundle is perfect for showing off your martial arts expertise. With bronze plates and jewelry shining in the spring light, you will step out onto the plains of Albion with the studied grace and power of a dedicated fighter. Along with a trusted white riding horse, the bundle also includes a daunting demon mask, striking fear into anyone who dares engage you in combat.

The mask and robes also include optional [b]guild versions[/b] to show off your guild's colors in style – and with the stylings of a close-combat expert, this is the perfect set to use in combination with the [b]War Gloves[/b] weapon line. So for anyone who’s been studying these weapons and mastering their powers since they launched in November, now you have the perfect vanity set in which to demonstrate your abilities!

The Master of Fists Bundle includes the following vanity skins, which work on male and female characters alike:
[list]	[*]Master of Fists Tattoo[/*]	[*]Master of Fists Hat[/*]	[*]Master of Fists Mask[/*]	[*]Master of Fists Guild Mask[/*]	[*]Master of Fists Robes[/*]	[*]Master of Fists Guild Robes[/*]	[*]Master of Fists Sandals[/*]	[*]Master of Fists Scroll[/*]	[*]Master of Fists Horse[/*][/list][video autoplay="yes" loop="yes" muted="yes" playsinline="yes"]http://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ceaabe289c56c6630e33276c4d1462a03893d673.mp4[/video]
As with past bundles, you can use all costume and mount skins with all characters on your account, and they are never lost or destroyed. All items will be unlocked in the ingame "Appearance" menu after purchase.

With Season 15 kicking off, grab this premiere bundle and show off your fighting skills!

notes.title: Dev Talk: 2022 Roadmap
notes.content:
While 2021 was Albion Online's biggest year yet, there's tons more in store for 2022. In our first Dev Talk of the year, Game Director [b]Robin Henkys[/b] takes a look back at the past year, before looking forward to some major changes, improvements, and updates coming to the world of Albion in 2022.

[previewyoutube=YNLrtIlM-dE;full][/previewyoutube]
No time to watch the video, or prefer a written summary? Then read on…
[h3]2021: A Huge Year for Albion[/h3]
2021 was a year of major reworks to some of Albion's biggest existing features. Some of these overhauls include:
[list]	[*]Faction Warfare[/*]	[*]Hellgates[/*]	[*]The entire Open World[/*]	[*]Guild Seasons[/*]	[*]Quality of Life Improvements: Loadouts, Rerolling, Land Sales[/*][/list]At the same time, entirely new content was introduced to the game, including:
[list]	[*]War Gloves[/*]	[*]Elite Levels[/*]	[*]The Conqueror’s Challenge[/*]	[*]Numerous new Open World objectives[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/80e86aed0c33ebcfa05d0d1bcf5fa7e34e866a1e.jpeg[/img]

2021 also saw the long-awaited official mobile launch, with extensive work done throughout the year to improve, expand, and optimize the mobile experience. In short, we made Albion Online better and more accessible to players around the world.
[h3]Coming in 2022[/h3]
In 2022, the goal is to find a good mix of new content, updating existing systems, and improving accessibility for new players.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/28706ead071b7c2a9f4c1402d6055f5911aef342.jpeg[/img]

[b]Reworked Weapon Lines [/b]

Work has already begun on a complete overhaul of existing weapon lines. First up is a full rework of all [b]Magic Staffs[/b] in the game, including:
[list]	[*]Improved [b]visuals, audio, and VFX[/b][/*]	[*][b]New spells[/b] added[/*]	[*]Outdated spells [b]reworked[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e5a4b04ac79d8c5d3a6420e722f10a5cf4abcc1e.jpeg[/img][/b]

[b]Open World Objectives[/b]

The next major open-world feature to be improved is [b]Castles and Castle Outposts[/b]:
[list]	[*]Chests will [b]spawn more dynamically[/b] and show their value on the world map[/*]	[*]Provide [b]more fights[/b] throughout the day to keep the open world exciting[/*]	[*]Castle [b]layouts, visuals and gameplay[/b] will be improved[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ec7b490321f9b19182fc32f95fe02a4e8b33cb5b.jpeg[/img]

[b]Roads of Avalon[/b]

New content will be added and rewards for playing in the Roads increased. They'll also be adjusted to better suit small-group play.

Furthermore, an entirely new type of Road called the [b]Mists [/b]is coming:
[list]	[*]Focused on [b]solo player[/b] experience[/*]	[*]Accessed through [b]special entrances[/b] that only allow single players[/*]	[*]Mists feature [b]gathering, upgrading mobs, treasures, mob camps[/b], and other content without risk from large groups[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7dc64d624f6bd5e30d11253774933160676e2ce4.jpeg[/img]

[b]Making High-Level Gameplay More Accessible[/b]
[list]	[*]Reworked [b]Guild Finder[/b] will make it easier to find guilds by interests, language, and time zone[/*]	[*]Portal cities expanded into fortified [b]Outlands Settlements[/b]:	[list]		[*]Offers new players safe areas with protective shrines[/*]		[*]Offers experienced players more convenience, with full access to city banks and marketplaces[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]To reduce the hassle of dying, equipment is saved as a [b]Loadout [/b]after death[/*]	[*]New guides and tips added about [b]ganking [/b]and strategies to deal with it[/*][/list][b]Recurring Gameplay Events[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Crafting events[/b] will boost crafting particular item lines for a short time, offering advantages for crafters and economy players[/*]	[*][b]Other events[/b] will boost Hellgates, Faction Warfare, or open-world exploration to offer new experiences and reward proficiency in different activities[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5a3171f17f2c5e2592c2c3c2c2b5f0aada97d719.jpeg[/img]

[b]Additional Improvements and Features[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Improved gathering gear[/b] and "Tomes of Gathering"[/*]	[*][b]Reinvigorated Crystal League[/b] with options for casual and hardcore players[/*]	[*][b]Trophies[/b] from PvP kills as keepsakes of victory over a guild or player[/*][/list]We'll talk about these features in more detail soon – until then, thanks for watching!

notes.title: Season 15 Starts Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

Albion’s [b]fifteenth Guild Season[/b] starts this weekend, bringing changes to [b]Might and Favor[/b] and the [b]Crystal League[/b]. Read on for details…
[h3]Season 15 Changes[/h3]
With the start of Season 15, [b]Might and Favor[/b] gained from various activities will be increased, to further reward those who participate in riskier activities, like gathering in the Outlands and Roads of Avalon or winning in Corrupted Dungeons. On top of this, [b]Might Level [/b]thresholds have been adjusted to make it easier to progress by completing a wide variety of activities across the game.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/242d972fdb91518d8e10467f95fa0b3fe66c79c1.jpeg[/img]

Meanwhile, the Crystal League has been updated and will offer [b]greatly improved rewards[/b]. A[b] new 5v5 map[/b], an updated version of the former Steppe Territory GvG map, should mean more tense and competitive matches with greater comeback potential. And in addition, Silver and Fame rewards in both 5v5 and 20v20 matches have been significantly increased at nearly all levels.

For full details of the Might and Favor changes, Crystal League rewards, and a full season schedule, see[b] [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/160789-Season-15-Schedule-and-Changes/]this forum post[/url][/b].
[h3]Season Rewards[/h3]
Conqueror’s Challenge rewards from gaining Might in Season 15 are as follows:

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8254c95218b277626389493137d281b26b7abb56.jpeg[/img]

For a full breakdown of guild and personal season rewards, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/160789-Season-15-Schedule-and-Changes/?postID=1204281#post1204281][b]this forum post[/b][/url].
[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The action starts on[b] Saturday, March 5[/b] and will be broadcast live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] from 17:30 UTC, with hosts[b] Shozen, Lewpac [/b]and [b]Bogul [/b]bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim them and launch attacks. Those in the North and South American time zones can also tune in for the second round of territory resets on [b]Sunday, March 6[/b] at 00:30 UTC, when hosts [b]Shozen, Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Bogul[/b] will cover the next round of invasions from 01:00 UTC. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Watch AlbionTV’s coverage of the final Season 14 Invasion Day here:
[previewyoutube=JxqAfEw1FQE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Season 15 Patch is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1957905f0fe184f22f277148f99ca4f81e0d61ea.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Season 15[/b] patch is here! This brings improvements to the [b]Crystal League[/b], [b]Might and Favor[/b] changes, upgrading [b]Randomized Dungeons[/b], automatic [b]Silver[/b] pickups, and much more. Read on for details...

[h3]Controller Support Beta[/h3]
This patch marks the beginning of [b]controller support testing[/b], which will be optimized over the coming months. Players will be able to use Xbox controllers, Playstation Dualshock, and other PC-compatible controllers with the game. Additionally, Steam players will be able to use the [b]Steam Deck[/b]. For controller support and to give feedback, please use [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Board/171][b]this subforum[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1a335a4d9e38600c1b64b7641e28a89c84e5bb75.jpeg[/img][h3]Guild Season Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]Might and Favor[/b] changes:	[list]		[*]In advance of Season 15, Might and Favor has been increased for various activities across the game[/*]		[*]Additionally, Might level progressions have been updated[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Crystal League[/b] changes:	[list]		[*]5v5 Crystal League matches now have a [b]new map[/b][/*]		[*]Crystal League match rewards have been significantly improved[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]For full details of all the Guild Season changes, please see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/160789-Season-15-Schedule-and-Changes/][b]this forum post[/b][/url][/*][/list][h3]Upgrading Randomized Dungeons[/h3]
Following the introduction of randomly upgrading Static Dungeons with the Lands Awakened update, this patch brings a similar upgrading system to [b]Randomized Dungeons[/b]. This applies to both solo and group Randomized Dungeons in all zones and tiers, and dungeons with upgraded rewards/mobs will be [b]marked visually[/b] around the dungeon entrance.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/896ef1d399f94d6038e3824fb7fc8b588f385205.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
This patch introduces several important quality-of-life improvements, including:
[list]	[*]A much-awaited [b]automatic Silver pickup[/b][/*]	[*]Various [b]Party marker[/b] improvements[/*]	[*]New [b]“Hideout under attack”[/b] audio and visual cues, including musical changes and a “falling masonry” visual effect[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7793646e24b6ab5d31dc62dbdd588a66fed04f0b.png[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
This patch brings some significant [b]combat balance changes[/b] to broaden options and ensure competitive play ahead of Season 15. Here are just some of the changes:
[list]	[*][b]Forge Hammers: [/b]Giant Steps now has a new ability, [b]Giant Smash[/b], available while in giant form[/*]	[*][b]Nature Staffs: Spirit Animal[/b] can now heal larger groups, and its instant healing has been increased[/*]	[*][b]Shoes: [/b]	[list]		[*][b]Run [/b]has been replaced with [b]Dodge[/b] on all shoes. This gives all shoes an invulnerability option, while [b]Sprint[/b] has been adjusted to take over the mobility role[/*]		[*][b]Assassin Shoes[/b] have the new ability [b]Swift Cut[/b][/*]		[*]All[b] Gathering Workboots[/b] now have the [b]Rejuvenating Sprint[/b] ability option[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5c6a3fb7a4e4eae07d9d67aedaa6c60c53eab94f.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Hostile Dismount status now prevents the looting of killed hostile players, and players must now [b]dismount[/b] before looting a killed player[/*]	[*]Options added to create [b]Loadouts[/b] while inspecting another player and via Kill / Death Screen details[/*]	[*][b]Rare fish[/b] of all types are no longer biome-exclusive, and now have a small chance to be caught in other select biomes[/*]	[*]…and much more[/*][/list]
For a full list of changes, read the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/lands-awakened-patch-6][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Keeper Challenge Returns!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9fade3d422c0bb7bdfc7f574d635d1be092368ac.jpeg[/img]

Spring is back, and the Keepers of Albion are beginning to awaken... and for the entire month of March, you can take the [b]Keeper Challenge[/b] to collect fantastic rewards! Earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Grizzly Bear mount[/b].

[h3][b]Timeless Treasures are Yours to Claim[/b][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FdTDY3p.png[/img]
[b]GRIZZLY BEAR:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the popular [b]Grizzly Bear[/b], a huge, intimidating mount with an arsenal of powerful spells. In addition to its Intimidating Aura toggle spell, it also gains a temporary [b]speed boost[/b] when attacked, giving its rider an edge when enemies are in pursuit.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dg76ds8.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Reach your goals to unlock the [b]Keeper Challenge avatar ring[/b], which gives your chosen avatar the stone-and-leather look of Albion's true guardians. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded for one [b]Adventurer's Token[/b] at the Vanity Merchant. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/C4sRQZo.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Keeper Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver bags, and rare resources, this month's chests contain various [b]Keeper-themed furniture and capes[/b].

 As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim your rewards!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1Z25w6R.gif[/img]

notes.title: Albion Online is Coming to the Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2cc5438b6ff74d312016b3c7be89ea7baaf4c9ea.jpeg[/img]

Exciting news: live testing for [b]controller support in Albion Online[/b] is coming soon! Beginning [b]March 2[/b], you'll be able to play Albion Online with a wide range of standard PC and console controllers, as well as via the newly launched [b]Steam Deck[/b].

The introduction of controller support marks the next step toward our goal of bringing Albion Online to as many players and platforms as possible, and we plan to continue optimizing this feature in anticipation of a full controller support release. Once testing begins, compatible controllers will be usable on all desktop versions of the game, and can be activated during this first phase via chat commands. (Those playing via the Steam client on Steam Deck will be able to use the device controllers by default.)

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1a335a4d9e38600c1b64b7641e28a89c84e5bb75.jpeg[/img]

We'll be publishing more information about controller testing in a new dedicated [b]subforum[/b]. We're looking forward to hearing your feedback on this feature, so once you've had a chance to try it out, leave a comment on the forum!

notes.title: IAMNIUBI Wins Season 14!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/845f34f114cf170ef6f8b15c1c9528b5b3d8bff8.jpeg[/img]

November saw the start of the first guild season since the [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update brought far-reaching changes to Guild Warfare such as Headquarters Hideouts, Energy Crystals, Power Cores, and Might and Favor. As this tumultuous season came to an end, [b]IAMNIUBI[/b] were declared season winners, with [b]Elevate[/b] finishing second and [b]Judicate[/b] third.

As the Lands Awakened, so too did the struggle for power in the Outlands. With the added security afforded by [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b], many guilds chose to venture out on their own, without the protection of a large alliance. And while some chose to defend their home territories, others took up arms against their former landlords. Indeed, in the previous offseason there were already rumors that a new coalition would form to take on the [b]POE[/b] empire, and this materialized under the leadership of the [b]DIOR[/b] alliance. As the season kicked off this coalition soon grew too powerful for POE to handle, and by mid-season they had pushed them to the very brink of eviction.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4b9ac761436ffa9f76e7ec6f3982a529b9a5e69b.jpeg[/img]

With the power of POE curtailed, this coalition rapidly began to dissolve. [b]Surf[/b] and [b]AAA[/b] switched targets, eventually turning on each other. Backroom deals between long-time enemies POE and [b]Black 0rder[/b] created new bonds and saw changes in leadership, with MagicMark taking control of Black 0rder, dissolving their alliance [b]16x13[/b], and joining AAA.

Amidst these raging battles and shifting power dynamics, a new force emerged to dominate the season rankings. IAMNIUBI, a primarily East and Southeast Asian guild, proved to be a formidable generator of Season Points, quickly snatching first place and pulling away from the competition, opening up a considerable lead over Elevate in second place. With fully upgraded towers, a strong stable of Crystal League competitors and a guild-wide dedication to open-world activities like Castles, Power Cores, and Energy Crystals, IAMNIUBI stood out for the variety of methods they used to secure season points.

[previewyoutube=oksfVjpvDIQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Working alongside other alliances including AAA, IAMNIUBI have proven to be a force to be reckoned with in the early time zones, and they recently announced plans to expand into a fully international alliance with increased participation across all time zones. It will be quite the challenge for IAMNIUBI to reproduce this success throughout the day but, with the momentum from their first victory behind them, anything seems possible.

Here are the season's top ten teams with their total season points:
[olist]	[*][b]IAMNIUBI [/b]- 1,072,456 points[/*]	[*][b]Elevate [/b]- 713,539 points[/*]	[*][b]Judicate [/b]- 617,666 points[/*]	[*][b]War Gods[/b] - 394,116 points[/*]	[*][b]Escalation[/b] - 384,225 points[/*]	[*][b]The Lonely Men[/b] - 311,747 points[/*]	[*][b]Baila Ella[/b] - 286,885 points[/*]	[*][b]Be Careful[/b] - 283,068 points[/*]	[*][b]B Y O T[/b] - 279,665 points[/*]	[*][b]Fax[/b] - 278,862 points[/*][/olist][previewyoutube=n3XANhIgYxU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Season 15 is on the way[/h3]
As the dust settles on this thrilling season, guilds are already preparing for [b]Season 15[/b] which kicks off on [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-15-coming][b]March 5[/b][/url]. This brings with it [b]increased Might and Favor[/b], [b]faster Might leveling[/b], a [b]new Crystal League map[/b], and [b]unique season rewards[/b]. Following the seismic power shifts that Season 14 saw, this is sure to be another fiercely contested season. Check out the complete schedule [b][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/160789-Season-15-Schedule-and-Changes/]here[/url][/b][b].[/b]

notes.title: Season 15 Starts March 5
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

Albion's milestone [b]fifteenth Guild Season[/b] kicks off [b]March 5[/b], with increased Might and Favor, updated Might Level progression, an updated Crystal League map with hugely increased rewards, and more. Read on for details, or for the complete Season 15 schedule, [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/160789-Season-15-Schedule-and-Changes/][b]click here[/b][/url].
[h3]More Might and Favor, and Faster Might Leveling[/h3]
To further reward players and guilds who partake in riskier activities, the [b]overall Might and Favor[/b] earned in various categories has been greatly increased. Here are a few examples:
[list]	[*]Gathering/Fishing in the Outlands and Roads of Avalon: +30%[/*]	[*]PvE in the Outlands and Roads of Avalon: +25%[/*]	[*]Winning in Corrupted Dungeons: +20%[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1957905f0fe184f22f277148f99ca4f81e0d61ea.jpeg[/img]

Additionally, the threshold for [b]early Might Levels[/b] has been lowered for a wide range of activities available at all times. And as these thresholds now increase faster with higher levels, reaching the highest levels requires significantly more Might for the same Season Point output, ensuring the competition remains intense at the higher levels of guild warfare.
[h3]Crystal League Changes: New Map, Big Rewards[/h3]
5v5 Crystal League matches now use an [b]updated map[/b] based on the popular former "Steppe Territory" map. This new map makes it significantly harder for one team to hold three orbs, offering increased comeback potential for more exciting matches. Respawn timers are now more normalized throughout the match, which allows early kills to remain impactful without making late-kill respawn timers too punishing.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/155e40452a28a31cb5538f42e916767b2f224374.jpeg[/img]

[b]Crystal League rewards[/b] for both 5v5 and 20v20 have been improved significantly, with massively increased Silver as well as big Fame increases at nearly all levels. Together with the new map, we hope this will incentivize more players to try out the Crystal League and experience thrilling PvP matches.
[h3]Unique Season Rewards[/h3]
Players who gain enough Might will receive unique [b]season-specific Avatar Sets[/b], as well as battle mounts and 90-day Fame Buffs. Might can be gathered for a huge range of PvP-adjacent activities in the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b], which was introduced in Season 14 as a way for guilds of all sizes – as well as players who are not in guilds – to earn rewards without requiring passive territory control. And as always, there are additional [b]bracket rewards[/b] for guilds who reach at least Iron Rank, and the grand prize of a permanent statue in [b]Conquerors' Hall[/b] for the season's number one guild.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/94225ce1c7647aedfa478d8a1a6087a5e7b227df.png[/img]

For the full list of season rewards, check out [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/160789-Season-15-Schedule-and-Changes/?postID=1204281#post1204281][b]this forum post[/b][/url].
[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The action starts Saturday, March 5 and will be broadcast live on [b]AlbionTV[/b] starting 17:30 UTC, with hosts [b]Shozen, Lewpac[/b] and [b]Bogul [/b]bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim them and launch attacks. Those in the North and South American time zones can also tune in for the second round of territory resets on Sunday, March 6 at 00:30 UTC, when hosts [b]Shozen, Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Bogul [/b]will cover the next round of invasions from 01:00 UTC. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

notes.title: Lands Awakened Patch 4 is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2039f874f00124a9f9ff478a07dea52ae17eeb3b.jpeg[/img]

[b]Lands Awakened Patch 4[/b] is now live! This patch brings some important quality-of-life improvements, extensive combat balance changes, adjustments to Static Dungeon mobs, and much more. Read on for details…
[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
This patch sees some very welcome quality-of-life improvements introduced, for example:
[list]	[*][b]Party markers[/b] now persist when changing zones[/*]	[*]An overhead message displays when the [b]effects of food[/b] expire[/*]	[*][b]Silver piles[/b] now behave like loot bags with their visual effects, no longer showing the "rising particle" effect until lootable[/*]	[*]Certain visuals in [b]Royal Cities [/b]have been reworked and improved, in line with the reworked biomes that came with the Lands Awakened update[/*]	[*][b]And much more…[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a1beb4113d9b9ca55690c3cb45dadfe3b123b690.jpeg[/img][h3]Static Dungeon Mob Rebalancing[/h3]
In order to better balance the performance of certain Static Dungeon mobs, and allow more counterplay opportunities, some adjustments have been made to their abilities. For example:
[list]	[*][b]Gifted Sorceress (Morgana)[/b]: Enfeeble Blades damage reduced by 33%[/*]	[*][b]Earthdaughter (Keeper)[/b]: Frenzy spell adjusted to put more pressure on tanks[/*]	[*]Various alterations to [b]cast times, cooldowns and areas of effect[/b] for Morgana, Keeper and Undead Factions[/*][/list]
In addition, across all factions a number of Static Dungeon mobs have had their[b] avatars updated[/b] to better reflect their characteristics visually.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1282f912f22332ac9db77cab28e5cc306ecd0c11.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
This patch sees the largest combat balance update since Lands Awakened launched. Firstly, certain [b]combat systems[/b] – Resilience, AoE Escalation, Crowd Control, and Diminishing Returns – have been adjusted, broadly in favour of smaller groups in combat. In light of these adjustments, changes have also been made to some weapons and armors - such as [b]Cursed Staff[/b] and [b]Cleric Robe[/b] - in order to keep their gameplay fair and competitive.

Numerous further changes have also been made, including:
[list]	[*]Various [b]War Glove E-abilities[/b] improved[/*]	[*][b]Rain of Arrows[/b] channel duration decreased and damage increased[/*]	[*][b]Capes [/b]with effects triggered by auto-attacks no longer activate while Hostile Dismount status is active[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1bf4f5eeb38d5d9136326ba8d4dc94f4b2e740e1.png[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]New [b]Loadouts[/b] and [b]Wardrobe[/b] buttons added to the Player Inventory Screen[/*]	[*][b]"Appearance" menu[/b] now opens to Wardrobe by default[/*]	[*]Players can now use [b]"escape dungeon"[/b] (Hotkey: A) while in active combat (though getting hit will interrupt it)[/*]	[*]Energy Surge Season [b]statue furniture items[/b] are now placeable[/*]	[*]…and much more[/*][/list]
As always, you can read the complete list of changes in the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/LANDS%20AWAKENED%20PATCH%204][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: 2021: Albion's Year in Review
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72140ef436e0121f99bda78720a02f3b99f8c9ce.jpeg[/img]

While 2021 may not have brought quite the same level of unprecedented upheavals as 2020, it was nonetheless a year of various challenges. For the Albion Online team, it meant another year of developing the game in an almost entirely remote capacity, during which it saw two massive content updates, the long-anticipated mobile launch, and exploding player numbers. Throughout it all, the Albion community was as supportive as ever, and with the continued engagement of veteran players, combined with ever-increasing new player numbers, the game had its biggest year yet.

Join us as we take a look back at some of the highlights of the past year…
[h3]Call to Arms: Faction Warfare and More[/h3]
In March 2021, the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/update/call-to-arms][b]Call to Arms[/b][/url] update went live, introducing major new options for [b]small- and medium-scale PvP[/b] to the world of Albion. First and foremost, a fully reworked and re-envisioned [b]Faction Warfare[/b] system came to the Royal Continent, offering a huge range of PvP, PvE, and transport options for players of all levels. An entirely new [b]Caerleon Faction[/b] arrived, which put a unique "bandit-style" twist on the Faction system, and all six Factions received new [b]Elite Faction Mounts[/b] with unique, powerful abilities. Faction Warfare came to life across the continent with interactive [b]map overlays[/b], new [b]non-lethal Faction zones[/b], and an unpredictable [b]Bandit Assault[/b] event that offered huge rewards.

[previewyoutube=54OBbmUfBP4;full][/previewyoutube]
Alongside these changes, Call to Arms brought fully reworked [b]Hellgates[/b], with a map-based entry system, ten new layouts, a time-based lava mechanic, and an all-new 10v10 option. The update was rounded out with major quality-of-life improvements including [b]Loadouts[/b], updated [b]ability tooltips[/b], and [b]animated vegetation[/b] alongside improvements, balance changes, and optimizations.
[h3]Albion Goes Mobile[/h3]
In June, the Albion team fulfilled a goal nearly ten years in the making: bringing the complete sandbox MMORPG experience to all players, regardless of whether they played on [b]desktop or mobile[/b]. Since the very earliest days of its development, Albion Online was intended to be a seamless [b]cross-platform experience[/b] – and on June 9, 2021, after years of development, testing, and optimization, it finally became a reality, with the game launching for the [b]Apple App Store[/b] and [b]Google Play Store[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dcd0097aef7fb34ddbd4160f0ae1ee2d5054aea6.png[/img]

To celebrate the occasion, we went all-out with a full live-action trailer that follows a group of highly creative "early adopters" trying to make the mobile experience a reality:

[previewyoutube=7MEvv81i3ek;full][/previewyoutube]
The worldwide launch, as well as rewards including the [b]Chimera[/b] mount skin for cross-platform play, brought countless new players to the world of Albion, and rocketed the game to the forefront of the most popular sandbox MMOs worldwide.
[h3]An Ever-Growing Population[/h3]
Following record numbers in 2020, the active player count in Albion [url=https://albiononline.com/news/population-update-spring-2021][b]continued to grow into 2021[/b][/url]. February saw Daily Average User count hit 135,000, and Call to Arms in March continued this trend even further, pushing the count past 140,000. Then came the mobile launch in June, which completely dwarfed previous user counts with [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-onlines-popularity-record-level][b]an average of over 270,000 users[/b][/url] per day. With the possibility to play on both desktop and mobile for the first time, players had even more incentive to stay active, and many also took the opportunity to return.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea596ba5431ea18466b1e070883dfabb06d6b5a7.jpeg[/img]

These greater numbers can only be good news for the experience of playing Albion, as a more populated world brings depth, unpredictability, and excitement. By the time of the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-turns-four][b]Fourth Anniversary[/b][/url] celebrations in July, this popularity was being reflected in ever higher view and subscriber counts on [b]Twitch[/b] and [b]YouTube[/b] as well.
[h3]Albion Awakens[/h3]
Fall 2021 marked the start of a new era for Albion, bringing the massive, much-anticipated [url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened][b]Lands Awakened[/b][/url] update. This was perhaps the game's most expansive update since launch, touching nearly every aspect of [b]open-world gameplay[/b]. From gorgeous new visuals for all five biomes, mobs that upgrade in power and value over time, and reworked static dungeons, to the brand-new [b]War Gloves[/b] weapon line, an expanded soundtrack, big changes to guild warfare, UI and quality-of-life improvements… the list goes on.

[previewyoutube=0GksQhov0kY;full][/previewyoutube]
These developments keep the experience of playing Albion fresh, immersive, and unpredictable, and we can’t wait to see what emerges as players put on their War Gloves, declare their Headquarters Hideouts, and fight for Energy Crystals and Power Cores in a fully remade open world.
[h3]The Albion Online Creators Program[/h3]
Along with the Lands Awakened update, November also saw the launch of the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/announcing-creators-program][b]Albion Online Creators Program[/b][/url]. This new program was created for the many talented individuals who stream and create video content around Albion Online, supporting them and giving them a platform to expand their audience. At the same time, it helps drive Albion Online as a community-focused game, bringing streamers, the wider player community, and the development team together to showcase the best of what Albion has to offer.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79febf9c593b6af1aebefd980677457661363b85.jpeg[/img]

The Creators Program celebrated the Lands Awakened release with a Streamer Showcase, as across the world players tuned in to see the new features in action as soon as they launched. This exciting journey has only just begun, and we can’t wait to see what comes from it in 2022.
[h3]Guild Warfare: A Year of Change[/h3]
2021 brought sweeping changes to [b]guild warfare[/b] in Albion Online. The year began midway through Season 11, which had introduced the new [b]20v20 Crystal League[/b]. In March, Season 12 brought an increased emphasis on [b]open-world gameplay[/b]. Season 13 introduced new objectives in Treasure Drones and Crystal Spiders, and in the final weeks before the Lands Awakened update, the standalone six-week [b]Energy Surge Season[/b] offered unique rewards including exclusive avatars and permanent statues in the open world.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

[url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-14-kickoff][b]Season 14[/b][/url] kicked off just days after Lands Awakened, introducing numerous new features that shifted the emphasis of Guild Seasons from passive territory control to active play, both on an individual as well as a guild level:
[list]	[*]Headquarters Hideouts[/*]	[*]Conqueror's Challenge[/*]	[*]Might and Favor[/*]	[*]Guild Might Levels[/*]	[*]Energy Crystals and Power Cores[/*][/list]
[previewyoutube=sg-6Ho_Wuyk;full][/previewyoutube]
These major new features have breathed new life into Albion's Guild Seasons, laying the foundation for thrilling endgame gameplay for years to come.
[h3]Year-End Honors[/h3]
As 2021 drew to a close, it still had time to bring two very welcome surprises, as Albion Online was awarded the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/deutscher-entwicklerpreis][b]Deutscher Entwicklerpreis[/b][/url] for "Best Mobile Game" and the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/best-pvp-2021][b]MassivelyOP Year-End Award[/b][/url] for "Best MMO PvP". Alongside the jury prize from MassivelyOP, Albion Online also won the readers’ poll in this category. These prizes were a tremendous validation of all the hard work the team put in over the year, acknowledging the highly successful mobile launch in June, and the focus on making Albion's PvP the most exciting, fresh, and competitive in the MMO world. With all the huge developments 2021 saw for the game, to have these recognized is extremely rewarding, and makes us even more excited to bring you what we have in store for 2022.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/355c43a70ec66d90d719e89bd0724b33a36bb0c8.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Looking Forward to 2022[/h3]
We're already hard at work on the next content update, with some big new features and improvements in the works, and in the coming weeks we'll be bringing you a new Dev Talk. For now, though, we want to extend our thanks to you, the Albion community, for making everything we do possible, and making 2021 the biggest year yet in the world of Albion.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/19211cd03f4e877e358eaa7c179a37026d7eab44.jpeg[/img]

Happy New Year, and we'll see you in-game!

notes.title: Albion Online named best PvP MMO by MassivelyOP
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/355c43a70ec66d90d719e89bd0724b33a36bb0c8.jpeg[/img]

[b]MassivelyOP[/b] have announced their end of year awards for 2021, and we’re delighted to say that Albion Online has received the prize for [b]best PvP[/b]! This follows the Deutscher Entwicklerpreis for Best Mobile Game [b][url=https://albiononline.com/news/deutscher-entwicklerpreis]received last week[/url][/b], making it Albion’s second award of the year. This particular award had not been given out since 2017, but this year the jury decided to bring it back, and we’re extremely proud that they chose to recognize the PvP experience of Albion Online in what was a very competitive field.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6c597d931e9eaf2a6a1edf501d0f98893e42f8d5.jpeg[/img]

Explaining his choice, jury member and MassivelyOP writer Chris Neal stated:
[i]“Albion actually enticed me to enter some PvP zones by giving me [b]good PvE and crafting[/b] reasons to do so. That’s not something I can say about most PvP-centric MMOs.”[/i]

With one of the goals for Albion Online, particularly with the [b][url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened]Lands Awakened update[/url][/b], being to encourage players to populate the open world and risk PvP in the pursuit of ever-greater rewards, it is especially heartening to hear that these efforts have been appreciated. Thanks are due to the jury, to everyone on the team who has worked so hard to create a unique PvP experience, and most of all to the players who truly make Albion such an exciting world in which to play.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2414b55547656b7cf30a9875731d1e8c9bc9b902.png[/img]

You can read the full article on MassivelyOP [url=https://massivelyop.com/2021/12/12/massively-ops-2021-awards-best-mmo-pvp/][b]here[/b][/url], where you can also participate in a [b]readers’ poll[/b] for this category.

We can’t wait to bring you even more new developments next year to continue making PvP such an enjoyable and competitive experience in Albion. See you out there!

notes.title: Uncle Frost Returns to Albion

notes.title: Lands Awakened Patch 1 is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f059da297d41e97c2281c3fad8b28b619a271aec.jpeg[/img]

The first [b]Lands Awakened[/b] patch is now live! This patch updates the requirements for Headquarters Hideouts, brings combat balance changes to War Gloves, Maces and other weapons, introduces UI improvements and guild invite spam protections, and much more. Here’s a summary of what’s new:

[h3]Headquarters Hideout Requirements Updated[/h3]
The requirements for declaring a [b]Headquarters Hideout[/b] have been updated. Most notably, you can now designate a Headquarters immediately when the Season Point threshold has been reached - you no longer need to wait until the following season to declare a Headquarters. Furthermore, the top-600 ranking requirement has been removed.

For more details, as well as the current point requirements by zone quality and tier, see this forum post: [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157670]https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157670[/url]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5bb077a829cf483d2091ea993245a7364d8303a6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Energy Surge Season Winner Statues Unveiled[/h3]
The winners of the standalone [b]Energy Surge Season[/b] have had their statues unveiled, and this time they are placed in the open-world! Here are the winners and where you can find their statues:
[list]	[*]First Place:[b] The Lonely Men, Redtree Enclave[/b][/*]	[*]Second Place:[b] Hadoop, Drybasin Oasis[/b][/*]	[*]Third Place:[b] Be Careful, Sunstrand Quicksands[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/28bd1e7af72aa89598e81cba9c91eafddc209f19.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]New Guild Invite Spam Protections[/h3]
To prevent players from being spammed with guild invitations, a limit has been placed on how many invitations can be sent out at a time. In addition, sending too many declined guild invitations in a short space of time now applies a guild-wide cooldown on sending invitations. Along with these changes, there is also clearer feedback on whether a guild invitation has been accepted or rejected.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0c80143a9d4961703c81dce0da5be1dcc3087d6f.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
With Lands Awakened having introduced a brand-new weapon line in [b]War Gloves[/b], Patch 1 makes some slight adjustments to ensure they are competitive in the combat meta, with a broad range of abilities across the line improved. [b]Maces[/b] have also been adjusted so that they don’t clearly outperform other, similar weapon types, with the Threatening Smash and Deep Leap abilities reworked somewhat.

Further changes:
[list]	[*]Whirlwind (Great Axes) speed increase removed[/*]	[*]Blood Ritual (Demonfang) self-damage decreased[/*]	[*]Channel time to enter a Hideout increased[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ad323966dfef6ab733acfe1f0fca9f9c15d60902.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Introduced a [b]Static Dungeon UI[/b] showing mob types and tiers[/*]	[*][b]Adventurer’s Challenge Daily Bonus[/b] upgraded to an Adept’s Tome of Insight (10,000 Fame)[/*]	[*][b]Hideout Power Levels[/b] are now viewable in the Guild Estates UI[/*]	[*][b]Power Cores and Energy Crystals[/b] can be carried through Passages in the Outlands[/*]	[*]…and much more[/*][/list]As always, you can read the full list of changes in the [b][url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/LANDS%20AWAKENED%20PATCH%201]official patchnotes[/url][/b].

notes.title: Albion Online Wins the Deutscher Entwicklerpreis

The 2021 [b]Deutscher Entwicklerpreis[/b] awards took place on December 9 in Cologne, and we're delighted to say that Albion Online took home the award for [b]Best Mobile Game![/b]

The [url=https://www.deutscherentwicklerpreis.de/deutscher-entwicklerpreis-ehrt-die-besten-games-des-jahres/][b]Deutscher Entwicklerpreis[/b][/url] (German Game Developer Prize) is the most prestigious industry award in the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), presented to professionals by fellow professionals. Unlike similar awards in other regions, the Deutscher Entwicklerpreis is organized, supported, and juried almost entirely by developers themselves, and is a vital and integral part of the ever-growing games industry here.

Albion Online's official mobile version launched in June 2021, fulfilling a nearly decade-long goal of bringing the full sandbox MMO experience to iOS and Android. And while game development can be a long and difficult process, the mobile launch trailer was decidedly more lighthearted:
[previewyoutube=7MEvv81i3ek;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks to the jury, the team, and most of all, to the Albion community, without whom none of this would have been possible!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Quality-of-Life Improvements
notes.content:
The [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update launched November 24, ushering in a new era of open-world gameplay in Albion Online. Along with sweeping changes to biome graphics and layouts, dungeons, mobs, open-world objectives and Guild Seasons, the update brought some major [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] to a wide variety of ingame activities. In our latest Dev Talk, UI Designer [b]Moritz Bokelmann[/b] discusses some of the biggest improvements to UI and usability that arrived with this latest update.
[previewyoutube=ao9p7o2hBJs;full][/previewyoutube]
No time to watch, or prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]Marketplace Loadouts[/h3]
[b]Loadouts[/b] were introduced with the Call to Arms update as a major quality-of-life improvement, and this feature has now been expanded to include the option to [b]directly purchase full Loadouts from the Marketplace[/b]. How it works:
[list]	[*]New tab added to Marketplace UI to allow purchase of Loadouts[/*]	[*]Allows users to designate which Loadout to look for, and what quantity[/*]	[*]Marketplace then searches all local Sell Orders for the items, using parameters set in Loadout creation[/*]	[*]Can purchase alternatives if one or more items are unavailable[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e547bb6078fbda2eda7708a1534448271ab14341.jpeg[/img]

Once the search is completed, the Marketplace shows a summary of available items and alternatives. Details:
[list]	[*]Shows prices of available items[/*]	[*]Compares each item to market average[/*]	[*]Each entry can be toggled to buy or skip[/*]	[*]Does not reserve the items, so they may be purchased by others. If so:	[list]		[*]Unavailable items appear on a separate screen alongside alternative suggestions[/*]		[*]This screen generates a new search if any alternatives are selected[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3]Farming Usability Improvements[/h3]
[b]Farming [/b]is an essential part of Albion's economy, but on a large scale can take a long time and lots of clicks. Alongside small improvements (simplifying animal placement, moving T2 hide animals)[b] the number of clicks farming takes has been greatly reduced[/b]:
[list]	[*]All farming actions can now be performed by shift-clicking (double-tapping on mobile)[/*]	[*]Steps are unchanged, but opening the farming interface is not required, reducing clicks/taps greatly[/*]	[*]Shift-click actions include a distinct icon above the crop or animal[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/54a4c23445df17ba1ebc8c2c77e3ca3372f11f46.jpeg[/img]

New in the UI:
[list]	[*]Animals with growth and production stages now have a “Take all” option[/*]	[*]Can be toggled to pick up the animal [b]and[/b] its product or offspring[/*]	[*]Can be set persistently based on the animal[/*][/list][h3]Party Improvements[/h3]
Lands Awakened brings updated [b]party chat commands[/b] for better feedback and easier party formation:
[list]	[*]In addition to using /invite to invite a player, a new /join command sends a request to join another party[/*]	[*]Both /invite and /join now work for entire parties	[list]		[*]With /invite, the inviting party's leader retains leadership[/*]		[*]With /join, the leader of the party being joined will stay the party’s leader[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]All solo and group invite and join requests can be expanded to show player details[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c1bbfcd3fa6ef4fede3720b9935e9b3c74c0e5a4.jpeg[/img]

In your Social settings you can now clearly define who can invite you to their group or request to join yours. Additionally, you can always use the /snooze chat command to temporarily suppress all party invitations.

We can't wait to hear your feedback on these changes, and of course we already have more quality-of-life improvements lined up for the next updates, so stay tuned!

notes.title: The Yuletide Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/018abb2522e1b1feab3288d50274986151fbcafc.jpeg[/img]

Winter has returned to Albion, and the [b]Yuletide Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of December, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests, and earn rewards like an avatar ring, classic furniture items, and the beloved [b]Snow Husky mount[/b].
[h3][b]Yuletide Greetings[/b][/h3]
[b]SNOW HUSKY:[/b] You've got another chance to claim the charming [b]Snow Husky[/b], a handsome canine companion that will carry you through Albion's harshest terrain. Along with its strong base move speed, its Hunting Instinct spell gives a short but powerful speed burst.
 
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Along with the Snow Husky, adventurers who reach this month's total point goal will unlock the [b]Yuletide Challenge Ring[/b], which gives your avatar a cheery holiday look any time of year. And remember: unclaimed Adventurer's Challenge Rings can always be traded in for Adventurer's Tokens at the Vanity Merchant!
 
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] Unlock Yuletide Challenge chests to get a mix of holiday-themed prizes, along with goodies like Silver, Tomes of Insight, treasures and resources. Each chest has a chance to give classic Yuletide decorations like [b]Presents [/b]and [b]Decorated Trees[/b] as well as the [b]Yuletide Candle, Wreath, Lantern,[/b] and[b] Candy Boot[/b]!

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

notes.title: Season 14 Begins Saturday
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

[b]Albion’s fourteenth Guild Season[/b] starts this weekend with a revamped structure and new features to make guild warfare more competitive and exciting than ever before. Most notably, this season marks the beginning of the [b]Conqueror’s Challenge[/b], which replaces the previous Guild Season reward system and allows a wider range of playstyles to pursue and profit from season goals. Alongside this, Season 14 sees the introduction of [b]Might, Favor, Guild Might Levels, Energy Crystals, Power Cores[/b], and [b]Headquarters Hideouts.[/b]

[h3]Season Rewards[/h3]
The [b]Conqueror’s Challenge[/b] allows individual players to earn season rewards throughout the course of the season without necessarily being part of a guild – though a successful guild will still benefit its members as it completes [b]Guild Might Levels[/b]. Individual Conqueror’s Challenge rewards are as follows:

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2bad7bf39ec31bdf43e6a34eff9d66d84cad371f.jpeg[/img]

For a full breakdown of guild and personal season rewards, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157165-Changes-for-Guild-Season-14/?postID=1184023#post1184023][b]this f[/b][b]orum post[/b][/url].

[h3]Headquarters Hideouts[/h3]
As recently announced in [b][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157590]this forum post[/url][/b], starting with Lands Awakened Patch 1, Headquarters Hideouts qualifications will apply [b]as soon as they are earned within the current season[/b]. This means guilds who earn enough Season Points during Season 14 will be able to declare an HQ or upgrade to a higher tier/quality zone [b]immediately[/b], regardless of whether they qualified during the Energy Surge season. And of course, guilds who met the HQ Hideout requirements during the last season can already declare Headquarters in qualifying zones.

For details of Headquarters Hideouts and Power Cores, check out this Dev Talk:

[previewyoutube=i1oWeiLp3hM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Watch the Season Kickoff Live[/h3]
The action starts on Saturday, November 27 and will be broadcast live on [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline]AlbionTV[/url][/b] from 17:30 UTC, with hosts [b]Shozen, Lewpac[/b] and [b]Bogul [/b]bringing full coverage of Invasion Day.

At 18:00 UTC all territories will be reset for guilds to claim them and launch attacks. Those in the North and South American time zones can also tune in for the second round of territory resets on Sunday, November 28 at 00:30 UTC, when hosts [b]Shozen, Robinhoodrs[/b] and [b]Bogul [/b]will cover the next round of invasions from 01:00 UTC. All open-world fights are broadcast live with a 15-minute delay.

Check out AlbionTV's coverage of the second Energy Surge Invasion Day:

[previewyoutube=AZqS3ZSeHHE;full][/previewyoutube]
The next era of guild warfare in Albion starts Saturday - we'll see you then!

notes.title: The Lands Awakened Update is Here!
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/609572c88c45d10ef11f0069d8fd8cab05ad9416.jpeg[/img]

The massive [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update is now live! This update brings a new era of [b]open-world gameplay[/b] to Albion with reworked [b]dungeons, mobs,[/b] and [b]treasure sites[/b], new open-world [b]PvP objectives[/b] for groups of all sizes, hugely improved [b]visuals and layouts[/b] for all five biomes, [b]War Gloves[/b], reworked [b]Guild Seasons[/b], numerous [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b], and much more.

To celebrate the occasion, we've created a brand-new trailer:

[previewyoutube=0GksQhov0kY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Reinvigorating Albion's Open World[/h3]
Lands Awakened brings a completely overhauled open-world experience, including [b]massively improved visuals and layouts[/b] in all five biomes, mobs that become [b]stronger and more rewarding[/b] over time, reworked [b]static dungeons[/b], and [b]treasure sites[/b] that spawn randomly throughout the world. Whether you're a brand-new player or a seasoned veteran, Albion's lands are home to countless new opportunities awaiting discovery.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bda0aec195dfd1d9d5260a4b3b69f5a8aaa1c57e.jpeg[/img][h3]New Weapons, Elite Levels, Faster Fame[/h3]
The all-new [b]War Gloves[/b] offer thrilling brawler-style combat for small-, medium-, and large-scale fights, along with numerous options for PvE. [b]Elite Levels[/b] add twenty additional mastery levels to each weapon and armor piece, with corresponding medals to let you show off your accomplishments. And the amount of [b]Fame [/b]granted for nearly all activities has been boosted significantly, shortening the time needed to unlock new skills and rewarding perseverant players.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e114239ebd87303075e7a3a1f7c4f26287bce247.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Reworked Guild Seasons[/h3]
[b]Power Cores[/b] and [b]Energy Crystals[/b] introduce open-world capture-the-flag gameplay with huge rewards. [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b] offer protected bases for dedicated guilds. And the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b] allows all players to earn [b]Might[/b] and [b]Favor[/b] for a wide range of activities, unlocking rewards for themselves and their guilds. Overall, Lands Awakened shifts the focus of Guild Seasons from passive territory control to active personal progress, offering dedicated players and guilds a chance at massive rewards.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d764348ff614f2576fbd26aff42e198a63d79195.jpeg[/img]
[h3]The Druid Vanity Bundle is Here[/h3]
The Lands Awakened update also brings the new [b]Druid Vanity Bundle.[/b] This premiere bundle is available in the in-game store, and includes a full [b]costume set[/b] plus a matching [b]Stag mount skin[/b]. The costume skins feature a thick, forest-green cape and a crown of antlers, and both the costume and mount skins are decorated with a glowing aura of fireflies.

The Druid Bundle includes the following vanity skins, which work on male and female characters alike:
[list]	[*][b]Druid's Horns[/b][/*]	[*][b]Druid's Garments[/b][/*]	[*][b]Druid's Shoes[/b][/*]	[*][b]Druid's Cape[/b][/*]	[*][b]Druid's Stag[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0a4b4dd48c81535e3dda49c3187553fdd0c8b085.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Improvements[/h3][list]	[*][b]Loadouts[/b] can now be purchased directly from the Marketplace[/*]	[*][b]Large resource nodes[/b] now spawn as treasure sites, appearing on the map to those nearby[/*]	[*]Improvements to [b]farming, rerolling,[/b] [b]building fees,[/b] and [b]party commands[/b][/*]	[*]Numerous [b]combat balance changes[/b][/*]	[*]Massively expanded [b]soundtrack[/b] with 17 new tracks[/*]	[*][b]Real estate plots[/b] added to Outlands towns[/*]	[*]New [b]Artifact resources[/b][/*]	[*]Bug fixes, mobile optimizations, new icons and achievements, and much more[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/650daa1653ea2fd2686be761a3b392de15f0d42b.jpeg[/img]

For more details, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened][b]official update page[/b][/url] or the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/LANDS%20AWAKENED%20UPDATE][b]update patchnotes[/b][/url].
