notes.title: Dev Talk: War Gloves and Elite Levels
notes.content:
The [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update on November 24 brings exciting developments to combat in Albion Online. In this Dev Talk, Combat Designer Michael Schwahn and Game Director Robin Henkys introduce two major new features: the [b]War Gloves[/b] weapon line and [b]Elite Levels[/b].

[previewyoutube=d0XBGtu-BlI;full][/previewyoutube]
Read on for a written summary...
[h3]War Gloves[/h3][list]	[*]An entirely new [b]brawler weapon line[/b] on the Warrior Weapons tree[/*]	[*]Three new [b]base weapons[/b][/*]	[*]Four new [b]artifact weapons[/b][/*]	[*]Allow various [b]attack combos[/b][/*][/list]War Gloves have a great deal of build versatility, giving players a variety of outplay possibilities and interesting decisions to make. They have [b]one more Q slot ability[/b] than other weapons, allowing build flexibility for different situations.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2d2efb0521eb85db521cfd3e7b4e43bd5ae604af.jpeg[/img]

Here’s a look at just some of their abilities:
[list]	[*][b]Triple Kick[/b]	[list]		[*]W-ability[/*]		[*]Fly towards the enemy, performing three kicks in the air[/*]		[*]Can be aimed close, or at a distance for extra mobility[/*]		[*]Can drag one enemy player with you[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b8a8e086d948a1204dd82a2ff25ba777fc8daa0c.jpeg[/img]
[list]	[*][b]Blazing Geyser[/b]	[list]		[*]E-ability of [b]Battle Bracers[/b][/*]		[*]An explosion in front of you, dealing damage and knocking enemies into the air[/*]		[*]Hitting one enemy [b]resets Q-slot cooldown[/b][/*]		[*]Well-suited to building combos[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cb8e48b8a88639904eaff58320ed696e074241df.jpeg[/img]
[list]	[*][b]Purifying Combination[/b]	[list]		[*]Three-part combo		[list]			[*][b]Roundhouse Kick[/b] knocks enemies away[/*]			[*][b]Dive Kick[/b] with jump knocks enemies into the air[/*]			[*][b]Purifying Fist[/b] deals massive damage[/*]			[*]Can be combined with other abilities between each attack[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][list]	[*]Some other new abilities:	[list]		[*][b]Cross Step[/b] and [b]Aggressive Burst[/b] suited to an auto-attack style[/*]		[*][b]Infernal Boulder[/b]		[list]			[*]Combined with Triple Kick, can make all three Boulder hits land on one player[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]New weapon lines for Hunter and Mage are also being worked on for future updates, so stay tuned.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/085cbb4d773fbe385325ad1c22848f134918d6cc.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Elite Levels[/h3]
Lands Awakened brings significantly increased Fame rewards across the game, which players can use to progress with their weapon specializations. As a further Fame objective for veteran players, the Destiny Board has also been expanded with Elite Levels:
[list]	[*]These allow combat specializations to reach [b]level 120[/b][/*]	[*]Can be unlocked with [b]Fame[/b] [b]credits and Silver[/b][/*]	[*]Increase maximum possible specialization bonuses by [b]60 points of Item Power[/b][/*]	[*][b]New badges [/b]appear on equipped items, indicating the level of specialization achieved[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72f34f468f23ab34c90a2c4690b505d18cefabe5.jpeg[/img]

Remember, Lands Awakened launches on November 24, and soon after that we’ll have a final Dev Talk where we show some big UI improvements to Loadouts, farming, and party invites.

Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Power Cores and HQ Hideouts
notes.content:
Lands Awakened arrives November 24, bringing major open-world features, Guild Season changes, and more. In our newest Dev Talk, Robin Henkys discusses [b]Hideout Power Cores[/b] and [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b], two related features that will shake up guild warfare and open-world PvP.

[previewyoutube=i1oWeiLp3hM;full][/previewyoutube]
Prefer a written summary? Read on...
[h3]Hideout Power Cores[/h3][list]	[*]New [b]capturable open-world objective[/b][/*]	[*]Spawn anywhere in the Outlands in shielded state[/*]	[*]While shielded, marked on local map but cannot be interacted with[/*]	[*]After a short period, the shielding ends, allowing players on foot to pick up and carry the Power Core[/*]	[*]If player is killed or drops the core, it remains for several minutes before dissipating[/*]	[*][b]Capturing Power Cores:[/b]	[list]		[*]Can be captured at a Hideout [b]owned by the capturing player's guild[/b][/*]		[*][b]Increases the Hideout’s power level[/b], which increases its crafting bonuses[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f325e5373a0419a796678d7bdc3a122ae5006cf3.jpeg[/img]

Additionally, entering owned Hideouts set as "Home" grants temporary Fame buff (based on Hideout power level) in the Outlands
[h3]Further Details[/h3][list]	[*]Beyond Hideout rewards, players in parties capturing Power Cores receive significant [b]Might and Favor[/b][/*]	[*]Cores spawn in varying strengths:	[list]		[*]Weaker: unlock sooner, less Power[/*]		[*]Stronger: visible further, longer shielding times, significant power boosts[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Overall, Power Cores appear more frequently and with less warning than Energy Vortices, allowing smaller groups to claim them easier[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e4c7dfe61363093b64ffb0a0a0cc31a741c1b537.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Headquarters Hideouts[/h3][list]	[*]Qualifying guilds can declare a Hideout "Headquarters" (HQ)[/*]	[*]Invulnerable to attack if properly powered[/*]	[*]Two downsides:	[list]		[*]Only accessible by owning guild[/*]		[*]Must be maintained[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3]Establishing HQ Hideouts[/h3][list]	[*]Must earn sufficient [b]Season Points in previous season[/b] to qualify[/*]	[*]Higher points earned unlocks better region Tier / Quality (e.g. 40,000 Energy Surge Season Points unlocks up to Tier 7 / Quality 3)[/*]	[*](Full qualification requirements: https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/156756)[/*]	[*]Once per season, a [b]Hideout construction site[/b] can be protected:	[list]		[*]Site placement follows usual restrictions[/*]		[*]After 20 minutes (NOTE: the video states 15 minutes, which is incorrect), it can be made invulnerable for the remainder of construction, turning it into an HQ[/*]		[*]Boost also provides some starting Power[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d2498ed00999b3e3decbd357f5524c696f760013.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Maintenance[/h3][list]	[*]If HQ's Power falls below required amount at start of battle time, it becomes [b]vulnerable[/b][/*]	[*]Preventable if owning guild captures Power Cores[/*]	[*]Power required depends on zone Quality[/*]	[*]High Power drains quicker, making it harder to maintain HQs in high-Quality regions[/*]	[*]To assist maintenance, Power from cores is increased by 50% in HQs[/*]	[*]Hideouts lose HQ status if the owners don't meet region requirements at season's end[/*]	[*]Damaged HQs are vulnerable until fully restored[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9127483d940a8fdda1cbd6ca3c43fbc79fb04ca4.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Conclusion[/h3]
Earning and maintaining HQ Hideouts is no easy task, but being protected from attack allows guilds to make their own choices and forge their own destiny in Albion. (Note: HQs will be added to the Roads of Avalon in a later update; until then, Power Cores cannot be taken through the Roads.)

Subscribe for upcoming videos on War Gloves, Elite Levels, and more!

notes.title: Season 14 Brings Big Changes
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9a118fb11509f9409491df69452668baaa884588.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update goes live on November 24, bringing revamped open-world visuals and gameplay, the new War Gloves weapon line, Elite Levels for weapon mastery, numerous quality-of-life improvements, and more. Alongside these changes, the update also ushers in a new era of [b]guild warfare[/b], with a completely new Guild Season structure that offers countless ways for resourceful players of all types to make seasonal progress and earn rewards, even those not affiliated with a guild. Traditional guild activities such as territory control and ZvZs will still provide a path to success, but individual players – and their guilds in turn – will also benefit from playing other smaller-scale activities.
[list]	[*]For the complete Season 14 Schedule, click [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157080][b]here[/b][/url].[/*]	[*]For a detailed breakdown of the changes listed in this article, and the reasoning behind them, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157165][b]this forum post[/b][/url].[/*][/list][h3]Introducing the Conqueror's Challenge[/h3]
To make Guild Seasons more about player activity and less about territory control and passive income, this season introduces the [b]Conquerors' Challenge[/b]. This dynamic, season-long system for tracking progress opens Albion's higher-level activities to guild members and non-guild-affiliated players alike, and introduces two new reward systems, [b]Might [/b]and [b]Favor[/b] (details below).

The Conqueror's Challenge offers players the freedom to earn Season Rewards in countless different ways, with a wide range of activities contributing to progress. Ultimately, any player willing to put in the work during a season will have a chance to unlock some of the most valuable and powerful rewards in the game.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d25b9963083e64ab69ab3843b78aa11bf4fd2f37.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Might, Favor, and Might Levels[/h3]
As part of the revamped Guild Seasons, this season brings two new concepts to the game: [b]Might[/b] and [b]Favor[/b], which measure the success of individuals and guilds during the season and unlock fantastic rewards.
[list]	[*][b]Might[/b] is earned by participating in [b]activities which carry the risk of PvP[/b], and allows players to progress towards personal season goals and unlock valuable rewards like battle mounts and unique avatars.[/*]	[*][b]Favor[/b] is a [b]new currency[/b] which is also earned in most cases where Might is earned, and can be used to purchase Siphoned Energy and additional reward chests.[/*][/list]Alongside personal Might, guild-affiliated players’ activities will contribute towards their [b]Guild Might Level[/b], which rewards guilds with Season Points, and their members with further Might and Might Boosts.

Additionally, a new [b]Season Overview UI[/b] will show a guild’s current rank, how its Season Points were earned, and which members contributed the most Might.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/56e038db5c878e8407dc56386a7290c4f8c3ed2c.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Headquarters Hideouts, Power Cores and Energy Crystals[/h3]
To further encourage exciting power struggles in the Outlands and keep things competitive for smaller guilds, [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b] have been introduced. Earning enough Season Points in the preceding season allows a guild to designate one of its Outlands Hideouts as an HQ, making it invulnerable. This status must be maintained, however, through capturing new [b]Power Cores[/b] as they appear across the landscape. Alongside [b]Energy Crystals[/b], which can be used to boost Territories, this will bring a whole new dynamic and competitive edge to Guild Seasons. For more information on these new features, see this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-guild-season-changes][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79d9996b72126f15186ee89902023cb5812fabbf.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Season 14 Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Killing Siphoning Mages, Crystal Spiders, etc. no longer directly gives Season Points, as these are now earned through the corresponding Might Levels[/*]	[*]Territory levels rebalanced[/*]	[*]Castles, Castle Outposts, and Guild Challenge no longer grant Siphoned Energy[/*]	[*]Crystal League rewards rebalanced, Season Rewards now based on Conqueror's Challenge[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Guild Season Changes
notes.content:
The [url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened][b]Lands Awakened update[/b][/url] arrives November 24, bringing massive open-world changes, a new weapon line, an updated soundtrack, and more. In today's Dev Talk, Game Director Robin Henkys discusses the huge changes coming to [b]Guild Seasons[/b] with this update.

[previewyoutube=sg-6Ho_Wuyk;full][/previewyoutube]
No time to watch the video? Read on for a summary...
[h3]Primary Goals[/h3][list]	[*]Allow players to earn Season Points for their guild via [b]small-scale activities[/b][/*]	[*]Grant [b]personal as well as guild rewards [/b]for making progress[/*]	[*]Shift the focus of Guild Seasons from [b]passive territory control[/b] to [b]player activity[/b][/*][/list][h3]Conqueror's Challenge[/h3][list]	[*]The Conqueror's Challenge replaces the existing Guild Season reward system[/*]	[*]Runs for the duration of a Guild Season[/*]	[*]Available to all Premium players, whether in a guild or not[/*]	[*]Uses a new type of points called [b]“Might”[/b][/*]	[*]Earning Might unlocks powerful and unique rewards, including new Seasonal Avatars for multiple levels, Battle Mounts, and Fame Boosts[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72f229fce20c299ff3896efe85d41b3390267d79.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Might[/h3]
Might is earned by participating in activities with a [b]risk of PvP[/b]:
[list]	[*]Killing mobs / gathering in the Outlands or Roads of Avalon[/*]	[*]Opening Treasure chests[/*]	[*]Killing Siphoning Mages / Crystal Spiders[/*]	[*]Playing Hellgates / Crystal League[/*]	[*]Winning Corrupted Dungeon matches[/*]	[*]Capturing Territory Energy Crystals (see below)[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/defec3b9fc06fdf1286cb1d88c07d172d2eee797.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Favor[/h3][list]	[*]When a player earns Might, in most cases they will also earn [b]Favor[/b][/*]	[*]Favor is a [b]currency[/b] which can be used to purchase Siphoned Energy and additional reward chests[/*]	[*]Favor thus offers a [b]direct economic benefit[/b] to earning Might[/*][/list][h3]Guild Might Levels[/h3]
As players earn Might and Favor for themselves, they contribute to another new feature, [b]Guild Might Levels[/b]:
[list]	[*]Guilds earn Season Points for each Might Level they complete[/*]	[*]All members contribute to these together[/*]	[*]Each activity has its own Might progress, allowing players numerous ways to contribute while earning Might and Favor for themselves[/*][/list]
[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/543422fd66df70244fe57f72b3344ff244c18439.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d66d0ef12d8fa7e1c7cfca0fd52225ebd9441f3e.jpeg[/img][/url]

Guild Might Levels in turn benefit guild members:
[list]	[*]With each new bracket unlocked, members are rewarded with a significant amount of [b]personal Might[/b][/*]	[*]Members also get a [b]bonus [/b]to Might generated for the rest of the season[/*]	[*]A new Season Overview allows players to see their guild’s current ranking, where its Season points came from, and which players contributed the most Might[/*][/list][h3]Energy Vortices[/h3][list]	[*]Like Open World Treasures, these spawn unpredictably in the Outlands[/*]	[*]Marked on the world and local map for everyone within a few regions[/*]	[*]After a time dependent on its strength, the storm dissipates, dropping a [b]Territory Energy Crystal[/b][/*]	[*]Crystals can be picked up and carried on foot to an owned territory[/*]	[*]Crystals transported successfully can be "captured" at the Tower[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/63a5a92eb9e90860b6a94940222dcda52cef40c6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Territory Energy Levels[/h3]
[b]Captured Crystals[/b] boost the Territory's energy, which:
[list]	[*]Increases its Tower level[/*]	[*]Improves the rate at which Siphoned Energy and Season Points are generated[/*]	[*]Boosts guard strength[/*]	[*]Boosts enchanted resource spawn rate / gathering yield in the zone[/*][/list]Over time, Territory energy diminishes, so guilds must remain active to get maximum Territory benefits. [b]Crystal League Matches[/b] played from Territory towers continue to supplement energy as well.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ec893664b00fb6557de69c84e620371e83a4b3cf.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Territory Rebalancing[/h3]
To encourage active Outlands play, Territories now generate far fewer Season Points if they are low on energy, but have a much higher maximum potential if they stay at maximum level. Season success is thus less dependent on passive income, instead requiring guilds to remain active around their Territories. Of course, players participating in this are also rewarded with significant Might and Favor themselves.
[h3]In Summary[/h3]
The [b]Conqueror’s Challenge, Might Levels[/b] and [b]Energy Vortices[/b] allow players to push their guild towards victory with smaller-scale activities, while earning rewards for themselves and enjoying new [b]open-world PvP objectives[/b].

Stay tuned for the next Dev Talks, where we'll discuss Headquarters Hideouts, Power Cores, War Gloves and more!

notes.title: Lands Awakened Arrives November 24
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/609572c88c45d10ef11f0069d8fd8cab05ad9416.jpeg[/img]

On November 24, the [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update goes live. This update brings a new era of [b]open-world gameplay[/b] to Albion with reworked [b]dungeons, mobs[/b] and [b]treasure sites[/b], new open-world [b]PvP objectives[/b] for groups of all sizes, massively improved [b]visuals and layouts[/b] for all five biomes, the new [b]War Gloves weapon line[/b], fully reworked [b]Guild Seasons[/b], numerous [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b], and much more.

Check out the teaser trailer here:
[previewyoutube=yD0hqXXqrKM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Albion Awakens[/h3]
From reworked [b]static dungeons [/b]with limited-time events and multi-zone exits, to mobs that increase in [b]power and value [/b]over time, Lands Awakened brings a completely overhauled open-world experience. All five biomes have [b]massively improved visuals [/b]and [b]layouts[/b], dynamically spawning [b]treasure sites [/b]offer intrepid players a chance at lucrative rewards, and an expanded [b]soundtrack[/b] brings new emotional depth to the world. On the combat side, [b]War Gloves[/b], Albion's first completely new weapon line since launch, offer brawler-style combat options, while [b]Elite Levels[/b] offer advanced mastery options and the overall speed of [b]Fame progress[/b] has been boosted significantly.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bda0aec195dfd1d9d5260a4b3b69f5a8aaa1c57e.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Guild Warfare Re-Envisioned[/h3]
[b]Power Cores[/b] and [b]Energy Crystals[/b] encourage strategic capture-the-flag gameplay with huge rewards, while [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b] offer protected bases for dedicated guilds. Guild Seasons have been completely reworked, with the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b] giving individual guild members the ability to contribute to seasonal progress while earning their own rewards. And the new [b]Might[/b] and [b]Favor[/b] systems give guilds of all sizes, as well as their individual members, countless new ways to earn Season Points and unlock rewards.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cdfcd746022e136a48ded86109ee981531a78318.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
Player-created [b]Loadouts[/b] can now be purchased directly from the Marketplace, while [b]Farming optimizations [/b]let players tend crops and animals with fewer clicks. [b]Rerolling items[/b] is newly streamlined, [b]crafting and refining fees[/b] are clearer, and new [b]party commands[/b] offer faster and easier party management. Alongside these changes, a host of additional improvements, fixes, balance changes, and optimizations make the world of Albion better than ever.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9ec807242c75baf90fde30e742da54930bb77346.jpeg[/img]

For more of what's coming, check out the [b]official update page[/b]:

[h3][url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened]LEARN MORE[/url][/h3]

notes.title: The Grim Challenge is Back
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/ec1560b9441b828936377c59c79adf7e38cc0ecf.jpeg[/img]

Allhallows is in full swing, and the [b]Grim Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of November, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get valuable loot, and claim your very own [b]Pest Lizard[/b].
[h3][b]Pestilential Prizes For Intrepid Adventurers[/b][/h3]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/37098394fc221f53b22942d5c2018a17b86b1dca.png[/img]
PEST LIZARD:[/b] This month's Challenge offers another chance to claim the popular [b]Pest Lizard[/b]. This sleek, slithery mount comes with a [b]Toxic Cloud [/b]ability that causes enemies who touch it to become temporarily disoriented.
 

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/fd248429c8bb16fadb892cc6075439f63762bd27.png[/img]
AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Grim Challenge avatar ring[/b], featuring a spooky skull-topped iron frame. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Expanded Soundtrack and Combat Audio
notes.content:
With the [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update coming in November, players can look forward to a revamped soundtrack as they explore Albion. Senior Audio Designer Marie Havemann gives a glimpse behind the scenes of its production in our latest [b]Dev Talk[/b], introducing new music for [b]combat, cities, Hideouts[/b] and more.

[previewyoutube=b5-pO8jZ18E;leftthumb]<iframe allowfullscreen="" frameborder="0" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/b5-pO8jZ18E" width="640"></iframe>[/previewyoutube]










Prefer a written summary? Then read on...

It’s already been five years since the original soundtrack for Albion Online was composed, and since then a good deal of new features have been introduced. To enhance the [b]sonic richness[/b] and [b]emotional impact[/b] of playing Albion, new music has been recorded with Prague's FILMharmonic Orchestra. This was composed over the last year by Marie along with Albion’s original composer Jonne Valtonen, and includes new music for:
[list]	[*]Combat and Bosses[/*]	[*]Cities and Starter Towns[/*]	[*]Hideouts[/*]	[*]Tutorial[/*]	[*]Destiny Board[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6bc0c18ca3f09f3888a0b6ec31a34ced455784cc.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat[/h3][list]	[*]A percussive soundtrack seamlessly [b]adapts to changes in threat level[/b][/*]	[*]Features in both [b]PvP and PvE[/b] and is adapted to different combat scenarios:	[list]		[*][b]Hellgates and dungeons[/b] include varied music "layers" based on the scenario[/*]		[*]Three different [b]boss themes[/b], depending on mob type and threat level[/*]		[*]These convey a sense of [b]danger and urgency[/b], while emphasizing the player’s own agency and a sense of fun[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/03b6886ba4d3f4eb0e8a0c774e9097b2fdbbd765.jpeg[/img]
[h3]City Themes[/h3]
In line with the stronger sense of [b]regional identity[/b] within Albion that the Lands Awakened update brings, each city will have its own theme that reflects the character of the different factions:
[list]	[*][b]Lymhurst[/b] retains its existing city theme, with its proud and playful character[/*]	[*]The down-to-earth, easy-going inhabitants of [b]Martlock[/b] have an upbeat theme, reminiscent of a beery celebration after a combat victory[/*]	[*]The music of [b]Bridgewatch[/b] reflects its dignity and elegance as well as the energy of a bustling trading city[/*]	[*]The magic and mystery of the swamps come through in [b]Thetford[/b]’s theme, which emphasizes its people’s wisdom, knowledge and connection to nature[/*]	[*]Deep in the cold, hostile mountains, the people of [b]Fort Sterling[/b] are sober, hardy warriors, whose pride in their strength is conveyed through its theme[/*]	[*][b]Caerleon[/b], the city of outlaws, musically expresses its identity as a devious, dangerous place, yet also with a sense of adventure[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2039f874f00124a9f9ff478a07dea52ae17eeb3b.jpeg[/img]

The [b]starter towns[/b] of Albion also have a new theme to convey their liveliness and the sense of adventure at the beginning of a journey.
[h3]Hideout Themes[/h3]
For the first time, [b]Hideouts[/b] have their own musical identity, befitting their status as a player’s home within the black zones.
[list]	[*]Simple, memorable melodies reinforce the “do-it-yourself” feeling of Hideouts[/*]	[*]The theme [b]develops as a Hideout grows[/b], reflecting its progression:	[list]		[*]Starts low-key and calm, with a sense of precarious beginnings[/*]		[*]Upgraded Hideouts gain a more orchestral theme reminiscent of a busy tavern[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/41e67da79c9ca9e0c06afc72e74bde5675bfc42a.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Soundtrack Changes[/h3][list]	[*]New [b]tutorial music[/b] which highlights the excitement of first arriving in Albion[/*]	[*]A new [b]Destiny Board theme[/b], reinforcing the mystical, fateful feeling of looking over one’s own journey[/*][/list]This new soundtrack will really enhance the emotional experience of fighting, trading and venturing within the world of Albion Online. Stay tuned for more Dev Talks coming soon, where we’ll look at upcoming changes to [b]Guild Seasons, HQ Hideouts[/b], and more. See you then!

notes.title: Allhallows Descends upon Albion
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea1105cb8228b8af7d800c70fc03048f32b2119e.jpeg[/img]

The nights are drawing in, there’s a chill in the air… yes,[b] Allhallows [/b]has returned to Albion! From [b]10:00 UTC on October 27[/b] through to [b]10:00 UTC on November 10[/b] you can run the [b]Hallowed Ground[/b] dungeon by entering one of the special portals that appear randomly in T4-T8 zones across the open world. Once inside you’ll find creepy corridors filled with pumpkins, gruesome mobs, and the strange, terrifying final boss known simply as [b]Bob.[/b]

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f97ab7ee8b6ab81ab4265aac225b84a92fb8b38c.png[/img][/b]

Both group and solo versions of the dungeons will appear, and each offer rare seasonal loot like the [b]Jack o' Donkey[/b] and [b]Horse Macabre [/b]mount skins. And as always, [b]Halloween decorations[/b] will adorn each of Albion’s cities to mark this eerie time.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b519c5c88c662c461251dab7ebb3c2b5bfb81b19.png[/img]

So don your dungeon-delving kit, venture out into the dark night and rid Albion of these malevolent spirits!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Open-World Gameplay
notes.content:
In our last [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-open-world-rework][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url], Game Director Robin Henkys introduced the visual and level design improvements coming with the [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update in November. In this newest video, he introduces open-world gameplay changes including mobs that [b]level up over time[/b], updated [b]Static Dungeons[/b], and fully reworked [b]treasure sites[/b].

[previewyoutube=b8Zdy9AFSic;leftthumb]<iframe allowfullscreen="" frameborder="0" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/bIwDCVSXNCQ" width="640"></iframe>[/previewyoutube]










No time to watch, or prefer a summary? Read on...
[h3]Challenges and Goals[/h3][list]	[*][b]Challenges:[/b]	[list]		[*]Offering valuable rewards that aren't [b]static or predictable[/b][/*]		[*]Avoiding [b]monopolization[/b] by powerful groups[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Goals: [/b]	[list]		[*][b]Dynamic, unpredictable rewards[/b] available to anyone in the right place at the right time[/*]		[*]Exciting gameplay opportunities for [b]all player types and group sizes[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a1beb4113d9b9ca55690c3cb45dadfe3b123b690.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]Open-World Mob Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Overhauled visuals, balancing, abilities, and rewards[/*]	[*]Mobs now [b]level up over time[/b]:	[list]		[*]"Recruits" spawn first[/*]		[*]Over time these upgrade to regular or Champion mobs[/*]		[*]If these remain unkilled, whole areas fill with them, offering massive rewards[/*]		[*]Rewards [b]exploration [/b][/*]		[*]Allows players to choose [b]worthwhile areas[/b][/*]		[*]Encourages players to stray further from [b]cities[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Additional new map view mode showing [b]approximate mob value[/b] of regions[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/297d05fc8861bd4ed0a54ba9125a76c40ee90615.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Static Dungeon Updates[/h3]
Mob upgrading system also applies to [b]Static Open-World Dungeons[/b]:
[list]	[*]Encourages dungeon exploration beyond the entrance areas[/*]	[*][b]Entrances in neighboring regions[/b] added to make dungeons interesting hotspots:	[list]		[*]Ensures players can’t camp one entrance[/*]		[*]Can be used as emergency exits to escape powerful groups[/*]		[*]Ensure that players can enter from all sides during “Dungeon Rush” Events[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Dungeon Rush:	[list]		[*]Limited warning; randomized start times; last for short periods[/*]		[*]Mobs and treasure chests upgrade more quickly, offering huge rewards[/*]		[*]Attracts other players, leading to showdowns[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/33b8d4e86f6805b63ef599611ab45b8e29be22cf.jpeg[/img]

The reworked open-world dungeons offer plenty of opportunities for different player types: [b]PvE players[/b] can explore them outside event times, while [b]PvP players[/b] can rush in during events.
[h3]Reworked Treasure Sites[/h3]
[b]Current system:[/b]
[list]	[*]Fixed locations[/*]	[*]Open at preset intervals[/*]	[*]Many players avoid for fear of encountering well-prepared groups[/*]	[*]Outdated rewards[/*][/list][b]New system:[/b]
[list]	[*]Treasures now appear [b]anywhere in the open world[/b][/*]	[*]Give only [b]limited warning[/b] before opening[/*]	[*]Only visible to [b]nearby players[/b][/*]	[*]Unlock time and visibility distance based on [b]value[/b][/*]	[*]Offer opportunities for various [b]player types and group sizes[/b][/*]	[*]Spawn [b]much more frequently[/b] than current treasures[/*]	[*]Treasures now use the [b]rarity randomization system[/b], resulting in rare and legendary treasures[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a5cc00a6d9ccb707dcabcce0076786fd4dc9a5f1.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Resource Treasures[/h3]
Treasure system now spawns resources as well:
[list]	[*]Fully charged [b]resource nodes[/b] are marked on the region map for local players[/*]	[*]Type and tier of resources depends on region, but will always be [b]valuable[/b] and often [b]enchanted[/b][/*]	[*]Additionally, for gatherers who want to avoid other players, the world map now shows approximate available resources by [b]type and tier[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ff52e55a4411e4e3f8c443bca3292d2466bd0e80.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]More to Come[/h3]
As you can see, there are tons of new features and improvements coming to the open world with the next update, and many other features as well. Soon we'll discuss [b]new music[/b], major [b]Guild Season[/b] changes, [b]HQ Hideouts[/b] and more, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Biome Rework
notes.content:
The next major content update for Albion Online, [b]Lands Awakened[/b], will bring major changes, improvements, and new features to [b]open-world gameplay[/b] in Albion. In this video, Game Director Robin Henkys introduces the upcoming [b]visual and structural redesigns[/b] planned for Albion's five biomes and discusses how they will affect the overall gameplay experience.

[previewyoutube=qJmgpvSdIjc;leftthumb]<iframe allowfullscreen="" frameborder="0" height="360" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/qJmgpvSdIjc?rel=0" width="640"></iframe>[/previewyoutube]










Prefer a written summary? Then read on...

[h3]Re-Envisioning Albion's Open World[/h3]
The [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update is scheduled to release in the second half of November, after the current [b]Energy Surge Season[/b]. Goals:
[list]	[*]Bring [b]open-world gameplay[/b] back to Albion Online[/*]	[*]Get players back out into the world with greatly improved [b]Fame and treasure rewards[/b][/*]	[*]Offer [b]varied and exciting PvE[/b][/*]	[*]Provide numerous opportunities for spontaneous, small- and mid-size [b]open-world PvP[/b][/*]	[*]Update and improve the look, feel, and layout of Albion's five [b]biomes[/b][/*][/list]This is a major undertaking, which involves revisiting all the content that makes up the world of Albion Online. For this Dev Talk, we're starting at the beginning: by looking at how the [b]visuals and layout[/b] of the open world will be updated and improved.

[h3]Wide-Ranging Biome Improvements[/h3]
The Lands Awakened update will bring huge visual improvements to Albion's biomes. All 15 [b]sub-biome graphics sets[/b] (3 for each of the 5 biomes) will be reworked with the following goals:
[list]	[*]Increasing [b]visual diversity[/b] in Albion’s game world[/*]	[*]Making each biome and sub-biome more [b]unique[/b][/*]	[*]Increasing the enjoyment of [b]travelling [/b]through the world of Albion Online[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c40433e780b49fa1a9dc53dd4e7b46cdff4648fc.jpeg[/img]

Each of the five biomes has a basic theme which increases in [b]intensity and menace[/b] in higher-tier zones:

[b]Forest[/b]
[list]	[*]Low-tier: Fresh, lush, welcoming[/*]	[*]Mid-tier: More focus on trees, environment is wilder and more overgrown[/*]	[*]High-tier: Mystical and magical, ethereal white-barked trees providing the most valuable resources[/*][/list][b]Swamp[/b]
[list]	[*]Low-tier: Mild wetlands, flooded meadows[/*]	[*]Mid-tier: Denser fog, larger puddles[/*]	[*]High-tier: Deeply flooded, bright colors among the mud and fog[/*][/list][b]Steppe[/b]
[list]	[*]Low-tier: Soft savannah, warm, green grass[/*]	[*]Mid-tier: Harsher sunlight, golden grass[/*]	[*]High-tier: Extreme heat, dead grass, red sand and white bones[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d4f9c5c9c967f45e78a304aee05f546d58348980.jpeg[/img]

[b]Mountain[/b]
[list]	[*]Low-tier: Sunnier, still some greenery[/*]	[*]Mid-tier: Colder, less green, more shadow[/*]	[*]High-tier: Extreme cold, deep blue-hued ice and snow[/*][/list][b]Highlands[/b]
[list]	[*]Low-tier: Gentle hills, green grass, flowers[/*]	[*]Mid-tier: Color shift to cooler rocks and more vivid meadows[/*]	[*]High-tier: Mythical, ancient, high-altitude feel[/*][/list]
[h3]Updating Layouts[/h3]
The maps introduced during the beta phase have worked fine, but often felt too cluttered or generic. To address this, we've challenged ourselves to completely rework all the [b]open-world layouts[/b] of Albion Online, with the following two goals:
[list]	[*]Make [b]navigation through the world[/b] more intuitive and enjoyable[/*]	[*]Allow players with different playstyles to [b]use map layouts[/b] to their advantage[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/92e322ff2e63ebffb681dd8e123acaecfc7c0170.jpeg[/img]

More specifically, these goals will be implemented in the following ways:
[list]	[*]Improving clarity of maps, reducing random cluttering elements, finding memorable themes for maps that are easy to remember and quick to read[/*]	[*]Adding strategic choke points via new terrain designs that feel natural within each biome:[/*][/list][list]	[*][b]Mountain:[/b] sheer cliffs with crevasses and waterfalls[/*]	[*][b]Swamps:[/b] flat, cut by rivers of varying depths[/*]	[*][b]Steppe:[/b] broad plains with higher plateaus and lower ravines[/*]	[*][b]Highlands:[/b] gentle hills and harsher cliffs, broken up by larger rocks[/*]	[*][b]Forest:[/b] varied landscape with valleys, hills, and rivers, broken up by ancient trees and roots[/*][/list]
[h3]What about Hideouts?[/h3]
When the Lands Awakened update launches, Hideouts will be automatically placed as close as possible to their original location. Guilds will have the opportunity to move each Hideout once within the same zone for a short time after the update launch.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/74e220bdb57e5d70ab9b84014dff8ed58d9db6d4.jpeg[/img]

Tune in next time to find out about more exciting changes coming to Albion Online with the next update, including new music, major improvements to open-world rewards, and new features for open-world PvE and PvP.

Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Call to Arms Patch 11 is Here
notes.content:
Call to Arms Patch 11 is live! This patch brings substantial combat balance changes, improvements to the Black Zone map display and Faction Warfare UI, and more. Read on for details...

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/242d972fdb91518d8e10467f95fa0b3fe66c79c1.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
Combat balance changes are a major focus of this patch, with numerous weapon line updates. In particular, there’s an emphasis on diversifying the ZvZ meta, with improvements to long-overlooked weapons and adjustments to some already popular ones to keep group fights fair and exciting. Here are just some of the changes:
[list]	[*][b]Maces: [/b]To increase their tank potential, Maces have been reworked: Guard Rune makes allies immune to knockback or stun; Slow added to Sacred Ground; Battle Howl cooldown reduced[/*]	[*][b]Mounts: [/b]Tower Chariots reworked to increase their support appeal: Health Factor increased; standtime removed from Energy Cloud; Toxic Crystal Waste standtime decreased[/*]	[*][b]Staffs:[/b] Numerous updates to Arcane, Cursed, Fire, Holy and Nature Staffs[/*]	[*][b]Swords:[/b] Re-buffed Galatine Pair to increase its appeal for ZvZ; Crescent Slash multi-stack effects increased[/*]	[*][b]Hammers: [/b]Iron Breaker and Power Geyser rebalanced; Tackle stun duration reduced[/*]	[*][b]...and much more[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b30997d30af473a9c4cdcbb63a0bf64be9ef35b3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Black Zone Map Improvements[/h3]
Black Zone map headers now display the [b]Zone Quality Level[/b] when you hover over them. Since this determines the season point multipliers for Territories, Castles, Castle Outposts and mobs, as well as Energy Storage by territory, this change allows this important information to be easily obtained via the ingame UI.

[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/46432f49924ce8a9105701440194499392ad8392.png][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0c5adf984966ef6e11def3c602048ab6469e431a.jpeg[/img][/url]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]To better reflect the current state of play, [b]Faction Warfare Player Rankings[/b] have been adjusted to only show players who have been active within the previous week.[/*]	[*]The Season 13 Winner Statue for [b]Blue Army[/b] is now in Conquerors’ Hall, and Season Winner Furniture Items are now placeable.[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/93b0b4e2a682f52c44d51174815a8309d1912ab8.jpeg[/img]

As always, you can read the complete list of changes in the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%2011][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Harvest Challenge Returns
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/06a4dcc5d3f6aacfeed5797945b98b539aa30661.jpeg[/img]

Fall has come to the world of Albion... the shadows are growing longer... and the [b]Harvest Challenge[/b] is back! For the entire month of October, earn points for open-world activities, unlock chests to get spooky loot, and claim your very own [b]Spectral Bat[/b].
[h3][b]Reap What You Sow[/b][/h3]
[b][img]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/5a9e734d7a37c596bd8f341dbc3a91df18612d68.png[/img]
SPECTRAL BAT:[/b] This month's Challenge offers another chance to claim the amazing [b]Spectral Bat[/b]. In addition to its spooky appearance, this winged menace comes with a powerful [b]Flicker[/b] spell that allows you to jump to a target location in the blink of an eye. (Note: like all mounts, the Spectral Bat cannot fly over obstacles or gaps.)

[b][img]https://assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/my-context/media/19075c42b2f6083a97620356e3a682f66f0a4774.png[/img]
AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Harvest Challenge avatar ring[/b], featuring a pair of eerie, grinning skeletons. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.

[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2c7ba7c8b9fff4083306b993696b33ec95415878.png[/img]
SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly point totals to unlock [b]Harvest Challenge Chests[/b]. Along with valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes, Silver, resources, and other loot, you'll also have a chance to unlock six seasonal furniture items: the [b]Scary Pumpkin Lantern, Friendly Pumpkin Lantern, Halloween Lantern, Halloween Cauldron, Halloween Scarecrow,[/b] and [b]Halloween Pyre[/b].

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount and avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while they last!

notes.title: Season 13 and Crystal League Championship Winners Announced!
notes.content:
With the Coalition’s war against the Empire already well underway when Season 13 began, some wondered if declarations of [b]Blue Army’s[/b] victory were premature. Others, however, believed that the return of several veteran players all but ensured their triumph. And indeed, by the time the season ended [b]Blue Army[/b] had amassed more points than any guild had previously managed, surpassing one million season points while also earning second place for their secondary guild [b]Blue Army Freemen[/b]. At the end of the season the Coalition was defeated, with their forces disbanded, destroyed, or simply moved along. In the final days only Elevate and Guildzinha remained standing. While the rest of the Coalition folded, Yur Mum stayed to fight.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c7ddb0eb227a8b53246a0403034f4932dca94b7b.jpeg[/img]

Here are the season’s top ten teams:
1. [b]Blue Army[/b] - 1,142,391 points
2. [b]Blue Army Freemen[/b] - 751,245 points
3. [b]Reject Sanity[/b] - 579,181 points
4. [b]I DOOM I[/b] - 473,263 points
5. [b]Aesirs[/b] - 417,168 points
6. [b]SUN[/b] - 328,043 points
7. [b]Elevate[/b] - 273,952 points
8. [b]Iron Hand[/b] - 270,359 points
9. [b]GOSTOP[/b] - 266,870 points
10. [b]JUST4 FUN[/b] - 263,926 points

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/28be59488a58150562c803c0959d90fa12021ecb.jpeg[/img][h3]Season 13 Video Roundup[/h3]
In the 5v5 Crystal League, few teams are as respected and feared as Cargera’s - referred to as The Meta or The Final Boss - and it is rare to see them challenged. In this match, Rafikon’s team gives them as much as they can possibly handle in an absolute brawl:

[previewyoutube=Z1VjRU0wwOc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










In a season full of incredible fights between the forces of POE and Elevate, this battle may have been the best. POE has Elevate surrounded but Elevate have the high ground and control of two choke points:

[previewyoutube=CyxQaC6G63E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Every season new faces join the war, and in this interview Shozen talks to Monjp - GM of Rising King and shot caller for the SIX alliance:

[previewyoutube=r2gUUt_g5WE;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[h3]Naptime Takes the Crystal League Crown![/h3]
Season 13’s best 5v5 teams faced off over the weekend in the latest [b]Crystal League Championship, [/b]and the results are in. [b]Naptime [/b]has claimed the top prize!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/01eee2447c5fc3e980a90850bcc44fadef04b6db.jpeg[/img]

Participation in the Crystal League Championship is a mighty achievement in itself, of course, so big congratulations are also due to the 2nd-4th placed teams:
[list]	[*][b]2nd place: Wendy’s[/b][/*]	[*][b]3rd place: Purple Cobras[/b][/*]	[*][b]4th place: Gone Fishin’[/b][/*][/list]
Once again, massive congratulations to [b]Naptime[/b] and to everyone who took part in our showcase 5v5 event. Here are the weekend’s final brackets:

[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/20bb874eb78323721df822486f58d0fa737ff08a.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0c6bebda82dbe5ddb939e886864357c49bf6b92f.jpeg[/img][/url]

Check out the grand finals:

[previewyoutube=oliuRxCy2sA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Thanks to the whole AlbionTV crew of [b]Shozen, Lewpac, Tazzik, Bogul,[/b] and [b]Robinhoodrs[/b], as well as Community Manager [b]Nesnes[/b], for their great work and for keeping everything running smoothly. Check out the schedule in this [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/154573/][b]forum post[/b][/url] and get ready to earn your [url=https://albiononline.com/video/devtalk-war-gloves-hq-hideouts][b]HQ Hideout[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Call to Arms Patch 10 is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b600e134d677a8c7cea00e91848e05798b263ad8.jpeg[/img]

The [url=https://albiononline.com/news/energy-surge][b]Energy Surge Season[/b][/url] starts September 25, featuring a shorter 6-week structure, accelerated point multipliers, and unique one-of-a-kind rewards for the top guilds. In anticipation of this unique standalone season, today's patch brings changes to Guild and Faction Warfare, quality-of-life improvements including new Nametag options and better Usage Fee notifications, and new artifact drops in the open world.
[h3]New Artifacts Added[/h3]
As part of the brand-new [b]War Gloves[/b] weapon line coming with the next major content update, new artifacts have been added to mob and chest drops in the open world.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9c7357c4978fb08e9a5102e86242108125a97171.jpeg[/img]

These artifacts cannot yet be used for crafting, and only appear in limited quantities for now, but they already offer economic and PvE players a new item line to start collecting and trading.

For more on War Gloves and these new artifacts, watch the latest [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-war-gloves-hq-hideouts][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].
[h3]Guild and Faction Warfare Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Entering Hideouts now requires a channel for players who have not set the Hideout as Home[/*]	[*]Removed doors of Castle Outposts to make them easier to conquer by smaller groups, reduced warning messages when outposts are under attack[/*]	[*]Level 6 Crystal League Tokens (5v5 and 20v20) are now non-tradable[/*]	[*]Decreased penalties for enlisting with Factions with low recruitment rates, increased value of red zone Faction kills[/*]	[*]Increased values of areas previously owned by non-Caerleon Factions during Bandit Assault[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/817348698287c66736db119ef15733a27550e389.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Added option to display guild names of other players without displaying player names, and players flagged to the same Faction now appear as allies[/*]	[*]Added "Tomes" category and "Mount" subcategories to Marketplace[/*]	[*]Popup message now displays when the Usage Fee of a crafting station was recently changed[/*]	[*]When both players in a Corrupted Dungeon are knocked down, get-up time is greatly reduced[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1282f912f22332ac9db77cab28e5cc306ecd0c11.jpeg[/img]

On top of the changes listed above, there are also numerous [b]Combat Balance Changes[/b], [b]bugfixes[/b], and other improvements. As always, you can read the complete list of changes in the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%2010][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Energy Surge Season is Coming
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/599e830da9e5ef1cb10fc01160d557357baa640a.jpeg[/img]

The next Guild Season kicks off on September 25! (See the full schedule[b] [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/154573]here[/url][/b]). The standalone [b]Energy Surge Season[/b] will run for approximately 10 weeks, and will have a unique structure and unique rewards, which include the ability to designate an [b]HQ Hideout[/b] for guilds who earn enough Season Points, plus four different brand-new [b]avatars[/b], a one-of-a-kind [b]winner statue[/b] placed in the open world, and more. Read on for all the details!
[h3]Unlock Your HQ Hideout[/h3]
In our last [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-war-gloves-hq-hideouts][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url], Game Director Robin Henkys introduced [b]HQ Hideouts[/b], a new feature that allows guilds to designate a single Hideout as their primary headquarters. As these special Hideouts are highly resistant to attack, they offer smaller guilds a chance to gain a foothold in Albion's black zones for as long as they are properly maintained.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/67846e42922adf54c91299442fb7a1e9bfbf7c05.jpeg[/img]

While this feature is still in the development phase and many more details are forthcoming, the ability to claim HQ Hideouts with the next update will be based on [b]total Season Points earned during the Energy Surge season[/b]. The following Season Point thresholds apply for where HQ status can be assigned in [b]Season 14[/b]:
[list]	[*]Quality 6 zones (inner circle of Outlands): [b]200,000 Season Points[/b][/*]	[*]Q5 zones: [b]120,000 Season Points[/b][/*]	[*]Q4 zones: [b]80,000 Season Points[/b][/*]	[*]Q3 zones: [b]40,000 Season Points[/b][/*]	[*]Q2 zones: [b]20,000 Season Points[/b][/*]	[*]Q1 zones (outer ring of Outlands + all Roads of Avalon zones): [b]10,000 Season Points[/b][/*][/list]
Going forward, the ability to assign HQ status to a Hideout in a given zone will be dependent on points earned during the prior season. We'll have plenty more details on this feature in the coming weeks, but for now, you can prepare for the Energy Surge season by checking out the complete list of zone quality levels in this[b] [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/154797]updated forum post[/url][/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/657cfe6697cfbc182f378490b2ddf239751efbc4.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Bracket Rewards... and an Open-World Statue[/h3]
As always, members of guilds who reach a high enough rank during the season will receive special rewards. This season, these rewards will include the powerful [b]Tower Chariot[/b] battle mount for guilds who reach Silver Rank or higher, unique Crystal, Gold, Silver and Bronze [b]Energy Surge Season Avatars[/b] for all ranks Bronze and higher, and Tomes of Insight. Here's the full rewards list (click to expand):

[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/10d6774fd3c520ae7edebf843de1a0b010c65939.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e540f48b14d0018a5b3970be02fcb15f1e363a3e.jpeg[/img][/url]

Additionally, the top five guilds of the season will receive a 90-day [b]Fame Buff[/b] to gathering and PvE, and the top three guilds will each receive a season winner statue with [b]a permanent place in Albion's open world[/b]! Here's the detailed breakdown (click to expand):

[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e7f36c0274ee49cac642264d91a4e2d4c018d306.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3b866515282878e506e4e2c25275d69bcc9fcc7e.jpeg[/img][/url]

The first-place winners will be able to select the [b]design and placement of their statue [/b]in collaboration with our team after the season ends, while the second and third place winners will receive a standard statue with their guild logo, which can also be placed in the open world in collaboration with our team. Take advantage of this one-of-a-kind opportunity to make your guild a permanent part of Albion's landscape!

The new season starts September 25 – get ready to rack up Season Points and unlock these unique rewards!

notes.title: Dev Talk: War Gloves and HQ Hideouts
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/0ba95f1fa0db0dfd36d49f8daae4dfbe9376ecfb.jpg[/img]

Our newest Dev Talk is here, featuring Game Director Robin Henkys broadcasting from the brand-new [b]Albion Online video studio[/b]! This new home for Albion's video content will streamline our filming process, allowing us to bring you Dev Talks more frequently. It's been awhile since our last Roadmap Update, and now we can reveal further details of two major upcoming features: [b]War Gloves[/b] and [b]HQ Hideouts[/b].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zo3pJ-4u93A
Note that the above video includes [b]subtitles [/b]for all nine of our supported languages – and as always, if you prefer a written summary, read on!
[h3]New Weapon Line: War Gloves[/h3]
[b]War Gloves[/b] are an entirely new weapon line, featuring:
[list]	[*][b]Three new base weapons[/b][/*]	[*][b]Four Artifact weapons[/b][/*]	[*][b]Fifteen new abilities[/b][/*]	[*]Melee-focused [b]brawler[/b] gameplay style (damage, mobility, control) plus limited [b]ranged[/b] abilities[/*]	[*]Dedicated [b]Combat [/b]and [b]Crafting Masteries[/b] (Warrior line / Warrior's Forge)[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2052ceb242198c06dc3b44090890479fc87f59bf.jpeg[/img]

These weapons excel at engaging an enemy and then keeping them engaged, dealing damage at the same time.
[h3]War Glove Artifacts[/h3][list]	[*]Although War Gloves will only become craftable once the next major update is released, the [b]Artifacts[/b] for this weapon line will already be added to loot tables before the start of the next season[/*]	[*]This ensures their availability once the update releases, and gives PvE and market players a valuable new loot type to play with[/*]	[*]Drop rates will start low and be adjusted to the same level as other artifacts once the update is released[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3351c4b0ceefeefacbca1b41b59419d8baf21ad2.jpeg[/img]
[h3]HQ Hideouts[/h3]
Headquarters Hideouts, AKA [b]HQ Hideouts[/b], are still early in development, but we’re very excited about the changes they will bring. We believe Albion to be best and most exciting when many small groups are competing for power in the Outlands, but the current Hideout system is controlled by large powerful groups, forcing players to consolidate or pay tribute.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fd64498d910cbb75a5b17fbb8de1a24cf722d55a.jpeg[/img]

Features of HQ Hideouts:
[list]	[*]Allows guilds to place and protect a Hideout based[b] only on their own achievements[/b][/*]	[*]Guilds will earn the ability to make [b]one Hideout[/b] an HQ Hideout as a [b]season reward[/b][/*]	[*]HQ Hideouts are [b]invulnerable to all attacks[/b], even during battle times[/*][/list][h3]Hideout Power Cores[/h3]
Once created, the Headquarters status will need to be maintained. The upcoming open-world [b]Vortex Power System[/b] has been extended to include [b]Hideout Power Cores[/b], which are required to make sure an HQ Hideout stays invulnerable. The required level of power depends on the quality of the region, with Hideouts deeper in the Outlands requiring significantly more power. Attackers can take advantage of this by preventing Power Cores from reaching the HQ, causing it to lose invulnerability eventually.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/18c716f6709870333f76e6037ac23350e28c7d6e.jpeg[/img]

Other features of HQ Hideouts and general Hideout changes:
[list]	[*]To assist in their creation, guilds can earn the right to make a Hideout construction site invulnerable [b]once per season[/b][/*]	[*]Access to HQ Hideouts is [b]limited to guild members[/b][/*]	[*]General Hideout upkeep for non-HQ Hideouts will [b]increase[/b] based on the number of Hideouts already in a region, to strengthen smaller guilds in the Outlands[/*][/list][h3]When will these features arrive?[/h3]
HQ Hideouts require guilds to collect enough Season Points by the end of a Guild Season. Thus, the current season will be followed by a shortened season before the launch of the next update:
[list]	[*]Name: [b]“Energy Surge”[/b][/*]	[*]Increased [b]Season Point[/b] and [b]Siphoned Energy[/b] reward rates[/*]	[*]Duration: [b]6 weeks [/b](ends early November): [b][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/154573]https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/154573[/url][/b][/*][/list]
This gives us sufficient time to finish these new features while giving guilds the opportunity to earn their right to an HQ Hideout.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/599e830da9e5ef1cb10fc01160d557357baa640a.jpeg[/img]

Stay tuned for more Dev Talks coming soon – thanks for watching!

[h3][b]Mighty Mules and Heretic Decor[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hd6P24z.png[/img][b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Heretic Challenge avatar ring[/b]. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this crazed, ramshackle avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Adventurer's Token.

As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. [img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d83bf046c0279d2ecc98aa9e2f8ace278a723242.png[/img]
[b]DIVINE OWL:[/b] This month's Challenge brings back the [b]Divine Owl[/b], a ghostly white flying mount with a brisk base move speed. This mount has a special ability, [b]Foresight[/b], which creates a shield that gives a temporary speed boost when broken. (Note: like all mounts, the Divine Owl can only move in navigable ground areas and cannot fly over obstacles.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4RhCStZ.png[/img]
[b]AVATAR RING:[/b] Adventurers who rack up enough total Challenge Points will also earn the [b]Divine Challenge avatar ring[/b], which will frame your chosen avatar in a heavenly golden aura. This non-tradable item permanently unlocks this avatar border for one character, or can be traded to the Vanity Merchant for one Vanity Token.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5e8qvan.png[/img]
[b]SEASONAL SPECIALS:[/b] All month long, reach weekly goals to unlock [b]Divine Challenge chests[/b]. In addition to valuable rewards like Adventurer's Tomes and Silver, you'll also have a chance to unlock mystical furniture items like the [b]Mage Statue, Magic Rune Circle[/b], and [b]Glass Sphere[/b].
 
As always, you can earn Challenge Points by [b]gathering, fishing, farming, and killing monsters[/b]. Points count simultaneously toward a daily bonus, a weekly unlockable chest, and the monthly mount / avatar ring reward. So log in, head out into the open world, gather points, and claim these rewards while you can!

notes.title: The Season 13 Balance Patch is Here
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/78a52766bb7618b5aae346c02f6ec4da3a6c2d6b.jpeg[/img]

Call to Arms Patch 9, AKA the [b]Season 13 Balance Patch[/b], is now live! This patch brings updates to Corrupted Dungeons as well as combat balance changes and quality-of-life improvements galore. Read on for more...
[h3]Corrupted Dungeon Changes[/h3]
To keep combat between different playstyles fair while discouraging endless cooldown resets, several changes have been made to Corrupted Dungeons:
[list]	[*]The new [b]Corrupted Mephit[/b] mob now appears after a set amount of time and debuffs the first player passing it, allowing some time to adjust tactics while discouraging constant disengages[/*]	[*][b]Shrine [/b]must be activated within 45 seconds[/*]	[*][b]Healing Cast[/b] reduced by a further 10%[/*]	[*]All [b]cooldowns [/b]reset at invasion start[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fcc72c82b96e35b64638626f2421961e1488b758.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
This patch includes changes to numerous weapon and armor lines, which are intended to bring some lesser-used items and abilities back into the spotlight and keep combat exciting and fair across a diverse array of builds. Here are just a few of the changes:
[list]	[*][b]Axes[/b]: Bloody Reap reworked into AoE execution tool; Rending Rage and Adrenaline Boost buffed[/*]	[*][b]Daggers[/b]: Deadly Swipe now consumes more energy when used purely for mobility, but is more energy efficient in fights[/*]	[*][b]Fire Staffs[/b]: New Q-ability, [b]Searing Flame[/b], added: shots deal moderate damage, fourth successful shot becomes [b]Furious Flame[/b] for greater damage[/*]	[*][b]Swords[/b]: Mobility increase returned to Heroic Charge, various E-ability cooldowns reduced, Hamstring reworked, new [b]Crescent Slash[/b] ability for Clarent Blade[/*]	[*][b]Armors[/b]: Energy Drain (Royal Armor) no longer steals enemy energy, renamed [b]Energy Source[/b][/*]	[*][b]Shoes[/b]: Royal March improved, effective uptime of Battle Frenzy and Premonition increased[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/817348698287c66736db119ef15733a27550e389.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Hideout, Zone Skipping, and Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][list]	[*][b]Reduced recovery time[/b] of items from destroyed Hideouts, [b]halved[/b] recovery fee[/*]	[*]Overall [b]zone skipping wait times[/b] reduced, as well as the [b]personal [/b]zone skip cooldown[/*]	[*][b]Marketplace notifications[/b] improved with clearer information about orders[/*]	[*]Four new [b]ability icons[/b] added[/*]	[*][b]Guild Season Winner popup[/b] now only shows for 3 days after season end[/*][/list]
As always, you can read the complete list of changes in the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%209][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Fourth Anniversary Events and Fame Boost
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/76aa59bc849dc52792b7724a559fe258665337d4.jpeg[/img]

It's been four years since Albion Online's official launch... and while anniversaries are a great time to [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-turns-four][b]take a look back[/b][/url] at what happened over the past year, they're also cause for celebration! Log in now and enjoy a [b]nine-day Fame Boost[/b], free fireworks, and the return of a [b]classic dungeon[/b] from Albion's beta.
[h3]The Mists of Albion Are Back[/h3]
What better way to celebrate another year in the world of Albion than a Fame Boost? Between now and maintenance on July 26, get [b]25% additional Fame[/b] for all ingame activities.
[list]	[*]At the end of maintenance on [b]Saturday, July 17[/b], the [b]Mists of Albion[/b] buff will be automatically enabled for all players[/*]	[*]This buff automatically grants [b]an additional 25% Fame[/b] for all activities[/*]	[*]The buff does not apply to Fame earned via PvP kills and Tomes of Insight, and does not boost the rate at which Challenge Points are earned[/*]	[*]The Fame boost ends at [b]10:00 UTC[/b] on [b]Monday, July 26[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/522376b59d328966eb3fa7eb843c21b87e0a0943.jpeg[/img]

Take advantage of this nine-day Fame Boost to level up your combat, crafting, and gathering!
[h3]A Classic Returns[/h3]
From now until July 31, you'll have a chance to revisit the [b]Defenders of the Past[/b] dungeon, a classic Keeper dungeon from Albion's beta. This dungeon keeps its classic terrain and enemy layout, updated with current shrines, loot, and rewards. In addition, those who complete this dungeon will have a chance to score the brand-new [b]Blue Anniversary Banner[/b].
[list]	[*]Defenders of the Past will [b]spawn randomly in T4-8 zones[/b] in both the Royal Continent and the Outlands (not in Roads of Avalon)[/*]	[*]The dungeon will spawn in both [b]solo[/b] and [b]group[/b] versions, with enemies and loot balanced accordingly[/*]	[*]The dungeon entrance will appear as a [b]portal flanked by Anniversary Banners[/b][/*]	[*]The final boss chest will give a chance to receive the [b]Blue Anniversary Banner[/b] along with other loot[/*][/list]
This limited-time dungeon will only be playable until [b]July 31 at 10:00 UTC[/b], so head out into the open world and revisit a unique piece of Albion's past!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/71884240bac66f8cc3bbf283b249d28b1dfbed39.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Celebrate in Style[/h3]
Albion's cities have been decked out with special anniversary decorations – and to help celebrate, we've sent [b]Anniversary Fireworks[/b] to all players. Just log in between now and [b]July 31 at 10:00 UTC[/b] to receive an in-game mail with your rewards. (Note: the mail will only be sent to characters created before July 17.)

Remember, the Fame Boost ends on [b]July 26[/b] and the classic dungeon and free fireworks end on [b]July 31[/b], so log in today and join the celebration!

notes.title: Albion Online Celebrates Four Years
notes.content:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/19211cd03f4e877e358eaa7c179a37026d7eab44.jpeg[/img]

Four incredible years have passed since Albion Online's official launch on [b]July 17, 2017.[/b] Since then, the game and community have grown in ways that we never could have imagined. To celebrate this momentous occasion, we've got some special ingame events including a [b]Fame Boost[/b] and a limited-time [b]classic Keeper dungeon[/b] - check out [url=https://albiononline.com/news/fourth-anniversary-events][b]this article[/b][/url] for all the details.

Join us as we look back at the major happenings of the past year – Albion's biggest and most successful yet!
[h3]Rise of Avalon[/h3]
On August 12, 2020, the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/rise-of-avalon][b]Rise of Avalon[/b][/url] update went live. This update brought two massive new features to the world of Albion, the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b] and [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b], as well as new Avalonian Weapons and numerous other changes and quality-of-life improvements.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=psUwESfA6yc
The Roads of Avalon and Corrupted Dungeons received further content with the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/brimstone-and-mist-is-here][b]Brimstone and Mist Midseason Update[/b][/url]. This mini-update brought new enemies and traps to Corrupted Dungeons, increased fishing opportunities and new fish in the Roads of Avalon, new recipes, crafting and butchery improvements, and much more.
[h3]The Crystal League Championship and New Guild Content[/h3]
Albion's first-ever [url=https://albiononline.com/news/offseason-crystal-tournament-starts-saturday][b]Crystal League Championship[/b][/url] (which at the time was called the "Offseason Crystal Tournament") took place August 22-23, 2020. Taking place between Albion's Guild Seasons, this championship pits Albion's top 5v5 teams against each other in the Crystal Realm, with massive rewards going to the winners.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/88bc45edccf4e69b14bc4b25e2b5431335882202.png[/img]

The final match came down to the last few seconds, where [b]June Esports[/b], after mounting an incredible comeback from a 17-70 deficit, pulled out an amazing win:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MJ81SchJaaU
Alongside the Crystal League Championship, guild warfare in Albion received numerous updates and improvements over the past year, as well as a unique battle mount for each season:
[list]	[*][url=https://albiononline.com/news/albions-tenth-guild-season-starts-saturday][b]Season 10[/b][/url]	[list]		[*]Avalonian Weapons, Hideouts in the Roads of Avalon[/*]		[*]Season Mount: [b]Goliath Horseeater[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/rise-of-avalon-patch-10-is-here][b]Season 11[/b][/url]	[list]		[*]20v20 Crystal League, PvE Fame buffs for world bosses, unified castle timers[/*]		[*]Season Mount: [b]Roving Bastion[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-12-brings-incredible-new-rewards][b]Season 12[/b][/url]	[list]		[*]Rebalanced Season Points[/*]		[*]Season Mount: [b]Juggernaut[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-13-starts-saturday][b]Season 13[/b][/url]	[list]		[*]Resource and Transmutation Changes[/*]		[*]Season Mount: [b]Phalanx Beetle[/b][/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
There was plenty of non-guild-related Seasonal Content throughout the year as well, including the monthly [b]Adventurer's Challenge[/b], bi-monthly [b]Referral Seasons[/b], and holiday events for [b]Halloween, Christmas, [/b]and [b]Easter[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/657cfe6697cfbc182f378490b2ddf239751efbc4.jpeg[/img]
[h3]An Ever-Growing Community[/h3]
In September 2020, Albion's population reached a new record of [url=https://albiononline.com/news/population-update-september-2020][b]125,000 Daily Average Users[/b][/url], buoyed by both the Rise of Avalon update and the introduction of two new ingame languages: [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]Korean[/b]. The trend continued throughout 2020 and into 2021, with a new peak of [url=https://albiononline.com/news/population-update-spring-2021][b]140,000 players[/b][/url] in March, and has continued since then, with player numbers exploding in recent months to nearly double the previous record (read on for more about that!).
[h3]Call to Arms[/h3]
On March 17, 2021, the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/call-to-arms][b]Call to Arms[/b][/url] update went live, bringing a complete ground-up rework of [b]Faction Warfare[/b]. [b]Caerleon[/b] joined the fight as a sixth playable Faction with its own unique rules and playstyle, and valuable rewards including [b]Elite Faction Mounts[/b] became available to those who pledged their loyalty to a single city.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=54OBbmUfBP4
Call to Arms also brought major changes to [b]Hellgates[/b], with 10 all-new maps featuring diverse enemies and layouts, an updated open-world spawn system, and all new [b]10v10 Hellgates[/b] for spontaneous midsize PvP. The update was rounded out with major quality-of-life improvements, particularly [b]Loadouts[/b], which allowed players to quickly regear based on easily adjustable presets.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dcd0097aef7fb34ddbd4160f0ae1ee2d5054aea6.png[/img]
[h3]A Promise Fulfilled: Albion Goes Mobile[/h3]
On June 9, 2021, Albion Online reached the final major milestone in its quest to become a truly cross-platform Sandbox MMORPG: the [b]official mobile launch[/b]. As a core goal since the earliest days of development nearly a decade ago, the worldwide launch on the [b]Apple App Store[/b] and [b]Google Play Store[/b] was the next massive step in opening up the world of Albion to countless new players, as well as allowing longtime players to play Albion Online whenever and wherever they wanted.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7MEvv81i3ek
The worldwide launch, coupled with an exclusive [b]cross-play reward[/b] for playing on both desktop and mobile, brought unprecedented player numbers to the game. In the week following the launch, Albion shattered its all-time record with an incredible [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-onlines-popularity-record-level][b]270,000 daily active players[/b][/url], nearly doubling the previous record.
[h3]Looking to the Future[/h3]
With the mobile launch complete, it was time to look to the future. In late June, Game Director Robin Henkys released a Dev Talk summing up the launch and discussing the big changes and improvements coming to the game with the next major update (watch until the end for a quick teaser of further changes as well):

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VcJcUMVVZyw
The energy and dedication of the Albion community continues to be an inspiration to us as we work toward making the world of Albion better and better. So as we celebrate another incredible year of Albion Online, we want to give our most heartfelt thanks to you, the Albion Online community, for your support. We can't wait to see how the game and its community reach new levels over the coming year (and beyond), and we hope you're as excited as we are for Albion's future.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72140ef436e0121f99bda78720a02f3b99f8c9ce.jpeg[/img]

notes.title: Call to Arms Patch 8 is Here
notes.content:
Call to Arms Patch 8 is here, bringing a range of improvements and fixes. First up, though, there's a new face in Conquerors' Hall...

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d9da74d35a30282a6bcd59353d7a2f1908057ec9.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Winner Statue: SUN[/h3]
Congratulations to [b]SUN[/b], winners of Guild Season 12! Check out their brand-new statue at the entrance to Conquerors' Hall in the Royal Cities. The statue also includes guild logos of the second and third place winners, [b]MudHouse[/b] and [b]MAHARLIKA[/b]. While you're there, be sure to pay your respects to past winners on multiple floors, and click on their statues to read their stories.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b83e0f7fec9626e7f6713f3e9f946aebfd955787.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Lethal Hellgate Rewards Increased[/h3]
The Call to Arms update brought new depth and complexity to PvE in Hellgates. To make the PvE experience in higher-risk [b]Lethal Hellgates[/b] more worthwhile, the overall value of chest loot in these Hellgates has been boosted: 
[list]	[*]2v2: +10%[/*]	[*]5v5: +20%[/*]	[*]10v10: +30%[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3bcb3c0d6f4d2ca27e77ed7265b956f8c9fdf39f.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Condensed Marketplace Notifications[/h3]
To reduce the number of Marketplace notifications and make them more meaningful, notifications are now only sent when a Buy or Sell Order is [b]completely fulfilled[/b] or [b]expires[/b]. These mails contain a summary of all relevant transactions in one easily-readable message, letting you check the status of orders on the go without excessive clicks.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fa7ed396ea3e74ad56f376919f29f37e7e86bc90.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Fixes[/h3][list]	[*]Balance changes to Axes and Maces[/*]	[*]Faction Warfare: improved feedback when capturing Outposts, and Outposts no longer claimable while mounted[/*]	[*]Corrupted Dungeon tutorial popup no longer appears each time a new dungeon is entered[/*]	[*]Various localization, animation, and terrain fixes[/*][/list]
For a complete list of changes, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%208][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Roadmap Update and Mobile Launch Recap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/3c740e523824d650203a8cb5ec19ffbe98683f7b.jpg[/img]

It's been an exciting few weeks for Albion Online: after years of anticipation, the game has officially launched worldwide on the [b]App and Play Stores[/b]. In our newest Dev Talk, Game Director Robin Henkys takes a look back at the mobile launch and gives a preview of some of the big changes coming to Albion with the next major [b]content update[/b].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VcJcUMVVZyw
Prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]Fulfilling the Cross-Play Promise: Albion Goes Mobile[/h3]
Albion Online's mobile version [b]officially launched June 9[/b], bringing hundreds of thousands of new players to the game. Albion's player population [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-onlines-popularity-record-level][b]shattered its previous record[/b][/url] this month, and tens of thousands of new players continue to discover the game daily. For those who have not yet tried the mobile version, the [b]Chimera Mount Skin Cross-Play Reward[/b] remains available for logging into desktop and mobile with the same account.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dcd0097aef7fb34ddbd4160f0ae1ee2d5054aea6.png[/img]
[list]	[*]For more information about the launch and rewards, and to watch the new live-action trailer, [url=https://albiononline.com/news/mobile-version-out-now][b]click here[/b][/url][/*]	[*]For device requirements and store links, [url=https://albiononline.com/download][b]click here[/b][/url][/*]	[*]Read answers to [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/150321][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/url] about the mobile version[/*][/list]
[b]Guild Season 13[/b] is also now underway, bringing various balance changes and improvements and giving veteran players the chance to show the newcomers how it's done.
[h3]Roadmap: The Next Content Update[/h3]
The next major content update for 2021 has the major overarching theme of bringing [b]open-world gameplay[/b] back to Albion. Note that all features discussed here are still in development, and may change greatly over the coming months.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/045c474d41c6cd5e591882fc48d2d81e9271c626.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Updating Albion's Look and Feel[/h3][list]	[*][b]Biome appearance upgrade:[/b] upgrading old graphics to look cleaner, further defining the visual identity of each biome[/*]	[*]Improving graphics of [b]higher-tier areas[/b] to make these stand out and feel more exciting[/*]	[*]Reworking region [b]layouts[/b], making them easier to navigate while adding strategic choke points for PvP[/*]	[*]Ensuring each biome type has [b]a clear theme[/b] recognizable from the region map[/*][/list][h3]New and Upgraded Activities[/h3][list]	[*][b]Treasure sites[/b] changed from static locations to dynamic spawns, rewarding players for actively roaming the world[/*]	[*][b]Open-world mobs[/b] will also receive a general rework, with a chance to upgrade into stronger versions over time, increasing value of unexplored regions[/*]	[*][b]Upgraded world map[/b] with different overlays which show the current availability of resources and high-value creatures[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79c990f055477fe19e7d1ca0ab6cefafb290f76a.jpeg[/img]
